name: allinone 學測精選
attribution: allinone（App Store「Allinone 讀書計畫」）學測精選字、片語句型
note: words：學測精選 3,000 字（level＝大考中心詞彙級數 L2～L5；family＝字族；drop／add＝tools/vocab.py 的字形規則要拿掉／補上的字形）；phrases：學測精選片語與句型（hard＝複雜易錯）。id 跟 allinone App 一樣。irregular：不規則變化（變化形 → 原形）。

words.zh: 通道、走廊；（文章的）一段；（時間的）流逝
words.ex: We walked through a narrow passage to reach the garden.
words.exZh: 我們穿過一條狹窄的通道來到花園。

words.zh: 發展、培養；開發；罹患（疾病）
words.ex: Playing sports can help children develop strong bones and good habits.
words.exZh: 運動能幫助孩子發展出強壯的骨骼和好習慣。

words.ex: Walking is a cheap means of getting around town.
words.exZh: 走路是在城裡移動的一種省錢方式。

words.zh: 特色、特點；以…為特色、主打
words.ex: The best feature of this room is the big window.
words.exZh: 這個房間最棒的特色是那扇大窗戶。

words.ex: Rain is coming soon, according to the weather report.
words.exZh: 根據氣象報告，很快就要下雨了。

words.zh: 正面的、樂觀的；確定的；（檢驗）陽性的
words.ex: Try to keep a positive attitude when things get hard.
words.exZh: 事情變難時，試著保持正面的態度。

words.ex: Making paper by hand is a slow process.
words.exZh: 手工做紙是個很慢的過程。

words.ex: This bottle contains one liter of fresh orange juice.
words.exZh: 這個瓶子裡裝有一公升的新鮮柳橙汁。

words.ex: He practiced every day, and thus he became a better player.
words.exZh: 他每天練習，因此變成了更好的球員。

words.zh: 聲稱；認領、索取；說法、主張；奪走（性命）
words.ex: He claims that he finished the whole book in one night.
words.exZh: 他聲稱他一晚就讀完整本書。

words.ex: Young children tend to get tired in the afternoon.
words.exZh: 年幼的孩子在下午往往容易累。

words.zh: 舉起、抬起；提高、增加；養育、飼養
words.ex: Raise your hand if you know the answer to this question.
words.exZh: 知道這題答案的人請舉手。

words.zh: 促進、提倡；使升遷；宣傳、促銷
words.ex: The school held an event to promote reading among students.
words.exZh: 學校舉辦活動來推廣學生閱讀。

words.zh: 定居；解決（爭端）；安頓、平靜下來
words.ex: After years of travel, they settled in a small town near the sea.
words.exZh: 旅行多年後，他們在海邊的小鎮定居下來。

words.ex: The official start time of the show is seven o'clock.
words.exZh: 表演正式開始的時間是七點。

words.ex: Students observe the plants and write down any changes.
words.exZh: 學生們觀察植物，並記下任何變化。

words.ex: This bag is cheap, but the quality is really good.
words.exZh: 這個包包很便宜，但品質真的很好。

words.zh: 接近、走近；方法、處理方式；（時間）即將到來
words.ex: The dog slowly approached the boy and wagged its tail.
words.exZh: 那隻狗慢慢走向男孩，並搖著尾巴。

words.ex: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
words.exZh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以帶把傘吧。

words.ex: Please refer to page ten for the answer.
words.exZh: 答案請參考第十頁。

words.ex: Time has great value, so we should not waste it.
words.exZh: 時間很有價值，所以我們不該浪費。

words.ex: We visited an ancient castle during our trip to the mountains.
words.exZh: 我們去山區旅行時參觀了一座古代城堡。

words.ex: Students should do some research before writing a report.
words.exZh: 學生在寫報告前應該先做一些研究。

words.ex: Use a ruler to measure the length of your desk.
words.exZh: 用尺量一下你書桌的長度。

words.ex: Being tall is a big advantage in basketball.
words.exZh: 個子高在籃球場上是很大的優勢。

words.ex: The shop sells various kinds of tea from many countries.
words.exZh: 這家店販售來自許多國家的各種茶。

words.ex: Turn off the lights so we don't waste electricity.
words.exZh: 把燈關掉，我們才不會浪費電。

words.zh: 目前的、現在的；水流、氣流；電流
words.ex: My current teacher likes to tell jokes in class.
words.exZh: 我現在的老師上課時喜歡說笑話。

words.zh: 社交的、愛交際的；社會的
words.ex: She is a social person who makes friends easily.
words.exZh: 她很愛交際，很容易交到朋友。

words.ex: The students will perform a short play for their parents on Friday.
words.exZh: 學生們星期五要為爸媽表演一齣短劇。

words.zh: 認出、認得；承認、意識到；表揚、認可
words.ex: I did not recognize my cousin because her hair was so short.
words.exZh: 我沒認出我表姊，因為她的頭髮剪得好短。

words.zh: 認為、把…看作；尊重、敬重；問候、致意
words.ex: Many people regard this old tree as a symbol of the town.
words.exZh: 很多人把這棵老樹視為小鎮的象徵。

words.zh: 平衡；兼顧、使平衡；（帳戶的）餘額
words.ex: The little girl tried to keep her balance on the narrow wall.
words.exZh: 小女孩努力在窄窄的牆上保持平衡。

words.zh: 維持、保持；維修、保養；堅持（說法）
words.ex: Regular exercise helps you maintain a healthy body.
words.exZh: 規律運動能幫助你維持健康的身體。

words.zh: 吸引、引起興趣；呼籲、懇求
words.ex: Camping in the rain does not appeal to me at all.
words.exZh: 下雨天露營對我一點吸引力都沒有。

words.zh: 傳開、蔓延；塗抹；展開、攤開
words.ex: Good news can spread quickly around a small school.
words.exZh: 好消息在小學校裡很快就會傳開。

words.zh: 到期的、預定的；由於、因為
words.ex: Your science report is due on Monday, so start early.
words.exZh: 你的自然科報告星期一要交，所以早點開始寫。

words.ex: Each fingerprint is unique, so no two people have the same one.
words.exZh: 每個指紋都是獨一無二的，沒有兩個人的指紋相同。

words.ex: Many young people get their daily news from social media.
words.exZh: 很多年輕人從社群媒體得知每天的新聞。

words.ex: Climbing the tall mountain was a real challenge for the whole class.
words.exZh: 爬那座高山對全班來說是一大挑戰。

words.ex: The teacher showed concern when she saw that I looked tired.
words.exZh: 老師看到我很累的樣子，露出關心的神情。

words.ex: Please treat the new student kindly and help her find her way.
words.exZh: 請好好對待新同學，幫她熟悉環境。

words.ex: Traffic jams often occur near the school in the morning.
words.exZh: 早上學校附近常常發生塞車。

words.ex: Teachers explain the importance of drinking enough water.
words.exZh: 老師們會說明喝足夠的水的重要性。

words.zh: 系統（電腦、交通等）；制度、方法
words.ex: The computer system at the bank stopped working this morning.
words.exZh: 銀行的電腦系統今天早上當機了。

words.ex: Sleep has a big effect on how well we study.
words.exZh: 睡眠對我們的學習成效有很大影響。

words.zh: 底部、底座；基地、據點；以…為根據
words.ex: The lamp has a heavy base, so it does not fall easily.
words.exZh: 這盞檯燈底座很重，所以不容易倒。

words.ex: I suddenly realized that I had left my lunch at home.
words.exZh: 我突然發現我把午餐忘在家裡了。

words.zh: 決定（結果）、影響；查明、確定
words.ex: How hard you practice will determine how well you play.
words.exZh: 你練習得多努力，決定了你表現得多好。

words.zh: 立即的；直接的、最親近的
words.ex: The doctor gave the hurt boy immediate help at the gate.
words.exZh: 醫生在門口立刻幫那個受傷的男孩處理。

words.ex: Planting trees helps protect the environment around our school.
words.exZh: 種樹有助於保護我們學校周圍的環境。

words.ex: The teacher asked us to identify the main idea of the story.
words.exZh: 老師要我們找出這個故事的主旨。

words.zh: 證明、證實；結果是、原來是
words.ex: Scientists did an experiment to prove their idea was right.
words.exZh: 科學家做了一個實驗來證明他們的想法是對的。

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come to the picnic.
words.exZh: 我不知道他會不會來野餐。

words.ex: The school will provide lunch for the trip.
words.exZh: 學校會為這次旅行提供午餐。

words.ex: The recent rain has made the river much higher.
words.exZh: 最近的雨讓河水漲高了許多。

words.ex: After many tries, the baby bird eventually learned to fly.
words.exZh: 試了很多次之後，小鳥終於學會飛了。

words.ex: What is the main purpose of this visit to the museum?
words.exZh: 這次參觀博物館的主要目的是什麼？

words.ex: Grandma still makes traditional rice dumplings for the Dragon Boat Festival.
words.exZh: 奶奶在端午節仍然會包傳統的粽子。

words.zh: 否則、不然；在其他方面；不同地、另外
words.ex: We must leave now; otherwise, we will miss the bus.
words.exZh: 我們得現在出發，不然會錯過公車。

words.zh: 進行、實施；指揮（樂團）；行為、品行
words.ex: Our class will conduct a simple experiment in the lab today.
words.exZh: 我們班今天要在實驗室進行一個簡單的實驗。

words.ex: Despite the rain, we had a great time at the park.
words.exZh: 儘管下雨，我們在公園還是玩得很開心。

words.ex: Riding a bike without a helmet is a big risk.
words.exZh: 騎腳踏車不戴安全帽是很大的風險。

words.ex: She has the ability to solve hard puzzles quickly.
words.exZh: 她有很快解開困難謎題的能力。

words.ex: My uncle manages a small bookstore near the train station.
words.exZh: 我叔叔在火車站附近經營一家小書店。

words.ex: The store will deliver the new desk to our house tomorrow.
words.exZh: 商店明天會把新書桌送到我們家。

words.zh: 貢獻；捐獻、捐助；促成、是…的原因之一
words.ex: Everyone in the group can contribute a good idea.
words.exZh: 小組裡的每個人都可以貢獻一個好點子。

words.ex: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.
words.exZh: 雨後天空出現了一道彩虹。

words.ex: Eating a good breakfast gives me enough energy for the whole morning.
words.exZh: 吃一頓豐盛的早餐讓我整個早上都有足夠的精力。

words.zh: 特定的、特別的；挑剔的、講究的
words.ex: Do you have a particular color in mind for the poster?
words.exZh: 你心中對這張海報有特定的顏色嗎？

words.ex: We need some strong material to build a small bridge.
words.exZh: 我們需要一些堅固的材料來搭一座小橋。

words.ex: Swimming is good for your physical health and helps you relax.
words.exZh: 游泳對你的身體健康有益，也能幫助你放鬆。

words.zh: 嚴重的、劇烈的；嚴厲的、嚴格的
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the old bridge.
words.exZh: 暴風雨對那座舊橋造成了嚴重的損壞。

words.ex: Please turn off every electronic device before the test starts.
words.exZh: 考試開始前請關閉所有電子裝置。

words.ex: You can apply for a library card with your student ID.
words.exZh: 你可以用學生證申請一張圖書館借書證。

words.ex: We finally found a solution to the problem with the printer.
words.exZh: 我們終於找到解決印表機問題的辦法了。

words.zh: 以為、假定；擔任、承擔（職務）
words.ex: Do not assume that the answer is always the same.
words.exZh: 不要以為答案永遠都一樣。

words.ex: The sun is the main source of light for plants.
words.exZh: 太陽是植物主要的光源。

words.zh: 克服、戰勝；（情緒）使受不了、壓倒
words.ex: She worked hard to overcome her fear of speaking in public.
words.exZh: 她很努力克服上台說話的恐懼。

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious injury when you ride a bike.
words.exZh: 騎腳踏車時戴安全帽能預防嚴重受傷。

words.ex: Bad weather had a big impact on the number of visitors.
words.exZh: 壞天氣對遊客人數造成很大的影響。

words.ex: We can reduce waste by bringing our own bags.
words.exZh: 我們可以自備購物袋來減少垃圾。

words.zh: 專心、集中注意力；焦點、重點
words.ex: Turn off your phone so you can focus on your homework.
words.exZh: 把手機關掉，你才能專心寫作業。

words.ex: Sleeping early is an effective way to stay healthy.
words.exZh: 早睡是保持健康的有效方法。

words.ex: The room is cheap; moreover, it is close to the station.
words.exZh: 這個房間很便宜，而且離車站很近。

words.ex: Pollution is a global problem that needs help from every country.
words.exZh: 汙染是需要每個國家共同努力的全球性問題。

words.zh: 負責的、有責任的；是…的原因；有責任感的、可靠的
words.ex: Who is responsible for cleaning the classroom this week?
words.exZh: 這個星期誰負責打掃教室？

words.ex: Our school holds a cultural day with food from many countries.
words.exZh: 我們學校舉辦文化日，有來自許多國家的食物。

words.zh: 自始至終、在整段時間；遍及、到處
words.ex: It rained throughout the night, so we stayed inside.
words.exZh: 整晚都在下雨，所以我們待在室內。

words.ex: The storm caused a lot of damage to the old bridge.
words.exZh: 暴風雨對那座舊橋造成了很大的損害。

words.ex: The room is clean; furthermore, it has a nice view.
words.exZh: 這個房間很乾淨，而且景觀很好。

words.ex: Please control your speed when you ride down the hill.
words.exZh: 下坡騎車時請控制好你的速度。

words.ex: Reading every day has many benefits for your mind.
words.exZh: 每天閱讀對你的頭腦有許多好處。

words.zh: 保持、仍然是；留下、停留；剩下、遺留
words.ex: The little shop remained open during the typhoon.
words.exZh: 那家小店在颱風期間仍然開著。

words.ex: The school was established more than fifty years ago.
words.exZh: 這所學校創立於五十多年前。

words.zh: 替代方案、其他選擇；替代的
words.ex: If it rains, we need an alternative to the outdoor game.
words.exZh: 如果下雨，我們需要戶外遊戲以外的替代方案。

words.zh: 在……的那一邊；超出（能力、理解）
words.ex: The small village lies just beyond that tall hill.
words.exZh: 那座小村莊就在那座高高的山丘另一邊。

words.zh: 顯著的、相當大的；重要的、有意義的
words.ex: There was a significant change in the weather after lunch.
words.exZh: 午餐後天氣有了明顯的變化。

words.ex: The population of the town is about ten thousand.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮的人口大約有一萬人。

words.ex: With a lot of effort, he finished the long book in a week.
words.exZh: 他費了很大的努力，在一週內讀完了那本厚書。

words.ex: The teacher praised the students for their good behavior on the trip.
words.exZh: 老師稱讚學生們在旅途中表現良好。

words.ex: We need to replace the old light bulb in the hall.
words.exZh: 我們得換掉走廊上那顆舊燈泡。

words.ex: The cat jumped upon the table and knocked over a cup.
words.exZh: 貓跳上桌子，打翻了一個杯子。

words.zh: （心理）壓力；壓力、氣壓（物理）；向…施壓、逼迫
words.ex: Too much pressure can make students feel tired.
words.exZh: 壓力太大會讓學生覺得疲累。

words.ex: The wet ground is evidence that it rained during the night.
words.exZh: 濕濕的地面顯示昨晚下過雨。

words.zh: 進一步地、更深入地；更多的、進一步的
words.ex: The scientists plan to study the problem further next year.
words.exZh: 科學家打算明年更深入地研究這個問題。

words.zh: 功能、作用；運作；（數學）函數
words.ex: The main function of a fridge is to keep food fresh.
words.exZh: 冰箱的主要功能是讓食物保持新鮮。

words.ex: This game requires two players and a small board.
words.exZh: 這個遊戲需要兩位玩家和一塊小棋盤。

words.ex: The food industry gives jobs to many people in our town.
words.exZh: 食品業為我們鎮上許多人提供工作。

words.ex: This region is famous for its tea farms and green hills.
words.exZh: 這個地區以茶園和綠色的山丘聞名。

words.ex: My teacher always encourages us to ask questions in class.
words.exZh: 我的老師總是鼓勵我們在課堂上發問。

words.ex: The gym has new equipment for students who like to exercise.
words.exZh: 體育館有新器材給喜歡運動的學生使用。

words.ex: The old bike is still in good condition.
words.exZh: 那台舊腳踏車的狀況還很好。

words.ex: Good friends can have a strong influence on how you behave.
words.exZh: 好朋友對你的行為會有很大的影響。

words.zh: 聲明；陳述、說法；（銀行）對帳單
words.ex: The school released a statement about the new schedule.
words.exZh: 學校針對新的課表發表了一份聲明。

words.ex: Some plants can survive in the desert with very little water.
words.exZh: 有些植物只要很少的水就能在沙漠中存活。

words.ex: Bright flowers attract bees and butterflies to the garden.
words.exZh: 鮮豔的花朵把蜜蜂和蝴蝶吸引到花園裡。

words.ex: Sleep is an important factor in doing well at school.
words.exZh: 睡眠是在學校表現良好的重要因素。

words.zh: 個別的、個人的；個人、個體
words.ex: Each student gets individual advice from the teacher during the lesson.
words.exZh: 課堂上每位學生都會得到老師個別的建議。

words.ex: Water is a precious resource in many dry parts of the world.
words.exZh: 在世界上許多乾燥的地區，水是珍貴的資源。

words.ex: A positive attitude helps you learn new things more easily.
words.exZh: 積極的態度能幫助你更容易學會新事物。

words.ex: The teacher used an innovative game to make math more fun.
words.exZh: 老師用了一個創新的遊戲，讓數學更有趣。

words.ex: These two shirts look very similar, but the colors are different.
words.exZh: 這兩件襯衫看起來很像，但顏色不同。

words.ex: Please remove the old posters from the wall before Friday.
words.exZh: 請在星期五前把牆上的舊海報拿下來。

words.zh: 探索、探險；探討、仔細研究
words.ex: We love to explore new paths in the forest.
words.exZh: 我們很喜歡在森林裡探索新的小路。

words.zh: 出現、浮現；（事實）顯露、為人所知
words.ex: The sun slowly emerged from behind the dark clouds.
words.exZh: 太陽慢慢從烏雲後面露出臉來。

words.ex: Good communication helps a team work well together.
words.exZh: 良好的溝通有助於團隊合作順利。

words.zh: 心理的、精神的；腦力的、在腦中進行的
words.ex: Taking a walk every day is good for your mental health.
words.exZh: 每天散步對你的心理健康有益。

words.ex: Our community holds a clean-up day every spring.
words.exZh: 我們的社區每年春天舉辦一次清掃日。

words.zh: 持續不斷的；固定的、不變的
words.ex: The constant noise from the road made it hard to sleep.
words.exZh: 馬路上持續不斷的噪音讓人很難入睡。

words.zh: 總和；一筆（錢）、金額；總結、概括
words.ex: The sum of three and four is seven.
words.exZh: 三加四的總和是七。

words.ex: You can check the status of your order on our website.
words.exZh: 你可以在我們的網站上查詢訂單狀態。

words.ex: Many people suffer from headaches when they sleep too little.
words.exZh: 許多人睡太少時會受頭痛之苦。

words.zh: 每年的、一年一度的；年度的、全年的
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day in the autumn.
words.exZh: 學校在秋天舉辦一年一度的運動會。

words.ex: Some students get financial help so they can keep studying.
words.exZh: 有些學生會得到經濟上的補助，讓他們能繼續念書。

words.ex: In summer, the demand for ice cream goes up.
words.exZh: 夏天時，冰淇淋的需求量會上升。

words.ex: Wear a hat for protection from the strong sun.
words.exZh: 戴頂帽子保護自己，免得被強烈的陽光曬傷。

words.zh: 職業的；專業的、內行的；專業人士
words.ex: The professional dancer taught our class some simple steps.
words.exZh: 那位職業舞者教了我們班一些簡單的舞步。

words.ex: The band gave a great performance at the school festival.
words.exZh: 樂團在校慶上有精彩的演出。

words.ex: Each color on the map represents a different kind of weather.
words.exZh: 地圖上的每種顏色都表示不同的天氣。

words.ex: She cut the paper into long, thin strips for the art class.
words.exZh: 她把紙剪成細長條，準備上美術課用。

words.ex: This summer job involves a lot of walking outside.
words.exZh: 這份暑期工作需要在戶外走很多路。

words.ex: Nobody can predict exactly what the weather will be like.
words.exZh: 沒有人能準確預測天氣會怎麼樣。

words.ex: Her singing impressed everyone at the school concert.
words.exZh: 她的歌聲讓學校音樂會上的每個人都印象深刻。

words.ex: Studying abroad is a great opportunity to learn about other cultures.
words.exZh: 出國讀書是認識其他文化的絕佳機會。

words.ex: The coach believes the young player has great potential.
words.exZh: 教練相信這位年輕球員很有潛力。

words.ex: Texting while driving can endanger your life and the lives of others.
words.exZh: 開車時傳訊息會危及你和他人的生命。

words.zh: 鼓舞、激勵；給予靈感、啟發
words.ex: A good teacher can inspire students to try new things.
words.exZh: 好老師能鼓舞學生嘗試新事物。

words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal that needs our protection.
words.exZh: 貓熊是瀕臨絕種的動物，需要我們保護。

words.ex: The actual price was lower than the one on the sign.
words.exZh: 實際的價格比標示牌上的還要低。

words.ex: My grandfather founded this noodle shop sixty years ago.
words.exZh: 我爺爺在六十年前創立了這家麵店。

words.zh: 警覺的、機警的；通知、提醒
words.ex: The dog stayed alert and listened to every sound.
words.exZh: 那隻狗保持警覺，聽著每一個聲音。

words.zh: 必要的、不可或缺的；必需品
words.ex: Clean water is essential for all living things on Earth.
words.exZh: 乾淨的水對地球上所有生物來說都不可或缺。

words.ex: Please give me a specific time so I can plan my day.
words.exZh: 請給我一個明確的時間，這樣我才能安排一天的行程。

words.ex: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon that many people enjoy.
words.exZh: 彩虹是許多人都喜歡的自然現象。

words.ex: Wash your hands often so the virus does not infect you.
words.exZh: 常洗手，病毒才不會感染你。

words.zh: 發行、發布；釋放、放走；鬆開、放開
words.ex: The band will release a new song next month.
words.exZh: 這個樂團下個月將發行一首新歌。

words.zh: 擺姿勢；姿勢；造成（威脅、問題）
words.ex: The children posed for a photo in front of the school.
words.exZh: 孩子們在學校前面擺姿勢拍照。

words.ex: Rising prices can cause economic problems for many families.
words.exZh: 物價上漲可能給許多家庭帶來經濟問題。

words.ex: A lack of sleep can make it hard to focus.
words.exZh: 睡眠不足會讓人很難集中精神。

words.zh: 人造的、人工的；假裝的、不自然的
words.ex: These artificial flowers look almost the same as real ones.
words.exZh: 這些人造花看起來幾乎和真花一樣。

words.ex: Soft music can enhance the mood of a family dinner.
words.exZh: 輕柔的音樂能提升家庭晚餐的氣氛。

words.ex: Please save the document before you close the computer.
words.exZh: 關電腦前請先把文件存檔。

words.zh: 獲得、得到；增加（體重、速度）
words.ex: You can gain new skills by joining a club at school.
words.exZh: 參加學校社團可以讓你獲得新的技能。

words.ex: Bad weather can affect the time our flight leaves.
words.exZh: 壞天氣可能會影響我們班機起飛的時間。

words.ex: The bird changed its position on the branch.
words.exZh: 那隻鳥在樹枝上換了位置。

words.zh: 衝突、矛盾；（時間、意見）相衝突
words.ex: There was a conflict between the two friends about the game.
words.exZh: 那兩個朋友為了遊戲起了衝突。

words.zh: 可用的、可取得的；有空的
words.ex: Are there any seats available on the morning train?
words.exZh: 早上那班火車還有空位嗎？

words.ex: The new washing machine is fast and very efficient.
words.exZh: 這台新洗衣機又快又很有效率。

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out to play.
words.exZh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出去玩了。

words.ex: The old factory was transformed into a bright art center.
words.exZh: 那座老工廠被改造成明亮的藝術中心。

words.zh: 感官、感覺；意義、道理；察覺、感覺到
words.ex: Dogs have a strong sense of smell and can find things easily.
words.exZh: 狗的嗅覺很靈敏，很容易找到東西。

words.ex: Scientists found a new species of frog in the rain forest.
words.exZh: 科學家在雨林裡發現了一種新的青蛙物種。

words.ex: She likes to compose short songs on her old piano.
words.exZh: 她喜歡用她的老鋼琴創作短曲。

words.ex: You can rely on me to bring the snacks.
words.exZh: 你可以信賴我，點心我會帶來。

words.zh: 粗糙的；粗略的、大概的；艱難的、不順的
words.ex: The bark of this old tree feels rough under my hand.
words.exZh: 這棵老樹的樹皮摸起來很粗糙。

words.ex: Her vision is poor, so she wears glasses.
words.exZh: 她的視力不好，所以戴眼鏡。

words.ex: I sent an email and waited two days for a response.
words.exZh: 我寄了電子郵件，等了兩天才收到回覆。

words.zh: 頻繁的、經常的；常去、常出入
words.ex: Frequent rain in June makes the roads wet and slippery.
words.exZh: 六月頻繁的降雨讓路面又濕又滑。

words.ex: The coach showed us a new technique for throwing the ball.
words.exZh: 教練教我們一種新的投球技巧。

words.zh: 沉著的、鎮靜的；由…組成的
words.ex: She stayed composed even when the test was very hard.
words.exZh: 即使考試很難，她依然保持沉著。

words.ex: My family wants to adopt a small puppy from the shelter.
words.exZh: 我們家想從收容所領養一隻小狗。

words.zh: 佔據、佔用；使忙碌、打發（時間）
words.ex: Three big desks occupy most of the small room.
words.exZh: 三張大書桌佔了這間小房間的大部分空間。

words.zh: 複雜的；（建築）綜合大樓、園區
words.ex: The rules of this board game are too complex for young kids.
words.exZh: 這個桌遊的規則對小孩子來說太複雜了。

words.ex: Many schools compete in the city basketball contest every year.
words.exZh: 每年都有許多學校參加市內的籃球比賽。

words.ex: Sleeping well can boost your energy and your grades.
words.exZh: 睡得好能提升你的精神和成績。

words.ex: Many students cope with stress by going for a walk.
words.exZh: 很多學生用散步來應付壓力。

words.ex: Which aspect of the school trip did you enjoy the most?
words.exZh: 這趟校外教學的哪個方面你最喜歡？

words.ex: Ask the staff if you need additional paper for the test.
words.exZh: 考試時如果需要額外的紙，可以問工作人員。

words.zh: （做某事）很吃力；奮鬥、艱難的努力；掙扎
words.ex: Some students struggle with math but improve with practice.
words.exZh: 有些學生數學學得很吃力，但透過練習會進步。

words.zh: 吸引（注意）、使投入；參與、從事
words.ex: A good teacher knows how to engage students in the lesson.
words.exZh: 好老師懂得如何讓學生投入課程。

words.ex: A good relationship with your neighbors makes life easier.
words.exZh: 和鄰居關係良好，生活會輕鬆許多。

words.ex: Being late every day may have serious consequences.
words.exZh: 每天遲到可能會有嚴重的後果。

words.zh: 痕跡、跡象；追蹤、追查；描摹、描繪
words.ex: There was not a trace of milk left in the glass.
words.exZh: 杯子裡連一點牛奶的痕跡都沒有。

words.ex: The arrow on the sign indicates the way to the exit.
words.exZh: 標誌上的箭頭指出了出口的方向。

words.ex: She could not hide her emotion when she saw the gift.
words.exZh: 她看到禮物時藏不住激動的心情。

words.ex: This app enables students to practice new words every day.
words.exZh: 這個應用程式讓學生每天都能練習新單字。

words.ex: Please give your seat to an elderly person on the bus.
words.exZh: 在公車上請把座位讓給年長的人。

words.ex: Show your identity card at the front desk.
words.exZh: 請在櫃檯出示你的身分證。

words.zh: 支撐；支持、鼓勵；供養、養活
words.ex: Strong pillars support the roof of the old house.
words.exZh: 堅固的柱子撐著這棟老房子的屋頂。

words.ex: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village.
words.exZh: 我的祖父母住在一個寧靜的鄉村小村莊。

words.ex: On my third attempt, I finally solved the puzzle.
words.exZh: 試到第三次，我終於解開了謎題。

words.ex: The town faced a water crisis during the long dry summer.
words.exZh: 在漫長乾旱的夏天裡，小鎮面臨缺水危機。

words.ex: Breakfast is crucial for having enough energy in the morning.
words.exZh: 早餐對於早上有足夠的精力至關重要。

words.ex: The magician will reveal the secret at the end of the show.
words.exZh: 魔術師會在表演結束時揭開祕密。

words.ex: It is illegal to park your car in front of the fire station.
words.exZh: 把車停在消防局前面是違法的。

words.zh: 範圍、一系列；（範圍）介於…之間；山脈
words.ex: The store sells a wide range of colorful notebooks and pens.
words.exZh: 這家店賣各式各樣色彩繽紛的筆記本和筆。

words.ex: The content of this video is easy to understand.
words.exZh: 這支影片的內容很容易懂。

words.zh: 附上（檔案）；貼上、裝上；依戀、喜愛
words.ex: Please attach a photo to your email before sending it.
words.exZh: 寄出前請在電子郵件裡附上一張照片。

words.zh: 幫忙、恩惠；偏愛、偏袒；贊成、支持
words.ex: Could you do me a favor and hold my bag for a minute?
words.exZh: 可以幫我個忙，幫我拿一下包包嗎？

words.ex: The singer walked onto the stage and waved to the crowd.
words.exZh: 歌手走上舞臺，向觀眾揮手。

words.ex: The fire chief told everyone to leave the building quickly.
words.exZh: 消防隊長叫大家快點離開大樓。

words.zh: 數字；人影、人物；想出、弄懂；身材
words.ex: Please write the figure in the box at the bottom.
words.exZh: 請把數字寫在最下面的格子裡。

words.ex: The camp keeps a large supply of clean water.
words.exZh: 營地儲備了大量的乾淨飲水。

words.ex: There is a big difference between these two kinds of tea.
words.exZh: 這兩種茶之間有很大的差別。

words.ex: This lesson does not relate to the topic of the test.
words.exZh: 這一課和考試的主題沒有關聯。

words.ex: We may encounter heavy traffic on the way to the airport.
words.exZh: 我們去機場的路上可能會遇到嚴重塞車。

words.ex: Lightning can strike tall trees during a big storm.
words.exZh: 大暴風雨時，閃電可能會擊中高大的樹。

words.zh: 捕捉（畫面、感覺）；捕獲、抓住；吸引（注意）
words.ex: The photographer captured the moment when the bird took off.
words.exZh: 攝影師捕捉到了鳥兒起飛的那一刻。

words.ex: She decided to commit more time to learning the piano.
words.exZh: 她決定投入更多時間學鋼琴。

words.ex: She wants to pursue her dream of becoming a doctor.
words.exZh: 她想追求成為醫生的夢想。

words.ex: My brother is always willing to help with the dishes.
words.exZh: 我弟弟總是願意幫忙洗碗。

words.ex: Please put your phone aside and listen to me.
words.exZh: 請把你的手機放到一旁，聽我說。

words.ex: It took my brother a week to recover from the cold.
words.exZh: 我弟弟花了一週才從感冒中康復。

words.ex: Talking with friends can reduce anxiety before a test.
words.exZh: 考試前和朋友聊天可以減輕焦慮。

words.zh: 精神；心情、情緒（常用複數）
words.ex: The whole class showed great team spirit at the sports day.
words.exZh: 全班在運動會上展現了很棒的團隊精神。

words.ex: Which musical instrument do you want to learn?
words.exZh: 你想學哪一種樂器？

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years before people appeared on Earth.
words.exZh: 恐龍在人類出現在地球上之前好幾百萬年就存在了。

words.ex: You can achieve your goal if you keep working hard.
words.exZh: 只要持續努力，你就能達成目標。

words.ex: Everyone in the class can participate in the game.
words.exZh: 班上每個人都可以參加這個遊戲。

words.ex: Our coach came up with a new strategy for the second half.
words.exZh: 我們的教練為下半場想出了新的策略。

words.zh: 伸展、伸直；延伸、綿延；一段（路程、時間）
words.ex: Stretch your arms before you start to run.
words.exZh: 開始跑步前先伸展一下手臂。

words.zh: 前進；進步、進展；事先、提前
words.ex: The hikers advanced slowly up the steep path.
words.exZh: 登山客沿著陡峭的小徑緩緩前進。

words.zh: 分開、分類；分開的、各自的
words.ex: Please separate the plastic bottles from the paper.
words.exZh: 請把塑膠瓶和紙類分開。

words.ex: The company will launch a new app next week.
words.exZh: 那家公司下星期會推出一款新的應用程式。

words.zh: 極重要的、不可缺少的；維持生命的
words.ex: Getting enough sleep is vital for teenagers who are growing.
words.exZh: 充足的睡眠對正在成長的青少年非常重要。

words.zh: 說服（做某事）；使相信、使確信
words.ex: I tried to convince my mom to buy me a new bike.
words.exZh: 我試著說服媽媽幫我買一輛新腳踏車。

words.ex: Please check the door to ensure that it is locked.
words.exZh: 請檢查門，確保它已經鎖好。

words.ex: Two bikes collided at the corner, but nobody was hurt.
words.exZh: 兩輛腳踏車在轉角相撞，幸好沒有人受傷。

words.ex: We decorated the classroom with balloons and paper flowers yesterday.
words.exZh: 我們昨天用氣球和紙花布置教室。

words.ex: The mother soothed her crying baby by singing softly.
words.exZh: 媽媽輕聲唱歌，安撫哭鬧的寶寶。

words.ex: We bought small key chains as souvenirs for our friends back home.
words.exZh: 我們買了小鑰匙圈當紀念品，送給家鄉的朋友。

words.ex: Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
words.exZh: 別站得太靠近懸崖邊。

words.ex: You can pay by credit card in most big stores.
words.exZh: 在大多數大型商店你都可以刷信用卡付款。

words.ex: I opened a bank account to save my money.
words.exZh: 我開了一個銀行帳戶來存錢。

words.ex: The former captain of the team still helps us practice.
words.exZh: 球隊的前任隊長還是會來幫我們練習。

words.zh: 大師、高手；精通、掌握；（動物的）主人
words.ex: It takes many years to become a master of the piano.
words.exZh: 要成為鋼琴大師需要很多年的時間。

words.zh: 迅速的、及時的；促使、引起；提示
words.ex: The company sent a prompt reply to my question.
words.exZh: 公司很快就回覆了我的問題。

words.zh: 目擊者、證人；目睹、親眼看見
words.ex: The only witness told the police what she saw.
words.exZh: 唯一的目擊者把她看到的告訴了警察。

words.ex: Don't judge a person only by his appearance.
words.exZh: 不要只憑外表去評斷一個人。

words.zh: 在…之內（時間）；在…範圍內（距離）
words.ex: Please return the library books within two weeks.
words.exZh: 請在兩週內歸還圖書館的書。

words.ex: Students can earn money by helping neighbors wash cars.
words.exZh: 學生可以幫鄰居洗車賺錢。

words.ex: It takes time to adapt to a new school.
words.exZh: 要適應新學校需要時間。

words.ex: A warm blanket brings comfort on a cold night.
words.exZh: 寒冷的夜晚，一條溫暖的毯子讓人很舒服。

words.zh: 關鍵的、極重要的；批評的、挑剔的；危急的
words.ex: Getting enough sleep is critical for doing well on tests.
words.exZh: 睡飽對考試考好非常重要。

words.zh: 關聯、關係；連接、（網路）連線；轉乘的班機、班車
words.ex: Scientists found a connection between sleep and memory.
words.exZh: 科學家發現睡眠和記憶之間有關聯。

words.ex: I cannot recall where I put my keys last night.
words.exZh: 我想不起來昨晚把鑰匙放在哪裡。

words.zh: 讓…離開、解散；不予理會、否定；解雇、開除
words.ex: The teacher will dismiss the class at four o'clock.
words.exZh: 老師會在四點鐘讓全班下課。

words.ex: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
words.exZh: 飛機起飛前請繫好安全帶。

words.ex: Old refrigerators consume more electricity than new ones.
words.exZh: 舊冰箱比新冰箱耗電。

words.zh: 知道的、察覺到的；有…意識的
words.ex: Drivers must be aware of children near the school gate.
words.exZh: 駕駛人必須注意到校門口附近的孩子。

words.ex: The strange sound outside the window aroused my curiosity.
words.exZh: 窗外奇怪的聲音激起了我的好奇心。

words.ex: I am so clumsy that I often drop my phone on the floor.
words.exZh: 我笨手笨腳的，常常把手機掉在地上。

words.ex: It was considerate of you to bring me soup when I was sick.
words.exZh: 我生病時你帶湯來給我，真是體貼。

words.ex: Our dog is very obedient and always sits when we ask.
words.exZh: 我們的狗很聽話，我們一叫牠坐下就會坐下。

words.ex: The farmer scattered seeds across the field before the rain came.
words.exZh: 農夫在下雨前把種子撒在整片田裡。

words.ex: The glass vase has a slender neck and a round bottom.
words.exZh: 這個玻璃花瓶有細長的瓶頸和圓圓的底部。

words.ex: Be careful, the floor is slippery because it was just mopped.
words.exZh: 小心，地板剛拖過，很滑。

words.zh: 精力充沛的、強健的；劇烈的、激烈的
words.ex: My grandfather is still vigorous and walks five kilometers every morning.
words.exZh: 我爺爺依然精力充沛，每天早上走五公里。

words.ex: The two brothers often argue about which show to watch.
words.exZh: 這兩兄弟常為了要看哪個節目而爭吵。

words.ex: Many comic fans came to the convention this weekend.
words.exZh: 許多漫畫迷這個週末來參加了這場大會。

words.ex: It was rather cold, so we stayed inside all day.
words.exZh: 天氣相當冷，所以我們整天都待在屋裡。

words.ex: As a general rule, we do not eat in the classroom.
words.exZh: 一般來說，我們不在教室裡吃東西。

words.zh: 各式各樣、多樣；品種、種類
words.ex: The market sells a wide variety of fruit.
words.exZh: 這個市場賣各式各樣的水果。

words.zh: 使暴露；揭發、揭露；使接觸、使體驗
words.ex: Do not expose the plant to strong sunlight all day.
words.exZh: 不要讓這株植物整天暴露在強烈陽光下。

words.ex: Although he won, he remained humble and thanked his team.
words.exZh: 雖然贏了，他還是很謙虛，並感謝他的隊友。

words.ex: Although he won first prize, he stayed modest.
words.exZh: 雖然他得了第一名，仍然很謙虛。

words.zh: 明顯的、顯而易見的；表面上的
words.ex: It soon became apparent that we had taken the wrong bus.
words.exZh: 我們很快就明顯發現自己搭錯公車了。

words.zh: 度假勝地；手段、最後的辦法
words.ex: The family spent a week at a mountain resort.
words.exZh: 這家人在一處山上的度假村待了一星期。

words.zh: 精心製作的、複雜的；詳細說明
words.ex: She wore an elaborate costume with many tiny stars.
words.exZh: 她穿著一件綴滿小星星、精心製作的服裝。

words.zh: 憂鬱、憂鬱症；（經濟）蕭條、不景氣；低氣壓
words.ex: Doctors say that talking to friends can help with depression.
words.exZh: 醫生說和朋友聊聊有助於緩解憂鬱。

words.ex: Did the teacher mention anything about tomorrow's field trip?
words.exZh: 老師有提到任何有關明天校外教學的事嗎？

words.zh: 景象、風景；視力；看見、視線
words.ex: The sunrise over the mountain was a beautiful sight.
words.exZh: 山上的日出是一幅美麗的景象。

words.ex: Do you know how to operate this machine?
words.exZh: 你知道怎麼操作這台機器嗎？

words.zh: 堅固的、結實的；堅定的；公司
words.ex: Put the table on firm ground so it will not shake.
words.exZh: 把桌子放在堅固的地面上，它就不會晃動。

words.ex: Three generations of my family live in the same house.
words.exZh: 我家三代人住在同一間房子裡。

words.ex: Traffic is a major problem in big cities.
words.exZh: 交通是大城市的主要問題。

words.ex: It was snowing hard, and therefore the trains ran late.
words.exZh: 雪下得很大，所以火車都誤點了。

words.zh: 喇叭、音響；演講者、說話的人；說某種語言的人
words.ex: This speaker is small, but the sound is very clear.
words.exZh: 這個喇叭雖然小，聲音卻很清楚。

words.ex: The judges will declare the winner of the contest tomorrow.
words.exZh: 評審明天會宣布比賽的優勝者。

words.zh: 手勢、姿勢；（表達心意的）舉動、表示
words.ex: The police officer used a hand gesture to stop the cars.
words.exZh: 警察用手勢讓車子停下來。

words.ex: You can use this app for free during a seven-day trial.
words.exZh: 這個應用程式可以免費試用七天。

words.zh: 展出、展示；展覽品；表現出、顯示
words.ex: The museum will exhibit paintings by young students this month.
words.exZh: 博物館這個月將展出年輕學生的畫作。

words.ex: You have made great progress in your math this year.
words.exZh: 你今年的數學進步很多。

words.ex: You must obtain permission before you use the school gym.
words.exZh: 你必須先取得許可才能使用學校體育館。

words.ex: He had to decline the invitation because he was busy.
words.exZh: 他因為太忙，只好婉拒邀請。

words.ex: The hikers slowly ascended the steep mountain path at dawn.
words.exZh: 登山客在黎明時慢慢爬上陡峭的山路。

words.ex: Wash your hands with soap to get rid of germs.
words.exZh: 用肥皂洗手，把細菌洗掉。

words.ex: Please don't embarrass me by showing my baby photos to my friends.
words.exZh: 拜託別把我的嬰兒照拿給朋友看，讓我很難為情。

words.ex: The fragrance of fresh flowers filled the whole room.
words.exZh: 鮮花的香味充滿整個房間。

words.ex: The old man glared at the boys who were kicking his door.
words.exZh: 老先生怒瞪那些踢他家門的男孩。

words.zh: 背誦、朗誦；一一列舉、說出
words.ex: Each student had to recite a short poem in front of the class.
words.exZh: 每個學生都要在全班面前背誦一首短詩。

words.ex: Please do not read my personal notes without asking.
words.exZh: 請不要沒問過就讀我的個人筆記。

words.ex: The popularity of this game grew quickly among my classmates.
words.exZh: 這款遊戲在我同學之間很快就流行起來。

words.ex: Press the green button twice to start the machine.
words.exZh: 按兩下綠色按鈕就能啟動機器。

words.ex: The heavy rain may ruin our picnic plans.
words.exZh: 這場大雨可能會毀了我們的野餐計畫。

words.ex: He was brave enough to admit that he had made a mistake.
words.exZh: 他很勇敢，願意承認自己犯了錯。

words.zh: 母語的、出生地的；原產的、本土的
words.ex: Spanish is her native language, but she also speaks English.
words.exZh: 西班牙語是她的母語，但她也會說英語。

words.zh: 力勸、催促；衝動、強烈慾望
words.ex: My friends urged me to join the swimming team.
words.exZh: 我的朋友們極力勸我加入游泳隊。

words.zh: 魅力；護身符、幸運小物；吸引、迷住
words.ex: The old town has a special charm that visitors love.
words.exZh: 這個老城鎮有一種遊客喜愛的特殊魅力。

words.ex: Many people believe that health is more important than wealth.
words.exZh: 許多人認為健康比財富更重要。

words.zh: 財產、所有物；房地產、地產；特性、性質
words.ex: Please do not leave your property on the classroom floor.
words.exZh: 請不要把你的物品留在教室的地板上。

words.ex: A good friendship is always built on mutual respect.
words.exZh: 良好的友誼總是建立在互相尊重上。

words.zh: 個人檔案、簡介；側面、側臉輪廓；低調、不引人注目
words.ex: Please add a short line about yourself to your profile page.
words.exZh: 請在你的個人簡介頁加上一行自我介紹。

words.ex: We must resolve this problem before the game starts.
words.exZh: 我們必須在比賽開始前解決這個問題。

words.ex: A powerful typhoon can devastate farms and small villages.
words.exZh: 強烈颱風可能摧毀農田和小村莊。

words.zh: 權力、職權；當局、主管機關；權威、專家
words.ex: The principal has the authority to close the school during storms.
words.exZh: 校長有權在暴風雨時停課。

words.ex: The village needs more medical help during the cold winter.
words.exZh: 這個村莊在寒冷的冬天需要更多醫療協助。

words.ex: The store may reject any coupon that is too old.
words.exZh: 商店可能會拒收過期太久的優惠券。

words.ex: She practiced daily, thereby improving her piano skills a lot.
words.exZh: 她每天練習，因此鋼琴技巧進步很多。

words.ex: The seemingly simple puzzle took me nearly an hour to solve.
words.exZh: 那道看似簡單的謎題，我花了將近一小時才解開。

words.ex: Presumably the bus is late because of the heavy rain.
words.exZh: 公車大概是因大雨而誤點。

words.ex: He spent a considerable amount of time on his homework.
words.exZh: 他花了相當多的時間寫作業。

words.ex: Every sport has some inherent risk, so wear a helmet.
words.exZh: 每項運動都有一些固有的風險，所以要戴安全帽。

words.ex: For me, the joy of traveling outweighs the cost.
words.exZh: 對我來說，旅行的樂趣勝過它的花費。

words.ex: I use a free app to learn new English words every day.
words.exZh: 我每天用一個免費的應用程式學新的英文單字。

words.zh: （名人的）親筆簽名；親筆簽名於
words.ex: The fans waited for hours to get the singer's autograph.
words.exZh: 歌迷等了好幾個小時，想拿到那位歌手的簽名。

words.ex: The company held a banquet to thank its workers at the end of the year.
words.exZh: 公司在年底舉辦宴會感謝員工。

words.ex: Nobody wants to work with Tom because he is so bossy.
words.exZh: 沒人想跟湯姆一起工作，因為他太愛指使別人了。

words.ex: The students gave their teacher a bouquet of roses on graduation day.
words.exZh: 畢業那天學生送老師一束玫瑰。

words.ex: My little brother grew five centimeters taller this year.
words.exZh: 我弟弟今年長高了五公分。

words.zh: 寒冷的、冷颼颼的；冷淡的、不友善的
words.ex: Bring a jacket because the mornings in the mountains are chilly.
words.exZh: 帶件外套，因為山上的早晨很冷。

words.ex: The hotel staff were courteous and helped us with our bags.
words.exZh: 飯店員工很有禮貌，還幫我們提行李。

words.ex: The mother gently rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.
words.exZh: 媽媽輕輕搖著搖籃，直到寶寶睡著。

words.ex: The results of the experiment surprised the whole class.
words.exZh: 實驗的結果讓全班都很驚訝。

words.ex: This cold medicine may make you drowsy, so don't drive.
words.exZh: 這種感冒藥可能讓你想睡，所以別開車。

words.zh: 古怪的、反常的；古怪的人
words.ex: Our eccentric neighbor wears a raincoat even on sunny days.
words.exZh: 我們那位古怪的鄰居連晴天都穿雨衣。

words.ex: You can look up the history of tea in an online encyclopedia.
words.exZh: 你可以在網路百科全書上查茶的歷史。

words.ex: I ran some errands for my mom, like buying eggs and mailing letters.
words.exZh: 我幫媽媽跑腿，像是買蛋和寄信。

words.ex: Stand on the right side when you take the escalator at the MRT station.
words.exZh: 在捷運站搭電扶梯時要站右邊。

words.ex: In the fable, the slow turtle wins the race against the rabbit.
words.exZh: 在那則寓言裡，慢吞吞的烏龜賽跑贏了兔子。

words.ex: My brother is a baseball fanatic who never misses a game.
words.exZh: 我哥是棒球狂，每場比賽都不錯過。

words.ex: Turn off the faucet while you brush your teeth to save water.
words.exZh: 刷牙時關掉水龍頭以節省用水。

words.ex: He flatters the manager because he wants a better job.
words.exZh: 他奉承經理，因為他想要更好的職位。

words.ex: The teacher frowned when she saw the messy homework.
words.exZh: 老師看到亂七八糟的作業時皺起了眉頭。

words.ex: A gigantic wave hit the beach during the storm.
words.exZh: 暴風雨期間一道巨浪打上海灘。

words.zh: 盡情享受、沉溺於；縱容、寵溺
words.ex: On rainy weekends, I indulge in long naps and good books.
words.exZh: 下雨的週末，我會盡情享受長長的午睡和好書。

words.ex: Mom scolded my brother for leaving his toys on the stairs.
words.exZh: 媽媽罵我弟弟把玩具丟在樓梯上。

words.ex: The proud artist looked at the cheap copies with scorn.
words.exZh: 那位高傲的藝術家輕蔑地看著那些廉價的仿製品。

words.zh: 壯觀的場面、奇觀；眼鏡（複數）
words.ex: The fireworks over the river were a wonderful spectacle.
words.exZh: 河上的煙火真是壯觀的景象。

words.zh: 不新鮮的；陳腐的、老套的
words.ex: This bread is stale, so let's feed it to the ducks.
words.exZh: 這麵包不新鮮了，我們拿去餵鴨子吧。

words.ex: The bus remained stationary in heavy traffic for twenty minutes.
words.exZh: 公車在車陣中停了二十分鐘動也不動。

words.ex: He is too stingy to share even one cookie with his friends.
words.exZh: 他小氣到連一塊餅乾都不肯分給朋友。

words.ex: Dad is boiling water on the stove for our tea.
words.exZh: 爸爸正在爐子上燒水要泡茶。

words.ex: You need sturdy shoes for hiking on rocky mountain paths.
words.exZh: 在多石的山路健行需要一雙堅固的鞋子。

words.ex: After the long hike, the weary students fell asleep on the bus.
words.exZh: 長途健行後，疲憊的學生們在公車上睡著了。

words.ex: This building is designed to withstand strong earthquakes.
words.exZh: 這棟大樓的設計能承受強烈地震。

words.ex: He solved the hard math problem with ease and smiled.
words.exZh: 他輕鬆解出那道難數學題，然後笑了。

words.ex: Our target is to read twenty books this year.
words.exZh: 我們的目標是今年讀二十本書。

words.zh: 較小的、輕微的；未成年人
words.ex: A minor mistake on the test will not make you fail.
words.exZh: 考試裡一個小錯誤不會讓你不及格。

words.zh: 給予、准許；補助金、獎助金；視為理所當然
words.ex: The school granted him extra time to finish the test.
words.exZh: 學校准許他多一點時間完成考試。

words.zh: 基礎、根據；（以…的）方式、頻率
words.ex: Trust is the basis of every good friendship.
words.exZh: 信任是每段好友誼的基礎。

words.zh: 抓住、握住；把握（機會）；沒收、查扣
words.ex: He seized the rope just before the boat drifted away.
words.exZh: 就在船漂走之前，他一把抓住了繩子。

words.ex: It is hard to endure the heat in the summer.
words.exZh: 夏天的酷熱很難忍受。

words.ex: You become immune to the disease after taking the vaccine.
words.exZh: 打了疫苗後你就會對這種疾病免疫。

words.ex: Your absence from the meeting yesterday was noticed by everyone.
words.exZh: 你昨天沒來開會，大家都注意到了。

words.zh: 介紹（人）；引言、導論；引進、採用
words.ex: The teacher began with a short introduction of our guest speaker.
words.exZh: 老師先簡短介紹了我們的演講來賓。

words.zh: 主動、進取心；新措施、新計畫
words.ex: She took the initiative and cleaned the room without being asked.
words.exZh: 她主動把房間打掃乾淨，沒有人要求她。

words.ex: The angry bees attacked anyone who came near the hive.
words.exZh: 生氣的蜜蜂攻擊任何靠近蜂窩的人。

words.zh: 收費、要價；充電；負責、主管
words.ex: How much do they charge for a bus ticket to the city?
words.exZh: 到市區的公車票要收多少錢？

words.zh: 總共的、全部的；總數、總額；完全的、徹底的
words.ex: The total cost of the trip was lower than we thought.
words.exZh: 這趟旅行的總花費比我們想的低。

words.zh: 合約、契約；收縮；感染（疾病）
words.ex: The player signed a two-year contract with the club.
words.exZh: 那名球員與球隊簽了一份為期兩年的合約。

words.ex: It is easy to overlook a small mistake when you read fast.
words.exZh: 讀得太快時，很容易忽略小錯誤。

words.ex: In many stories, a white dove is a symbol of peace.
words.exZh: 在許多故事裡，白鴿是和平的象徵。

words.ex: The dress has a pattern of small blue flowers.
words.exZh: 這件洋裝上有藍色小花的圖案。

words.ex: Can you locate our town on this big map?
words.exZh: 你能在這張大地圖上找到我們的小鎮嗎？

words.ex: From his wet shoes, I can infer that it is raining outside.
words.exZh: 從他濕掉的鞋子，我可以推斷外面正在下雨。

words.zh: 反射、倒映；反映、顯示；反省、深思
words.ex: The lake reflects the mountains like a giant mirror.
words.exZh: 湖面像一面大鏡子，倒映出群山。

words.ex: Music helps many people express their feelings without words.
words.exZh: 音樂幫助許多人不用言語就能表達感受。

words.ex: People bring white flowers to the grave in spring.
words.exZh: 人們春天時帶白花到墳前。

words.zh: 牢固的、安全的；取得、獲得；固定、綁緊
words.ex: Make sure the ladder is secure before you climb up.
words.exZh: 爬上去之前，先確定梯子穩固。

words.zh: 排出、使流乾；排水管、排水孔；使筋疲力盡、耗盡
words.ex: Please drain the water from the pot before you add the sauce.
words.exZh: 加醬汁前請先把鍋裡的水倒掉。

words.ex: Parents teach their children moral values like honesty and kindness.
words.exZh: 父母教導孩子誠實、善良這類道德價值。

words.zh: 對手、競爭者；比得上、與…匹敵
words.ex: Our school's basketball team beat its old rival yesterday.
words.exZh: 我們學校的籃球隊昨天打敗了老對手。

words.zh: 脆弱的、易碎的；精緻的、細緻的；微妙的、需小心處理的
words.ex: The delicate glass cup broke when it fell from the table.
words.exZh: 那個易碎的玻璃杯從桌上掉下來摔破了。

words.zh: 聯想、把…聯繫在一起；同事、工作夥伴
words.ex: Many people associate the color red with luck.
words.exZh: 許多人會把紅色和好運聯想在一起。

words.ex: Trade between the two towns grew after the new road opened.
words.exZh: 新路開通後，兩個城鎮之間的貿易成長了。

words.ex: Each paragraph in your essay should have one main idea.
words.exZh: 你作文裡的每一段都應該有一個主要概念。

words.ex: Do you know who invented the first light bulb?
words.exZh: 你知道是誰發明了第一顆燈泡嗎？

words.ex: Two players were injured during the rainy soccer game.
words.exZh: 在那場下雨的足球賽中，有兩名球員受傷了。

words.zh: 稀有的、罕見的；（肉）三分熟的
words.ex: This rare bird lives only on one small island.
words.exZh: 這種稀有的鳥只住在一座小島上。

words.zh: 化學物質、化學品；化學的
words.ex: Keep cleaning chemicals in a high place away from small children.
words.exZh: 清潔用的化學品要放在高處，讓小孩拿不到。

words.ex: I owe my friend five dollars for lunch.
words.exZh: 我欠朋友五塊錢的午餐錢。

words.zh: 移動、挪動；輪班；轉變、改變
words.ex: Please shift your bag so that I can sit down.
words.exZh: 請把你的包包移開，讓我可以坐下。

words.zh: 備用的、多餘的；空閒的；騰出、撥出（時間等）
words.ex: I always keep a spare pen in my school bag.
words.exZh: 我書包裡總是放著一支備用的筆。

words.zh: 吸收（液體、光、熱）；吸收（知識）、理解；使專心、使入迷
words.ex: A dry sponge can absorb a lot of water.
words.exZh: 乾海綿能吸收很多水。

words.ex: If you keep trying, you will succeed one day.
words.exZh: 只要你一直努力，總有一天會成功。

words.ex: Travel is a big expense for many families.
words.exZh: 旅行對很多家庭來說是一筆很大的開銷。

words.zh: 國內的；家庭的、家務的；（動物）馴養的
words.ex: Domestic flights are usually cheaper than international ones.
words.exZh: 國內航班通常比國際航班便宜。

words.zh: 一大團、大量；大規模的、大眾的；質量
words.ex: A mass of dark clouds moved slowly over the hills.
words.exZh: 一大團烏雲緩緩飄過山丘。

words.ex: A few leaves floated on the surface of the pond.
words.exZh: 幾片葉子漂浮在池塘的水面上。

words.ex: My brother is keen on basketball and plays every day.
words.exZh: 我弟弟熱衷籃球，每天都打。

words.zh: 便宜貨、划算的東西；討價還價
words.ex: I found a great bargain at the night market yesterday.
words.exZh: 我昨天在夜市買到一個很划算的東西。

words.zh: 一定會、必然的；開往……的；跳躍、蹦跳
words.ex: If you practice every day, you are bound to get better.
words.exZh: 如果你每天練習，就一定會進步。

words.zh: 最初的、開始的；（姓名的）首字母
words.ex: My initial idea was simple, but it changed a lot later.
words.exZh: 我最初的想法很簡單，但後來改變了很多。

words.ex: Workers poured the foundation before they built the walls.
words.exZh: 工人們先灌好地基，才開始蓋牆。

words.ex: The new game became a worldwide hit in just one month.
words.exZh: 這款新遊戲短短一個月就紅遍全世界。

words.zh: 維持、使持續；遭受（傷害、損失）；支撐、承受
words.ex: A good diet helps sustain your energy all day.
words.exZh: 良好的飲食能幫助你整天維持體力。

words.zh: 較優秀的、較好的；上司、長官
words.ex: This new bike is superior to my old one in every way.
words.exZh: 這輛新腳踏車在各方面都比我的舊車好。

words.ex: Please submit your homework before the bell rings.
words.exZh: 請在鐘響前繳交你的作業。

words.ex: Honesty is an attribute that we all admire in a friend.
words.exZh: 誠實是我們都欣賞的朋友特質。

words.ex: When she came home, her grandmother embraced her warmly.
words.exZh: 她回到家時，奶奶熱情地擁抱了她。

words.zh: 耕種、栽培；培養（習慣、能力）
words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields near the river.
words.exZh: 農夫在靠近河邊的田裡種稻米。

words.zh: 歧視、差別對待；區別、分辨
words.ex: It is wrong to discriminate against people because of their age.
words.exZh: 因為年齡而歧視別人是不對的。

words.ex: We followed the dog's footprints in the snow.
words.exZh: 我們沿著雪地上的狗腳印走。

words.ex: The speed limit near the school is thirty kilometers per hour.
words.exZh: 學校附近的速限是每小時三十公里。

words.zh: 加法；增加的人或物；除…之外、此外
words.ex: My little sister is learning addition and subtraction at school.
words.exZh: 我妹妹在學校學加法和減法。

words.zh: 熟悉的、眼熟的；（對某事）熟悉、了解
words.ex: Her face looks familiar, but I forget her name.
words.exZh: 她的臉看起來很眼熟，但我忘了她的名字。

words.ex: There are numerous stars in the sky on a clear night.
words.exZh: 晴朗的夜晚，天空中有許許多多的星星。

words.ex: Life in an urban area can be busy and noisy.
words.exZh: 都市地區的生活可能很忙碌又吵雜。

words.ex: He has a strange notion that cats can talk.
words.exZh: 他有個奇怪的想法，認為貓會說話。

words.ex: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal dinner.
words.exZh: 牛仔褲不適合穿去正式晚宴。

words.ex: Too much noise can undermine your ability to focus.
words.exZh: 太多噪音會削弱你的專心能力。

words.ex: My two sisters are ten and twelve years old, respectively.
words.exZh: 我的兩個妹妹分別是十歲和十二歲。

words.zh: 提倡、主張；擁護者、倡導者
words.ex: Our teacher advocates reading for at least twenty minutes a day.
words.exZh: 我們的老師提倡每天至少閱讀二十分鐘。

words.ex: Two students answered the question almost simultaneously in class.
words.exZh: 兩位學生在課堂上幾乎同時回答了這個問題。

words.ex: Girls constitute half of the students in our school club.
words.exZh: 女生占了我們學校社團學生的一半。

words.ex: Planting trees can mitigate the heat in crowded city streets.
words.exZh: 種樹可以減緩擁擠街道上的炎熱。

words.ex: Visitors to the night market are predominantly young people and tourists.
words.exZh: 夜市的遊客主要是年輕人和觀光客。

words.ex: Colds are more prevalent in winter when people stay indoors.
words.exZh: 冬天大家都待在室內，感冒比較普遍。

words.zh: 降低、放低；較低的、下面的
words.ex: Please lower your voice when you are in the library.
words.exZh: 在圖書館裡請放低音量。

words.ex: Please check every item on the list before you leave.
words.exZh: 離開前請檢查清單上的每一個項目。

words.zh: 典型的、平常的；（某人）一貫的
words.ex: A typical day at school begins with a short morning meeting.
words.exZh: 學校平常的一天是從簡短的晨會開始。

words.ex: The two houses are about one kilometer apart.
words.exZh: 那兩棟房子相隔大約一公里。

words.zh: 原本的、最初的；原創的、有創意的；原作、正本
words.ex: The original plan was to go hiking, but it rained.
words.exZh: 原本的計畫是去健行，但下雨了。

words.zh: 展示、陳列；展示、顯示；顯示器、螢幕
words.ex: The shop put a display of colorful hats in the window.
words.exZh: 商店在櫥窗裡陳列了一排五顏六色的帽子。

words.ex: My father will install a new light in my room.
words.exZh: 我爸爸要在我房間裝一盞新燈。

words.ex: We spent the entire afternoon cleaning the garden together.
words.exZh: 我們整個下午都一起在整理花園。

words.ex: I propose that we meet at the library after lunch.
words.exZh: 我提議我們午餐後在圖書館碰面。

words.ex: It is time to get rid of these old toys.
words.exZh: 是時候把這些舊玩具處理掉了。

words.ex: The doctor advised him to drink more water.
words.exZh: 醫生建議他多喝水。

words.zh: 結構、構造；建築物、構造物；組織、安排（架構）
words.ex: The structure of this bridge is strong and simple.
words.exZh: 這座橋的結構堅固又簡單。

words.zh: 標準、水準；標準的、一般的
words.ex: Our teacher has very high standards for our writing.
words.exZh: 老師對我們作文的標準很高。

words.zh: 有禮貌的、客氣的；公民的、民間的
words.ex: Please stay civil and speak politely to each other.
words.exZh: 請保持禮貌，彼此客氣地說話。

words.ex: Animals slowly evolve to fit the places where they live.
words.exZh: 動物會慢慢演化，以適應牠們居住的環境。

words.ex: The image on the screen was too dark to see clearly.
words.exZh: 螢幕上的影像太暗，看不清楚。

words.ex: I could hardly hear the teacher from the back row.
words.exZh: 我坐在後排，幾乎聽不到老師說話。

words.ex: Nowadays, many students read books on their phones.
words.exZh: 現今許多學生用手機看書。

words.ex: Your presence at the meeting is very important.
words.exZh: 你出席這場會議非常重要。

words.ex: The mere sight of a spider makes her scream.
words.exZh: 她光是看到蜘蛛就會尖叫。

words.ex: Trust is an important element of every good friendship.
words.exZh: 信任是每段好友誼的重要要素。

words.ex: I enjoy many water sports, for instance, swimming and surfing.
words.exZh: 我喜歡很多水上運動，例如游泳和衝浪。

words.ex: This small factory produces thousands of paper cups every day.
words.exZh: 這間小工廠每天生產數千個紙杯。

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly when the singer came on stage.
words.exZh: 歌手上台時，觀眾大聲鼓掌。

words.ex: Bananas grow well in tropical places with heavy rain.
words.exZh: 香蕉在雨量豐沛的熱帶地區長得很好。

words.ex: The baby had a funny expression on her face.
words.exZh: 那個小寶寶臉上有一個滑稽的表情。

words.ex: The crow showed great intelligence in solving the puzzle.
words.exZh: 那隻烏鴉在解謎時展現出很高的智力。

words.zh: 活動、比賽項目；（重要的）事件
words.ex: The school sports event starts at nine on Saturday.
words.exZh: 學校的運動會星期六九點開始。

words.ex: It is my belief that hard work brings success.
words.exZh: 我相信努力會帶來成功。

words.ex: It was indeed a long day, but we had fun.
words.exZh: 那真的是漫長的一天，但我們玩得很開心。

words.ex: Some students in my class like to read political news.
words.exZh: 我班上有些同學喜歡看政治新聞。

words.ex: He is a devoted teacher who helps students after class.
words.exZh: 他是一位全心投入的老師，下課後還會幫助學生。

words.ex: I was so tired that I could barely stand.
words.exZh: 我累到幾乎站不起來。

words.ex: She decided to devote her weekends to helping at the animal shelter.
words.exZh: 她決定把週末投入在動物收容所幫忙。

words.ex: The main objective of this lesson is to practice speaking.
words.exZh: 這堂課的主要目標是練習口說。

words.ex: We had a long discussion about where to go on the trip.
words.exZh: 我們針對旅行要去哪裡討論了很久。

words.ex: Whales and dolphins are marine animals that breathe air.
words.exZh: 鯨魚和海豚是用肺呼吸的海洋動物。

words.ex: This method makes it easier to remember new words.
words.exZh: 這個方法讓記新單字變得更容易。

words.ex: None of the students in the class were late today.
words.exZh: 今天班上沒有一個學生遲到。

words.ex: Washing your hands can stop a virus from spreading.
words.exZh: 洗手可以防止病毒擴散。

words.ex: The company will publish a new comic book next month.
words.exZh: 這家公司下個月會出版一本新漫畫。

words.ex: An expert in plants came to our school to give a talk.
words.exZh: 一位植物專家來我們學校演講。

words.zh: 網路（電腦）；網狀系統、交通網；建立人脈
words.ex: The school network is down, so we cannot use the computers.
words.exZh: 學校的網路壞了，所以我們不能使用電腦。

words.ex: This is a temporary bridge until the new one opens.
words.exZh: 這是新橋開通前的臨時橋樑。

words.ex: I always get a snack during the commercial break.
words.exZh: 我總是在廣告時間去拿點心。

words.ex: The form asks for your name, age, and gender.
words.exZh: 這張表格要填姓名、年齡和性別。

words.ex: There has been a gradual rise in the number of people riding bikes to work.
words.exZh: 騎腳踏車上班的人數逐漸增加。

words.ex: Teenagers often care about what their peers think.
words.exZh: 青少年常常在意同儕的想法。

words.zh: 生產、產出；讓路、讓步；產量
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of rice every year.
words.exZh: 這座農場每年產出大量稻米。

words.ex: An eagle soared high above the mountains in the clear sky.
words.exZh: 一隻老鷹在晴朗的天空中高高翱翔於群山之上。

words.ex: The bakery will employ two more workers this summer.
words.exZh: 這家麵包店今年夏天會再僱用兩名員工。

words.zh: 使氣餒、使灰心；勸阻、使打消念頭
words.ex: Don't let one bad grade discourage you from trying again.
words.exZh: 別因為一次考不好就灰心，不再嘗試。

words.zh: 使筋疲力盡；廢氣；用盡、耗盡
words.ex: The long hike exhausted even the strongest students in our class.
words.exZh: 這趟長途健行連我們班最強壯的學生都累壞了。

words.zh: 虛擬的；實際上的、幾乎完全的
words.ex: We took a virtual tour of the museum on the computer.
words.exZh: 我們用電腦參加了博物館的虛擬導覽。

words.zh: 生物的、生物學的；親生的、有血緣的
words.ex: Scientists study the biological changes that happen as a frog grows.
words.exZh: 科學家研究青蛙成長過程中發生的生物變化。

words.ex: The city plans to expand the park next year.
words.exZh: 市政府計畫明年擴建這座公園。

words.zh: 適當的、合適的；專有的（文法）
words.ex: Wear proper shoes when you play sports at school.
words.exZh: 在學校做運動時要穿合適的鞋子。

words.zh: 負面的、消極的；否定的、反對的；（檢驗）陰性的
words.ex: Try not to let one bad grade make you feel so negative.
words.exZh: 別讓一次成績不好就讓你這麼消極。

words.zh: （用螢光筆）標示；強調、突顯；最精彩的部分
words.ex: Use a yellow pen to highlight the important words.
words.exZh: 用黃色的筆把重要的單字標示出來。

words.ex: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?
words.exZh: 你比較喜歡茶還是咖啡？

words.ex: This shop sells shoes of many different brands.
words.exZh: 這家店賣很多不同品牌的鞋子。

words.ex: We reached the peak of the mountain before noon.
words.exZh: 我們在中午前登上了山頂。

words.ex: The menu gives you three options for the main dish.
words.exZh: 菜單上的主餐有三種選擇。

words.ex: The dinosaur era ended millions of years ago.
words.exZh: 恐龍時代在數百萬年前就結束了。

words.ex: Tall mountains surround the little village on all sides.
words.exZh: 高聳的山從四面八方環繞著這個小村莊。

words.ex: The class did a simple scientific experiment with water.
words.exZh: 全班用水做了一個簡單的科學實驗。

words.ex: Please tell me the precise time of the meeting.
words.exZh: 請告訴我會議的確切時間。

words.ex: You resemble your mother more than your father.
words.exZh: 你長得比較像你媽媽，而不是你爸爸。

words.ex: Music is a universal language that people everywhere can enjoy.
words.exZh: 音樂是世界各地的人都能欣賞的共通語言。

words.ex: Good interaction between teachers and students makes class fun.
words.exZh: 老師和學生之間良好的互動，讓上課變得有趣。

words.ex: Watch the movement of the clouds across the sky.
words.exZh: 看看雲在天空中移動的樣子。

words.ex: The teacher said that violence never solves any problem.
words.exZh: 老師說暴力解決不了任何問題。

words.ex: We recycle old bottles and paper at our school every week.
words.exZh: 我們學校每週都會回收舊瓶子和紙張。

words.ex: We will play outside unless it starts to rain hard.
words.exZh: 除非開始下大雨，否則我們會在外面玩。

words.ex: Nothing on the menu could satisfy my picky little brother.
words.exZh: 菜單上沒有一樣東西能讓我挑嘴的弟弟滿意。

words.ex: An enormous whale appeared next to our small boat.
words.exZh: 一隻巨大的鯨魚出現在我們的小船旁。

words.zh: 偏僻的、遙遠的；遙控器；遠距的、遠端的
words.ex: They live in a remote village high in the mountains.
words.exZh: 他們住在高山上一個偏僻的村莊。

words.ex: The cafe has a warm and quiet atmosphere.
words.exZh: 這家咖啡店有溫暖又安靜的氣氛。

words.ex: The creation of a new game takes many months.
words.exZh: 創作一款新遊戲要花好幾個月。

words.zh: 柔軟的、可彎曲的；有彈性的、靈活的
words.ex: Yoga makes your body more flexible over time.
words.exZh: 瑜伽會讓你的身體隨著時間變得更柔軟。

words.zh: 嚴酷的、惡劣的；嚴厲的、苛刻的；刺眼的、刺耳的
words.ex: The harsh winter made it hard for birds to find food.
words.exZh: 嚴酷的冬天使鳥兒很難找到食物。

words.ex: A smile can convey kindness without any words.
words.exZh: 微笑不用任何言語就能傳達善意。

words.ex: People in the past used primitive tools made of stone.
words.exZh: 以前的人使用石頭做的原始工具。

words.ex: The formation of clouds begins when warm, wet air rises.
words.exZh: 溫暖潮濕的空氣上升時，雲就開始形成。

words.ex: The poster depicts a group of children playing outside.
words.exZh: 這張海報描繪一群孩子在戶外玩耍。

words.ex: The young pianist showed extraordinary skill on stage.
words.exZh: 這位年輕的鋼琴家在台上展現了非凡的技巧。

words.zh: （電影、戲劇的）一幕；（事情發生的）現場；景色、景象
words.ex: The last scene of the movie made many people cry.
words.exZh: 電影的最後一幕讓很多人哭了。

words.ex: Many people wonder about the origin of this old story.
words.exZh: 很多人好奇這個古老故事的起源。

words.ex: Bikes and buses are both vehicles that people use every day.
words.exZh: 腳踏車和公車都是人們每天使用的交通工具。

words.ex: Please connect the cable to the back of the computer.
words.exZh: 請把線接到電腦的背面。

words.ex: The ink from this pen is permanent, so be careful.
words.exZh: 這支筆的墨水是永久性的，所以要小心。

words.ex: We like to wander through the old streets on holidays.
words.exZh: 假日時我們喜歡在老街上閒逛。

words.ex: Scientists found a gene that affects the color of eyes.
words.exZh: 科學家發現了一個會影響眼睛顏色的基因。

words.zh: 轉乘；轉學、調職；轉移、轉帳
words.ex: You can transfer to the green line at the next station.
words.exZh: 你可以在下一站轉乘綠線。

words.ex: Our final destination is a small beach town in the south.
words.exZh: 我們最後的目的地是南部的一個海邊小鎮。

words.ex: I called the restaurant to reserve a table for six.
words.exZh: 我打電話給餐廳預訂六個人的位子。

words.ex: Dust can trigger an allergy in some people.
words.exZh: 灰塵會讓某些人引發過敏。

words.ex: A small committee will choose the best poster.
words.exZh: 一個小型委員會將選出最佳海報。

words.ex: The new sports facility has a swimming pool and two gyms.
words.exZh: 這座新的運動設施有一座游泳池和兩間健身房。

words.ex: Grandma sang a gentle lullaby until the baby fell asleep.
words.exZh: 奶奶唱著輕柔的搖籃曲，直到寶寶睡著。

words.ex: A slow glacier cut a deep valley through the mountains.
words.exZh: 一條緩慢移動的冰河在山間切出了一道深谷。

words.ex: The cat has gray stripes on its back and tail.
words.exZh: 這隻貓的背上和尾巴有灰色條紋。

words.ex: The cut on my finger will heal in a few days.
words.exZh: 我手指上的傷口幾天後就會痊癒。

words.ex: A strong storm can destroy houses and trees in one night.
words.exZh: 強烈的暴風雨一夜之間就能摧毀房屋和樹木。

words.ex: The heavy fog will delay our flight for two hours.
words.exZh: 大霧會讓我們的班機延誤兩個小時。

words.ex: How did your mother react when she saw your test score?
words.exZh: 你媽媽看到你的成績時有什麼反應？

words.ex: I sent a request to the teacher for more time.
words.exZh: 我向老師提出請求，希望多給一些時間。

words.ex: A smoke alarm can detect smoke before a fire gets big.
words.exZh: 煙霧警報器能在火勢變大之前偵測到煙。

words.zh: 諮詢、請教；查閱（書、地圖等）
words.ex: You should consult a doctor if the pain does not stop.
words.exZh: 如果疼痛沒有停止，你應該去看醫生。

words.ex: We should preserve old buildings so future kids can see them.
words.exZh: 我們應該保存老建築，讓未來的孩子也看得到。

words.ex: A sore throat is a common symptom of a cold.
words.exZh: 喉嚨痛是感冒常見的症狀。

words.ex: The wealthy man gave a lot of money to the school.
words.exZh: 那位有錢人捐了很多錢給學校。

words.ex: Students have free access to the library after class.
words.exZh: 學生下課後可以自由使用圖書館。

words.ex: Heavy rain is a threat to the small village near the river.
words.exZh: 大雨對河邊的小村莊是一種威脅。

words.ex: The desert has extreme heat during the day and cold nights.
words.exZh: 沙漠白天極度炎熱，夜晚則很寒冷。

words.ex: The main finding of the science project was surprising.
words.exZh: 這個科學專題的主要發現令人驚訝。

words.ex: She has a great talent for drawing animals.
words.exZh: 她很有畫動物的天分。

words.zh: （皮膚等）敏感的；體貼的、善解人意的；（話題）敏感的
words.ex: My skin is sensitive to strong sunlight, so I wear a hat.
words.exZh: 我的皮膚對強烈陽光很敏感，所以我會戴帽子。

words.ex: The doctor said the operation went well and he can go home soon.
words.exZh: 醫生說手術很順利，他很快就能回家了。

words.zh: 方便的、便利的；（時間）合適的
words.ex: The store is convenient because it is right next to the station.
words.exZh: 這家店就在車站旁邊，很方便。

words.ex: Scientists test a new theory again and again before they trust it.
words.exZh: 科學家會一再測試新理論，才會相信它。

words.ex: Let's organize the books on your desk by subject.
words.exZh: 我們把你桌上的書按科目整理好吧。

words.ex: Doctors are working hard to find better ways to treat cancer.
words.exZh: 醫生們正努力尋找更好的方法來治療癌症。

words.ex: The discovery of fire changed the way people lived.
words.exZh: 火的發現改變了人們的生活方式。

words.ex: Kindness is a trait that everyone admires in a friend.
words.exZh: 善良是大家都欣賞朋友身上的一項特質。

words.ex: The teacher used a picture to explain the concept of time zones.
words.exZh: 老師用一張圖來說明時區的概念。

words.zh: 生動的、鮮明的；（顏色）鮮豔的
words.ex: She has a vivid memory of the first time she saw snow.
words.exZh: 她對第一次看到雪的情景記憶鮮明。

words.ex: Children acquire new words quickly when they read every day.
words.exZh: 孩子每天閱讀時，學新單字學得很快。

words.zh: 減輕、緩解；使放心、使寬慰
words.ex: A short walk can relieve stress after a long day of study.
words.exZh: 念了一整天書後，散個步可以減輕壓力。

words.ex: Except for the occasional bird, the lake was quiet all afternoon.
words.exZh: 除了偶爾出現的鳥，整個下午湖面都很安靜。

words.ex: After the test, the teacher concluded that we needed more practice.
words.exZh: 考完試後，老師斷定我們需要更多練習。

words.ex: He has a strong desire to learn how to play the piano.
words.exZh: 他非常渴望學會彈鋼琴。

words.ex: Every resident of the building received a note about the water.
words.exZh: 這棟大樓的每一位住戶都收到了一張關於用水的通知。

words.zh: 建築風格、建築物；建築學
words.ex: The old train station is famous for its beautiful architecture.
words.exZh: 那座舊火車站以美麗的建築聞名。

words.ex: As the old saying goes, practice makes perfect.
words.exZh: 俗話說得好，熟能生巧。

words.ex: We sat on wooden stools around the small kitchen table.
words.exZh: 我們坐在小餐桌旁的木凳子上。

words.ex: We had to rush to catch the last train home.
words.exZh: 我們得趕緊去搭回家的最後一班火車。

words.ex: We drove along the coast and stopped to watch the waves.
words.exZh: 我們沿著海岸開車，還停下來看海浪。

words.ex: Our town has seen rapid growth in the past ten years.
words.exZh: 我們鎮上過去十年發展得很快速。

words.ex: It is a great honor to speak in front of the whole school.
words.exZh: 能在全校面前發言是莫大的榮幸。

words.zh: 除了…之外（還有）；此外、而且
words.ex: Besides English, my cousin can speak Japanese and French.
words.exZh: 除了英文之外，我表哥還會說日文和法文。

words.ex: It takes courage to say sorry in front of everyone.
words.exZh: 在大家面前道歉需要勇氣。

words.zh: 平均的；平均、平均數；一般的、普通的
words.ex: The average temperature in this town is around twenty degrees.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮的平均氣溫大約是二十度。

words.ex: The goalkeeper works hard to defend the goal.
words.exZh: 守門員很努力地守住球門。

words.ex: I got an urgent message from my teacher this morning.
words.exZh: 我今天早上收到老師傳來的緊急訊息。

words.ex: This dog breed is friendly and loves children.
words.exZh: 這個品種的狗很友善，又喜歡小孩。

words.ex: My brother enjoys reading historical stories about ancient kings.
words.exZh: 我哥哥喜歡讀有關古代國王的歷史故事。

words.ex: There was a slight change in the weather this afternoon.
words.exZh: 今天下午天氣有些微的變化。

words.zh: 應該、按規定；所謂的、據說的
words.ex: You are supposed to arrive at school before eight o'clock.
words.exZh: 你應該在八點前到校。

words.ex: We watched an educational show about sea animals today.
words.exZh: 我們今天看了一個關於海洋動物的教育節目。

words.ex: I suggest that we take a short break after this chapter.
words.exZh: 我建議我們讀完這一章後休息一下。

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain this weekend.
words.exZh: 這個週末有可能會下雨。

words.ex: The teacher distributed the worksheets to every student in the class.
words.exZh: 老師把學習單發給班上每一位學生。

words.ex: The bright red door is a sharp contrast to the gray wall.
words.exZh: 亮紅色的門和灰色的牆形成強烈的對比。

words.ex: Reading books helps children build a rich imagination.
words.exZh: 閱讀幫助孩子培養豐富的想像力。

words.ex: Please accompany your little brother to the bus stop.
words.exZh: 請陪你弟弟走到公車站。

words.zh: 找路、導航；航行；瀏覽、操作（網站等）
words.ex: My father uses his phone to navigate through the busy city.
words.exZh: 我爸爸用手機在繁忙的城市裡導航找路。

words.ex: My cousin has a cheerful personality and makes friends easily.
words.exZh: 我表哥個性開朗，很容易交到朋友。

words.zh: 特徵、特性；特有的、典型的
words.ex: Kindness is a characteristic of my best friend.
words.exZh: 善良是我最好的朋友的一個特點。

words.ex: He made an earnest promise to study harder next semester.
words.exZh: 他誠懇地承諾下學期會更用功。

words.zh: 重大變革；革命；旋轉、公轉（一圈）
words.ex: The invention of the phone brought a revolution in daily life.
words.exZh: 電話的發明為日常生活帶來了重大的變革。

words.ex: The singer has a distinctive voice that everyone remembers.
words.exZh: 那位歌手有獨特的嗓音，大家都記得。

words.ex: The deceased writer left behind many wonderful stories for children.
words.exZh: 這位已故的作家留下許多精彩的兒童故事。

words.ex: These hiking boots are durable enough to last for many years.
words.exZh: 這雙登山靴很耐用，可以穿很多年。

words.zh: 陷阱、捕捉器；困住、使受困
words.ex: The mouse ran into the trap and could not get out.
words.exZh: 老鼠跑進捕鼠器裡，出不來了。

words.ex: Please do not disturb your sister while she studies.
words.exZh: 你姊姊在讀書時，請不要打擾她。

words.ex: We did a science experiment with ice and salt.
words.exZh: 我們用冰塊和鹽做了一個科學實驗。

words.ex: Prices of fruit vary from one store to another.
words.exZh: 水果的價格每家店都不一樣。

words.ex: Wash fruit well to remove any pesticides on the skin.
words.exZh: 水果要洗乾淨，去除表皮殘留的農藥。

words.ex: A cactus can live in the desert for months without rain.
words.exZh: 仙人掌在沙漠裡沒有雨水也能活好幾個月。

words.ex: The team's mission is to bring water to the village.
words.exZh: 這個團隊的任務是把水送到村子裡。

words.ex: Can you recommend a good book for a rainy weekend?
words.exZh: 你能推薦一本適合下雨週末看的好書嗎？

words.zh: 景點、吸引人的事物；吸引力
words.ex: The old tower is the main attraction of this small town.
words.exZh: 這座古塔是這個小鎮最主要的景點。

words.zh: 限制、侷限；關住、使不能離開
words.ex: Please confine your speech to five minutes or less.
words.exZh: 請把你的演講限制在五分鐘以內。

words.ex: He can neither sing nor dance, but he loves music.
words.exZh: 他既不會唱歌也不會跳舞，但他很愛音樂。

words.zh: 系列、一連串；影集、連續劇
words.ex: This series of books has ten stories about animals.
words.exZh: 這套系列叢書有十個關於動物的故事。

words.ex: Plants need sunlight and water for healthy growth.
words.exZh: 植物需要陽光和水才能健康成長。

words.ex: The sad news came as a shock to all of us.
words.exZh: 這個悲傷的消息讓我們所有人都很震驚。

words.ex: We have a small budget, so we must plan the trip carefully.
words.exZh: 我們的預算不多，所以必須仔細規劃這趟旅行。

words.zh: 認為、猜想；假設、假定；應該（被期望）
words.ex: I suppose it will rain, so let's take umbrellas.
words.exZh: 我猜會下雨，所以我們帶傘吧。

words.ex: Our teacher assigns us a short reading every night.
words.exZh: 老師每天晚上都會指定一篇短文給我們讀。

words.ex: The teacher wrote a kind comment at the bottom of my report.
words.exZh: 老師在我的報告最下面寫了一句親切的評語。

words.ex: Be careful with the box because the glasses inside are fragile.
words.exZh: 這個箱子要小心搬，因為裡面的玻璃杯很容易破。

words.ex: I felt guilty after I broke my friend's cup.
words.exZh: 我打破朋友的杯子後覺得很內疚。

words.ex: I intend to walk to school every day this month.
words.exZh: 我打算這個月每天走路上學。

words.ex: Our coach always emphasizes the importance of working as a team.
words.exZh: 我們的教練總是強調團隊合作的重要。

words.ex: Call this number if there is an emergency.
words.exZh: 如果有緊急情況，請撥打這個號碼。

words.ex: My uncle has a large collection of old coins.
words.exZh: 我叔叔收藏了一大批舊硬幣。

words.ex: Building the road took months of hard labor.
words.exZh: 修這條路花了好幾個月的辛苦勞動。

words.zh: 療法、治療藥；補救辦法、改善方法
words.ex: Warm tea with honey is a good remedy for a sore throat.
words.exZh: 加蜂蜜的熱茶是治喉嚨痛的好療法。

words.ex: There are multiple ways to solve this math problem.
words.exZh: 這道數學題有很多種解法。

words.ex: I repeatedly called my friend, but nobody answered the phone.
words.exZh: 我一再打電話給朋友，但沒有人接。

words.ex: Contrary to what I expected, the test was easy.
words.exZh: 和我預期的相反，這次考試很簡單。

words.ex: Good music can stimulate your brain while you study.
words.exZh: 好聽的音樂能在你讀書時刺激大腦。

words.ex: The small hotel can accommodate up to fifty guests.
words.exZh: 這間小旅館最多可以容納五十位客人。

words.ex: The game was apparently moved to Friday because of the weather.
words.exZh: 比賽好像因為天氣改到星期五了。

words.ex: This shop specializes in fresh bread and cakes.
words.exZh: 這家店專門賣新鮮的麵包和蛋糕。

words.ex: My aunt prefers conventional cooking methods to using new machines.
words.exZh: 比起使用新機器，我阿姨比較喜歡傳統的烹飪方法。

words.ex: This bag of rice weighs about five kilograms.
words.exZh: 這袋米大約重五公斤。

words.ex: Remove the outer skin of the onion before you cook it.
words.exZh: 煮洋蔥之前先把外層的皮剝掉。

words.ex: Cleaning the classroom was a hard task for two students.
words.exZh: 打掃教室對兩個學生來說是件辛苦的工作。

words.zh: 直接的、直達的；導演、指揮；指引（方向）
words.ex: There is a direct bus from the station to the beach.
words.exZh: 有一班直達公車從車站開到海邊。

words.ex: Every citizen should follow the rules of the road.
words.exZh: 每位公民都應該遵守交通規則。

words.ex: The missing cookies stayed a mystery until we saw the dog.
words.exZh: 餅乾失蹤一直是個謎，直到我們看見那隻狗。

words.ex: A strange creature moved slowly across the dark ocean floor.
words.exZh: 一隻奇怪的生物慢慢爬過漆黑的海底。

words.ex: My ancestors came to this island by boat long ago.
words.exZh: 我的祖先很久以前搭船來到這座島。

words.zh: 威脅、恐嚇；危及、對…構成威脅
words.ex: The bully threatened to take my lunch money.
words.exZh: 那個惡霸威脅要拿走我的午餐錢。

words.zh: 開明的、思想開放的；大方的、大量的
words.ex: The teacher has a liberal view and welcomes new ideas.
words.exZh: 這位老師思想開明，歡迎新的想法。

words.zh: 放棄（計畫、夢想）；拋棄、遺棄
words.ex: Do not abandon your dream just because it is difficult.
words.exZh: 不要只因為夢想很難就放棄它。

words.ex: Follow the safety procedure when you use the lab.
words.exZh: 使用實驗室時要遵守安全流程。

words.ex: The book gave me a deeper insight into how plants grow.
words.exZh: 這本書讓我對植物如何生長有更深入的了解。

words.ex: A psychologist studies how people think and feel.
words.exZh: 心理學家研究人們如何思考和感受。

words.ex: The museum has a room about the aboriginal people of the island.
words.exZh: 博物館有一個展間介紹島上的原住民。

words.ex: Plastic bags and bottles pollute the beaches near our town.
words.exZh: 塑膠袋和瓶子污染了我們鎮附近的海灘。

words.ex: Listening to loud music can harm your ears over time.
words.exZh: 長時間聽大聲的音樂會傷害你的耳朵。

words.zh: 艱難的、困難的；堅固耐用的；（肉）老的、硬的
words.ex: It was a tough match, but our team never gave up.
words.exZh: 那是一場艱難的比賽，但我們的隊伍從不放棄。

words.ex: Our class did a survey about favorite school lunches.
words.exZh: 我們班做了一項關於最愛營養午餐的調查。

words.ex: Please call the hotel to confirm your room for tomorrow night.
words.exZh: 請打電話給旅館，確認你明晚的房間。

words.ex: Many neighbors oppose the plan to build a tall factory here.
words.exZh: 許多鄰居反對在這裡蓋高聳工廠的計畫。

words.ex: Please behave yourself when we visit Grandma's house.
words.exZh: 我們去奶奶家時，請你要乖。

words.zh: 遮蔽處、避難處；收容所；遮蔽、保護
words.ex: We found shelter under a big tree when it rained.
words.exZh: 下雨時，我們在一棵大樹下找到地方躲雨。

words.ex: Do not complain about the food if you have not tried it.
words.exZh: 還沒試吃就不要抱怨食物。

words.zh: 場合、特殊的日子；（某一）次、時候
words.ex: A birthday is a special occasion for the whole family.
words.exZh: 生日對全家人來說是個特別的日子。

words.ex: There is a thin layer of snow on the roof.
words.exZh: 屋頂上有一層薄薄的雪。

words.ex: We wore formal clothes to the school award ceremony.
words.exZh: 我們穿著正式服裝參加學校的頒獎典禮。

words.ex: The dog got a small reward after learning the trick.
words.exZh: 小狗學會把戲後得到了一點小獎賞。

words.ex: We import many kinds of fruit from other countries.
words.exZh: 我們從其他國家進口許多種水果。

words.ex: It is hard to resist a warm slice of cake.
words.exZh: 很難抗拒一塊溫熱的蛋糕。

words.ex: The number of visitors will decrease in the winter.
words.exZh: 冬天遊客人數會減少。

words.ex: This warm coat is not suitable for a hot summer day.
words.exZh: 這件保暖外套不適合炎熱的夏天穿。

words.zh: 軍隊、軍方；軍事的、軍隊的
words.ex: The military helped local people after the big flood last year.
words.exZh: 去年那場大洪水過後，軍隊協助了當地居民。

words.ex: A healthy lifestyle includes good food, sleep, and exercise.
words.exZh: 健康的生活方式包括良好的飲食、睡眠和運動。

words.ex: The school has a policy that phones must stay in bags.
words.exZh: 學校規定手機必須放在書包裡。

words.ex: You can purchase a bus ticket at the small window over there.
words.exZh: 你可以在那邊的售票口購買公車票。

words.zh: （有風險的）事業；冒險前往、大膽嘗試
words.ex: Opening a small bakery was a risky venture for them.
words.exZh: 開一家小麵包店對他們來說是一項有風險的事業。

words.ex: Her ultimate goal is to become a famous doctor.
words.exZh: 她的最終目標是成為一位有名的醫生。

words.ex: I can't guarantee that the bus will come on time today.
words.exZh: 我無法保證公車今天會準時來。

words.ex: Only a few intimate friends came to her small birthday party.
words.exZh: 只有幾位親密的朋友來參加她的小型生日派對。

words.ex: A school is an institution that helps children learn.
words.exZh: 學校是幫助孩子學習的機構。

words.zh: 用…代替、替換；代課老師、替補者
words.ex: You can substitute honey for sugar in this cake.
words.exZh: 這個蛋糕可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

words.ex: Solar panels generate power from the light of the sun.
words.exZh: 太陽能板利用陽光產生電力。

words.ex: The lion is a strong predator that hunts in a group.
words.exZh: 獅子是成群狩獵的強大掠食者。

words.ex: Learning to read is a fundamental skill for every child.
words.exZh: 學會閱讀是每個孩子的基本能力。

words.ex: Clear signs facilitate the movement of people in the busy station.
words.exZh: 清楚的標示讓人們在擁擠的車站裡更容易走動。

words.ex: A low wooden fence encloses the garden behind our school.
words.exZh: 一道矮木籬笆圍住了我們學校後面的花園。

words.ex: The flood displaced hundreds of families from their homes.
words.exZh: 洪水迫使數百個家庭離開家園。

words.ex: The aroma of fresh bread filled the whole kitchen.
words.exZh: 剛出爐麵包的香氣瀰漫整個廚房。

words.ex: The new version of this game has more levels and better music.
words.exZh: 這款遊戲的新版本有更多關卡和更好聽的音樂。

words.ex: The mountain landscape looks beautiful after the rain.
words.exZh: 雨後的山景看起來很美。

words.zh: 扭、轉動；扭傷；（情節的）轉折
words.ex: Twist the cap to the left to open the bottle.
words.exZh: 把瓶蓋往左扭就能打開瓶子。

words.ex: My grandfather just bought his first digital camera.
words.exZh: 我爺爺剛買了他的第一臺數位相機。

words.ex: She won an award for her drawing at the art fair.
words.exZh: 她的畫在美術展上得了獎。

words.ex: I have no doubt that our team will win the game.
words.exZh: 我毫不懷疑我們的隊伍會贏得比賽。

words.ex: I was in a good mood after the test.
words.exZh: 考完試後我心情很好。

words.ex: Wearing big backpacks is a new trend among students.
words.exZh: 背大背包是學生之間的新潮流。

words.ex: The new teacher handled the noisy class very well.
words.exZh: 新老師把吵鬧的班級處理得很好。

words.ex: The small shop made a good profit during the holiday.
words.exZh: 這家小店在假期期間賺了不少利潤。

words.ex: Firefighters came to rescue the cat from the tree.
words.exZh: 消防員來把貓從樹上救下來。

words.ex: Our family does not possess a car, so we take the bus.
words.exZh: 我們家沒有車，所以都搭公車。

words.ex: Choose one category from the list, such as sports or music.
words.exZh: 請從清單中選一個類別，例如運動或音樂。

words.ex: The teacher wrote a report about the incident in the hall.
words.exZh: 老師寫了一份關於走廊上那起事件的報告。

words.ex: The workers poured concrete to make a new road.
words.exZh: 工人們澆灌混凝土來鋪一條新路。

words.ex: The primary goal of this club is to help new students.
words.exZh: 這個社團的主要目標是幫助新生。

words.ex: Washing your hands with soap can remove harmful bacteria.
words.exZh: 用肥皂洗手可以清除有害的細菌。

words.ex: I tried to persuade my parents to let me adopt a cat.
words.exZh: 我試著說服爸媽讓我養一隻貓。

words.ex: The doctor examined my throat with a small light.
words.exZh: 醫生用一個小燈檢查了我的喉嚨。

words.zh: 覆蓋、蓋住；封面；涵蓋、包括
words.ex: Snow covered the roofs and the road this morning.
words.exZh: 今早雪覆蓋了屋頂和馬路。

words.ex: My sister plays the piano with great passion every evening.
words.exZh: 我姊姊每天晚上都滿懷熱情地彈鋼琴。

words.ex: A small pond can be a complete ecosystem for fish, frogs, and plants.
words.exZh: 一個小池塘就可以是魚、青蛙和植物的完整生態系。

words.ex: She worked hard to accomplish her goal of running ten kilometers.
words.exZh: 她努力達成了跑十公里的目標。

words.ex: Some people abuse the school computers by playing games all day.
words.exZh: 有些人濫用學校的電腦，整天玩遊戲。

words.zh: 同意、意見一致；協議、合約
words.ex: We are all in agreement about where to have lunch.
words.exZh: 我們對要去哪裡吃午餐意見一致。

words.zh: 交通運輸、交通工具；運送、運輸
words.ex: Public transport in this city is cheap and easy to use.
words.exZh: 這個城市的大眾運輸便宜又方便。

words.ex: Friends can communicate by phone even when they live far away.
words.exZh: 朋友即使住得很遠也能用手機聯繫。

words.zh: 專心、集中注意力；集中、聚集
words.ex: It is hard to concentrate when the room is noisy.
words.exZh: 房間很吵的時候很難專心。

words.ex: Problems may arise when too many people use one computer.
words.exZh: 太多人共用一台電腦時，可能會產生問題。

words.zh: 隨機的、任意的；莫名其妙的、毫無來由的
words.ex: The teacher picked a random name from the box.
words.exZh: 老師從盒子裡隨機抽出一個名字。

words.ex: The school does not permit students to use phones in class.
words.exZh: 學校不允許學生在課堂上使用手機。

words.ex: This bottle can retain heat for about twelve hours.
words.exZh: 這個瓶子可以保溫大約十二個小時。

words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take to finish this homework?
words.exZh: 你能估計一下寫完這份作業要花多久嗎？

words.zh: 實現（夢想、願望）；履行、達到（要求）
words.ex: She worked hard to fulfill her dream of becoming a nurse.
words.exZh: 她努力工作，要實現當護理師的夢想。

words.ex: It was evident from her smile that she loved the gift.
words.exZh: 從她的笑容就明顯看得出她很喜歡這份禮物。

words.ex: I have absolute trust in my best friend.
words.exZh: 我對我最好的朋友有絕對的信任。

words.ex: Are you implying that I did not do my share of the work?
words.exZh: 你是在暗示我沒有做好我那份工作嗎？

words.ex: The teacher will evaluate our work at the end of the month.
words.exZh: 老師會在月底評估我們的作品。

words.ex: The doctor gave him a thorough check before he left the hospital.
words.exZh: 他出院前，醫生幫他做了一次徹底的檢查。

words.ex: Our class will initiate a project to clean the park.
words.exZh: 我們班將發起一項清潔公園的計畫。

words.ex: She is a dedicated nurse who works hard every day.
words.exZh: 她是位認真投入的護理師，每天都很努力工作。

words.ex: Workers will construct a new bridge over the river next year.
words.exZh: 工人明年會在河上建造一座新橋。

words.ex: He is a capable student who finishes every task on time.
words.exZh: 他是個能幹的學生，每項工作都準時完成。

words.ex: Students must interpret the poem in their own words.
words.exZh: 學生必須用自己的話來詮釋這首詩。

words.ex: My little brother was reluctant to go to bed early.
words.exZh: 我弟弟不太情願早睡。

words.zh: 適度的、中等的；溫和的、不極端的；主持（討論）
words.ex: Moderate exercise every day is good for your health.
words.exZh: 每天適度運動對健康有益。

words.ex: The teacher used a small drawing to illustrate her idea.
words.exZh: 老師用一張小圖來說明她的想法。

words.zh: 顯眼的、突出的；著名的、重要的
words.ex: The tower is a prominent sight from the top of the hill.
words.exZh: 從山頂看，這座塔非常顯眼。

words.ex: In subsequent lessons, we will learn more about plants.
words.exZh: 在接下來的課程中，我們會學到更多有關植物的知識。

words.zh: 原生的、本土的；原住民的
words.ex: Indigenous plants grow well here without much water.
words.exZh: 原生植物在這裡不需要太多水也長得很好。

words.ex: Warm summers and heavy rain characterize the climate of this island.
words.exZh: 溫暖的夏天和大雨是這座島氣候的特色。

words.ex: During the pandemic, many students took their classes online.
words.exZh: 疫情大流行期間，許多學生改在線上上課。

words.zh: 奉獻、致力於；把（作品）獻給
words.ex: The nurse dedicated her whole life to helping the poor.
words.exZh: 那位護理師把一生奉獻給幫助窮人。

words.ex: Many retired people derive great joy from gardening.
words.exZh: 許多退休的人從園藝中得到很大的樂趣。

words.ex: Pandas spend most of the day eating bamboo in the forest.
words.exZh: 貓熊一天大部分時間都在森林裡吃竹子。

words.ex: The new dance became a craze among students last summer.
words.exZh: 這支新舞去年夏天在學生之間掀起一陣熱潮。

words.zh: 樸素的、素色的；清楚的、易懂的；平原
words.ex: She wore a plain white shirt to the concert.
words.exZh: 她穿了一件樸素的白襯衫去參加音樂會。

words.zh: 命令、口令；命令、指揮；（語言的）掌握能力
words.ex: The dog sat down at once when it heard the command.
words.exZh: 狗一聽到口令就立刻坐下。

words.zh: 合法的；法律的、法律上的
words.ex: It is legal to ride a bike on this road.
words.exZh: 在這條路上騎腳踏車是合法的。

words.ex: At the zoo, a peacock spread its colorful tail feathers.
words.exZh: 在動物園裡，一隻孔雀展開了牠色彩繽紛的尾羽。

words.ex: There is a small gap between the door and the floor.
words.exZh: 門和地板之間有一條小縫。

words.zh: 漏、滲出；漏水處、裂縫；洩漏（消息）
words.ex: Water began to leak from the pipe under the sink.
words.exZh: 水槽下方的水管開始漏水。

words.ex: Rice is the main crop in this part of the country.
words.exZh: 稻米是這個地區的主要農作物。

words.zh: （故事的）背景；環境、場所；（機器的）設定
words.ex: The story has a quiet mountain village as its setting.
words.exZh: 這個故事以一座寧靜的山村為背景。

words.zh: 情誼、聯繫；建立感情；黏合、黏結
words.ex: Playing on the same team made a strong bond between us.
words.exZh: 在同一隊打球讓我們之間建立了深厚的情誼。

words.zh: 開幕、開張；開頭、開場；職缺
words.ex: Hundreds of people came to the opening of the new library.
words.exZh: 數百人來參加新圖書館的開幕。

words.zh: 流動、流；（車、水等的）流量、流動
words.ex: The river flows slowly through the green fields.
words.exZh: 河水緩緩流過綠色的田野。

words.ex: This old book is worth reading twice because the story is so deep.
words.exZh: 這本舊書值得讀兩遍，因為故事很有深度。

words.ex: She felt great pride when her sister won the race.
words.exZh: 她妹妹贏得比賽時，她感到非常驕傲。

words.ex: Many people now read the news on their mobile phones.
words.exZh: 現在許多人用手機看新聞。

words.ex: Please adjust the chair so you can sit comfortably.
words.exZh: 請調整椅子，這樣你才能坐得舒服。

words.ex: You need a minimum of three players to start.
words.exZh: 至少要有三個玩家才能開始。

words.ex: My mother arranged the flowers in a blue vase.
words.exZh: 我媽媽把花插在一個藍色花瓶裡。

words.ex: I like hot summers, whereas my sister prefers cool weather.
words.exZh: 我喜歡炎熱的夏天，而我妹妹比較喜歡涼爽的天氣。

words.zh: 方式；態度、舉止；禮貌（常用複數）
words.ex: The teacher explained the problem in a clear and simple manner.
words.exZh: 老師用清楚又簡單的方式講解這道題目。

words.ex: My father insists on walking me to the bus stop.
words.exZh: 我爸爸堅持要陪我走到公車站。

words.ex: The aircraft landed safely after a long flight over the sea.
words.exZh: 那架飛機飛越海洋後安全降落。

words.ex: It rained all night, hence the wet road this morning.
words.exZh: 整晚都在下雨，所以今天早上路面是濕的。

words.ex: A raincoat is a practical gift for someone who lives in a rainy city.
words.exZh: 對住在多雨城市的人來說，雨衣是很實用的禮物。

words.ex: The students were eager to start the science experiment.
words.exZh: 學生們迫不及待想開始做科學實驗。

words.ex: Learning to play the piano takes time and patience.
words.exZh: 學鋼琴需要時間和耐心。

words.ex: Technological changes have made our daily lives much easier.
words.exZh: 科技上的改變讓我們的日常生活便利許多。

words.ex: Tourists help the economy of this small island town.
words.exZh: 觀光客為這個海島小鎮的經濟帶來助益。

words.ex: I thank you on behalf of all my classmates.
words.exZh: 我代表全班同學向你道謝。

words.ex: Cars must not exceed the speed limit on this road.
words.exZh: 在這條路上，車子不可以超過速限。

words.ex: The photo has a blue sky in the background.
words.exZh: 這張照片的背景是藍天。

words.ex: The team consists of five students from our school.
words.exZh: 這支隊伍由我們學校的五名學生組成。

words.zh: 悲慘的、不幸的；悲劇的（戲劇）
words.ex: It is tragic that the old library burned down last night.
words.exZh: 那間老圖書館昨晚被燒毀，真是令人難過的悲劇。

words.ex: She made remarkable progress in English this year.
words.exZh: 她今年的英文有了顯著的進步。

words.zh: 有攻擊性的、兇的；積極的、強勢的
words.ex: That dog is aggressive, so please do not go near it.
words.exZh: 那隻狗很兇，所以請不要靠近牠。

words.ex: The long voyage across the sea lasted almost a month.
words.exZh: 橫越大海的漫長航行持續了將近一個月。

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for every living thing.
words.exZh: 水是所有生物的基本必需品。

words.ex: Cutting down trees can destroy the habitat of many animals.
words.exZh: 砍伐樹木可能破壞許多動物的棲息地。

words.ex: The old street is part of our cultural heritage.
words.exZh: 這條老街是我們文化遺產的一部分。

words.ex: This small room is adequate for one student and a desk.
words.exZh: 這間小房間足夠容納一位學生和一張書桌。

words.zh: 致命的；嚴重的、無法挽回的
words.ex: Driving too fast can lead to a fatal accident.
words.exZh: 開車太快可能導致致命的車禍。

words.zh: 極好的、驚人的；難以置信的
words.ex: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible.
words.exZh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得驚人。

words.zh: 極度渴望的；絕望的、走投無路的
words.ex: The lost boy was desperate to find his mother.
words.exZh: 那個走失的男孩急著想找到媽媽。

words.ex: The town is renowned for its fresh fruit and friendly people.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮以新鮮水果和友善的居民聞名。

words.ex: It is a privilege to speak with you today.
words.exZh: 今天能和您談話是我的榮幸。
