words.ex: Nobody knew the outcome of the game until the last minute.
words.exZh: 直到最後一分鐘，沒有人知道比賽的結果。

words.ex: How can you justify being late again today?
words.exZh: 你今天又遲到了，要怎麼為自己辯解？

words.zh: 強烈的、劇烈的；緊張激烈的
words.ex: The intense heat made us stay inside all afternoon.
words.exZh: 強烈的高溫讓我們整個下午都待在室內。

words.ex: We have sufficient food for the whole camping trip.
words.exZh: 我們帶的食物足夠整趟露營使用。

words.zh: 紀律、自律；管教、處罰；學科
words.ex: Good discipline helps you finish your homework every day.
words.exZh: 良好的自律能幫你每天把功課寫完。

words.zh: 學業的、學術的；學者、大學教師
words.ex: Her academic results improved after she made a study plan.
words.exZh: 她訂了讀書計畫之後，學業成績進步了。

words.ex: The bottle has a capacity of one liter.
words.exZh: 這個瓶子的容量是一公升。

words.ex: Try to see the problem from your friend's perspective.
words.exZh: 試著從你朋友的角度來看這個問題。

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we should stay home and rest today.
words.exZh: 在這種情況下，我們今天應該待在家休息。

words.ex: The actor will portray a brave doctor in the new film.
words.exZh: 那位演員將在新片中飾演一位勇敢的醫生。

words.zh: 當代的、現代的；同時代的
words.ex: The museum shows contemporary art from young artists.
words.exZh: 這間美術館展出年輕藝術家的當代藝術。

words.ex: The shop compensated us with a free drink for the long wait.
words.exZh: 店家請我們喝一杯免費飲料，補償我們等了很久。

words.ex: Put the pictures in the right sequence to tell the story.
words.exZh: 把圖片按照正確的順序排好來說故事。

words.ex: Rice is an important part of agriculture in many countries.
words.exZh: 稻米在許多國家都是農業的重要部分。

words.ex: There is a small variation in temperature between day and night.
words.exZh: 白天和晚上的溫度有些微的變化。

words.ex: Good teachers foster a love of reading in their students.
words.exZh: 好老師會培養學生對閱讀的熱愛。

words.ex: The majority of students in my class take the bus.
words.exZh: 我們班上大多數的同學搭公車。

words.zh: 可再生的；可續約的、可延期的
words.ex: Wind and sunlight are renewable sources of energy.
words.exZh: 風和陽光都是可再生的能源。

words.ex: The movie was much better than my expectations.
words.exZh: 這部電影比我預期的好得多。

words.ex: Heavy rain caused widespread flooding across the region.
words.exZh: 大雨在整個地區造成大範圍的淹水。

words.ex: Big cities are becoming increasingly crowded and noisy every year.
words.exZh: 大城市每年都變得越來越擁擠吵鬧。

words.ex: The family faced great hardship after the flood.
words.exZh: 那個家庭在水災後面臨極大的困境。

words.ex: A person of integrity tells the truth even when it is hard.
words.exZh: 有誠信的人即使很難也會說實話。

words.ex: It will be a fun trip regardless of the weather.
words.exZh: 不管天氣如何，這都會是一趟有趣的旅行。

words.ex: She will inherit the old farm from her grandfather someday.
words.exZh: 她將來會從祖父那裡繼承那座老農場。

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me when I try to watch videos.
words.exZh: 我想看影片時，很慢的網路讓我很沮喪。

words.ex: Reading stories about other people helps children develop empathy.
words.exZh: 閱讀關於別人的故事能幫助孩子培養同理心。

words.ex: Given the circumstances, we decided to cancel the picnic.
words.exZh: 考慮到當時的情況，我們決定取消野餐。

words.ex: If you plan to visit the museum, buy your tickets beforehand.
words.exZh: 如果你打算去博物館，要事先買好票。

words.zh: 事情、問題；要緊、有關係；物質
words.ex: We need to talk about an important matter after class.
words.exZh: 下課後我們需要談一件重要的事情。

words.ex: Please buckle your seat belt before the car starts moving.
words.exZh: 車子開動前請扣好安全帶。

words.ex: A white dove is often seen as a symbol of peace.
words.exZh: 白鴿常被視為和平的象徵。

words.ex: The large bird glided over the lake without moving its wings.
words.exZh: 那隻大鳥沒有拍動翅膀就滑翔過湖面。

words.zh: 剩菜、剩飯；剩下的、剩餘的
words.ex: We often eat the leftovers from dinner for lunch the next day.
words.exZh: 我們常把晚餐的剩菜當作隔天的午餐。

words.ex: A large vessel entered the harbor early in the morning.
words.exZh: 一艘大船在清晨駛進了港口。

words.ex: The cafe plans to hire two new workers this summer.
words.exZh: 那家咖啡館打算今年夏天僱用兩名新員工。

words.zh: 出口、輸出；出口品；匯出（檔案）
words.ex: This small country exports fruit to many places.
words.exZh: 這個小國把水果出口到許多地方。

words.ex: The students held a quiet protest against the new school rule.
words.exZh: 學生們針對新校規舉行了一場安靜的抗議。

words.zh: 來回、往返；等等、諸如此類
words.ex: The dog ran back and forth in the yard all afternoon.
words.exZh: 那隻狗整個下午在院子裡跑來跑去。

words.ex: Good students strive to do a little better every single day.
words.exZh: 好學生每天都努力讓自己再進步一點點。

words.ex: The school closed for a week because of a flu epidemic.
words.exZh: 因為流感大流行，學校停課了一週。

words.ex: The two schools will negotiate a time for the friendly match.
words.exZh: 兩所學校會協商友誼賽的時間。

words.zh: 修復、整修；恢復（電力、秩序等）
words.ex: Workers restored the old train station to its original look.
words.exZh: 工人把老火車站修復成原來的樣子。

words.zh: 感覺、知覺；轟動、轟動的人事物
words.ex: I felt a cold sensation on my feet when I stepped into the water.
words.exZh: 我踏進水裡時，腳上有一種冰涼的感覺。

words.ex: Salt is a common substance found in most kitchens.
words.exZh: 鹽是大多數廚房裡都有的常見物質。

words.ex: The new building has ramps to help people with a disability.
words.exZh: 這棟新大樓有斜坡，方便身心障礙的人。

words.ex: The old fisherman sang a ballad about a storm at sea.
words.exZh: 老漁夫唱了一首講海上暴風雨的民謠。

words.ex: Turn the knob slowly to open the old wooden door.
words.exZh: 慢慢轉動門把，打開那扇舊木門。

words.ex: Long ago, many slaves were forced to work on large farms.
words.exZh: 很久以前，許多奴隸被迫在大型農場工作。

words.ex: A flock of sheep walked slowly across the green field.
words.exZh: 一群羊慢慢走過綠色的草地。

words.ex: Having good friends is a real blessing in life.
words.exZh: 有好朋友是人生中真正的福氣。

words.ex: Please don't blame your little brother for the broken cup.
words.exZh: 請不要為了打破的杯子責怪你的弟弟。

words.ex: Please put a label on each box before we move.
words.exZh: 搬家前請在每個箱子上貼標籤。

words.ex: Living alone gave him the freedom to plan his own day.
words.exZh: 獨自生活讓他能自由安排自己的一天。

words.ex: I admire my grandmother because she never gives up on anything.
words.exZh: 我很敬佩我奶奶，因為她做任何事都不放棄。

words.zh: 例行公事、日常作息；例行的、常規的
words.ex: My morning routine starts with a glass of water.
words.exZh: 我每天早上的例行公事是從喝一杯水開始。

words.ex: Combine the flour and eggs, then add a little milk.
words.exZh: 把麵粉和蛋混合，然後加一點牛奶。

words.zh: 尷尬的、不自在的；笨拙的
words.ex: It felt awkward to talk to a stranger on the first day.
words.exZh: 第一天就跟陌生人說話感覺很尷尬。

words.ex: The principal will announce the winners tomorrow morning.
words.exZh: 校長明天早上會公布得獎名單。

words.zh: 基金、資金；資助、提供資金
words.ex: The school set up a fund to buy new books.
words.exZh: 學校設立一筆基金來買新書。

words.ex: The painter added every small detail to the picture of the farm.
words.exZh: 畫家把每個小細節都加進這幅農場的畫裡。

words.ex: Can you define this word in your own words?
words.exZh: 你能用自己的話解釋這個單字的意思嗎？

words.ex: The town received food aid after the big flood.
words.exZh: 大水災後，這個小鎮收到了糧食援助。

words.ex: Nobody should bully a classmate because of how he looks.
words.exZh: 沒有人該因為同學的外表而欺負他。

words.ex: It was an ordinary day until a strange letter arrived.
words.exZh: 那原本是普通的一天，直到一封奇怪的信寄來。

words.ex: If you have trouble, you can seek help from your parents.
words.exZh: 如果你遇到困難，可以向父母尋求協助。

words.ex: Good music can motivate me to keep running.
words.exZh: 好聽的音樂能激勵我繼續跑下去。

words.ex: She was furious when she found mud on the clean floor.
words.exZh: 她發現乾淨的地板上有泥巴時，氣炸了。

words.ex: The rules of this board game are too complicated for kids.
words.exZh: 這款桌遊的規則對小孩來說太複雜了。

words.zh: 有毒的；有害的（人際、環境）
words.ex: Some cleaning products are toxic, so keep them away from children.
words.exZh: 有些清潔用品有毒，所以要放在小孩拿不到的地方。

words.ex: There is a shortage of water in the village this summer.
words.exZh: 這個夏天村裡缺水。

words.zh: 家庭、一戶人家；家用的、家務的
words.ex: Each household in our building shares one large garden.
words.exZh: 我們大樓的每一戶人家共用一座大花園。

words.ex: His dream of being a pilot finally became a reality.
words.exZh: 他當飛行員的夢想終於成真了。

words.ex: My sister bought an electronic dictionary for school.
words.exZh: 我姊姊為了上學買了一本電子辭典。

words.ex: The store advertises its sale on the radio every morning.
words.exZh: 這家店每天早上在廣播上宣傳折扣活動。

words.zh: 真正的、非仿冒的；真誠的
words.ex: This wallet is made of genuine leather, not plastic.
words.exZh: 這個皮夾是真皮做的，不是塑膠。

words.ex: A continuous line of cars moved slowly along the road.
words.exZh: 一長串連續不斷的車子沿著馬路緩緩前進。

words.ex: Doing push-ups every day can strengthen your arms.
words.exZh: 每天做伏地挺身可以讓你的手臂更強壯。

words.ex: The repair work on the road is still ongoing.
words.exZh: 這條路的修補工程仍在進行中。

words.ex: If you neglect your plants, their leaves will soon turn yellow.
words.exZh: 如果你疏於照顧植物，它們的葉子很快就會變黃。

words.ex: Good preparation will help you feel calm before the exam.
words.exZh: 充分的準備能讓你在考試前感到平靜。

words.ex: I cannot tolerate the loud noise from the street at night.
words.exZh: 我受不了晚上街上傳來的吵鬧聲。

words.ex: We need to eliminate waste to protect the environment.
words.exZh: 我們需要杜絕浪費來保護環境。

words.ex: My parents made many sacrifices to give us a good life.
words.exZh: 我爸媽為了讓我們過好日子做了許多犧牲。

words.ex: Dogs can perceive sounds that people cannot hear at all.
words.exZh: 狗能察覺到人完全聽不到的聲音。

words.ex: There is a new regulation about bikes in the park.
words.exZh: 公園裡有一項關於腳踏車的新規定。

words.ex: The twins wore identical shirts, so nobody could tell them apart.
words.exZh: 那對雙胞胎穿著一模一樣的襯衫，沒有人分得出誰是誰。

words.ex: Practice will give you more confidence before the speech.
words.exZh: 練習會讓你在演講前更有信心。

words.zh: 加固、強化；加深（觀念、記憶）
words.ex: Workers used steel bars to reinforce the old wall.
words.exZh: 工人用鋼筋來加固那面舊牆。

words.ex: Reading many books can enrich your life and your vocabulary.
words.exZh: 多讀書可以讓你的生活和字彙都更豐富。

words.ex: The teacher will demonstrate how to make a paper plane.
words.exZh: 老師會示範怎麼摺紙飛機。

words.zh: 截然不同的；清楚的、明顯的
words.ex: The two brothers have distinct voices, so I can tell them apart.
words.exZh: 那兩兄弟的聲音很不一樣，所以我分得出來。

words.zh: 分辨、區別；使傑出、使出眾
words.ex: It is hard to distinguish the twins because they look so alike.
words.exZh: 那對雙胞胎長得太像了，很難分辨。

words.ex: This factory manufactures toys for children around the world.
words.exZh: 這間工廠為世界各地的孩子生產玩具。

words.zh: 占優勢的、主要的；顯性的（遺傳）
words.ex: The dominant color in the painting is a deep blue.
words.exZh: 這幅畫的主要顏色是深藍色。

words.ex: The song was a collaboration between two young musicians.
words.exZh: 這首歌是兩位年輕音樂人合作的作品。

words.ex: An outbreak of flu closed the school for three days.
words.exZh: 流感爆發讓學校停課三天。

words.ex: The immigrant family opened a small noodle shop downtown.
words.exZh: 那個移民家庭在市中心開了一家小麵店。

words.ex: The school restricts phone use during class time.
words.exZh: 學校限制上課時間使用手機。

words.zh: 財務、金融；提供資金、資助
words.ex: My cousin studies finance and wants to work at a bank.
words.exZh: 我表哥讀金融，想去銀行工作。

words.ex: Every rule has an exception, even this one.
words.exZh: 每條規則都有例外，這條也不例外。

words.zh: 強加；徵收、實施（規定）；打擾、添麻煩
words.ex: Parents should not impose their wishes on their children.
words.exZh: 父母不應該把自己的願望強加在孩子身上。

words.ex: She won a place at a prestigious music school.
words.exZh: 她考上了一所很有聲望的音樂學校。

words.ex: Scientists made a big breakthrough in the study of sleep.
words.exZh: 科學家在睡眠研究上有了重大突破。

words.ex: The smell of rice cakes always evokes memories of my grandma's kitchen.
words.exZh: 年糕的味道總會喚起我對奶奶廚房的回憶。

words.ex: The campers sat around the bonfire and told funny stories.
words.exZh: 露營的人圍坐在營火旁講好笑的故事。

words.ex: Turn the lid clockwise to close the bottle tightly.
words.exZh: 把蓋子順時針轉，就能把瓶子關緊。

words.ex: After his parents divorced, the boy spent weekends with his father.
words.exZh: 父母離婚後，那個男孩週末都和爸爸一起過。

words.ex: I washed the dishes with a soft sponge and warm water.
words.exZh: 我用柔軟的海綿和溫水洗碗。

words.ex: In Taiwan, people usually write their surname before their given name.
words.exZh: 在臺灣，人們通常把姓寫在名字前面。

words.ex: My new watch is waterproof, so I can wear it while swimming.
words.exZh: 我的新手錶防水，所以游泳時也能戴著。

words.ex: The circus performers amazed us with their acrobatic jumps.
words.exZh: 馬戲團的表演者用特技跳躍讓我們看得目瞪口呆。

words.ex: The heavy snow crippled the city's traffic for two days.
words.exZh: 大雪讓這座城市的交通癱瘓了兩天。

words.ex: Stinky tofu is a famous local delicacy at night markets.
words.exZh: 臭豆腐是夜市有名的在地美食。

words.ex: He put a wooden plank across the stream so we could cross.
words.exZh: 他在小溪上架了一塊木板，讓我們可以走過去。

words.ex: Nobody should ridicule a classmate for asking a simple question.
words.exZh: 沒有人應該因為同學問了簡單的問題就嘲笑他。

words.ex: Let's get together for lunch sometime next week, okay?
words.exZh: 我們下週找個時間一起吃午餐，好嗎？

words.ex: Gravity pulls the apple down from the tree to the ground.
words.exZh: 地心引力把蘋果從樹上拉到地面。

words.ex: Please scan this paper and send it to the teacher.
words.exZh: 請把這張紙掃描後寄給老師。

words.ex: The tall clock tower is a famous landmark in the old town.
words.exZh: 那座高高的鐘塔是老城區的著名地標。

words.ex: We heard a loud explosion from the building site.
words.exZh: 我們聽到工地傳來一聲巨大的爆炸聲。

words.ex: He worked hard all summer to pay off his debt.
words.exZh: 他整個夏天努力工作來還清債務。

words.ex: Please do not use that angry tone with me.
words.exZh: 請不要用那種生氣的語氣跟我說話。

words.ex: Cut the cake into equal pieces so everyone gets the same amount.
words.exZh: 把蛋糕切成大小相等的幾塊，讓每個人分到一樣多。

words.ex: Don't ignore the rules just because nobody is watching.
words.exZh: 不要因為沒人在看就無視規則。

words.ex: It was obvious that the boy had studied hard.
words.exZh: 很明顯，那個男孩一直很用功。

words.zh: 買得起、負擔得起；承擔得起（後果）
words.ex: We cannot afford a new car this year.
words.exZh: 我們今年買不起新車。

words.ex: The teacher praised him for his hard work.
words.exZh: 老師稱讚他很用功。

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.exZh: 植物從空氣中吸收二氧化碳。

words.ex: I regret not studying harder before the test.
words.exZh: 我後悔考試前沒有更用功讀書。

words.ex: My family decided to donate old clothes to people who need them.
words.exZh: 我們家決定把舊衣服捐給需要的人。

words.zh: 回覆、回應；（對治療等）有反應
words.ex: She did not respond to my message until the evening.
words.exZh: 她直到晚上才回覆我的訊息。

words.ex: A long hot bath feels like a luxury after a hard day.
words.exZh: 辛苦一天後，泡個長長的熱水澡感覺很享受。

words.ex: My grandfather had surgery on his knee last year.
words.exZh: 我爺爺去年膝蓋動了手術。

words.ex: This elevator can carry a maximum of ten people.
words.exZh: 這台電梯最多可以載十個人。

words.ex: Please do not accuse him before you know the whole story.
words.exZh: 在你了解來龍去脈之前，請不要責怪他。

words.ex: Wool clothes may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
words.exZh: 羊毛衣服用熱水洗可能會縮水。

words.ex: Many volunteers work to help families out of poverty.
words.exZh: 許多志工努力幫助家庭脫離貧窮。

words.ex: Everyone needs some privacy in their own room.
words.exZh: 每個人在自己房間裡都需要一點隱私。

words.ex: The principal approved our plan for a used book sale.
words.exZh: 校長批准了我們舉辦二手書義賣的計畫。

words.ex: My aunt's monthly income is enough to support her family.
words.exZh: 我阿姨每月的收入足夠養活她的家人。

words.ex: Our class held a debate about school uniforms.
words.exZh: 我們班舉辦了一場關於學校制服的辯論。

words.ex: The old bridge may collapse if the river gets higher.
words.exZh: 如果河水再漲高，那座舊橋可能會倒塌。

words.ex: The children's books are in the back section of the library.
words.exZh: 童書放在圖書館後面的區域。

words.ex: My father likes to invest a little money each month.
words.exZh: 我爸爸喜歡每個月投資一點錢。

words.ex: Please inform the teacher if you will be absent.
words.exZh: 如果你要缺席，請通知老師。

words.ex: The long instructions confused many of the students.
words.exZh: 冗長的說明讓很多學生感到困惑。

words.ex: Honesty is a basic principle in our family.
words.exZh: 誠實是我們家的基本原則。

words.ex: A fallen tree became an obstacle on the mountain road.
words.exZh: 一棵倒下的樹成了山路上的障礙。

words.ex: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
words.exZh: 我真的很感謝你幫我做自然科學專題。

words.zh: 交換、互換；兌換、換貨；交換、交流
words.ex: We exchange gifts with our classmates at the end of the year.
words.exZh: 我們在年底和同學交換禮物。

words.ex: He has a strong interest in insects and small animals.
words.exZh: 他對昆蟲和小動物很有興趣。

words.ex: In comparison with last year, this test was easier.
words.exZh: 和去年比起來，這次考試比較簡單。

words.zh: 規模、範圍；秤、體重計；等級、刻度
words.ex: The storm caused damage on a very large scale.
words.exZh: 這場暴風雨造成了非常大規模的損害。

words.ex: The runner kept a steady pace during the whole race.
words.exZh: 那位跑者整場比賽都保持穩定的速度。

words.ex: A low barrier stops cars from driving onto the path.
words.exZh: 一道矮柵欄擋住汽車，不讓它們開上步道。

words.ex: The scientists will investigate why the river water turned green.
words.exZh: 科學家將會調查河水為什麼變成綠色。

words.ex: There is a small flaw in the glass, but it still works.
words.exZh: 這個玻璃杯有個小瑕疵，但還是能用。

words.zh: 代辦處、仲介公司；（政府）機構
words.ex: We booked our trip through a travel agency.
words.exZh: 我們透過旅行社訂了這趟旅行。

words.zh: 災難、災害；徹底失敗的事
words.ex: The heavy storm caused a terrible disaster in the village.
words.exZh: 那場暴風雨在村子裡造成了可怕的災害。

words.ex: The police helped the victim of the traffic accident.
words.exZh: 警察幫助那起車禍的受害者。

words.ex: The door is automatic, so it opens by itself.
words.exZh: 這扇門是自動門，會自己打開。

words.ex: I need to withdraw some money from the bank before the trip.
words.exZh: 旅行前我需要從銀行領一些錢。

words.ex: Loud music can distract you when you try to study.
words.exZh: 你想讀書時，吵鬧的音樂會讓你分心。

words.zh: 有自信的；確信的、有把握的
words.ex: She felt confident before the speech because she had practiced a lot.
words.exZh: 因為練習了很多次，她在演講前很有自信。

words.ex: The deadline for the homework is Friday at noon.
words.exZh: 這份作業的截止時間是星期五中午。

words.ex: The previous lesson was easier than the one we have today.
words.exZh: 上一堂課比我們今天的課簡單。

words.ex: I assure you that the food is safe to eat.
words.exZh: 我向你保證這些食物可以安心食用。

words.ex: She always tries to excel in math and science.
words.exZh: 她總是努力在數學和自然科方面表現出色。

words.zh: 合理的；（價格）公道的；講道理的
words.ex: It is reasonable to ask for help when you feel sick.
words.exZh: 身體不舒服時請別人幫忙是合理的。

words.zh: 使勞累、拉傷；壓力、負擔；過濾、瀝乾
words.ex: Reading in the dark can strain your eyes.
words.exZh: 在黑暗中看書會讓眼睛太勞累。

words.ex: Too much homework can be a heavy burden for students.
words.exZh: 太多功課對學生來說可能是沉重的負擔。

words.zh: 死板的、嚴格的；堅硬的、僵硬的
words.ex: The rules at that camp are rigid, so nobody is ever late.
words.exZh: 那個營隊的規定很嚴格，所以從來沒有人遲到。

words.ex: I suspect that my brother ate the last cookie.
words.exZh: 我懷疑是我哥哥吃了最後一塊餅乾。

words.zh: （有組織的）活動、運動；發起運動、爭取
words.ex: Our class started a campaign to keep the beach clean.
words.exZh: 我們班發起了一項維護海灘整潔的活動。

words.ex: An excess of sugar can be bad for your teeth.
words.exZh: 過量的糖對你的牙齒不好。

words.ex: We can convert the garage into a small study room.
words.exZh: 我們可以把車庫改成一間小書房。

words.ex: Please proceed with your speech after the noise stops.
words.exZh: 等噪音停了，請繼續你的演講。

words.ex: Music therapy helps some patients feel calm and happy.
words.exZh: 音樂治療能幫助一些病人感到平靜與快樂。

words.zh: 細微的、不明顯的；巧妙的、含蓄的
words.ex: There is a subtle difference between these two shades of blue.
words.exZh: 這兩種藍色之間有細微的差別。

words.zh: （動植物）長得好；興旺、蓬勃發展
words.ex: Cactus plants thrive in hot and dry places.
words.exZh: 仙人掌在炎熱乾燥的地方長得很好。

words.ex: On a clear night, you can see countless stars in the sky.
words.exZh: 在晴朗的夜晚，你可以看見天上數不盡的星星。

words.zh: 有抱負的、有企圖心的；（計畫）宏大的、艱鉅的
words.ex: The ambitious student wants to finish three books this month.
words.exZh: 那位很有企圖心的學生想在這個月讀完三本書。

words.zh: 慈善、慈善事業；慈善機構
words.ex: The students sold cookies to raise money for charity.
words.exZh: 學生們賣餅乾來為慈善事業募款。

words.ex: You need prior permission before you use the school hall.
words.exZh: 使用學校禮堂之前，你需要事先取得許可。

words.zh: 有活力的、有幹勁的；動態的、不斷變化的
words.ex: She is a dynamic leader who inspires her team.
words.exZh: 她是個充滿活力的領導者，能鼓舞她的團隊。

words.ex: Being ten minutes late is not acceptable in this class.
words.exZh: 在這個班上，遲到十分鐘是不被接受的。

words.ex: A friendly workplace makes people happy to come to work every day.
words.exZh: 友善的職場讓人每天都樂於上班。

words.ex: Waiting for exam results can be very stressful for many students.
words.exZh: 等待考試成績對許多學生來說壓力很大。

words.ex: You need to register online before you join the swimming class.
words.exZh: 參加游泳課之前，你得先在線上註冊。

words.ex: Scientists analyze the water to see if it is clean.
words.exZh: 科學家分析水質，看它是否乾淨。

words.ex: Tax is excluded from the price shown on the sign.
words.exZh: 招牌上標示的價格不含稅。

words.ex: Your English has shown great improvement since last term.
words.exZh: 你的英文從上學期到現在進步很多。

words.ex: Fresh water is scarce in the dry parts of the world.
words.exZh: 在世界上乾燥的地區，淡水很稀少。

words.ex: Tourism helps many small towns earn money every year.
words.exZh: 觀光業幫助許多小鎮每年賺錢。

words.ex: Everyone in the class condemned the rude messages about the new student.
words.exZh: 全班都譴責那些針對新同學的無禮留言。

words.ex: Is this map accurate enough for our hike?
words.exZh: 這張地圖夠準確，可以用來健行嗎？

words.zh: 中立的；中性的、素色的（顏色）
words.ex: The teacher stayed neutral when two students argued.
words.exZh: 兩位學生爭論時，老師保持中立。

words.ex: Helping others made her feel her life was meaningful.
words.exZh: 幫助別人讓她覺得自己的生活很有意義。

words.ex: Taiwan has diverse food from many different cultures.
words.exZh: 臺灣有來自許多不同文化的多元美食。

words.ex: Buses and trains are common forms of transportation in big cities.
words.exZh: 公車和火車是大城市常見的交通工具。

words.zh: 挖出、揭開（遮蓋物）；揭露、查出（真相）
words.ex: Scientists uncovered a very old village under the sand.
words.exZh: 科學家在沙子底下挖出了一座非常古老的村莊。

words.ex: The library decided to extend its opening hours during exams.
words.exZh: 考試期間，圖書館決定延長開放時間。

words.ex: He wrote a short apology to his friend for breaking her pen.
words.exZh: 他弄壞了朋友的筆，於是寫了一張簡短的道歉字條給她。

words.zh: 劇烈的、戲劇性的；誇張的、愛演的
words.ex: There was a dramatic change in the weather this morning.
words.exZh: 今天早上的天氣出現了劇烈的變化。

words.ex: We had to alter our travel plans because of the typhoon.
words.exZh: 因為颱風，我們不得不改變旅行計畫。

words.ex: An immense whale swam slowly beside our small boat.
words.exZh: 一隻巨大的鯨魚在我們的小船旁緩緩游過。

words.ex: She stays optimistic even when the test is difficult.
words.exZh: 即使考試很難，她還是保持樂觀。

words.ex: Read the instructions carefully before you start the game.
words.exZh: 開始遊戲之前請先仔細讀說明。

words.ex: Children get a vaccine to protect them from serious illness.
words.exZh: 孩子們接種疫苗，以預防嚴重的疾病。

words.ex: The heavy rain disrupted bus service in the city this morning.
words.exZh: 大雨打亂了今天早上市區的公車班次。

words.ex: The company made drastic changes to save money last year.
words.exZh: 公司去年為了省錢做了大幅的改變。

words.ex: If the pain persists, you should see a doctor.
words.exZh: 如果疼痛一直持續，你應該去看醫生。

words.ex: Many people in this town work in the service sector.
words.exZh: 這個鎮上有許多人在服務業工作。

words.ex: The students asked for a reform of the old school rules.
words.exZh: 學生們要求改革舊的校規。

words.ex: With the teacher's guidance, we finished the science project.
words.exZh: 在老師的指導下，我們完成了自然科專題。

words.ex: This room is exclusive to teachers, so students cannot enter.
words.exZh: 這間房間是老師專用的，所以學生不能進去。

words.ex: Wolves protect their territory from other animals in the forest.
words.exZh: 狼會保護自己的地盤，不讓森林裡的其他動物進入。

words.ex: The school rules prohibit students from running in the hall.
words.exZh: 校規禁止學生在走廊奔跑。

words.ex: You must confront your fears one small step at a time.
words.exZh: 你必須一小步一小步地面對自己的恐懼。

words.ex: Tomatoes grow well in the warm greenhouse all winter.
words.exZh: 番茄整個冬天都在溫暖的溫室裡長得很好。

words.ex: We assembled the desk by following the pictures in the guide.
words.exZh: 我們照著說明書上的圖把書桌組裝起來。

words.zh: 意識到的、察覺的；清醒的、有意識的
words.ex: He was conscious of the noise behind him in the dark.
words.exZh: 在黑暗中，他察覺到身後有聲音。

words.ex: The library has an extensive collection of story books.
words.exZh: 這間圖書館收藏了大量的故事書。

words.ex: I agree with you to some extent, but not completely.
words.exZh: 我在某種程度上同意你，但不是完全同意。

words.ex: You have worked hard all week, so you deserve a good rest.
words.exZh: 你努力了一整個星期，應該好好休息一下。

words.ex: The students were enthusiastic about the class trip to the zoo.
words.exZh: 學生們對去動物園的校外教學充滿熱情。

words.ex: In a democracy, citizens can choose their leaders by voting.
words.exZh: 在民主國家，公民可以投票選出領導人。

words.ex: She tried to suppress her laughter during the quiet class.
words.exZh: 安靜的課堂上，她努力忍住不笑出來。

words.ex: Building the school garden was a big endeavor for our class.
words.exZh: 打造學校花園對我們班來說是一項艱鉅的嘗試。

words.ex: Fresh vegetables give our bodies many important nutrients.
words.exZh: 新鮮蔬菜提供我們身體許多重要的營養素。

words.ex: Rain is abundant in this area during the summer months.
words.exZh: 這個地區夏季的雨量很豐沛。

words.ex: This cheap pen is inferior to the one I bought last year.
words.exZh: 這支便宜的筆比我去年買的那支差。

words.ex: Good leadership means listening to every member of the team.
words.exZh: 好的領導代表要傾聽團隊裡每一位成員的意見。

words.ex: My older brother is independent and cooks for himself every day.
words.exZh: 我哥哥很獨立，每天都自己煮飯。

words.ex: Birds begin their long migration south when autumn comes.
words.exZh: 秋天來臨時，鳥類開始長途向南遷徙。

words.ex: Ignorance of the rules is not a good excuse for breaking them.
words.exZh: 不了解規則並不是違規的好藉口。

words.ex: We should not judge people with prejudice before we know them.
words.exZh: 在認識一個人之前，我們不該帶著偏見評斷他。

words.ex: She wrote a card to show her gratitude to the teacher.
words.exZh: 她寫了一張卡片向老師表達感激之情。

words.ex: The students devised a clever way to save water at school.
words.exZh: 學生們想出了一個在學校節約用水的聰明辦法。

words.ex: We can utilize old boxes to make toys for the children.
words.exZh: 我們可以利用舊紙箱為孩子們做玩具。

words.ex: We anticipate heavy traffic on the road this weekend.
words.exZh: 我們預料這個週末路上會大塞車。

words.ex: It is not ethical to copy another student's work.
words.exZh: 抄襲別的同學的作業是不道德的。

words.ex: The new phone needs minimal setup and works right away.
words.exZh: 這支新手機幾乎不用設定，馬上就能用。

words.ex: Please connect an external speaker to the computer.
words.exZh: 請在電腦上接一個外接喇叭。

words.zh: 混亂、雜亂；（身心）失調、疾病
words.ex: The classroom was in complete disorder after the class celebration.
words.exZh: 班上慶祝活動之後，教室一團混亂。

words.ex: The car began to accelerate as it entered the highway.
words.exZh: 車子開上高速公路後開始加速。

words.zh: 邊界、界線；（人際的）分寸、底線
words.ex: A low fence marks the boundary of our garden.
words.exZh: 一道矮籬笆標出我們花園的邊界。

words.zh: 重疊；（時間）撞期、部分重疊
words.ex: The two circles overlap in the middle of the page.
words.exZh: 兩個圓在頁面中間重疊。

words.zh: 承認；（公開）感謝；確認收到
words.ex: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
words.exZh: 他承認自己犯了錯。

words.ex: Dust will accumulate on the shelf if nobody cleans it.
words.exZh: 如果沒人打掃，架子上就會積灰塵。

words.ex: The test was somewhat harder than I expected.
words.exZh: 這次考試比我預期的難一點。

words.ex: Kindness is the essence of a good friendship.
words.exZh: 善良是好友誼的本質。

words.ex: Fishermen often exaggerate the size of the fish they caught.
words.exZh: 漁夫常常誇大他們釣到的魚有多大。

words.ex: The numbers on the map correspond to the list below.
words.exZh: 地圖上的數字和下面的清單相對應。

words.zh: 傳送、發送；傳染、傳播（疾病）
words.ex: Radio towers transmit signals to phones across the city.
words.exZh: 無線電塔把訊號傳送到全市的手機。

words.ex: She won a scholarship because of her excellent grades.
words.exZh: 她因為成績優異而得到獎學金。

words.ex: The little boy cried in distress when he lost his mother in the crowd.
words.exZh: 小男孩在人群中和媽媽走散時，難過得哭了起來。

words.ex: The duration of the movie is about two hours.
words.exZh: 這部電影片長大約兩小時。

words.zh: 透明的；公開的、清楚易懂的
words.ex: The water in the lake was so transparent that we saw the fish.
words.exZh: 湖水清澈透明，我們都看得到魚。

words.ex: Writing was an important step in the growth of civilization.
words.exZh: 文字是文明發展中重要的一步。

words.ex: The shop sells a wide array of colorful pens and notebooks.
words.exZh: 這家店賣各式各樣彩色的筆和筆記本。

words.ex: We stood and looked at the magnificent mountain view.
words.exZh: 我們站著欣賞壯麗的山景。

words.zh: 尊敬、尊重；尊重、敬重；方面、點
words.ex: We should show respect to older people on the bus.
words.exZh: 我們在公車上應該對年長的人表示尊重。

words.ex: Wash your hands before lunch, and likewise before dinner.
words.exZh: 午餐前要洗手，晚餐前也一樣。

words.ex: Small plants are dependent on sunlight and water.
words.exZh: 小植物依賴陽光和水生長。

words.ex: The clock has a small mechanism that moves the hands.
words.exZh: 這座時鐘有一個帶動指針的小機械裝置。

words.ex: We took a spontaneous trip to the beach when the weather turned nice.
words.exZh: 天氣一轉好，我們就臨時起意去了海邊。

words.ex: The writer of the letter wanted to stay anonymous.
words.exZh: 寫這封信的人想保持匿名。

words.ex: Heavy rain may compel us to cancel the picnic tomorrow.
words.exZh: 大雨可能會迫使我們取消明天的野餐。

words.ex: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for everyone in the car.
words.exZh: 車上每個人都必須繫安全帶，這是強制規定。

words.ex: This bakery has a good reputation for fresh bread.
words.exZh: 這家麵包店以新鮮麵包聞名。

words.ex: We need a viable plan to finish the project on time.
words.exZh: 我們需要一個可行的計畫，才能準時完成專題。

words.ex: Please share only the facts that are relevant to the topic.
words.exZh: 請只分享和主題相關的事實。

words.zh: 補充品、補給品；補充、增補
words.ex: Some people take a vitamin supplement every morning.
words.exZh: 有些人每天早上吃維他命補充劑。

words.ex: The trip to the museum takes approximately thirty minutes.
words.exZh: 去博物館的路程大約要三十分鐘。

words.ex: The old bridge was reportedly closed for repairs last week.
words.exZh: 據報導，那座舊橋上週因整修而封閉。

words.ex: Only a small minority of students wanted to change the plan.
words.exZh: 只有一小部分學生想要更改這個計畫。

words.zh: 考慮；體貼、體諒；考量的因素
words.ex: After careful consideration, we chose the cheaper train tickets.
words.exZh: 經過仔細考慮，我們選了比較便宜的火車票。

words.ex: Many adolescents need more sleep than adults do.
words.exZh: 許多青少年需要比大人更多的睡眠。

words.ex: The team comprises five students from different grades.
words.exZh: 這個隊伍由來自不同年級的五位學生組成。

words.zh: 特別優秀的；特殊的、例外的
words.ex: She is an exceptional student who reads far above her grade.
words.exZh: 她是個特別優秀的學生，閱讀程度遠超過她的年級。

words.ex: The school will implement a new recycling plan next month.
words.exZh: 學校下個月將實施新的資源回收計畫。

words.zh: 起重要作用的；樂器演奏的
words.ex: Her advice was instrumental in helping me choose a club.
words.exZh: 她的建議對我選社團起了很大的作用。

words.ex: There is a clear distinction between weather and climate.
words.exZh: 天氣和氣候之間有明確的區別。

words.ex: His fear of public speaking manifested itself in shaking hands.
words.exZh: 他對上台說話的恐懼表現在發抖的雙手上。

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is very high.
words.exZh: 明天下雨的機率很高。

words.ex: The small cafe earned more revenue during the summer.
words.exZh: 這家小咖啡店在夏天的營收增加了。

words.ex: Some medicines can induce sleep in a short time.
words.exZh: 有些藥物能在短時間內使人入睡。

words.zh: 簡單明瞭的；坦率的、直截了當的
words.ex: The test was straightforward, so most students finished early.
words.exZh: 這次考試很簡單明瞭，所以多數學生都提早交卷。

words.ex: You need a legitimate reason if you want to leave school early.
words.exZh: 如果你想提早離開學校，需要有正當的理由。

words.ex: Young plants are vulnerable to cold weather and strong wind.
words.exZh: 幼苗很容易受到寒冷天氣和強風的傷害。

words.ex: Good roads and bridges are part of a city's infrastructure.
words.exZh: 好的道路和橋梁是城市基礎建設的一部分。

words.ex: The company did not disclose the price of the new phone.
words.exZh: 那家公司沒有公布新手機的價格。

words.zh: 美學的、審美的；美感、風格
words.ex: She has a good aesthetic sense and chooses colors well.
words.exZh: 她很有審美眼光，很會挑選顏色。

words.zh: 職位相當的人、對應的事物
words.ex: The principal met his counterpart from the school across the river.
words.exZh: 校長和河對岸學校的校長見了面。

words.zh: 哲學的；豁達的、看得開的
words.ex: My uncle likes philosophical questions, such as what makes people happy.
words.exZh: 我叔叔喜歡哲學問題，例如什麼讓人快樂。

words.ex: His cough worsened after he walked home in the cold rain.
words.exZh: 他在冷雨中走路回家後，咳嗽變得更嚴重了。

words.ex: This old road is prone to flooding after heavy rain.
words.exZh: 這條老路在大雨後很容易淹水。

words.ex: Good teachers nurture curiosity by letting students ask questions.
words.exZh: 好老師會讓學生發問，藉此培養他們的好奇心。

words.ex: Let's not argue about such trivial things as the color of the poster.
words.exZh: 我們別為海報顏色這種小事爭吵了。

words.zh: 充滿活力的；（顏色）鮮豔的
words.ex: The night market is a vibrant place full of noise and laughter.
words.exZh: 夜市是個充滿活力、到處是喧鬧聲和笑聲的地方。

words.zh: 同時發生；（意見等）一致、相符
words.ex: This year, my birthday coincides with the Moon Festival.
words.exZh: 今年我的生日剛好和中秋節同一天。

words.ex: The jacket has intricate patterns that were sewn by hand.
words.exZh: 這件外套上有手工縫製的精細花紋。

words.ex: Heavy snow hindered the search for the lost hikers.
words.exZh: 大雪阻礙了搜尋失蹤登山客的行動。

words.ex: The sweet sauce complements the spicy chicken perfectly.
words.exZh: 甜甜的醬汁和辣雞肉搭配得恰到好處。

words.ex: English is a compulsory subject for all students at our school.
words.exZh: 英文是我們學校所有學生的必修科目。

words.ex: These plants flourish in warm and wet weather.
words.exZh: 這些植物在溫暖潮濕的天氣裡長得很茂盛。

words.ex: We need credible sources for our history report.
words.exZh: 我們的歷史報告需要可信的資料來源。

words.ex: The scientist's groundbreaking research changed how we treat the disease.
words.exZh: 那位科學家的突破性研究改變了我們治療這種病的方式。

words.ex: Our meeting was fruitful, and we finally agreed on a plan.
words.exZh: 我們的會議很有成果，終於對計畫達成共識。

words.zh: 沉浸於、專心於；浸入（液體）
words.ex: He immersed himself in the novel and forgot about dinner.
words.exZh: 他沉浸在小說裡，忘了吃晚餐。

words.ex: Turn off the lights when you leave to conserve electricity.
words.exZh: 離開時關燈以節約用電。

words.ex: Studies show that sleep time correlates with test scores.
words.exZh: 研究顯示睡眠時間和考試成績有關聯。

words.ex: The question was ambiguous, so students gave very different answers.
words.exZh: 這個題目意思模糊，所以學生給的答案差異很大。

words.ex: Can you envision what our town will look like in fifty years?
words.exZh: 你能想像五十年後我們的小鎮會是什麼樣子嗎？

words.ex: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning a new language.
words.exZh: 學新語言時，一本好字典是不可或缺的。

words.ex: You need a certain level of English proficiency to join the exchange program.
words.exZh: 參加交換計畫需要具備一定程度的英語能力。

words.ex: The typhoon destroyed the fishing boats that many families depend on for their livelihood.
words.exZh: 颱風摧毀了許多家庭賴以維生的漁船。

words.zh: 遵守、依照；忍受（多用於否定）

words.exZh: 所有選手都必須遵守比賽規則。

words.ex: This aerial photo shows the whole city from above.
words.exZh: 這張空拍照從上方拍下了整座城市。

words.ex: Many aquatic plants grow along the edges of this quiet lake.
words.exZh: 許多水生植物長在這座寧靜湖泊的岸邊。

words.ex: My father takes an aspirin when he has a bad headache.
words.exZh: 爸爸頭很痛的時候會吃一顆阿斯匹靈。

words.ex: We hired a babysitter to watch the kids on Saturday night.
words.exZh: 我們請了臨時保母星期六晚上照顧孩子。

words.ex: Many shops jumped on the bandwagon and started selling bubble tea.
words.exZh: 許多店家跟上潮流，開始賣珍珠奶茶。

words.ex: The microwave beeped to tell us the soup was ready.
words.exZh: 微波爐嗶了一聲，告訴我們湯熱好了。

words.ex: The typhoon caused a blackout in the whole town last night.
words.exZh: 颱風昨晚造成全鎮停電。

words.ex: Loud music blared from the car next to us at the red light.
words.exZh: 等紅燈時，旁邊那輛車傳出刺耳的大聲音樂。

words.ex: Each visitor gets a free booklet about the history of the old town.
words.exZh: 每位遊客都可以免費拿到一本介紹這座老城鎮歷史的小冊子。

words.ex: My aunt opened a small boutique that sells handmade bags.
words.exZh: 我阿姨開了一家賣手工包包的小精品店。

words.zh: 鼓起、塞得鼓鼓的；凸起、鼓起處
words.ex: His backpack bulges with books and snacks every Monday.
words.exZh: 每個星期一他的背包都塞滿書和零食，鼓鼓的。

words.ex: The bus ride up the mountain was long and bumpy.
words.exZh: 上山的公車路程又長又顛簸。

words.ex: The green color of the frog is perfect camouflage among the leaves.
words.exZh: 青蛙的綠色在樹葉間是完美的保護色。

words.ex: We paddled a canoe across the quiet lake in the morning.
words.exZh: 早上我們划獨木舟橫越平靜的湖面。

words.ex: A lion is a carnivore, so it eats only meat.
words.exZh: 獅子是肉食動物，所以只吃肉。

words.ex: The song is so catchy that the whole class keeps singing it.
words.exZh: 這首歌太朗朗上口了，全班一直在唱。

words.ex: Grandpa keeps potatoes and onions in the cool, dark cellar.
words.exZh: 爺爺把馬鈴薯和洋蔥放在陰涼黑暗的地窖裡。

words.ex: Birds were chirping outside my window early this morning.
words.exZh: 今天一大早鳥兒在我窗外啾啾叫。

words.ex: The baby has chubby cheeks and a big smile.
words.exZh: 這個寶寶有胖嘟嘟的臉頰和燦爛的笑容。

words.ex: I feel claustrophobic in small elevators with no windows.
words.exZh: 在沒有窗戶的小電梯裡我會有幽閉恐懼的感覺。

words.zh: 把⋯弄亂、塞滿；雜亂的東西
words.ex: Piles of old magazines cluttered the living room floor.
words.exZh: 一疊疊舊雜誌亂七八糟地堆滿客廳地板。

words.ex: The runner lost consciousness in the heat but woke up soon.
words.exZh: 那位跑者在高溫下失去知覺，但很快就醒了過來。

words.ex: Studying all night before a test can be counterproductive.
words.exZh: 考試前熬夜念書可能會適得其反。

words.zh: 臨時抱佛腳、死記硬背；把⋯塞進
words.ex: Many students cram for the exam the night before.
words.exZh: 很多學生在考前一晚臨時抱佛腳。

words.ex: Put the clean plates back in the kitchen cupboard, please.
words.exZh: 請把乾淨的盤子放回廚房的櫥櫃。

words.ex: It is customary to give red envelopes during the Lunar New Year.
words.exZh: 農曆新年送紅包是習俗。

words.ex: The new restaurant was full of diners on Friday night.
words.exZh: 新餐廳星期五晚上坐滿了用餐的客人。

words.ex: The old paper map disintegrated when I tried to open it.
words.exZh: 我想打開那張舊紙地圖時，它就碎掉了。

words.ex: The workers dismantled the stage after the concert.
words.exZh: 演唱會結束後工人把舞台拆掉。

words.zh: 有彈性的；鬆緊帶、橡皮筋
words.ex: These pants have an elastic waist, so they are comfortable.
words.exZh: 這條褲子是鬆緊褲頭，所以穿起來很舒服。

words.ex: My grandma likes to end every text message with a smiling emoji.
words.exZh: 我奶奶喜歡在每則簡訊結尾加一個笑臉表情符號。

words.ex: Many teenagers feel enslaved by their phones and social media.
words.exZh: 許多青少年覺得自己被手機和社群媒體綁住了。

words.ex: My uncle eschews sugar and eats only fresh fruit for dessert.
words.exZh: 我叔叔不吃糖，飯後甜點只吃新鮮水果。

words.ex: The empty building on our street has become an eyesore.
words.exZh: 我們街上那棟空屋已經變得很礙眼。

words.ex: On that fateful day, she decided to become a doctor.
words.exZh: 在那決定命運的一天，她決定要當醫生。

words.ex: The streets look festive with red lanterns everywhere.
words.exZh: 到處掛著紅燈籠，街上充滿節慶氣氛。

words.ex: A flake of snow landed on my nose and melted.
words.exZh: 一片雪花落在我的鼻子上融化了。

words.ex: Keep flammable things like paper away from the stove.
words.exZh: 像紙這類易燃的東西要遠離爐子。

words.ex: The hotel offers gourmet meals made by famous chefs.
words.exZh: 這家飯店供應由名廚烹調的精緻美食。

words.ex: Sheep graze on the green hills near the farm.
words.exZh: 羊群在農場附近的青翠山丘上吃草。

words.ex: My brother groaned in pain after he twisted his ankle.
words.exZh: 我弟弟扭到腳踝後痛得直呻吟。

words.ex: Warm weather hastened the melting of the snow on the mountain.
words.exZh: 溫暖的天氣加快了山上積雪融化的速度。

words.ex: Don't make a hasty decision before you know all the facts.
words.exZh: 在了解所有事實之前，別倉促做決定。

words.ex: The story about a shark in the river turned out to be a hoax.
words.exZh: 河裡有鯊魚的傳聞後來證實是一場騙局。

words.ex: The shelter tries to find humane ways to care for stray dogs.
words.exZh: 這間收容所努力用人道的方式照顧流浪狗。

words.ex: I have an itch on my back that I cannot reach.
words.exZh: 我背上有個地方癢，可是抓不到。

words.ex: This wool sweater makes my neck feel itchy all day.
words.exZh: 這件羊毛毛衣讓我的脖子整天覺得癢。

words.ex: Did you notice the new poster near the school gate?
words.exZh: 你有注意到校門口那張新海報嗎？

words.ex: Let me jot down the address of the museum before I forget it.
words.exZh: 趁還沒忘記，讓我把博物館的地址記下來。

words.ex: Put some lotion on your hands when the air is dry.
words.exZh: 空氣乾燥時，手上要擦點乳液。

words.zh: 糟糕的、差勁的；不舒服的
words.ex: The food was cold, and the service was lousy too.
words.exZh: 食物是冷的，服務也很差勁。

words.ex: This lens can magnify tiny insects so we can study them.
words.exZh: 這個鏡片可以放大小昆蟲，讓我們仔細觀察。

words.ex: We stood quietly and looked at the majestic mountains at sunrise.
words.exZh: 日出時我們靜靜站著，望著雄偉的群山。

words.ex: In the midst of the storm, the power suddenly went out.
words.exZh: 在暴風雨當中，突然停電了。

words.ex: That red bike is mine, but the blue one is my sister's.
words.exZh: 那台紅色腳踏車是我的，藍色那台是我妹妹的。

words.ex: The mischievous puppy hid my shoes under the sofa again.
words.exZh: 那隻調皮的小狗又把我的鞋子藏到沙發底下。

words.ex: Keep the soil moist so the young plants can grow well.
words.exZh: 讓土壤保持濕潤，幼苗才能長得好。

words.zh: 低聲說、喃喃自語；低語聲、潺潺聲
words.ex: The sleepy baby murmured something and then smiled.
words.exZh: 想睡的寶寶喃喃說了些什麼，然後笑了。

words.zh: 赤裸的、光禿禿的；肉眼的（不靠儀器）
words.ex: Baby birds are naked when they first come out of their eggs.
words.exZh: 小鳥剛破殼時身上光禿禿的，沒有羽毛。

words.ex: My obstinate grandfather still refuses to use a smartphone.
words.exZh: 我那固執的爺爺還是不肯用智慧型手機。

words.ex: The pilot jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.exZh: 飛行員跳出飛機，打開了降落傘。

words.zh: 使癱瘓（身體）；使停擺、使無法運作；使嚇呆、使動彈不得
words.ex: The accident paralyzed his legs, but he kept training hard.
words.exZh: 那場意外使他雙腿癱瘓，但他仍持續努力訓練。

words.ex: Cows were eating grass quietly in the green pasture.
words.exZh: 牛群在綠色的牧草地上安靜地吃草。

words.zh: （鳥）棲息、停在；坐在（高處或邊緣）
words.ex: A small bird perched on the edge of my window this morning.
words.exZh: 今天早上有一隻小鳥停在我的窗邊。

words.ex: We stayed in a picturesque village surrounded by tea fields.
words.exZh: 我們住在一個被茶園環繞、風景如畫的村莊。

words.ex: The family grows coffee on a large plantation in the mountains.
words.exZh: 這家人在山上的一座大型種植園種咖啡。

words.ex: She keeps her coins in a small leather pouch.
words.exZh: 她把零錢放在一個小皮袋裡。

words.ex: The author writes poems as well as prose about nature.
words.exZh: 這位作家除了寫詩，也寫關於大自然的散文。

words.ex: The band rehearsed for hours before the school concert.
words.exZh: 樂團在學校音樂會前排練了好幾個小時。

words.ex: The whole village rejoiced when the long dry season finally ended.
words.exZh: 漫長的乾季終於結束時，全村都歡欣鼓舞。

words.ex: This spray helps repel mosquitoes when we go camping.
words.exZh: 我們去露營時，這種噴霧有助於驅趕蚊子。

words.ex: We stayed indoors because the afternoon sun was scorching.
words.exZh: 因為午後的太陽太毒辣，我們都待在室內。

words.ex: Hungry seagulls flew over the boat, hoping for some fish.
words.exZh: 飢餓的海鷗在船的上空飛來飛去，想討點魚吃。

words.ex: The lake at dawn gave me a feeling of deep serenity.
words.exZh: 清晨的湖讓我感到非常平靜。

words.zh: 削尖、磨利；加強、提升（能力）
words.ex: Please sharpen your pencil before the drawing class starts.
words.exZh: 畫畫課開始前，請先把鉛筆削尖。

words.ex: The shrill whistle of the referee stopped the game.
words.exZh: 裁判刺耳的哨聲讓比賽停了下來。

words.ex: The gardener planted small shrubs along the school fence.
words.exZh: 園丁沿著學校圍牆種了一排小灌木。

words.ex: Grandpa likes to take a short snooze after lunch.
words.exZh: 爺爺喜歡在午飯後小睡一下。

words.ex: My dad snores so loudly that I can hear him upstairs.
words.exZh: 我爸打鼾很大聲，我在樓上都聽得到。

words.ex: Soy milk and tofu are both made from soybeans.
words.exZh: 豆漿和豆腐都是用黃豆做的。

words.ex: Visitors are amazed by the splendor of the ancient palace.
words.exZh: 遊客都對這座古老宮殿的壯麗感到驚嘆。

words.ex: She sprained her ankle while playing basketball yesterday.
words.exZh: 她昨天打籃球時扭傷了腳踝。

words.ex: If you subtract three from ten, you get seven.
words.exZh: 十減去三等於七。

words.ex: The little boy sucked the juice through a straw.
words.exZh: 小男孩用吸管把果汁吸光。

words.ex: We were too tired to cook, so we ordered a takeaway.
words.exZh: 我們累到不想煮飯，所以叫了外帶。

words.ex: My cat has a calm temperament and rarely gets angry.
words.exZh: 我的貓個性溫和，很少發脾氣。

words.ex: Her simple white dress has a timeless style.
words.exZh: 她那件簡單的白洋裝有一種不退流行的風格。

words.ex: The farmers toiled in the fields from sunrise to sunset.
words.exZh: 農夫們從日出到日落都在田裡辛勤工作。

words.ex: People in the city felt several small tremors last night.
words.exZh: 市區居民昨晚感覺到好幾次輕微的地震。

words.ex: He tucked the letter into his jacket pocket.
words.exZh: 他把信塞進夾克口袋裡。

words.ex: The birds built their nest with dry grass and twigs.
words.exZh: 鳥兒用乾草和細樹枝築巢。

words.ex: Even after losing the game, the team stayed upbeat.
words.exZh: 即使輸了比賽，球隊還是保持樂觀。

words.ex: Our dog always wags its tail when we come home.
words.exZh: 我們回家時，狗狗總是搖著尾巴。

words.zh: 揮舞、使用（工具）；擁有、行使（權力）
words.ex: The worker wielded a heavy hammer to break the old wall.
words.exZh: 工人揮動沉重的鐵鎚打掉舊牆。

words.ex: The flowers withered because nobody watered them for a week.
words.exZh: 因為一個星期都沒人澆水，花都枯萎了。

words.ex: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
words.exZh: 小心別在濕地板上滑倒。

words.ex: A beam of light came through the gap in the curtain.
words.exZh: 一道光束從窗簾的縫隙中透進來。

words.ex: A small spark from the campfire landed on the grass.
words.exZh: 營火冒出一個小火花，落在草地上。

words.ex: My computer monitor is too bright for my eyes.
words.exZh: 我的電腦螢幕對我的眼睛來說太亮了。

words.zh: 絆倒、踉蹌；結結巴巴（說話）；偶然發現
words.ex: I stumbled on a stone and almost fell down the steps.
words.exZh: 我被一顆石頭絆了一下，差點從台階上摔下去。

words.ex: Please put your signature at the bottom of the page.
words.exZh: 請在這頁的底部簽上你的名字。

words.zh: 圓柱、柱子；（報紙的）專欄；（表格的）欄、直行
words.ex: A tall stone column stands in front of the old library.
words.exZh: 一根高大的石柱立在老圖書館前面。

words.ex: There are twenty students altogether in our art club.
words.exZh: 我們美術社總共有二十個學生。

words.zh: 錨；新聞主播；固定、使穩固
words.ex: The sailors dropped the anchor near the quiet beach.
words.exZh: 水手們在安靜的海灘附近下了錨。

words.ex: A square has four right angles and four equal sides.
words.exZh: 正方形有四個直角和四個等長的邊。

words.zh: 爆裂、破掉；突然（哭、笑）起來
words.ex: The balloon burst with a loud bang in the classroom.
words.exZh: 氣球在教室裡砰的一聲爆掉了。

words.ex: Blend the milk and bananas together to make a sweet drink.
words.exZh: 把牛奶和香蕉打在一起，就能做出甜甜的飲料。

words.zh: 吹噓、自誇；擁有（值得自豪的事物）
words.ex: My cousin always boasts about his high test scores.
words.exZh: 我表哥總愛吹噓他考試考高分。

words.zh: 磁鐵；吸引人的人或地方
words.ex: A magnet can pick up small pieces of iron.
words.exZh: 磁鐵可以吸起小鐵片。

words.zh: 遙遠的、遠方的；冷淡的、疏遠的；（親戚）遠房的
words.ex: A distant train whistle woke me up early this morning.
words.exZh: 遠處的火車汽笛聲今天一早就把我吵醒了。

words.ex: Small children can play safely in the shallow water.
words.exZh: 小孩子可以安全地在淺水裡玩耍。

words.zh: 打擾；使困擾、使煩惱；費心、特地
words.ex: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me find this room?
words.exZh: 抱歉打擾你，可以幫我找一下這間教室嗎？

words.ex: Cut the stem of the flower before putting it in water.
words.exZh: 把花插進水裡前，先把花莖剪一下。

words.ex: The little boy tumbled down the grassy hill, laughing.
words.exZh: 小男孩笑著從草坡上滾了下去。

words.zh: 精煉、提煉；改進、使更完善
words.ex: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used in cars.
words.exZh: 原油必須先經過提煉，才能用在汽車上。

words.ex: Our teacher taught us a useful phrase for ordering food.
words.exZh: 老師教了我們一個點餐時很好用的說法。

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to protect the fish in the sea.
words.exZh: 兩國簽署了一項保護海中魚類的協議。

words.ex: I put all my stuff into the bag and left for school.
words.exZh: 我把所有東西放進書包，就出門上學了。

words.ex: We heard a loud boom, and then the lights went out.
words.exZh: 我們聽到一聲巨大的轟隆聲，接著燈就熄了。

words.ex: This bag of rice weighs about five pounds.
words.exZh: 這袋米大約重五磅。

words.zh: 面板、控制板；專家小組、評審團
words.ex: Press the button on the control panel to start.
words.exZh: 按下控制面板上的按鈕就能開始。

words.ex: This old myth explains why the moon changes its shape.
words.exZh: 這個古老的神話解釋了月亮為什麼會改變形狀。

words.zh: 小溪；串流（播放）；一連串、源源不斷
words.ex: We sat by the stream and put our feet in the cool water.
words.exZh: 我們坐在小溪邊，把腳泡在涼涼的水裡。

words.zh: 音量；容量、體積；（書的）冊、卷
words.ex: Please turn down the volume because the baby is sleeping.
words.exZh: 寶寶在睡覺，請把音量調小。

words.zh: 破壞、毀掉；寵壞；（食物）壞掉
words.ex: Do not spoil the surprise by telling everyone.
words.exZh: 別把這件事告訴大家，破壞了驚喜。

words.zh: 駕駛、掌舵；引導（話題、方向）
words.ex: He used both hands to steer the boat past the rocks.
words.exZh: 他用雙手掌舵，讓船避開岩石。

words.zh: 英俊的、好看的；（金額）可觀的
words.ex: The handsome actor in the movie wore a simple gray coat.
words.exZh: 電影裡那位英俊的演員穿著一件簡單的灰色外套。

words.zh: （身體）僵硬的、痠痛的；硬的、不易彎的；（競爭）激烈的
words.ex: My neck felt stiff after sleeping in a strange position.
words.exZh: 我用怪姿勢睡覺後，脖子覺得僵硬。

words.ex: The wheel began to rotate slowly when the wind blew.
words.exZh: 風一吹，輪子就開始慢慢轉動。

words.ex: The nurse will inject the medicine into your arm.
words.exZh: 護理師會把藥打進你的手臂。

words.ex: We watched the sun sink slowly below the horizon.
words.exZh: 我們看著太陽慢慢沉到地平線下。

words.ex: Everyone applauded when the little girl finished her song.
words.exZh: 小女孩唱完歌時，大家都鼓掌了。

words.zh: 擦亮；亮光劑、指甲油；潤飾、改進
words.ex: I polish my shoes every Sunday morning before we go out.
words.exZh: 我每個星期天早上出門前都會把鞋子擦亮。

words.ex: One half is a simple fraction that every student learns early.
words.exZh: 二分之一是每個學生很早就會學到的簡單分數。

words.zh: 投、拋；演員陣容；石膏（固定骨折）
words.ex: The fisherman cast his line far into the quiet water.
words.exZh: 漁夫把釣線遠遠拋進平靜的水裡。

words.ex: A funny clown tried to entertain the children at the school fair.
words.exZh: 一位逗趣的小丑努力在園遊會上逗孩子們開心。

words.zh: 後面的；後方、後部；養育、飼養
words.ex: The rear door of the bus is broken.
words.exZh: 公車的後門壞了。

words.ex: My knee joint hurts after running up the stairs.
words.exZh: 跑上樓梯後我的膝關節會痛。

words.zh: 使恢復精神、使清爽；重新整理（網頁）；喚起（記憶）
words.ex: A cold shower can refresh you on a hot summer day.
words.exZh: 炎熱的夏天沖個冷水澡能讓你神清氣爽。

words.ex: The tall trees sway gently when the wind blows over the hill.
words.exZh: 風吹過山丘時，高大的樹木輕輕搖擺。

words.ex: Too much sun gave me a red rash on my arm.
words.exZh: 曬太多太陽，我的手臂起了紅疹。

words.zh: （鬼魂）出沒；縈繞心頭、使困擾；常去的地方
words.ex: People say a ghost haunts the old house at the end of the street.
words.exZh: 大家說街尾那棟老房子鬧鬼。

words.zh: 居住、棲息；老是想著、糾結
words.ex: Some small animals dwell under rocks near the stream.
words.exZh: 有些小動物棲息在溪邊的石頭底下。

words.ex: Write your notes in the margin of the page.
words.exZh: 把你的筆記寫在頁面的空白處。

words.ex: It took us five hours to reach the summit of the mountain.
words.exZh: 我們花了五個小時才爬到山頂。

words.zh: 過夜的、夜間的；一夜之間、突然
words.ex: We took an overnight train to the south.
words.exZh: 我們搭了一班夜車前往南部。

words.ex: She jumped over the last hurdle and crossed the finish line first.
words.exZh: 她跳過最後一個跨欄，第一個衝過終點線。

words.ex: The Earth takes one year to revolve around the sun.
words.exZh: 地球繞太陽一圈要花一年的時間。

words.zh: 尺寸、大小；面向、層面；維度、次元
words.ex: Please measure the dimensions of the box before you buy a shelf.
words.exZh: 買架子之前，請先量一量這個箱子的尺寸。

words.zh: 說出、發出（聲音）；完全的、徹底的
words.ex: The scared boy could not utter a single word.
words.exZh: 那個嚇壞的男孩一個字也說不出來。

words.ex: Strong winds can overturn small boats on the lake.
words.exZh: 強風可能會吹翻湖上的小船。

words.ex: Farmers reap the rice in the fields in late autumn.
words.exZh: 農夫在深秋時收割田裡的稻子。

words.zh: （疾病）會傳染的；（情緒）有感染力的
words.ex: Stay home this week because the flu is very contagious.
words.exZh: 這星期待在家，因為流感的傳染力很強。

words.zh: 好客的、殷勤的；（環境）適宜的
words.ex: The villagers were very hospitable and invited us for dinner.
words.exZh: 村民們非常好客，還邀我們一起吃晚餐。

words.zh: 責任、義務；值班、值勤；稅、關稅
words.ex: It is your duty to feed the class fish every day.
words.exZh: 每天餵班上的魚是你的責任。

words.ex: I practiced my presentation three times before class.
words.exZh: 上課前我把我的報告練習了三次。

words.ex: In my leisure time, I read comic books and draw.
words.exZh: 空閒時我會看漫畫和畫畫。

words.ex: The hourly wage for this summer job is quite good.
words.exZh: 這份暑期工作的時薪相當不錯。

words.ex: Stealing from a shop is a crime in every country.
words.exZh: 在每個國家，從商店偷東西都是犯罪。

words.ex: A broad river runs along the edge of the town.
words.exZh: 一條寬闊的河流沿著小鎮邊緣流過。

words.ex: Please select one topic for your speech from this list.
words.exZh: 請從這份清單中挑選一個演講主題。

words.ex: He cannot deny that he ate the last piece of cake.
words.exZh: 他無法否認最後一塊蛋糕是他吃掉的。

words.ex: Some countries in the world make electricity from nuclear energy.
words.exZh: 世界上有些國家用核能來發電。

words.ex: A fierce wind blew all night and shook the windows.
words.exZh: 猛烈的風吹了一整夜，把窗戶吹得嘎嘎作響。

words.ex: Our team hopes to defeat the top team next week.
words.exZh: 我們的隊伍希望下週能擊敗第一名的隊伍。

words.ex: A volunteer will assist you if you need any help.
words.exZh: 如果你需要幫忙，會有志工協助你。

words.zh: 不像、與…不同；不符合…的作風
words.ex: She is unlike her brother because she likes early mornings.
words.exZh: 她不像她哥哥，她喜歡早起。

words.ex: Don't hesitate to ask questions if you don't understand.
words.exZh: 如果不懂，別猶豫，儘管發問。

words.zh: 廣大的、遼闊的；大量的、極多的
words.ex: A vast desert lay ahead of the travelers.
words.exZh: 一片遼闊的沙漠橫在旅人們的前方。

words.ex: I cannot say with certainty when the bus will arrive.
words.exZh: 我沒辦法確定公車什麼時候會來。

words.zh: 簡短的；短暫的；向…簡報、簡要說明
words.ex: Please give a brief answer because time is almost up.
words.exZh: 時間快到了，請簡短回答。

words.ex: The first phase of the school project is finished.
words.exZh: 學校專題的第一階段已經完成了。

words.ex: Long ago, only the elite could read and write.
words.exZh: 很久以前，只有菁英階層會讀書寫字。

words.ex: Our team has a lot at stake in tomorrow's final match.
words.exZh: 明天的決賽對我們隊來說關係重大。

words.zh: 抑制、控制；路緣、人行道邊
words.ex: Parents try to curb the time children spend on games.
words.exZh: 家長試著限制孩子玩遊戲的時間。

words.ex: There is a strange object on the floor under the bed.
words.exZh: 床底下的地板上有一個奇怪的東西。

words.ex: The police warned people about phone fraud in the area.
words.exZh: 警方提醒民眾當地有電話詐騙。

words.zh: 有效的；合理的、有根據的
words.ex: Your ticket is valid for one day only.
words.exZh: 你的票只有一天有效。

words.ex: The school plans to equip every classroom with a new screen.
words.exZh: 學校計畫為每間教室配備新的螢幕。

words.ex: You can omit the last question if you run out of time.
words.exZh: 如果時間不夠，你可以省略最後一題。

words.ex: There was chaos in the kitchen when ten guests arrived early.
words.exZh: 十位客人提早抵達時，廚房裡亂成一團。

words.zh: 令人憂心的、嚴峻的；嚴肅的、陰沉的
words.ex: The weather report looks grim for our camping trip this weekend.
words.exZh: 這週末露營的天氣預報看起來很不樂觀。

words.zh: 計畫、方案；詭計、陰謀；配置、（色彩）搭配
words.ex: The town has a new scheme to plant more trees along the roads.
words.exZh: 這個鎮有一項沿路多種樹的新計畫。

words.ex: We saw a lot of wildlife on our walk through the forest.
words.exZh: 我們穿過森林散步時看到了許多野生動物。

words.ex: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my speech.
words.exZh: 老師對我的演講給了很有用的回饋。

words.zh: 穩固的、不搖晃的；穩定的；馬廄
words.ex: Make sure the ladder is stable before you climb it.
words.exZh: 爬梯子之前，先確定梯子很穩固。

words.ex: She wrote a card to show her appreciation for the teacher's help.
words.exZh: 她寫了一張卡片，感謝老師的幫忙。

words.ex: The whole family felt deep grief after they lost their old dog.
words.exZh: 失去老狗之後，一家人都感到深深的悲痛。

words.ex: The coach did not criticize him but gave him some advice.
words.exZh: 教練沒有批評他，而是給了他一些建議。

words.ex: We won the game by sheer luck, not by skill.
words.exZh: 我們完全是靠運氣贏了比賽，不是靠技術。

words.ex: The teacher will assess our work by reading each report.
words.exZh: 老師會透過閱讀每份報告來評量我們的作業。

words.ex: The young celebrity waved at the fans outside the hall.
words.exZh: 那位年輕的名人向大廳外的粉絲揮手。

words.ex: I cooked dinner; meanwhile, my brother set the table.
words.exZh: 我煮晚餐，同時我弟弟擺好餐桌。

words.zh: 處理、著手解決；（運動）擒抱、攔截
words.ex: Let's tackle the hardest homework problem first before dinner.
words.exZh: 我們吃晚餐前先來解決最難的那題功課吧。

words.ex: The old teacher left a legacy of kindness in our town.
words.exZh: 那位老教師在我們鎮上留下了善良的精神遺產。

words.ex: The food festival has dishes from many ethnic groups in the city.
words.exZh: 這場美食節有來自城裡許多族群的菜餚。

words.ex: We have ample time to finish the project.
words.exZh: 我們有充裕的時間完成這項專題。

words.ex: The journalist asked the coach three questions after the game.
words.exZh: 比賽結束後，記者問了教練三個問題。

words.ex: Please verify your answers before you hand in the test.
words.exZh: 交卷前請先確認你的答案。

words.ex: Every student made a pledge to keep the school clean.
words.exZh: 每位學生都承諾要保持學校整潔。

words.ex: You can guess the word's meaning from the context.
words.exZh: 你可以從上下文猜出這個字的意思。

words.ex: My swimming coach is also a mentor who gives me good advice.
words.exZh: 我的游泳教練也是常給我好建議的良師。

words.ex: Students must cooperate to finish the group project on time.
words.exZh: 學生們必須合作，才能準時完成小組報告。

words.ex: A local shop agreed to sponsor our school sports day.
words.exZh: 當地一家商店同意贊助我們學校的運動會。

words.zh: 堅稱、斷言；維護、表明（主見）
words.ex: He asserted that the answer was correct and showed his notes.
words.exZh: 他堅稱答案是對的，並拿出他的筆記。

words.ex: The school explained its stance on using phones in class.
words.exZh: 學校說明了它對於在課堂使用手機的立場。

words.ex: Patience is a virtue when you learn a new skill.
words.exZh: 學新技能時，耐心是一種美德。

words.ex: The neighbors had a dispute about the noise.
words.exZh: 鄰居們為了噪音起了爭執。

words.ex: A basketball is a sphere, so it rolls in every direction.
words.exZh: 籃球是球體，所以會往各個方向滾動。

words.ex: With hard work, you can attain your goals.
words.exZh: 只要努力，你就能達成目標。

words.zh: 招募、招收；新成員、新進人員
words.ex: The club wants to recruit new members this fall.
words.exZh: 社團想在今年秋天招募新成員。

words.ex: The city built new parks for the welfare of its people.
words.exZh: 這座城市為了市民的福祉蓋了新公園。

words.ex: You need your parents' consent to join the school trip.
words.exZh: 你需要父母的同意才能參加校外教學。

words.ex: Curiosity made the little girl open the old box.
words.exZh: 好奇心驅使小女孩打開了那個舊盒子。

words.zh: 使轉向、改道；轉移（注意力）
words.ex: The police diverted cars away from the road because of the flood.
words.exZh: 因為淹水，警方讓車輛改道避開那條路。

words.zh: 違反（規定）；侵犯（隱私、權利）
words.ex: Drivers who violate the traffic rules must pay a fine.
words.exZh: 違反交通規則的駕駛人必須繳罰款。

words.zh: 接受（手術、檢查）；經歷（變化）
words.ex: My uncle will undergo a small operation next Monday.
words.exZh: 我叔叔下週一要接受一個小手術。

words.ex: Thank you for the nice compliment about my drawing.
words.exZh: 謝謝你稱讚我的畫。

words.ex: I have a dentist appointment at four o'clock tomorrow.
words.exZh: 我明天下午四點和牙醫有約。

words.zh: 慢性的（疾病）；長期的、一直存在的
words.ex: My uncle has a chronic cough and sees a doctor often.
words.exZh: 我叔叔有慢性咳嗽，常去看醫生。

words.zh: 一群、一串、一簇；聚集、群集
words.ex: A cluster of tiny stars shone in the night sky.
words.exZh: 夜空中有一群小小的星星在閃爍。

words.zh: 觀點、看法；觀景點、觀景台
words.ex: Try to listen to a different viewpoint before you argue.
words.exZh: 在爭辯之前，先試著聽聽不同的看法。

words.ex: Her pursuit of a music career took years of practice.
words.exZh: 她為了追求音樂事業，付出了多年的練習。

words.zh: 移居者、外來工作者；遷徙的
words.ex: Many migrants come to the city to look for work.
words.exZh: 許多外地人來到城市找工作。

words.ex: Could you clarify what you mean by that last sentence?
words.exZh: 你可以說明一下最後那句話是什麼意思嗎？

words.zh: 有敵意的、不友善的；（環境）惡劣的、不利的
words.ex: The crowd was hostile to the referee after the unfair call.
words.exZh: 群眾因不公平的判決而對裁判充滿敵意。

words.ex: It is unlikely that it will rain on such a clear day.
words.exZh: 這麼晴朗的日子不太可能下雨。

words.ex: He tried to conceal the gift behind his back.
words.exZh: 他試著把禮物藏在背後。

words.ex: Each candidate for the job had to answer ten questions.
words.exZh: 每位應徵這份工作的人都得回答十個問題。

words.ex: There is no logic in going out without a coat in winter.
words.exZh: 冬天不穿外套就出門，實在沒道理。

words.ex: Some shoppers decided to boycott the store after it raised prices.
words.exZh: 那家店漲價之後，有些顧客決定抵制它。

words.ex: The rough terrain made the hike slow and tiring.
words.exZh: 崎嶇的地形讓這趟健行又慢又累。

words.ex: She worked hard to surpass her own best score in math.
words.exZh: 她努力想超越自己在數學上的最高分。

words.ex: Many countries have decided to abolish old and unfair rules.
words.exZh: 許多國家已決定廢除老舊又不公平的規定。

words.ex: Imagine this scenario: your bike breaks down far from home.
words.exZh: 想像這個情況：你的腳踏車在離家很遠的地方壞掉了。

words.ex: Draw two parallel lines on the paper with a ruler.
words.exZh: 用尺在紙上畫兩條平行線。

words.ex: This small device helps regulate the temperature of the room.
words.exZh: 這個小裝置能幫忙調節房間的溫度。

words.ex: Many birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
words.exZh: 天氣變冷時，許多鳥會往南遷徙。

words.ex: Doctors isolate sick patients so the illness does not spread.
words.exZh: 醫生把生病的病人隔離開來，避免疾病擴散。

words.ex: I faced a dilemma: sleep early or finish my homework.
words.exZh: 我陷入兩難：要早點睡，還是把功課寫完。

words.ex: Students under eighteen are eligible for a cheaper ticket.
words.exZh: 十八歲以下的學生有資格買比較便宜的票。

words.ex: I cherish the time I spend with my grandparents in summer.
words.exZh: 我很珍惜夏天和祖父母相處的時光。

words.ex: Please refrain from using your phone during the test.
words.exZh: 考試期間請勿使用手機。

words.ex: The teacher gave us explicit instructions for the project.
words.exZh: 老師給了我們這份作業明確的說明。

words.ex: Each component of the machine must be checked carefully.
words.exZh: 機器的每個零件都必須仔細檢查。

words.ex: Love and freedom are abstract ideas that are hard to draw.
words.exZh: 愛和自由是很難畫出來的抽象概念。

words.ex: Teachers from many schools met at a conference last week.
words.exZh: 上星期，許多學校的老師在一場研討會上見面。

words.ex: My uncle left his small shop for a corporate job in the city.
words.exZh: 我叔叔離開自己的小店，到城裡的企業上班。

words.ex: The doctor diagnosed my cough as a mild cold.
words.exZh: 醫生診斷我的咳嗽是輕微的感冒。

words.ex: Cleaning up the park together shows our civic pride.
words.exZh: 一起清潔公園展現了我們身為市民的榮譽感。

words.zh: 取回、找回；讀取、檢索（資料）
words.ex: The dog jumped into the pond to retrieve the ball.
words.exZh: 那隻狗跳進池塘把球叼回來。

words.zh: 整體的、全部的；總體而言
words.ex: The overall cost of the trip was lower than we expected.
words.exZh: 這趟旅行的總費用比我們預期的低。

words.ex: We felt great sympathy for the boy who lost his pet.
words.exZh: 我們很同情那個失去寵物的男孩。

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.exZh: 這支隊伍踢進第一球後氣勢大增。

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct when winter comes.
words.exZh: 冬天來臨時，鳥類憑本能往南飛。

words.ex: The magician created an illusion that the box was floating.
words.exZh: 魔術師製造出箱子飄在空中的錯覺。

words.ex: We had to modify the plan because of the heavy rain.
words.exZh: 因為下大雨，我們必須修改計畫。

words.ex: Space is a frontier that people have only begun to explore.
words.exZh: 太空是人類才剛開始探索的新領域。

words.ex: The pain will diminish after you rest for a few days.
words.exZh: 休息幾天後，疼痛就會減輕。

words.ex: She conceived the idea for the game while waiting for the bus.
words.exZh: 她在等公車時想出了這個遊戲的點子。

words.ex: A good judge always tries to bring justice to everyone.
words.exZh: 好法官總是努力為每個人伸張正義。

words.ex: The irony is that the weatherman forgot his own umbrella.
words.exZh: 諷刺的是，氣象播報員自己忘了帶傘。

words.ex: Small arguments can escalate quickly if nobody stays calm.
words.exZh: 如果沒有人保持冷靜，小爭吵可能很快就會升高惡化。

words.ex: I am inclined to stay home if it rains all afternoon.
words.exZh: 如果下一整個下午的雨，我傾向留在家裡。

words.ex: This program can simulate the weather on a different planet.
words.exZh: 這個程式可以模擬另一個行星上的天氣。

words.ex: Engineers optimize the app so it runs faster on old phones.
words.exZh: 工程師優化這個應用程式，讓它在舊手機上跑得更快。

words.ex: Joining the school cleaning team is voluntary, not required.
words.exZh: 加入學校的打掃小組是自願的，不是強制的。

words.ex: The shop gives students a small discount as an incentive to come back.
words.exZh: 這家店給學生一點折扣，作為吸引他們再來的誘因。

words.zh: 相反的、顛倒的；扭轉、使反轉；倒車、往後退
words.ex: Please read the list in reverse order, starting from the bottom.
words.exZh: 請從最下面開始，用相反的順序唸這份名單。

words.zh: 統計資料、統計數字；統計學
words.ex: The statistics show that more students ride bikes to school.
words.exZh: 統計資料顯示，越來越多學生騎腳踏車上學。

words.ex: Don't let your phone interfere with your homework.
words.exZh: 別讓手機干擾你寫功課。

words.ex: The company decided to terminate the old contract at the end of May.
words.exZh: 公司決定在五月底終止舊合約。

words.zh: 引用、引述；舉出（理由、例子）
words.ex: Please cite the book you used in your report.
words.exZh: 請在你的報告中註明引用的書。

words.ex: The school made a radical change to its schedule.
words.exZh: 學校對課表做了徹底的改變。

words.zh: 道地的；真正的、非仿冒的
words.ex: This small restaurant serves authentic noodles made by hand.
words.exZh: 這家小餐館供應手工製作的道地麵條。

words.zh: 相等的、等值的；相等物、對應的東西
words.ex: In math class, we learned that two halves are equivalent to one whole.
words.exZh: 我們在數學課學到，兩個一半等於一個整體。

words.ex: My aunt brought back some exotic fruits from her trip.
words.exZh: 我阿姨從旅行帶回了一些異國水果。

words.ex: New students soon integrate into the class through games.
words.exZh: 新同學很快就透過遊戲融入班級。

words.ex: The teacher had to intervene when the two boys began to argue.
words.exZh: 兩個男生開始爭吵時，老師必須出面介入。

words.zh: 包容的；包含在內的、包括的
words.ex: The club tries to be inclusive, so everyone can join the games.
words.exZh: 這個社團努力保持包容，讓每個人都能參加遊戲。

words.ex: The road is notorious for heavy traffic at rush hour.
words.exZh: 這條路尖峰時段塞車嚴重是出了名的。

words.zh: 緊張（氣氛）；拉力、緊繃程度
words.ex: There was tension in the room before the test results came.
words.exZh: 成績公布前，房間裡的氣氛很緊張。

words.ex: The town is notable for its beautiful old bridge.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮以美麗的老橋聞名。

words.zh: 提取、萃取；拔出、取出；摘錄、選段
words.ex: People extract oil from olives to use in cooking.
words.exZh: 人們從橄欖中提取油來做菜。

words.ex: The school will enforce the new rule about phones.
words.exZh: 學校將會執行關於手機的新規定。

words.ex: We reached a compromise: we would watch one movie and play one game.
words.exZh: 我們達成妥協：看一部電影，再玩一場遊戲。

words.ex: People speculate about what the new phone will look like.
words.exZh: 大家都在猜測新手機會長什麼樣子。

words.ex: Prolonged sitting in front of a screen can hurt your back.
words.exZh: 長時間坐在螢幕前會傷害你的背。

words.ex: Her excuse for being late sounded plausible, so the teacher believed her.
words.exZh: 她遲到的理由聽起來很合理，所以老師相信了她。

words.ex: The desert seemed to have perpetual sunshine and almost no rain.
words.exZh: 那片沙漠似乎永遠都是晴天，幾乎不下雨。

words.ex: Lightning usually precedes the sound of thunder by a few seconds.
words.exZh: 閃電通常比雷聲早幾秒出現。

words.zh: 出席、參加；上（學）、就讀；照料、處理
words.ex: Every student must attend the meeting in the hall today.
words.exZh: 每位學生今天都必須參加禮堂的集會。

words.ex: After a good harvest, the outlook for local farmers is bright.
words.exZh: 豐收之後，當地農民的前景一片光明。

words.zh: 被動的、消極的；（文法）被動語態
words.ex: He is too passive in class and rarely asks questions.
words.exZh: 他上課太被動，很少發問。

words.ex: The singer received tremendous applause from the crowd.
words.exZh: 那位歌手獲得觀眾熱烈的掌聲。

words.ex: The plan to cut down the old trees caused public outrage.
words.exZh: 砍掉老樹的計畫引起了大眾的憤慨。

words.zh: 判斷力、判斷；（法院的）判決
words.ex: Good judgment helps you make wise choices in daily life.
words.exZh: 良好的判斷力能幫你在日常生活中做出明智的選擇。

words.ex: Is this charger compatible with my old phone?
words.exZh: 這個充電器跟我的舊手機相容嗎？

words.ex: There is a pronounced difference between summer and winter here.
words.exZh: 這裡的夏天和冬天差別很明顯。

words.ex: I bought the toy on impulse and later felt sorry.
words.exZh: 我一時衝動買了那個玩具，後來很後悔。

words.ex: It is a stereotype that all teenagers love to play video games.
words.exZh: 認為所有青少年都愛打電玩是一種刻板印象。

words.ex: The nurse treated every patient with kindness and compassion.
words.exZh: 那位護理師以親切和同情心對待每位病人。

words.zh: 利用（自然力量）；安全吊帶、挽具
words.ex: Solar panels harness the power of the sun.
words.exZh: 太陽能板利用太陽的能量。

words.ex: Many kinds of birds inhabit the wetland near our town.
words.exZh: 許多種鳥棲息在我們鎮附近的濕地。

words.zh: 使退化、使品質下降；貶低、侮辱
words.ex: Strong sunlight can degrade plastic and make it weak.
words.exZh: 強烈的陽光會讓塑膠劣化變脆弱。

words.ex: We classify the books by subject on these shelves.
words.exZh: 我們把這些架上的書按科目分類。

words.ex: Everyone should be treated with dignity and respect.
words.exZh: 每個人都應該受到有尊嚴且尊重的對待。

words.ex: A pedestrian waited at the corner for the light to turn green.
words.exZh: 一位行人在街角等燈號變綠。

words.ex: The teacher used an analogy to compare the heart to a pump.
words.exZh: 老師用類比的方式，把心臟比喻成幫浦。

words.zh: 智力的、知性的；知識分子
words.ex: Puzzles and chess are great for a child's intellectual growth.
words.exZh: 拼圖和下棋對孩子的智力發展很有幫助。

words.ex: A single candle illuminated the whole small room.
words.exZh: 一根蠟燭就照亮了整個小房間。

words.ex: The teacher gave us a comprehensive list of things to review.
words.exZh: 老師給了我們一份全面的複習清單。

words.ex: Please do not contradict your teacher in front of the class.
words.exZh: 請不要在全班面前反駁老師。

words.ex: The new school rule caused a lot of controversy among parents.
words.exZh: 新的校規在家長之間引起很大的爭議。

words.ex: A rational person thinks carefully before making a big choice.
words.exZh: 理性的人在做重大決定前會仔細思考。

words.ex: A positive mindset helps you learn from mistakes.
words.exZh: 正向的心態能幫助你從錯誤中學習。

words.ex: Fire was one of the most useful discoveries in the history of mankind.
words.exZh: 火是人類歷史上最有用的發現之一。

words.ex: It was hard to comprehend the long science article at first.
words.exZh: 一開始要理解那篇長長的科學文章很困難。

words.zh: 失望；令人失望的人或事
words.ex: He hid his disappointment when he lost the game.
words.exZh: 他輸了比賽，卻把失望藏在心裡。

words.ex: In the realm of science, curiosity is very important.
words.exZh: 在科學領域裡，好奇心非常重要。

words.ex: The buses come at intervals of fifteen minutes.
words.exZh: 公車每隔十五分鐘來一班。

words.ex: Wearing a coat on a cold day is a sensible choice.
words.exZh: 冷天穿外套是明智的選擇。

words.ex: The narrative of the novel is told through a young girl's eyes.
words.exZh: 這本小說的故事是透過一個小女孩的眼睛來敘述的。

words.zh: 精密的、先進的；有品味的、見多識廣的
words.ex: This sophisticated machine can sort thousands of letters in an hour.
words.exZh: 這台精密的機器一小時可以分類好幾千封信。

words.zh: 敏銳的；嚴重的、劇烈的；急性的
words.ex: Dogs have an acute sense of smell and find things quickly.
words.exZh: 狗的嗅覺很敏銳，能很快找到東西。

words.ex: The test was hard, but she did well nonetheless.
words.exZh: 考試很難，但她還是考得很好。

words.zh: 鮮明的、明顯的；荒涼的、光禿的
words.ex: There is a stark difference between city life and farm life.
words.exZh: 城市生活和農村生活有著明顯的差別。

words.ex: A surge of visitors arrived when the festival opened.
words.exZh: 節慶一開幕，大批遊客湧入。

words.ex: Two classes will collaborate on a big poster for the school fair.
words.exZh: 兩個班會合作為園遊會做一張大海報。

words.ex: Dinner will be ready soon, and in the meantime you can set the table.
words.exZh: 晚餐快好了，這段時間你可以先擺好餐具。

words.zh: 始終如一的、穩定的；一致的、相符的
words.ex: Her grades have been consistent all through the year.
words.exZh: 她的成績整年都很穩定。

words.ex: The teacher was sympathetic when I said I felt sick.
words.exZh: 我說身體不舒服時，老師很體諒我。

words.ex: The store was full, so we went elsewhere for dinner.
words.exZh: 那家店客滿了，所以我們去別的地方吃晚餐。

words.ex: A small boat sailed alongside the big ship.
words.exZh: 一艘小船在大船旁邊並排航行。

words.ex: The teacher gave us a simple framework for writing essays.
words.exZh: 老師給了我們一個寫作文的簡單架構。

words.ex: The new nurse is very competent and never makes careless mistakes.
words.exZh: 新來的護理師很能幹，從不犯粗心的錯誤。

words.zh: 密集的、集中的；加護的（醫療）
words.ex: She joined an intensive summer course to improve her writing.
words.exZh: 她參加了密集的暑期課程來加強寫作。

words.zh: 使不知所措、使難以承受；淹沒、壓倒
words.ex: Too much homework can overwhelm a tired student on Monday night.
words.exZh: 太多功課會讓疲累的學生在週一晚上感到不知所措。

words.ex: Phone addiction can make it hard to sleep well.
words.exZh: 手機成癮可能讓人很難睡好。

words.ex: Moving to a new school can be a hard transition.
words.exZh: 轉到新學校可能是一段不容易的轉變。

words.ex: Drivers who disregard the red light put everyone in danger.
words.exZh: 無視紅燈的駕駛人會讓所有人陷入危險。

words.ex: It is premature to celebrate before the game is over.
words.exZh: 比賽還沒結束就慶祝，還太早了。

words.ex: My brother was skeptical when he heard the ticket was free.
words.exZh: 我哥哥聽到票是免費的時候很懷疑。

words.zh: 故意的、蓄意的；從容的、審慎的；仔細考慮、商議
words.ex: It was a deliberate choice, not a mistake.
words.exZh: 那是刻意的選擇，不是失誤。

words.ex: The factory hired more people to enlarge its workforce this year.
words.exZh: 這家工廠今年僱用更多人來擴充員工陣容。

words.ex: People lose trust in leaders when there is corruption.
words.exZh: 一旦有貪汙，人們就會對領導者失去信任。

words.ex: Good players exploit the weak points of the other team.
words.exZh: 好的球員會利用對手的弱點。

words.ex: Good education empowers young people to make their own choices.
words.exZh: 良好的教育使年輕人有能力做出自己的選擇。

words.ex: The two phones are comparable in size, but not in price.
words.exZh: 這兩支手機大小相當，但價格不同。

words.ex: Many birds work hard to feed their offspring in spring.
words.exZh: 許多鳥兒在春天辛勤地餵養牠們的幼鳥。

words.zh: 無辜的、無罪的；天真的、單純的
words.ex: The judge said the man was innocent of the crime.
words.exZh: 法官說那名男子是無罪的。

words.ex: That kind of music is now part of the mainstream.
words.exZh: 那種音樂現在已成為主流的一部分。

words.ex: The proportion of girls in our club is about half.
words.exZh: 我們社團中女生的比例約占一半。

words.zh: 傑出的、出色的；未付清的、未解決的
words.ex: She received an award for her outstanding work in science.
words.exZh: 她因為在科學上的傑出表現而獲獎。

words.ex: Your health should always be your first priority.
words.exZh: 你的健康應該永遠是第一優先。

words.zh: 獲勝、占上風；盛行、普遍存在
words.ex: Common sense will prevail if we all stay calm.
words.exZh: 只要大家保持冷靜，理智終將獲勝。

words.zh: 誤導的、容易讓人誤會的
words.ex: The sign was misleading, so many people took the wrong road.
words.exZh: 那個標誌容易讓人誤會，所以很多人走錯了路。

words.zh: 鮮為人知的、冷僻的；難以理解的、晦澀的；遮住、使模糊
words.ex: The song was written by an obscure singer from a small village.
words.exZh: 這首歌出自一位來自小村莊、沒什麼名氣的歌手。

words.ex: Heavy rain had an adverse effect on the farmers' crops this year.
words.exZh: 大雨今年對農民的作物造成了不利的影響。

words.ex: Eight hours of sleep is optimal for most teenagers.
words.exZh: 對大多數青少年來說，睡八小時是最理想的。

words.ex: It was hard to resist the temptation to eat another cookie.
words.exZh: 要抗拒再吃一片餅乾的誘惑真的很難。

words.ex: Plastic waste is a serious ecological problem for the ocean.
words.exZh: 塑膠廢棄物是海洋嚴重的生態問題。

words.ex: Clean water is one of the most basic needs of humanity.
words.exZh: 乾淨的水是人類最基本的需求之一。

words.ex: He returned the lost wallet because his conscience told him to.
words.exZh: 他歸還了撿到的錢包，因為他的良心要他這麼做。

words.ex: Too little exercise and too much sugar can lead to obesity.
words.exZh: 運動太少又吃太多糖，可能導致肥胖。

words.ex: He took the criticism calmly and tried to improve.
words.exZh: 他冷靜地接受批評，並努力改進。

words.ex: A tiny organism in the pond can only be seen with a microscope.
words.exZh: 池塘裡有一種微小的生物，只有用顯微鏡才看得到。

words.ex: Music is an integral part of our school festival.
words.exZh: 音樂是我們校慶不可或缺的一部分。

words.ex: Honesty is the most important criterion for this job.
words.exZh: 誠實是這份工作最重要的標準。

words.ex: All visitors must comply with the safety rules.
words.exZh: 所有訪客都必須遵守安全規定。

words.ex: The poet uses a river as a metaphor for passing time.
words.exZh: 詩人用河流來比喻時間的流逝。

words.ex: Many students share the same sentiment about early morning classes.
words.exZh: 許多學生對早上的課有同樣的感受。

words.ex: Your total score must pass this threshold to join the school team.
words.exZh: 你的總分必須超過這個門檻，才能加入校隊。

words.ex: The old vase fell off the shelf, but it stayed intact.
words.exZh: 那個舊花瓶從架上掉下來，卻完好無缺。

words.zh: 重大、嚴重程度；（地震）規模
words.ex: The magnitude of the problem surprised the whole team.
words.exZh: 問題的嚴重程度讓整個團隊都很驚訝。

words.ex: Inflation makes the price of food go up over the years.
words.exZh: 通貨膨脹使食物的價格逐年上漲。

words.ex: My uncle studies philosophy at a university near our home.
words.exZh: 我叔叔在我們家附近的大學研讀哲學。

words.ex: New legislation now requires all cyclists to wear helmets.
words.exZh: 新的法規現在要求所有騎腳踏車的人都要戴安全帽。

words.zh: 大量的、可觀的；豐盛的、結實的
words.ex: We made substantial progress on our science project this week.
words.exZh: 我們這星期的自然科專題有了相當大的進展。

words.ex: Honest communication underlies every strong friendship and team.
words.exZh: 誠實的溝通是每段穩固友誼和每個團隊的基礎。

words.zh: 多變的、易變的；變數、變因
words.ex: The weather in spring is variable, so bring an umbrella.
words.exZh: 春天的天氣多變，所以要帶把雨傘。

words.zh: 答應、保證；承諾、諾言；前途、潛力
words.ex: I promise to call you when I get home.
words.exZh: 我答應你，到家就打電話給你。

words.ex: Our hypothesis is that plants grow faster with more sunlight.
words.exZh: 我們的假設是植物在陽光更多時長得更快。

words.ex: The young entrepreneur started a small shop selling handmade cards.
words.exZh: 這位年輕的創業家開了一家賣手工卡片的小店。

words.ex: It rained for three consecutive days last week.
words.exZh: 上星期連續下了三天的雨。

words.zh: 深遠的、極大的；深奧的、意義深刻的
words.ex: The teacher's words had a profound effect on the whole class.
words.exZh: 老師的話對全班產生了深遠的影響。

words.ex: She decided to undertake a big project about local birds.
words.exZh: 她決定著手進行一個關於本地鳥類的大專題。

words.ex: With so many dark clouds, rain seemed inevitable this afternoon.
words.exZh: 烏雲這麼多，今天下午似乎免不了要下雨。

words.ex: She spoke with strong conviction, and everyone believed her.
words.exZh: 她帶著堅定的信念說話，大家都相信她。

words.ex: The teacher decided to incorporate games into the English lessons.
words.exZh: 老師決定把遊戲融入英文課中。

words.ex: Her insecurity about speaking in front of others faded with practice.
words.exZh: 她對在別人面前說話的不安隨著練習而消退。

words.ex: Old buses emit a lot of black smoke into the air.
words.exZh: 老舊公車會向空氣中排放大量黑煙。

words.zh: 絕種的、滅絕的；不再活動的（火山）
words.ex: Many kinds of large animals became extinct thousands of years ago.
words.exZh: 許多種大型動物在幾千年前就滅絕了。

words.ex: The little girl was on the verge of tears after losing her bag.
words.exZh: 小女孩弄丟包包後，快要哭出來了。

words.ex: The music stopped abruptly when the power went out.
words.exZh: 停電時音樂突然停了。

words.ex: In some cultures, there is a taboo against asking about someone's salary.
words.exZh: 在某些文化中，問別人的薪水是一種禁忌。

words.ex: Many students in the village aspire to become doctors or teachers.
words.exZh: 村裡許多學生立志成為醫生或老師。

words.ex: Many people equate money with happiness, but that is not always true.
words.exZh: 許多人把金錢等同於快樂，但事情並非總是如此。

words.ex: Babies seem to have an innate ability to learn languages.
words.exZh: 嬰兒似乎天生就有學習語言的能力。

words.ex: It is futile to argue with him once he has made up his mind.
words.exZh: 他一旦下定決心，跟他爭論也是徒勞的。

words.zh: 主張、聲稱；競爭、爭奪；應付、對付
words.ex: Some scientists contend that the earth is warming faster than expected.
words.exZh: 有些科學家主張地球暖化的速度比預期更快。

words.zh: 新奇、新鮮感；新奇的事物
words.ex: The novelty of the new game wore off after a week.
words.exZh: 這款新遊戲的新鮮感一個星期就沒了。

words.ex: The small town began to prosper after the new train line opened.
words.exZh: 新的火車路線通車後，這個小鎮開始繁榮起來。

words.zh: 提升、改善（心情、地位）；抬高、舉起
words.ex: A short walk in the sun can elevate your mood.
words.exZh: 在陽光下散步一下可以讓你的心情變好。

words.ex: Keep your answer concise, and write no more than three sentences.
words.exZh: 你的答案要簡潔，不要超過三句。

words.ex: At night, the temperature in the desert can plummet below zero.
words.exZh: 夜晚沙漠的氣溫可能驟降到零度以下。

words.ex: Long hikes in the sun can deplete your energy, so bring snacks.
words.exZh: 在大太陽下長途健行會耗盡體力，所以要帶點心。

words.zh: 貧困的、弱勢的；缺乏…的、被剝奪…的
words.ex: The volunteers teach English to children in deprived areas.
words.exZh: 志工們在貧困地區教孩子英文。

words.ex: The food was mediocre, but the view from the restaurant was amazing.
words.exZh: 餐點很普通，但從餐廳看出去的景色非常棒。

words.zh: 著手、開始（新的事）；上船、登機
words.ex: After graduation, she embarked on a new career as a nurse.
words.exZh: 畢業後，她展開了護理師的新職業生涯。

words.ex: Climbing the mountain alone seemed like a daunting task.
words.exZh: 獨自爬那座山似乎是件令人卻步的艱鉅任務。

words.ex: Don't be so pessimistic, because we still have time to win the game.
words.exZh: 別那麼悲觀，我們還有時間贏得比賽。

words.ex: She has a natural aptitude for learning foreign languages.
words.exZh: 她天生就有學外語的才能。

words.ex: Washing your hands often can lessen the risk of catching a cold.
words.exZh: 常洗手可以減少感冒的風險。

words.ex: My cousin is fluent in English, Japanese, and Korean.
words.exZh: 我表姊的英文、日文和韓文都很流利。

words.zh: 多才多藝的；用途廣泛的
words.ex: She is a versatile musician who plays piano, guitar, and drums.
words.exZh: 她是個多才多藝的音樂人，會彈鋼琴、吉他，也會打鼓。

words.ex: Vegetable prices often fluctuate a lot after typhoons.
words.exZh: 颱風過後，菜價常常大幅波動。

words.ex: The ad was deceptive because the toy looked much bigger in the photo.
words.exZh: 那則廣告很誤導人，因為照片裡的玩具看起來大得多。

words.ex: She came up with an ingenious way to store all her shoes.
words.exZh: 她想出一個巧妙的方法來收納她所有的鞋子。

words.ex: People who stay indoors all day may be deficient in vitamin D.
words.exZh: 整天待在室內的人可能會缺乏維生素D。

words.ex: Listening to loud music for years can impair your hearing.
words.exZh: 多年聽大聲的音樂會損害你的聽力。

words.zh: 口齒清晰的、善於表達的；清楚表達
words.ex: She is an articulate speaker who explains hard ideas clearly.
words.exZh: 她是個很會表達的講者，能把難懂的觀念講得很清楚。

words.ex: It took me a month to get accustomed to my new school.
words.exZh: 我花了一個月才習慣新學校。

words.ex: The lost hikers were in dire need of food and water.
words.exZh: 迷路的登山客急需食物和水。

words.ex: Nobody could foresee how popular the small shop would become.
words.exZh: 沒有人料想得到那家小店會變得這麼受歡迎。

words.zh: 可疑的、不可靠的；半信半疑的
words.ex: The website looked dubious, so I didn't enter my card number.
words.exZh: 那個網站看起來很可疑，所以我沒有輸入卡號。

words.ex: The last goal was a pivotal moment in the match.
words.exZh: 最後那一球是這場比賽的關鍵時刻。

words.ex: Some websites distort the facts to get more clicks.
words.exZh: 有些網站扭曲事實來換取更多點閱。

words.zh: 實際的、明確的；有形的、摸得到的
words.ex: The new library brought tangible benefits to the whole town.
words.exZh: 新圖書館為全鎮帶來了實際的好處。

words.ex: Before you quit the team, contemplate how it will affect others.
words.exZh: 退出球隊之前，先仔細想想這會怎麼影響別人。

words.zh: 區分、辨別；使有差異、使與眾不同
words.ex: Can you differentiate between these two kinds of birds?
words.exZh: 你能分辨這兩種鳥嗎？

words.ex: Finding a parking space downtown can be problematic on weekends.
words.exZh: 週末要在市中心找停車位可能很麻煩。

words.ex: The descendants of the first farmers still live in this valley.
words.exZh: 第一批農民的後代至今仍住在這個山谷裡。

words.ex: Judging people only by their looks is superficial.
words.exZh: 只憑外表評斷別人是很膚淺的。

words.ex: Strong waves slowly erode the rocks along the coast.
words.exZh: 強浪慢慢侵蝕海岸邊的岩石。

words.ex: Everyone has shortcomings, so be patient with your friends.
words.exZh: 每個人都有缺點，所以對朋友要有耐心。

words.zh: 挑釁的；發人深省的、引發討論的
words.ex: His provocative comments online started a big argument.
words.exZh: 他在網路上挑釁的留言引發了一場大爭吵。

words.zh: 黯淡的、無望的；荒涼寒冷的
words.ex: The future of the old bookstore looks bleak.
words.exZh: 那家老書店的前景看起來很黯淡。

words.ex: Many people lost their jobs during the recession.
words.exZh: 經濟衰退期間，很多人失去了工作。

words.ex: The only drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.exZh: 這支手機唯一的缺點是電池撐不久。

words.ex: In a wolf pack, there is a clear hierarchy among the members.
words.exZh: 在狼群中，成員之間有明確的階層。

words.ex: In the aftermath of the flood, volunteers helped clean the streets.
words.exZh: 水災過後，志工們幫忙清理街道。

words.ex: Strong winds hampered the workers who were fixing the power lines.
words.exZh: 強風妨礙了正在修理電線的工人。

words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how people take photos.
words.exZh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了人們拍照的方式。

words.ex: The news report showed the plight of animals after the forest fire.
words.exZh: 新聞報導呈現了森林大火後動物們的困境。

words.ex: Be proactive and ask questions before the test, not after.
words.exZh: 要積極主動，在考試前發問，而不是考完才問。

words.ex: She persevered with her piano practice and finally passed the exam.
words.exZh: 她堅持不懈地練鋼琴，終於通過了考試。

words.ex: It is a paradox that more choices can make shopping less enjoyable.
words.exZh: 選擇越多，購物反而越不開心，這真是個矛盾。

words.ex: In the thick fog, we could barely discern the road ahead.
words.exZh: 在濃霧中，我們幾乎看不清前方的路。

words.zh: 難以捉摸的、難找到的；難以達成的
words.ex: The elusive leopard cat is rarely seen by hikers in the mountains.
words.exZh: 行蹤難以捉摸的石虎，登山客在山裡很少看到。

words.ex: Loud neighbors deprived us of sleep for the whole weekend.
words.exZh: 吵鬧的鄰居害我們整個週末都睡不好。

words.ex: Each group member is accountable for one part of the project.
words.exZh: 每個組員都要為專題的其中一部分負責。

words.ex: The bus had to deviate from its usual route because of the parade.
words.exZh: 因為遊行，公車只好偏離平常的路線。

words.ex: The singer's new song had an unprecedented number of views in one day.
words.exZh: 這位歌手的新歌一天內的觀看次數創下空前紀錄。

words.ex: Teenagers want more autonomy in choosing their own clothes and classes.
words.exZh: 青少年想在選擇自己的衣服和課程上有更多自主權。

words.ex: In the lab, we added a catalyst to make the reaction faster.
words.exZh: 在實驗室裡，我們加入催化劑讓反應變快。

words.zh: 施加（力量、影響）；盡力、使勁
words.ex: Friends can exert a strong influence on the way teenagers dress.
words.exZh: 朋友對青少年的穿著打扮有很大的影響力。
