words.ex: Is it feasible to finish the whole project in one week?
words.exZh: 一個星期內完成整個專題可行嗎？

words.ex: Our savings dwindled after we bought a new car.
words.exZh: 買了新車後，我們的存款逐漸減少。

words.ex: Every new medicine must pass close scrutiny before it is sold.
words.exZh: 每種新藥在上市前都必須通過嚴格審查。

words.zh: 即將發生的、迫在眉睫的
words.ex: With the exam imminent, the library was full of quiet students.
words.exZh: 考試迫在眉睫，圖書館裡坐滿了安靜讀書的學生。

words.ex: Smartphones have made many old cameras and maps obsolete.
words.exZh: 智慧型手機讓許多舊相機和地圖被淘汰了。

words.ex: Rude comments online can alienate people who once supported you.
words.exZh: 網路上的無禮留言可能讓曾經支持你的人疏遠你。

words.ex: The story about a lonely boy resonated with many young readers.
words.exZh: 這個關於孤單男孩的故事引起許多年輕讀者的共鳴。

words.ex: Smartphones have caused great societal changes in how people communicate.
words.exZh: 智慧型手機讓人們的溝通方式產生了巨大的社會變化。

words.ex: Deforestation leaves many wild animals without a place to live.
words.exZh: 濫伐森林讓許多野生動物失去棲身之所。

words.ex: The rule seemed arbitrary because nobody could explain the reason for it.
words.exZh: 這條規定似乎很武斷，因為沒人說得出理由。

words.ex: The class formulated a plan to reduce plastic waste at school.
words.exZh: 全班擬定了一個減少校園塑膠垃圾的計畫。

words.ex: A cold towel can help alleviate the pain of a headache.
words.exZh: 冷毛巾能幫助減輕頭痛。

words.ex: Reading for fun gives you intrinsic rewards, not prizes or grades.
words.exZh: 為樂趣而閱讀帶給你的是內在的收穫，而不是獎品或分數。

words.ex: Scientists hope to eradicate the disease within the next ten years.
words.exZh: 科學家希望在未來十年內根除這種疾病。

words.zh: 有韌性的、能很快復原的；有彈性的
words.ex: After hard times, children are often more resilient than adults think.
words.exZh: 經歷困境後，孩子往往比大人想像的更有韌性。

words.ex: A small budget is the biggest constraint on the school's building plans.
words.exZh: 預算不多是學校建築計畫最大的限制。

words.ex: Her advice was invaluable when I was choosing a university.
words.exZh: 我在選大學時，她的建議非常寶貴。

words.ex: Players go through rigorous training before joining the national team.
words.exZh: 選手加入國家隊之前要經過嚴格的訓練。

words.ex: The old bridge will deteriorate quickly without regular repairs.
words.exZh: 沒有定期維修，那座舊橋很快就會損壞。

words.ex: The cat seemed indifferent to the new toy we bought.
words.exZh: 那隻貓對我們買的新玩具似乎毫不在意。

words.ex: Babies are more susceptible to colds than adults.
words.exZh: 嬰兒比大人更容易感冒。

words.ex: The flood was a catastrophe for farmers along the river.
words.exZh: 那場洪水對河邊的農民來說是一場大災難。

words.ex: Wear a conspicuous yellow jacket when you ride your bike at night.
words.exZh: 晚上騎腳踏車時，要穿顯眼的黃色外套。

words.ex: Check the source before sharing a post to help stop misinformation.
words.exZh: 分享貼文前先確認來源，有助於阻止錯誤資訊散播。

words.ex: Coral reefs are famous for their rich biodiversity.
words.exZh: 珊瑚礁以豐富的生物多樣性聞名。

words.ex: A small bird sat on the branch outside my window.
words.exZh: 一隻小鳥停在我窗外的樹枝上。

words.zh: 暫定的；猶豫的、試探性的
words.ex: We made tentative plans to meet on Sunday, but it depends on the weather.
words.exZh: 我們暫定星期日見面，但還要看天氣。

words.ex: My intuition told me to bring an umbrella, and it rained later.
words.exZh: 我的直覺告訴我要帶傘，結果後來真的下雨了。

words.ex: Facing adversity can teach young people to be strong and patient.
words.exZh: 面對逆境能教會年輕人堅強與耐心。

words.ex: A quiet, tidy desk is conducive to good study habits.
words.exZh: 安靜整潔的書桌有助於養成良好的讀書習慣。

words.ex: Staying up late every night is detrimental to your health.
words.exZh: 每晚熬夜對你的健康有害。

words.ex: It is a common misconception that goldfish only remember things for seconds.
words.exZh: 金魚只能記住幾秒鐘的事，是一個常見的錯誤觀念。

words.ex: There is a large disparity between rich and poor areas of the city.
words.exZh: 這座城市的富裕和貧窮地區之間有很大的差距。

words.ex: The movie criticizes materialism and shows that friends matter more than money.
words.exZh: 這部電影批判物質主義，並說明朋友比金錢更重要。

words.ex: Huge holiday sales are a clear sign of modern consumerism.
words.exZh: 大型節日特賣是現代消費主義的明顯跡象。

words.ex: My little brother invariably falls asleep during long car rides.
words.exZh: 我弟弟坐長途車時總是會睡著。

words.zh: 不穩的、搖搖欲墜的；（處境）不安定的、危險的
words.ex: The stack of books looked precarious, so I moved it off the shelf.
words.exZh: 那疊書看起來搖搖欲墜，所以我把它從架子上拿下來。

words.ex: I inadvertently deleted the photos while cleaning up my phone.
words.exZh: 我在整理手機時不小心刪掉了照片。

words.ex: I felt uneasy when I heard strange noises outside.
words.exZh: 聽到外面有奇怪的聲音時，我感到很不安。

words.zh: 赤裸的、光著的；空的、光禿的
words.ex: The children ran on the beach with bare feet.
words.exZh: 孩子們光著腳在沙灘上奔跑。

words.ex: He bought a pair of brown leather shoes for winter.
words.exZh: 他買了一雙過冬穿的棕色皮鞋。

words.ex: I felt encouraged when my teacher praised my hard work.
words.exZh: 老師稱讚我的努力時，我覺得很受鼓舞。

words.ex: The children looked for the hidden treasure on the map.
words.exZh: 孩子們照著地圖找尋藏起來的寶藏。

words.ex: The flag hangs from a tall pole in front of our school.
words.exZh: 旗子掛在我們學校前面的一根高桿子上。

words.ex: Workers will pave the dirt road with stones next week.
words.exZh: 工人下週會用石頭鋪這條泥土路。

words.ex: Pain travels along the nerve to your brain quickly.
words.exZh: 疼痛會沿著神經很快傳到你的大腦。

words.ex: Rice is a grain that people eat in many countries.
words.exZh: 稻米是許多國家的人都會吃的穀物。

words.ex: The path up the mountain is very steep, so we walked slowly.
words.exZh: 通往山上的小路很陡，所以我們走得很慢。

words.ex: I write a few lines in my journal before going to bed.
words.exZh: 我睡前會在日誌裡寫幾行字。

words.ex: Some cleaning products contain alcohol, so keep them away from fire.
words.exZh: 有些清潔用品含有酒精，所以要讓它們遠離火源。

words.ex: We use a simple formula to find the area of a circle.
words.exZh: 我們用一個簡單的公式來算圓的面積。

words.zh: 入口；參賽作品；進入、入場
words.ex: The entry to the hall is on the left side.
words.exZh: 大廳的入口在左邊。

words.ex: We listened to a lecture about ocean animals in the hall.
words.exZh: 我們在禮堂聽了一場關於海洋動物的演講。

words.zh: 外星人；陌生的、格格不入的
words.ex: The movie is about a friendly alien who visits Earth.
words.exZh: 這部電影在講一個造訪地球的友善外星人。

words.zh: 中等的、中號的；媒介、手段
words.ex: I would like a medium cup of hot tea, please.
words.exZh: 麻煩給我一杯中杯熱茶。

words.zh: 安裝、固定；逐漸增加；騎上、登上
words.ex: Dad will mount the shelf on the wall this weekend.
words.exZh: 爸爸這個週末會把架子裝到牆上。

words.ex: Look in the index at the back to find the page.
words.exZh: 查看書後面的索引來找到那一頁。

words.ex: We buy rice in bulk because it is cheaper that way.
words.exZh: 我們大量買米，因為這樣比較便宜。

words.zh: 黴、黴菌；模具、模子；塑造、形成
words.ex: There is green mold on the bread you left out.
words.exZh: 你放在外面的麵包長了綠色的黴。

words.ex: We paid a small toll before crossing the long bridge.
words.exZh: 我們過那座長橋前付了一點通行費。

words.zh: 噁心的、令人作嘔的；總的、（重量）毛的
words.ex: Leaving dirty socks on the dinner table is really gross.
words.exZh: 把髒襪子丟在餐桌上真的很噁心。

words.zh: 通風口、排氣孔；發洩（情緒）
words.ex: Warm air comes out of the vent near the window.
words.exZh: 暖氣從窗邊的通風口吹出來。

words.zh: 聲音的、發聲的；直言的、大聲表達意見的
words.ex: The singer took a rest to protect her vocal cords.
words.exZh: 那位歌手休息一下來保護她的聲帶。

words.zh: 違抗、不服從；難以（解釋、描述）
words.ex: The boy chose to defy the rules and swam in the deep pool.
words.exZh: 那個男孩選擇違抗規定，跑去深水池游泳。

words.ex: The chef gave a short demonstration of how to make noodles.
words.exZh: 主廚簡短地示範了如何做麵條。

words.ex: Can you translate this sentence into Chinese for me?
words.exZh: 你可以幫我把這句話翻成中文嗎？

words.ex: He grasped the rope tightly and climbed up the wall.
words.exZh: 他緊緊抓住繩子，爬上了牆。

words.ex: If you multiply three by four, you get twelve.
words.exZh: 三乘以四等於十二。

words.zh: 一縷、一股；使困住、使擱淺
words.ex: A single strand of hair fell across her face.
words.exZh: 一縷頭髮垂落在她的臉上。

words.ex: Long ago, a plague spread quickly through the crowded towns.
words.exZh: 很久以前，瘟疫迅速傳遍擁擠的城鎮。

words.ex: A true friend will never betray your trust.
words.exZh: 真正的朋友絕不會辜負你的信任。

words.zh: 點燃、生（火）；激起（興趣、情感）
words.ex: We used dry leaves to kindle a small fire at the campsite.
words.exZh: 我們用乾樹葉在營地生起一小堆火。

words.ex: Make sure the tape can adhere to the wall before you use it.
words.exZh: 使用前先確認膠帶能黏在牆上。

words.ex: He walked into the classroom with a confident stride.
words.exZh: 他信心十足地大步走進教室。

words.ex: He plugged the game console into the TV and turned it on.
words.exZh: 他把遊戲主機接上電視並打開。

words.ex: A rainbow shows the whole spectrum of colors in the sky.
words.exZh: 彩虹在天空中呈現出完整的色彩光譜。

words.zh: 不得不的、有義務的；感激的
words.ex: I felt obliged to help him because he had helped me before.
words.exZh: 他以前幫過我，所以我覺得有義務幫他。

words.ex: Our class won the relay race on sports day.
words.exZh: 我們班在運動會上贏得了接力賽。

words.zh: 承辦餐飲；迎合、滿足需求
words.ex: A local bakery catered our school event with cakes and sandwiches.
words.exZh: 當地一家麵包店為我們學校的活動提供了蛋糕和三明治。

words.ex: You need a token to ride the old merry-go-round.
words.exZh: 你需要一枚代幣才能坐那座舊旋轉木馬。

words.zh: 意圖、目的；專注的、一心想…的
words.ex: The intent of the new rule is to keep students safe.
words.exZh: 這條新規定的目的是保護學生的安全。

words.ex: Reading books every day improves a child's literacy skills.
words.exZh: 每天閱讀能提升孩子的讀寫能力。

words.ex: There is only one outlet in this room for the lamp.
words.exZh: 這個房間只有一個插座可以插檯燈。

words.zh: 打開、攤開；（故事等）展開、逐漸呈現
words.ex: She unfolded the map on the table to find the station.
words.exZh: 她把地圖攤開在桌上找車站。

words.ex: She threw a handful of seeds to the hungry birds.
words.exZh: 她撒了一把種子給飢餓的鳥兒。

words.ex: The descent from the mountain was steeper than the climb.
words.exZh: 下山的路比上山還要陡。

words.ex: Proper disposal of old batteries helps protect the earth.
words.exZh: 妥善處理舊電池有助於保護地球。

words.zh: 資產、財產；寶貴的人事物
words.ex: The company sold some of its assets to pay back the bank.
words.exZh: 那家公司賣掉部分資產來償還銀行。

words.zh: 有資格的、有權的；名為……的
words.ex: Every student is entitled to use the school library.
words.exZh: 每位學生都有權使用學校圖書館。

words.ex: Joining the school band gave him a strong sense of belonging.
words.exZh: 加入學校樂隊讓他有很強的歸屬感。

words.ex: Please underline the new words in each paragraph.
words.exZh: 請在每一段的生字下面劃線。

words.zh: 有（法律）責任的；容易…的、可能…的
words.ex: You are liable for any damage to the bike you rent.
words.exZh: 你要對租來的腳踏車的任何損壞負責。

words.zh: 為…布置家具；提供（資料、物品）
words.ex: They furnished their small apartment with secondhand tables and chairs.
words.exZh: 他們用二手桌椅布置自己的小公寓。

words.zh: 天文（學）的；極龐大的、天價的
words.ex: An astronomical clock shows the positions of the sun and moon.
words.exZh: 天文鐘會顯示太陽和月亮的位置。

words.zh: 直覺的；容易上手的、好懂的
words.ex: She had an intuitive feeling that the old bridge was not safe.
words.exZh: 她直覺地感到那座舊橋不安全。

words.ex: The old man made a fortune selling tea.
words.exZh: 那位老先生靠賣茶賺了一大筆錢。

words.ex: The graduation ceremony will be held in the gym.
words.exZh: 畢業典禮將在體育館舉行。

words.ex: The night market was full of shoppers looking for cheap snacks.
words.exZh: 夜市裡擠滿了找便宜小吃的購物人潮。

words.ex: A small paper boat floated down the stream.
words.exZh: 一艘小紙船順著溪流漂下去。

words.ex: I can't buy the game because I'm broke this week.
words.exZh: 我這週沒錢，所以買不了這款遊戲。

words.ex: The town holds a religious festival with music every spring.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮每年春天都會舉辦有音樂的宗教慶典。

words.ex: The theme of this year's school festival is friendship.
words.exZh: 今年校慶的主題是友誼。

words.ex: The tall bridge over the river is made of steel.
words.exZh: 河上那座高高的橋是用鋼鐵建造的。

words.ex: The school built a ramp for students who use a wheelchair.
words.exZh: 學校為使用輪椅的學生蓋了一條斜坡道。

words.ex: She felt inspired after listening to the young painter's talk.
words.exZh: 聽完年輕畫家的演講後，她覺得受到啟發。

words.ex: People from different cultures live in harmony in this town.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮裡來自不同文化的人和睦相處。

words.ex: The cut became infected, so she went to see a doctor.
words.exZh: 傷口感染發炎了，所以她去看醫生。

words.ex: The show will begin shortly, so please take your seats.
words.exZh: 表演馬上就要開始了，請大家就座。

words.ex: In the game, the hero finds a magic weapon in a cave.
words.exZh: 在遊戲裡，主角在山洞中發現一件魔法武器。

words.ex: We visited a medieval castle on our trip last summer.
words.exZh: 去年夏天旅行時，我們參觀了一座中世紀城堡。

words.ex: He likes to carve small animals out of soft wood.
words.exZh: 他喜歡用軟木頭雕刻小動物。

words.zh: 移動、運動；（用手勢）示意；（會議的）提議、動議
words.ex: The train moved slowly, and the motion made me sleepy.
words.exZh: 火車開得很慢，那搖晃讓我昏昏欲睡。

words.ex: Reading every day can improve a child's cognitive skills.
words.exZh: 每天閱讀能增進孩子的認知能力。

words.ex: The doctor told him to take one capsule after each meal.
words.exZh: 醫生要他每餐飯後吃一顆膠囊。

words.ex: The old railway runs through green fields and small towns.
words.exZh: 這條老鐵路穿過綠色的田野和小鎮。

words.ex: Colorful fish swim around the coral in the warm sea.
words.exZh: 色彩繽紛的魚在溫暖的海裡繞著珊瑚游動。

words.zh: 旋轉、轉動；（蜘蛛）結網、紡紗
words.ex: The dancer began to spin faster and faster.
words.exZh: 舞者開始越轉越快。

words.ex: Many tourists take photos in front of the old stone monument.
words.exZh: 許多遊客在古老的石造紀念碑前拍照。

words.ex: Every viewer of the show got a small gift at the door.
words.exZh: 每位來看表演的觀眾都在門口拿到一份小禮物。

words.zh: 一段時間、期間；橫跨、跨越；跨度、寬度
words.ex: Small children usually have a short attention span in class.
words.exZh: 小孩子上課時的專注時間通常很短。

words.ex: The actor disguised himself as an old man for the play.
words.exZh: 那位演員為了演出，把自己喬裝成老人。

words.ex: Having tea before bed is a nightly ritual for my grandfather.
words.exZh: 睡前喝茶是我爺爺每晚的固定習慣。

words.zh: 提供的東西、推出的產品
words.ex: The shop's newest offering is a cold drink made with fresh fruit.
words.exZh: 這家店最新推出的商品是用新鮮水果做的冷飲。

words.ex: The princess wore a small crown made of silver.
words.exZh: 公主戴著一頂銀製的小王冠。

words.ex: Colorful fish swim around the reef near the small island.
words.exZh: 彩色的魚在小島附近的礁石周圍游動。

words.ex: The town helped each refugee find a safe place to live.
words.exZh: 鎮上幫每一位難民找到安全的住處。

words.ex: It feels odd to walk in the empty school hallway.
words.exZh: 走在空無一人的學校走廊感覺怪怪的。

words.ex: The young singer found fame after her first song became popular.
words.exZh: 這位年輕歌手在第一首歌走紅後就成名了。

words.zh: 平滑的、平坦的；順利的；弄平、撫平
words.ex: The road was smooth, so the long bus ride felt comfortable.
words.exZh: 路面很平坦，所以搭這趟長途公車感覺很舒服。

words.zh: 香味、氣味；（動物留下的）氣味
words.ex: The scent of fresh bread filled the whole kitchen.
words.exZh: 剛出爐麵包的香味瀰漫整個廚房。

words.ex: Twins may look alike, but their tastes often differ.
words.exZh: 雙胞胎也許長得很像，但口味常常不同。

words.ex: This soft fabric is perfect for making summer dresses.
words.exZh: 這種柔軟的布料很適合做夏天的洋裝。

words.ex: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
words.exZh: 她把首飾放在一個小木盒裡。

words.ex: The student council planned a new recycling activity for our school.
words.exZh: 學生會為我們學校規劃了一項新的資源回收活動。

words.ex: The film critic said the new movie was funny and warm.
words.exZh: 那位影評人說這部新電影既有趣又溫馨。

words.ex: She bought a red scarf as an accessory for her winter coat.
words.exZh: 她買了一條紅圍巾，當作冬季外套的配件。

words.ex: Our family has a big gathering at Grandma's house every Lunar New Year.
words.exZh: 我們家每年農曆新年都在奶奶家大團聚。

words.ex: The ship's crew worked together during the storm.
words.exZh: 暴風雨中，船上的全體船員同心協力。

words.ex: She screamed in horror when she saw the spider.
words.exZh: 她看到蜘蛛時驚恐地尖叫。

words.ex: The soles of these running shoes are made of soft rubber.
words.exZh: 這雙跑鞋的鞋底是用柔軟的橡膠做的。

words.ex: We bought tickets at the small booth near the entrance.
words.exZh: 我們在入口附近的小售票亭買了票。

words.ex: Teaching young children takes a lot of patience.
words.exZh: 教小孩需要很多耐心。

words.ex: Tourists lined up to see the royal palace and its gardens.
words.exZh: 遊客排隊參觀皇宮和它的花園。

words.ex: My hands got sticky after I ate the sweet rice cake.
words.exZh: 我吃完甜甜的年糕後，手變得黏黏的。

words.ex: Press the switch on the wall to turn on the light.
words.exZh: 按一下牆上的開關就能開燈。

words.ex: Water is a liquid, but ice is a solid.
words.exZh: 水是液體，但冰是固體。

words.ex: The squirrel likes to bury nuts under the tree.
words.exZh: 松鼠喜歡把堅果埋在樹下。

words.ex: She felt deep sorrow when her old dog got lost.
words.exZh: 她的老狗走失時，她非常難過。

words.ex: Can you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
words.exZh: 你可以告訴我會議確切的時間嗎？

words.ex: Loud music for many years can damage your hearing.
words.exZh: 多年聽大聲的音樂可能會傷害你的聽力。

words.ex: He felt like a fool after he forgot the answer.
words.exZh: 他忘記答案後覺得自己像個傻瓜。

words.zh: 身心障礙的；（功能）停用的、失效的
words.ex: This elevator has a special button for disabled people.
words.exZh: 這部電梯有一個給身心障礙者用的特殊按鈕。

words.ex: The train will depart from platform two at noon.
words.exZh: 火車將在中午從第二月台出發。

words.ex: The birds flee whenever someone walks near the pond.
words.exZh: 只要有人走近池塘，鳥兒就會飛走。

words.ex: My grandmother loves to listen to classical music.
words.exZh: 我奶奶很愛聽古典音樂。

words.ex: Long trips can cause fatigue, so take a rest often.
words.exZh: 長途旅行會讓人疲勞，所以要常常休息。

words.ex: Washing your hands is a simple way to keep good hygiene.
words.exZh: 洗手是保持良好衛生的簡單方法。

words.ex: Two subjects, namely math and science, are hard for me.
words.exZh: 有兩個科目對我來說很難，也就是數學和自然。

words.zh: 照字面地；簡直、真的（加強語氣）
words.ex: The name of this town literally means 'little mountain' in Chinese.
words.exZh: 這個小鎮的名字在中文裡照字面是「小山」的意思。

words.zh: 合作的、肯配合的；合作社
words.ex: The cooperative students finished the group project in only two days.
words.exZh: 這群肯合作的學生只花兩天就完成了分組報告。

words.ex: My parents bought insurance for our car and our house.
words.exZh: 我爸媽為我們的車和房子買了保險。

words.zh: 停用、使失效；使失能、使傷殘
words.ex: You can disable this app's camera access in your phone settings.
words.exZh: 你可以在手機設定裡停用這個應用程式的相機權限。

words.ex: My brother enjoys nature photography on quiet weekends.
words.exZh: 在悠閒的週末，我哥哥喜歡拍攝大自然的照片。

words.ex: The tide comes in and covers the beach every evening.
words.exZh: 每天傍晚漲潮都會淹沒海灘。

words.ex: This district has a big park and many small shops.
words.exZh: 這個地區有一座大公園和許多小商店。

words.ex: Wait for the green light at the intersection before you cross.
words.exZh: 在十字路口要等綠燈再過馬路。

words.ex: The island looked like a paradise with clear water and white sand.
words.exZh: 那座島有清澈的海水和白沙，宛如樂園。

words.ex: Her decisive goal won the game in the last minute.
words.exZh: 她在最後一分鐘的決定性進球贏得了比賽。

words.ex: He practices a martial art every Saturday morning.
words.exZh: 他每個星期六早上都練武術。

words.ex: The room was too dim for me to read a book.
words.exZh: 房間太暗了，我沒辦法看書。

words.ex: Countries in the southern hemisphere have summer in December.
words.exZh: 南半球的國家在十二月是夏天。

words.ex: Workers dug a deep trench along the side of the road.
words.exZh: 工人沿著馬路旁挖了一條很深的溝。

words.zh: 純的、不摻雜的；純淨的、乾淨的
words.ex: This bottle contains pure orange juice with no sugar.
words.exZh: 這瓶是沒加糖的純柳橙汁。

words.zh: 音樂的；有音樂天分的；音樂劇
words.ex: The guitar is my favorite musical instrument to play.
words.exZh: 吉他是我最喜歡的樂器。

words.ex: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
words.exZh: 把你的外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

words.ex: She likes to quote a line from her favorite book.
words.exZh: 她喜歡引用她最愛的書裡的一句話。

words.ex: The colors of the old poster began to fade.
words.exZh: 這張舊海報的顏色開始褪掉了。

words.zh: 失明的、瞎的；百葉窗、遮光簾
words.ex: A guide dog helps a blind person cross the street.
words.exZh: 導盲犬幫助盲人過馬路。

words.ex: The lightning flashed and then the thunder rolled in.
words.exZh: 閃電一閃，接著雷聲滾滾而來。

words.zh: 彎道、曲線；彎曲、沿弧線前進
words.ex: The road makes a sharp curve near the river.
words.exZh: 這條路在河邊有個急轉彎。

words.zh: 呼吸、一口氣；口氣、呼出的氣
words.ex: Take a deep breath before you start your speech.
words.exZh: 開始演講之前，先深呼吸一下。

words.ex: Grandma can weave a basket out of dry grass.
words.exZh: 奶奶會用乾草編籃子。

words.ex: The inner walls of the house are painted white.
words.exZh: 這棟房子的內牆漆成白色。

words.ex: The test was fairly easy for most of us.
words.exZh: 這次考試對我們大多數人來說相當簡單。

words.ex: Our school teaches students to respect every racial group.
words.exZh: 我們學校教導學生尊重每個種族。

words.zh: 有藝術天分的；藝術的、有美感的
words.ex: My brother is very artistic, and he draws funny cartoons.
words.exZh: 我哥哥很有藝術天分，他會畫有趣的漫畫。

words.ex: The principal appointed our math teacher to lead the science club.
words.exZh: 校長指派我們的數學老師帶領科學社。

words.ex: Green algae covered the surface of the pond in summer.
words.exZh: 夏天時，綠色的藻類布滿了池塘的水面。

words.zh: 液體、流質；流暢的、流動的
words.ex: You should drink plenty of fluids when you have a fever.
words.exZh: 發燒的時候你應該多補充水分。

words.ex: This is a quiet zone, so please talk in a low voice.
words.exZh: 這裡是安靜區，請小聲說話。

words.zh: 存貨、庫存；股票、股份；備有、進貨
words.ex: Sorry, that size is out of stock right now.
words.exZh: 抱歉，那個尺寸現在沒有庫存。

words.ex: The dry branch will snap if you step on it.
words.exZh: 你要是踩上去，那根乾樹枝就會啪的一聲斷掉。

words.ex: The table is made of solid wood, so it is heavy.
words.exZh: 這張桌子是實木做的，所以很重。

words.ex: Steam rose from the hot soup on the table.
words.exZh: 桌上的熱湯冒出了蒸氣。

words.zh: 獸群、牧群；趕（成群的動物）
words.ex: A herd of cows slowly crossed the road in front of us.
words.exZh: 一群乳牛慢慢地走過我們面前的馬路。

words.ex: Members of the tribe still make their own baskets by hand.
words.exZh: 這個部落的成員仍然自己用手編籃子。

words.ex: Cows roam freely on the green hills near my grandfather's farm.
words.exZh: 牛群在我爺爺農場附近的綠色山丘上自在地漫步。

words.ex: The bride wore a long white dress to the ceremony.
words.exZh: 新娘穿著一件白色長禮服參加典禮。

words.zh: 漂流、飄；不知不覺進入（某狀態）
words.ex: The small boat began to drift slowly down the river.
words.exZh: 那艘小船開始慢慢順著河漂流。

words.ex: The first item on today's agenda is the school festival.
words.exZh: 今天議程的第一項是校慶活動。

words.ex: She tapped her fingers to the rhythm of the music.
words.exZh: 她隨著音樂的節奏用手指打拍子。

words.ex: The mayor visited our school to talk about traffic safety.
words.exZh: 市長來到我們學校談交通安全。

words.ex: The old train station is a historic building in our town.
words.exZh: 那座老火車站是我們鎮上具歷史意義的建築。

words.ex: Don't panic if you forget a word during your speech.
words.exZh: 演講時如果忘了某個字，別驚慌。

words.ex: My aunt has to commute an hour to her office every day.
words.exZh: 我阿姨每天要花一小時通勤到辦公室。

words.zh: 穩固的；穩定的、持續的；使穩定、穩住
words.ex: The ladder is steady, so you can climb safely.
words.exZh: 這個梯子很穩，你可以安全地爬上去。

words.ex: The cashier stood behind the counter and smiled at us.
words.exZh: 收銀員站在櫃檯後面對我們微笑。

words.ex: The rabbit vanished from the magician's hat in a second.
words.exZh: 兔子一瞬間就從魔術師的帽子裡消失了。

words.zh: 主要的、首要的；最好的、黃金的；質數的
words.ex: Safety is the prime concern when we go camping.
words.exZh: 我們去露營時，安全是首要考量。

words.ex: Can you summarize the story in two or three sentences?
words.exZh: 你能用兩三句話總結這個故事嗎？

words.ex: The swift runner crossed the finish line first.
words.exZh: 那位跑得飛快的選手第一個衝過終點線。

words.zh: 明確的、確定的；明顯的、無疑的
words.ex: We need a definite answer before the shop closes today.
words.exZh: 我們需要在商店今天打烊前得到明確的答覆。

words.ex: That town is famous for its cotton textiles and colorful cloth.
words.exZh: 那個小鎮以棉紡織品和色彩繽紛的布料聞名。

words.ex: The movie has a touching ending about two old friends.
words.exZh: 這部電影有個關於兩位老朋友的感人結局。

words.ex: She picked up a fragment of the broken cup from the floor.
words.exZh: 她從地上撿起一塊破杯子的碎片。

words.ex: Plants need moisture in the soil to grow well.
words.exZh: 植物需要土壤中的水分才能長得好。

words.zh: 後退、撤退；休養處、避靜處
words.ex: When the storm grew stronger, we had to retreat indoors.
words.exZh: 暴風雨變強時，我們只好退回室內。

words.ex: The team packed food and tents for the long expedition.
words.exZh: 隊員為了這趟長途探險打包了食物和帳篷。

words.zh: 主管、高階經理；行政的、執行的
words.ex: Two executives from the company visited our factory this morning.
words.exZh: 公司的兩位主管今天早上來參觀我們的工廠。

words.ex: The caretaker locks the school gates every evening at six.
words.exZh: 管理員每天傍晚六點鎖上學校大門。

words.ex: Grandpa grows medicinal herbs in small pots on the balcony.
words.exZh: 爺爺在陽台的小盆子裡種藥草。

words.ex: I can't get that happy tune out of my head.
words.exZh: 那首輕快的曲子一直在我腦中揮之不去。

words.zh: 民間的、民俗的；人們、鄉親
words.ex: Folk music from the countryside tells stories of daily life.
words.exZh: 鄉間的民謠述說著日常生活的故事。

words.ex: We cleared out all the junk from the old garage.
words.exZh: 我們把舊車庫裡的廢物全部清掉了。

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the human body.
words.exZh: 心臟是人體中很重要的器官。

words.ex: My cousin is a vegan, so she never eats eggs or cheese.
words.exZh: 我表姊是純素食者，所以她從不吃蛋或起司。

words.ex: The knight in the story carried a shiny silver shield.
words.exZh: 故事裡的騎士拿著一面閃亮的銀色盾牌。

words.ex: Scientists use a satellite to take pictures of the weather from space.
words.exZh: 科學家利用衛星從太空拍攝天氣的照片。

words.ex: Students share study tips on the school online forum.
words.exZh: 學生在學校的網路論壇分享讀書技巧。

words.ex: Our county has a big library and several small parks.
words.exZh: 我們縣裡有一座大圖書館和幾座小公園。

words.ex: After the earthquake, a tsunami warning was sent to every phone.
words.exZh: 地震後，海嘯警報傳送到了每支手機。

words.ex: Every living thing is made of tiny cells.
words.exZh: 每種生物都是由微小的細胞組成的。

words.zh: 代理人、仲介；特務、情報員
words.ex: The travel agent helped us find a cheap flight for the holiday.
words.exZh: 旅行社的人員幫我們找到假期便宜的機票。

words.ex: My aunt will dye the cloth blue this weekend.
words.exZh: 我阿姨這個週末要把布染成藍色。

words.ex: I made a recording of my speech to practice.
words.exZh: 我把自己的演講錄下來練習。

words.ex: We have an oral test in English class tomorrow.
words.exZh: 我們明天英文課有口試。

words.ex: My room is on the upper floor of the house.
words.exZh: 我的房間在房子的上層。

words.zh: 撞到、碰到；腫包；（路面的）凸起
words.ex: Be careful not to bump your head on the shelf.
words.exZh: 小心別讓頭撞到架子。

words.ex: He has a small scar on his knee from a fall.
words.exZh: 他膝蓋上有一道摔傷留下的小疤。

words.ex: Do not crush the box, because there is a cake inside.
words.exZh: 不要壓壞這個盒子，裡面有一個蛋糕。

words.ex: The soup tasted awful, so we ordered noodles instead.
words.exZh: 湯的味道很糟，所以我們改點了麵。

words.ex: We ate dinner at a fancy restaurant on my father's birthday.
words.exZh: 我爸爸生日那天，我們在一間高級餐廳吃晚餐。

words.zh: 空白的；空格；（腦中）一片空白的
words.ex: Please write your name on the blank line at the top.
words.exZh: 請把名字寫在最上面的空白線上。

words.ex: My grandmother told us a legend about a magic lake.
words.exZh: 奶奶跟我們講了一個關於神奇湖泊的傳說。

words.ex: The twin sisters look so alike that people mix them up.
words.exZh: 那對雙胞胎姊妹長得好像，大家常常搞混。

words.ex: Many flowers bloom in the garden every April.
words.exZh: 每年四月，花園裡都開滿了花。

words.ex: She is very mature for a girl of twelve.
words.exZh: 以十二歲的女孩來說，她非常成熟。

words.ex: Please fetch my glasses from the table upstairs.
words.exZh: 請去樓上的桌子把我的眼鏡拿來。

words.ex: People called the young girl a genius at math.
words.exZh: 大家都說這個小女孩是數學天才。

words.ex: In the story, a kind queen ruled a small kingdom.
words.exZh: 在故事裡，一位善良的女王統治著一個小王國。

words.ex: The squirrel lives in a hollow tree near the pond.
words.exZh: 松鼠住在池塘邊一棵空心的樹裡。

words.ex: It was a miracle that the little bird survived the storm.
words.exZh: 那隻小鳥在暴風雨中活下來真是奇蹟。

words.ex: The children screamed with excitement when they saw the ocean.
words.exZh: 孩子們看到大海時興奮地尖叫。

words.ex: My uncle is a skilled cook who makes noodles by hand.
words.exZh: 我叔叔是位手藝純熟的廚師，會手工做麵條。

words.zh: 經由（某地）；透過（某種方式）
words.ex: This bus goes to the beach via the old harbor.
words.exZh: 這班公車經過舊港口開往海邊。

words.ex: Please walk with caution on the wet floor near the pool.
words.exZh: 在泳池旁濕滑的地板上請小心行走。

words.ex: She wore a simple but elegant dress to the concert.
words.exZh: 她穿著一件簡單卻優雅的洋裝去聽音樂會。

words.zh: 中央的、中心的；主要的、核心的
words.ex: The central library is close to the main train station.
words.exZh: 中央圖書館離主要的火車站很近。

words.zh: 技術上的；專門的、專業的
words.ex: The bike shop fixed the technical problem with my gears.
words.exZh: 腳踏車店修好了我變速器的技術問題。

words.ex: The two countries have close relations in trade.
words.exZh: 這兩個國家在貿易上關係密切。

words.ex: You can choose tea or juice, and I prefer the latter.
words.exZh: 你可以選茶或果汁，我比較喜歡後者。

words.ex: My aunt gets her salary on the last day of every month.
words.exZh: 我阿姨每個月的最後一天領薪水。

words.ex: Parents should not punish a child for telling the truth.
words.exZh: 父母不該因為孩子說實話而處罰他。

words.zh: 頑固的、固執的；（汙漬等）難以去除的
words.ex: My stubborn little brother will not wear a coat in winter.
words.exZh: 我固執的弟弟冬天也不肯穿外套。

words.ex: My new neighbor speaks English with a soft accent.
words.exZh: 我的新鄰居說英語帶著輕柔的口音。

words.ex: Some snakes have a deadly bite, so stay away from them.
words.exZh: 有些蛇的咬傷會致命，所以要離牠們遠一點。

words.zh: 綁、捆；使團結、使緊密結合
words.ex: Use a strong rope to bind the boxes together.
words.exZh: 用一條堅固的繩子把箱子綁在一起。

words.ex: The sudden news seemed to stun the whole class.
words.exZh: 這個突如其來的消息似乎讓全班都愣住了。

words.zh: 色彩豐富的；豐富有趣的
words.ex: The market was full of colorful flowers and fruit.
words.exZh: 市場裡擺滿了色彩繽紛的花和水果。

words.ex: I wrote the first draft of my story in one hour.
words.exZh: 我花一個小時寫完故事的初稿。

words.ex: Draw a horizontal line across the middle of the page.
words.exZh: 在這頁中間畫一條水平線。

words.ex: A lone tree stood on the hill above the village.
words.exZh: 村子上方的山丘上孤零零地站著一棵樹。

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is two to three.
words.exZh: 我們班男生和女生的比例是二比三。

words.ex: A fleet of fishing boats left the port at dawn.
words.exZh: 一支漁船隊在黎明時出港。

words.ex: The heavy rain finally ceased, and the children ran outside.
words.exZh: 大雨終於停了，孩子們都跑到外面去。

words.zh: 含糊的、不明確的；模糊的、不清楚的
words.ex: He gave a vague answer, so we asked him again.
words.exZh: 他的回答很含糊，所以我們又問了一次。

words.ex: The magician showed us an astonishing trick with a coin.
words.exZh: 魔術師用一枚硬幣為我們表演了驚人的把戲。

words.zh: 冒犯；違法行為、過錯；（球賽的）進攻
words.ex: I meant no offense when I made that joke.
words.exZh: 我開那個玩笑時並無冒犯之意。

words.ex: The interior of the old house was clean and bright.
words.exZh: 那間老房子的內部乾淨又明亮。

words.ex: The team celebrated its triumph with a big dinner.
words.exZh: 球隊用一頓大餐慶祝勝利。

words.zh: 激怒、惹惱；引起、激起（反應）
words.ex: My little brother likes to provoke me by hiding my pencils.
words.exZh: 我弟弟喜歡把我的鉛筆藏起來激怒我。

words.ex: Please disconnect the charger when the phone is full.
words.exZh: 手機充飽電後，請把充電器拔掉。

words.ex: The team's unity helped them win the final game.
words.exZh: 這支隊伍的團結幫助他們贏得了決賽。

words.ex: Our school is situated at the top of a hill.
words.exZh: 我們學校位於一座小山的山頂。

words.ex: The spacecraft flew around the moon and came back safely.
words.exZh: 這艘太空船繞了月球一圈後安全返回。

words.zh: 被限制在…的、受限的；（空間）狹小的
words.ex: Because of his broken leg, he was confined to bed for a month.
words.exZh: 因為腿骨折，他被困在床上一個月。

words.ex: She went to the bank to deposit her allowance.
words.exZh: 她到銀行去存她的零用錢。

words.ex: The farm uses heavy machinery to harvest the rice.
words.exZh: 這座農場用大型機械來收割稻米。

words.ex: I made an inquiry about the price of the tickets.
words.exZh: 我詢問了這些票的價格。

words.ex: Her curly hair is an inherited trait from her grandmother.
words.exZh: 她的捲髮是從奶奶那裡遺傳來的特徵。

words.zh: 空著的、沒人用的；（職位）空缺的；茫然的、發呆的
words.ex: There is a vacant seat next to the window on the train.
words.exZh: 火車上靠窗的位子有一個空位。

words.ex: The east side of the island is heavily populated.
words.exZh: 這座島的東邊人口很稠密。

words.ex: The teacher deems his answer correct and gives him a point.
words.exZh: 老師認為他的答案正確，給他一分。

words.ex: Strawberries are a seasonal fruit that we buy in winter.
words.exZh: 草莓是季節性水果，我們都在冬天買。

words.zh: 供應、提供；（法規）條款、規定；糧食、補給品
words.ex: The provision of clean water is important in every town.
words.exZh: 提供乾淨的水對每個城鎮都很重要。

words.ex: My grandmother is very conservative about spending her money.
words.exZh: 我奶奶花錢的態度非常保守。

words.ex: Which song is the best is a subjective question.
words.exZh: 哪首歌最好聽是個主觀的問題。

words.ex: Many office workers suffer from dry eye syndrome.
words.exZh: 許多上班族都有乾眼症候群。

words.ex: After a long talk, the group reached a consensus on the trip.
words.exZh: 經過長談，大家對這趟旅行達成了共識。

words.ex: Swimming and hiking are my favorite forms of recreation on weekends.
words.exZh: 游泳和健行是我週末最愛的休閒活動。

words.ex: Bring a reusable cup when you buy drinks at the shop.
words.exZh: 在店裡買飲料時，記得帶可重複使用的杯子。

words.ex: Habits we form as children often stay with us into adulthood.
words.exZh: 我們小時候養成的習慣常會一直延續到成年。

words.ex: Under the microscope, we could see tiny cells in the onion skin.
words.exZh: 在顯微鏡下，我們能看到洋蔥表皮裡微小的細胞。

words.ex: My sister wants to study culinary arts and become a chef.
words.exZh: 我姊姊想學烹飪藝術，將來當廚師。

words.ex: The interviewer asked me why I wanted the job.
words.exZh: 面試官問我為什麼想要這份工作。

words.ex: I need to edit my essay before I hand it in.
words.exZh: 交出去之前，我得先修改我的文章。

words.ex: The story is about a brave girl and an evil wizard.
words.exZh: 這個故事講的是一個勇敢的女孩和一個邪惡的巫師。

words.ex: This bag looks nice, but it is fake.
words.exZh: 這個包包看起來不錯，但它是假貨。

words.ex: A bird sat on the wire near my window.
words.exZh: 一隻鳥停在我窗邊的電線上。

words.ex: We followed a narrow trail up the hill.
words.exZh: 我們沿著一條狹窄的小徑上山。

words.ex: It is a shame that the picnic was canceled by rain.
words.exZh: 野餐因為下雨取消了，真是可惜。

words.ex: The minister answered questions from reporters about the new bus system.
words.exZh: 部長回答記者有關新公車系統的提問。

words.ex: In the cartoon, a pirate wants to kidnap the little dog.
words.exZh: 在卡通裡，有個海盜想要綁架那隻小狗。

words.ex: Riding the big roller coaster gave us a real thrill.
words.exZh: 坐大雲霄飛車讓我們覺得超刺激。

words.ex: Fruit and vegetables have a lot of fiber, which is good for you.
words.exZh: 水果和蔬菜含有很多纖維，對身體很好。

words.ex: The merchant sold silk and tea in the old market.
words.exZh: 這位商人在古老的市場裡賣絲綢和茶。

words.ex: Our school team ranks second in the city this year.
words.exZh: 我們的學校球隊今年在全市排名第二。

words.ex: Washing your hands can help stop the spread of infection.
words.exZh: 洗手能幫助防止感染擴散。

words.zh: 使模糊；模糊的東西、模糊不清
words.ex: Rain can blur the view through the car window.
words.exZh: 雨會讓車窗外的景色變得模糊。

words.ex: Each neuron in the brain sends tiny signals to the cells next to it.
words.exZh: 大腦裡的每個神經元都會傳送微小的訊號給相鄰的細胞。

words.ex: Many people visited the memorial in the park to remember the town's founders.
words.exZh: 許多人到公園裡的紀念碑緬懷小鎮的創建者。

words.zh: 新生訓練、說明會；方位、朝向
words.ex: All new students attend an orientation before the first class.
words.exZh: 所有新生在第一堂課前都要參加新生訓練。

words.zh: 使熟悉、使適應；以…為導向（常用被動）
words.ex: The first week helps new students orient themselves to high school life.
words.exZh: 第一週幫助新生熟悉並適應高中生活。

words.ex: Our school held its inaugural science fair last spring.
words.exZh: 我們學校去年春天舉辦了第一屆科展。

words.ex: Drink plenty of water during the race to avoid dehydration.
words.exZh: 比賽時要多喝水，避免脫水。

words.zh: 標題、書名、歌名；冠軍頭銜、稱號
words.ex: Can you guess the title of this song from the first line?
words.exZh: 你能從第一句歌詞猜出這首歌的歌名嗎？

words.ex: The fish tank in our classroom needs cleaning.
words.exZh: 我們教室裡的魚缸需要清洗了。

words.zh: （故事的）情節；陰謀、祕密計畫；一小塊地
words.ex: The plot of this story is easy to follow.
words.exZh: 這個故事的情節很容易理解。

words.ex: Please do not dump trash in the river.
words.exZh: 請不要把垃圾倒進河裡。

words.ex: We put the picture in a wooden frame.
words.exZh: 我們把那張照片放進木框裡。

words.zh: 戰役、戰鬥；激烈的競爭、奮鬥
words.ex: Many old stories describe a great battle between two kingdoms.
words.exZh: 許多古老的故事描寫兩個王國之間的一場大戰。

words.ex: This quiet park is an ideal place to read.
words.exZh: 這座安靜的公園是讀書的理想地點。

words.ex: The police arrested the man who stole bikes near the station.
words.exZh: 警察逮捕了那個在車站附近偷腳踏車的男子。

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.exZh: 這條河形成了兩個國家之間的邊界。

words.ex: The shop gave us a free sample of the new cookie.
words.exZh: 店家送我們新餅乾的免費試吃品。

words.ex: Be careful not to spill the soup when you carry the bowl.
words.exZh: 端碗的時候小心不要把湯灑出來。

words.ex: My uncle likes to roast chicken in the oven on weekends.
words.exZh: 我叔叔週末喜歡用烤箱烤雞。

words.ex: They had to cancel the picnic because of heavy rain.
words.exZh: 因為下大雨，他們不得不取消野餐。

words.ex: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms.
words.exZh: 嬰兒在媽媽的懷裡安靜地睡著。

words.ex: The students found a fossil of a small fish in the rock.
words.exZh: 學生們在岩石裡發現了一條小魚的化石。

words.ex: Many neighbors came to the funeral to say goodbye.
words.exZh: 很多鄰居來參加喪禮，作最後的道別。

words.ex: The scholar spent many years studying old books.
words.exZh: 那位學者花了很多年研究古書。

words.ex: Farmers work hard during the rice harvest in autumn.
words.exZh: 農夫在秋天稻米收成期間非常辛勞。

words.ex: Please squeeze a little lemon juice onto the fish.
words.exZh: 請擠一點檸檬汁在魚上。

words.ex: He decided to confess that he broke the window.
words.exZh: 他決定承認窗戶是他打破的。

words.ex: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the shirt.
words.exZh: 請留著收據，以防你需要退回這件襯衫。

words.ex: The young man gave his seat to a pregnant woman on the bus.
words.exZh: 那位年輕人在公車上把座位讓給一位孕婦。

words.ex: There is a rumor that our school will build a new pool.
words.exZh: 有傳聞說我們學校會蓋一座新游泳池。

words.zh: 體貼的；深思的、若有所思的
words.ex: It was thoughtful of you to bring me an umbrella.
words.exZh: 你幫我帶了一把傘，真是體貼。

words.zh: 反抗、叛逆；叛逆者、反抗者
words.ex: Some teenagers rebel against rules just to feel free.
words.exZh: 有些青少年為了感受自由而反抗規定。

words.zh: 開花；（果樹的）花；成長茁壯、發展
words.ex: Cherry trees blossom in early spring, and many people come to see them.
words.exZh: 櫻花樹在初春開花，很多人會來欣賞。

words.ex: A large portrait of a smiling woman hangs in the hall.
words.exZh: 一幅微笑女子的大肖像掛在走廊上。

words.ex: Every region has its own cuisine with special flavors and dishes.
words.exZh: 每個地區都有自己的料理，有特別的味道和菜色。

words.ex: The restaurant received a complaint about the slow service.
words.exZh: 這家餐廳收到一則關於上菜太慢的投訴。

words.ex: The director told the actors to repeat the last scene again.
words.exZh: 導演要演員們把最後一幕再演一次。

words.ex: Can you calculate the total cost of these three books?
words.exZh: 你能算出這三本書的總價嗎？

words.ex: Her facial expression showed that she was very surprised.
words.exZh: 她臉上的表情顯示她非常驚訝。

words.zh: 到達、抵達；新來的人或物
words.ex: We waited at the gate for the arrival of the train.
words.exZh: 我們在閘門口等火車到站。

words.ex: Swimming twice a week helps improve your fitness.
words.exZh: 每週游泳兩次有助於提升體能。

words.ex: We had lunch, and afterward we went for a walk.
words.exZh: 我們吃了午餐，之後去散步。

words.ex: Write a short description of your favorite animal.
words.exZh: 寫一段簡短的文字描述你最喜歡的動物。

words.ex: Each garment in this little shop is sewn by hand.
words.exZh: 這家小店的每件衣服都是手工縫製的。

words.zh: 忠誠的、忠心的；忠實的（不改動原作）
words.ex: A faithful dog waited for its owner at the station every day.
words.exZh: 一隻忠心的狗每天都在車站等著牠的主人。

words.ex: This fish has firm white flesh that tastes great when grilled.
words.exZh: 這種魚的肉白皙結實，用烤的很好吃。

words.ex: The ship carried cargo such as rice, tea, and wooden boxes.
words.exZh: 那艘船載著米、茶和木箱之類的貨物。

words.ex: The moon travels in an orbit around the earth.
words.exZh: 月球沿著軌道繞著地球運行。

words.zh: 格式；編排格式、格式化；（節目、活動的）形式
words.ex: Please save the photo in a different format before you send it.
words.exZh: 傳送之前，請把照片存成另一種格式。

words.ex: The whole village came together to mourn the kind old doctor.
words.exZh: 全村的人聚在一起哀悼那位親切的老醫生。

words.ex: Our team needs one more win to qualify for the finals.
words.exZh: 我們隊再贏一場就能晉級決賽。

words.ex: The villagers think the old mountain is a sacred place.
words.exZh: 村民認為那座古老的山是一處神聖的地方。

words.ex: Wet floors are a hazard for people who walk fast.
words.exZh: 濕滑的地板對走得快的人來說很危險。

words.ex: A wise king governed the land for many peaceful years.
words.exZh: 一位賢明的國王治理這片土地許多年，天下太平。

words.ex: You can customize your phone with different colors and sounds.
words.exZh: 你可以用不同的顏色和聲音來客製化你的手機。

words.zh: 先驅、開拓者；開創、率先採用
words.ex: She was a pioneer in teaching science to young children.
words.exZh: 她是把科學教給年幼孩子的先驅。

words.ex: I opened the attachment in the email and printed the map.
words.exZh: 我打開電子郵件的附件，把地圖印了出來。

words.zh: 可能性、指望；前途、發展機會
words.ex: The prospect of a long holiday made everyone happy.
words.exZh: 想到即將放長假，大家都很開心。

words.zh: 金色的、金黃的；絕佳的、難得的
words.ex: The children ran across the field of golden wheat.
words.exZh: 孩子們跑過一片金黃色的麥田。

words.ex: The coach decided to resign after ten years with the team.
words.exZh: 教練帶隊十年後決定辭職。

words.ex: His kind remark made the shy girl smile.
words.exZh: 他一句親切的話讓那個害羞的女孩笑了。

words.ex: This jacket is made of synthetic material, so it dries quickly.
words.exZh: 這件外套是合成材質做的，所以乾得很快。

words.ex: Fresh air circulates through the room when we open the windows.
words.exZh: 我們打開窗戶時，新鮮空氣就會在房間裡流通。

words.ex: The team built a prototype of the robot before making more.
words.exZh: 團隊在大量製造之前，先做了一個機器人的原型。

words.ex: The school will certify that you finished the course.
words.exZh: 學校會證明你已經修完這門課。

words.zh: 操縱（他人）；（熟練地）操作、處理
words.ex: He tried to manipulate his friends into doing his homework.
words.exZh: 他想操縱朋友幫他寫作業。

words.ex: Please discard the old milk before it makes the fridge smell.
words.exZh: 請在冰箱變臭之前把過期牛奶丟掉。

words.ex: The class made a collective decision to plan a picnic.
words.exZh: 全班共同決定要籌劃一次野餐。

words.zh: 移植（植物）、移種；（器官）移植手術
words.ex: Farmers transplant young rice plants into the wet field.
words.exZh: 農夫把稻苗移植到濕潤的田裡。

words.zh: 使變成、使成為；提供、給予
words.ex: The heavy rain rendered the small road impossible to use.
words.exZh: 大雨使那條小路完全無法通行。

words.ex: Very few plants can grow in this arid land without rain.
words.exZh: 在這片不下雨的乾旱土地上，很少植物能生長。

words.ex: Every student filled out a questionnaire about their sleep habits.
words.exZh: 每位學生都填寫了一份關於睡眠習慣的問卷。

words.ex: Farmers use fertilizer to help their rice grow faster.
words.exZh: 農夫使用肥料幫助稻子長得更快。

words.zh: 符合、遵守（規定）；順從、隨大流
words.ex: All bike helmets must conform to the new safety rules.
words.exZh: 所有的腳踏車安全帽都必須符合新的安全規定。

words.ex: My grandparents speak a dialect that I can only partly understand.
words.exZh: 我的祖父母說一種我只聽得懂一部分的方言。

words.ex: Many rare animals lose their homes when a rainforest is cut down.
words.exZh: 雨林被砍伐時，許多稀有動物會失去牠們的家。

words.ex: Can people and wild animals coexist peacefully in the same area?
words.exZh: 人類和野生動物能在同一個地區和平共存嗎？

words.ex: People with dementia may forget the names of family members.
words.exZh: 失智症患者可能會忘記家人的名字。

words.ex: My grandfather was hospitalized for a week with a bad cough.
words.exZh: 我爺爺因為嚴重咳嗽住院了一個星期。

words.ex: Dark clouds in the west usually signify that heavy rain is coming.
words.exZh: 西邊出現烏雲，通常表示大雨快來了。

words.ex: A sedentary lifestyle with little exercise raises the risk of heart disease.
words.exZh: 久坐少動的生活方式會提高罹患心臟病的風險。

words.ex: Other scientists could not replicate the surprising results of the experiment.
words.exZh: 其他科學家無法重現那個實驗令人驚訝的結果。

words.zh: 原木、木頭；登入；日誌、紀錄
words.ex: We sat on a big log beside the campfire.
words.exZh: 我們坐在營火旁的一根大木頭上。

words.ex: Laughter filled the classroom when the teacher told a funny story.
words.exZh: 老師講了一個好笑的故事，教室裡充滿了笑聲。

words.zh: （一車的）貨物、負擔；裝（貨）、裝載；（網頁、程式）載入
words.ex: The truck carried a heavy load of fresh vegetables.
words.exZh: 卡車載了滿滿一車新鮮的蔬菜。

words.ex: Do not quit when the work becomes difficult.
words.exZh: 工作變難的時候不要放棄。

words.ex: Don't forget to bring your camping gear on the trip.
words.exZh: 別忘了帶你的露營裝備去旅行。

words.ex: Lemon juice has acid in it, so it tastes sour.
words.exZh: 檸檬汁含有酸，所以嚐起來很酸。

words.ex: Long ago, trains used coal to make steam.
words.exZh: 很久以前，火車用煤來產生蒸汽。

words.ex: He didn't dare to look down from the top of the tower.
words.exZh: 他站在塔頂，不敢往下看。

words.ex: My knee was swollen and painful after I fell off my bike.
words.exZh: 我從腳踏車上摔下來後，膝蓋又腫又痛。

words.ex: Leftover fruit will rot quickly in the summer heat.
words.exZh: 吃剩的水果在夏天的高溫下很快就會腐爛。

words.ex: He moved to the city for the sake of his children.
words.exZh: 他為了孩子而搬到城市裡。

words.ex: The fate of the old tree depends on the town's decision.
words.exZh: 這棵老樹的命運取決於鎮上的決定。

words.ex: Many trees shed their leaves in the fall.
words.exZh: 許多樹木在秋天會落葉。

words.ex: The children made small animals out of soft clay.
words.exZh: 孩子們用軟黏土捏出小動物。

words.ex: He shouted in rage when he saw the broken window.
words.exZh: 他看到破掉的窗戶時憤怒地大喊。

words.ex: I swear that I will keep your secret.
words.exZh: 我發誓會替你保守這個祕密。

words.ex: Please toss the ball to me and I will catch it.
words.exZh: 請把球丟給我，我會接住。

words.zh: 溫和的、暖和的；輕微的；（味道）溫和的、不辣的
words.ex: The weather is mild in spring, so we often go outside.
words.exZh: 春天天氣溫和，所以我們常常到戶外去。

words.ex: The teacher measured the depth of the pool.
words.exZh: 老師量了泳池的深度。

words.ex: The frog leaped from one leaf to another.
words.exZh: 青蛙從一片葉子跳到另一片葉子上。

words.ex: She looked pale because she had not slept well.
words.exZh: 她因為沒睡好而臉色蒼白。

words.ex: Dad sighed and put the broken toy back on the shelf.
words.exZh: 爸爸嘆了口氣，把壞掉的玩具放回架子上。

words.ex: Soak the beans in water overnight before you cook them.
words.exZh: 煮之前先把豆子泡水一整夜。

words.zh: 喜歡的、喜愛的；美好的、溫馨的（回憶）
words.ex: My grandfather is fond of walking in the park every morning.
words.exZh: 我爺爺很喜歡每天早上在公園散步。

words.ex: After the long hike, every limb in my body felt tired.
words.exZh: 走完長途健行後，我全身的手腳都好累。

words.ex: Mom had to shorten my pants because they were too long.
words.exZh: 媽媽得把我的褲子改短，因為太長了。

words.ex: He likes to brag about how fast he can run.
words.exZh: 他喜歡吹噓自己跑得有多快。

words.ex: There is a coffee stain on my new white shirt.
words.exZh: 我的新白襯衫上有一塊咖啡污漬。

words.ex: It is cruel to leave a pet alone for days.
words.exZh: 把寵物獨自留在家好幾天很殘忍。

words.ex: The boy began to choke on a piece of hard candy.
words.exZh: 男孩被一塊硬糖噎住了。

words.ex: The baby began to crawl toward the colorful toy.
words.exZh: 寶寶開始朝著彩色玩具爬去。

words.ex: Please do not tease your little brother about his haircut.
words.exZh: 請不要拿你弟弟的髮型取笑他。

words.zh: 說明書、手冊；手動的；用手的、體力的
words.ex: Read the manual carefully before you use the new machine.
words.exZh: 使用新機器前，請仔細閱讀說明書。

words.zh: 眨眼；（燈光）閃爍；一眨眼、一瞬間
words.ex: Try not to blink while I take your photo.
words.exZh: 我幫你拍照時，盡量不要眨眼。

words.ex: Using a bus pass gives you a saving of about twenty percent.
words.exZh: 使用公車月票可以讓你省下大約兩成的錢。

words.ex: My grandpa had a stroke and now walks with a cane.
words.exZh: 我爺爺中風過，現在要拄拐杖走路。

words.zh: 便裝的、休閒的；隨意的、不經意的
words.ex: We wore casual clothes to the picnic by the river.
words.exZh: 我們穿著輕便的衣服去河邊野餐。

words.ex: My grandmother shares her wisdom with us over tea.
words.exZh: 我奶奶在喝茶時和我們分享她的智慧。

words.ex: Please insert the coin into the slot first.
words.exZh: 請先把硬幣投入投幣孔。

words.ex: Police officers patrol the night market every evening.
words.exZh: 警察每天晚上都在夜市巡邏。

words.ex: The little boy shook with terror during the loud thunderstorm.
words.exZh: 小男孩在猛烈的雷雨中嚇得發抖。

words.ex: The puppy sniffed every corner of the new room.
words.exZh: 小狗把新房間的每個角落都聞了一遍。

words.ex: A stone statue of a lion stands in front of the library.
words.exZh: 圖書館前面立著一座石獅子雕像。

words.ex: The penalty for parking here is a large fine.
words.exZh: 在這裡停車會被罰一大筆錢。

words.ex: All passengers are now aboard, and the ship is ready to leave.
words.exZh: 所有乘客都已上船，船準備出發了。

words.ex: We visited a small gallery and looked at many paintings.
words.exZh: 我們參觀了一家小畫廊，看了很多畫。

words.ex: The trip to the beach was very enjoyable for everyone.
words.exZh: 這趟海邊之旅讓大家都玩得很愉快。

words.ex: Don't believe every piece of gossip you hear at school.
words.exZh: 不要相信你在學校聽到的每一則八卦。

words.ex: The motor of the toy car suddenly stopped working.
words.exZh: 這輛玩具車的馬達突然不動了。

words.ex: The emperor lived in a huge palace with hundreds of rooms.
words.exZh: 皇帝住在一座有上百個房間的巨大宮殿裡。

words.ex: The balloon drifted upward until we could not see it.
words.exZh: 氣球往上飄，直到我們看不見它。

words.ex: The amateur singer sang better than many professionals.
words.exZh: 這位業餘歌手唱得比許多專業人士還好。

words.ex: After losing last year, our team wanted revenge in the final.
words.exZh: 去年輸了之後，我們隊想在決賽中報一箭之仇。

words.ex: News of the scandal spread quickly through the small town.
words.exZh: 醜聞的消息很快傳遍了這個小鎮。

words.ex: Not every wild mushroom in the forest is edible.
words.exZh: 森林裡的野生菇類並不是每一種都能吃。

words.ex: The cat is hiding beneath the wooden table in the kitchen.
words.exZh: 貓躲在廚房的木桌下面。

words.ex: Stir the mixture of flour, eggs, and sugar until it is smooth.
words.exZh: 把麵粉、雞蛋和糖的混合物攪拌到滑順為止。

words.ex: He made a sincere apology for being late to practice.
words.exZh: 他為練習遲到誠懇地道歉。

words.ex: Each province in the country has its own local food.
words.exZh: 這個國家的每個省都有自己的地方美食。

words.ex: We need your input before we decide on the class trip.
words.exZh: 在決定班遊之前，我們需要你的意見。

words.ex: This wooden chair is an antique from my great-grandfather.
words.exZh: 這張木椅是我曾祖父留下來的古董。

words.ex: The old street looked romantic under the soft yellow lights.
words.exZh: 老街在柔和的黃色燈光下顯得很浪漫。

words.ex: The worker will inspect every bike before it leaves the shop.
words.exZh: 工作人員會在每輛腳踏車出店前逐一檢查。

words.ex: Let's meet at the main entrance of the library at noon.
words.exZh: 我們中午在圖書館的大門口碰面吧。

words.ex: You must renew your library card every year.
words.exZh: 你每年都必須更新你的借書證。

words.ex: Time is precious, so do not waste it.
words.exZh: 時間很寶貴，所以不要浪費。

words.ex: We read a short dialogue between two friends in English class.
words.exZh: 我們在英文課念了一段兩個朋友之間的簡短對話。

words.ex: The clown told an amusing story about a lost hat.
words.exZh: 小丑講了一個關於遺失帽子的好笑故事。

words.ex: My uncle works overseas and visits us every summer.
words.exZh: 我叔叔在海外工作，每年夏天都會來看我們。

words.ex: An invasion of ants ruined our picnic in the park.
words.exZh: 一群螞蟻大舉入侵，毀了我們在公園的野餐。

words.ex: Eating too much sugar can raise the risk of diabetes.
words.exZh: 吃太多糖會提高罹患糖尿病的風險。

words.ex: Her parents got a loan from the bank to buy a small house.
words.exZh: 她的父母向銀行貸款來買一間小房子。

words.ex: I have felt tired lately because I go to bed too late.
words.exZh: 我最近覺得很累，因為太晚上床睡覺了。

words.ex: The school decided to postpone the sports day because of the storm.
words.exZh: 學校因為暴風雨決定把運動會延期。

words.ex: The customer decided to sue the company for the broken phone.
words.exZh: 那位顧客決定為了壞掉的手機控告那家公司。

words.ex: A large colony of ants lives under the old tree.
words.exZh: 一大群螞蟻住在那棵老樹下面。

words.ex: His hard work made him worthy of the prize.
words.exZh: 他的努力讓他值得獲得這個獎。

words.ex: The hot weather took away my appetite at lunch.
words.exZh: 天氣很熱，午餐時我都沒胃口。

words.zh: 經典作品；典型的、經典的
words.ex: This old film is a classic that many families enjoy.
words.exZh: 這部老電影是許多家庭都喜愛的經典。

words.ex: The road was partly closed because of the fallen tree.
words.exZh: 因為倒下的樹，這條路有一部分被封閉了。

words.ex: She gave me a large portion of fried rice.
words.exZh: 她給了我一大份炒飯。

words.ex: Please put your phone in silent mode during class.
words.exZh: 上課時請把手機調成靜音模式。

words.ex: The departure of the train was delayed by ten minutes.
words.exZh: 火車延後十分鐘出發。

words.ex: You can choose whatever you like from this shelf.
words.exZh: 你可以從這個書架上選任何你喜歡的東西。

words.ex: The children pretend to be animals in the garden.
words.exZh: 孩子們在花園裡假裝自己是動物。

words.zh: 即溶的、速食的；立即的、即時的；瞬間、片刻
words.ex: My brother often eats instant noodles for a quick lunch.
words.exZh: 我哥哥常常吃泡麵當作簡單的午餐。

words.zh: 儲藏、儲藏空間；（電腦等的）儲存容量
words.ex: We keep old toys in the storage room upstairs.
words.exZh: 我們把舊玩具放在樓上的儲藏室裡。

words.ex: I have a dental checkup next week, so I brush carefully.
words.exZh: 我下星期要做牙齒檢查，所以我很仔細地刷牙。

words.ex: She was the sole winner of the drawing contest.
words.exZh: 她是那場繪畫比賽唯一的得獎者。

words.ex: The students made a clay sculpture in art class today.
words.exZh: 學生們今天在美術課做了一件黏土雕塑。

words.zh: 棘手的、難處理的；狡猾的、詭計多端的
words.ex: The last question on the test was really tricky.
words.exZh: 考卷上最後一題真的很難。

words.zh: 昂貴的；代價高的、損失大的
words.ex: Buying a new phone every year is a costly habit.
words.exZh: 每年都買新手機是很花錢的習慣。

words.ex: My sister prefers fiction to books about science.
words.exZh: 比起科學書，我妹妹比較喜歡小說。

words.ex: When the lights turn red, that is your cue to walk on stage.
words.exZh: 燈光一變紅，就是你上台的提示。

words.zh: （地上的）垃圾；亂丟、散落；（動物的）一窩
words.ex: Please pick up any litter you see on the beach.
words.exZh: 請撿起你在海灘上看到的任何垃圾。

words.ex: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not worry.
words.exZh: 每個人有時都會犯錯，所以別擔心。

words.zh: 不知怎麼地；以某種方法、設法
words.ex: Somehow I lost my keys on the way home.
words.exZh: 不知怎麼的，我在回家路上弄丟了鑰匙。

words.zh: 大綱；輪廓、外形；概述、簡要說明
words.ex: Before writing the essay, she made an outline on a piece of paper.
words.exZh: 寫作文之前，她先在紙上列了大綱。

words.zh: 喚醒、醒來；喚起、激起（興趣等）
words.ex: The sound of birds awakened me early this morning.
words.exZh: 今天一大早，鳥叫聲把我吵醒了。

words.ex: Our bodies need minerals like iron and calcium to stay healthy.
words.exZh: 我們的身體需要鐵和鈣等礦物質來保持健康。

words.ex: A good judge should not show bias toward either team.
words.exZh: 好的裁判不應該偏袒任何一隊。

words.zh: 可能性、機率；困難、不利條件
words.ex: The odds of rain today are quite low.
words.exZh: 今天下雨的機率相當低。

words.ex: Only a trained operator can use this big machine.
words.exZh: 只有受過訓練的操作員才能使用這台大機器。

words.ex: We will take a mock exam on Friday to practice.
words.exZh: 我們星期五要考模擬考來練習。

words.ex: The bus came to a sudden halt at the red light.
words.exZh: 公車在紅燈前突然停了下來。

words.ex: Wearing uniforms is the norm in most schools here.
words.exZh: 在這裡，穿制服是大多數學校的常態。

words.ex: The dancer moved across the stage with great grace.
words.exZh: 那位舞者優雅地在舞台上移動。

words.ex: Our family holds a reunion at my grandmother's house every year.
words.exZh: 我們家每年都在奶奶家團聚。

words.ex: The cat is sleeping underneath the kitchen table.
words.exZh: 貓正在廚房餐桌底下睡覺。

words.ex: The toddler laughed and ran across the room on his short legs.
words.exZh: 那個小小孩笑著用短短的腿跑過房間。

words.ex: I do a short workout every morning before school.
words.exZh: 我每天早上上學前做一下簡短的運動。

words.ex: The cat waited silently for its prey to come closer.
words.exZh: 貓靜靜地等獵物靠近。

words.ex: The family sold the large estate and moved to a small apartment.
words.exZh: 那家人賣掉了大莊園，搬到一間小公寓。

words.ex: The town built a shelter for homeless people in winter.
words.exZh: 鎮上在冬天為無家可歸的人蓋了收容所。

words.ex: The team returned home covered in glory after the final game.
words.exZh: 球隊在決賽後帶著榮耀回家。

words.ex: Helping a stranger in trouble is a noble act.
words.exZh: 幫助遇到麻煩的陌生人是高尚的行為。

words.ex: The hero began a long quest to find the lost key.
words.exZh: 英雄展開了一段漫長的追尋，要找到那把失落的鑰匙。

words.zh: 統治期間、在位期間；統治、盛行
words.ex: The queen's reign lasted for more than fifty years.
words.exZh: 女王在位五十多年。

words.ex: The scope of the test includes the first three lessons.
words.exZh: 這次考試的範圍包括前三課。

words.ex: Each idea has its merit, so let's listen to everyone.
words.exZh: 每個想法都有它的優點，所以讓我們聽聽每個人的意見。

words.zh: 有價值的人或物、優勢；資產、財產
words.ex: Being able to speak two languages is a great asset.
words.exZh: 會說兩種語言是很大的優勢。

words.ex: The headline on the front page was about a new bridge.
words.exZh: 頭版的新聞標題是關於一座新橋。

words.zh: 健壯的、擅長運動的；運動的、體育的
words.ex: My cousin is tall and athletic, and he plays every sport well.
words.exZh: 我表哥又高又健壯，什麼運動都玩得很好。

words.ex: Troops helped carry food and water to the flooded town.
words.exZh: 軍隊協助把食物和水送到淹水的小鎮。

words.zh: 悄悄移動、躡手躡腳；（植物）蔓生、攀爬
words.ex: I tried to creep past my sleeping dog without waking him.
words.exZh: 我想躡手躡腳經過睡著的狗，不吵醒牠。

words.ex: The documentary about deep sea animals was truly fascinating.
words.exZh: 那部深海動物紀錄片真的非常引人入勝。

words.zh: 選擇、挑選；可供選擇的種類、精選品
words.ex: The selection of the team captain took the whole afternoon.
words.exZh: 挑選隊長花了整個下午。

words.ex: Planting more trees can help combat air pollution.
words.exZh: 多種樹能幫助對抗空氣汙染。

words.zh: 濃密的、濃厚的；密集的、稠密的
words.ex: A dense fog covered the road, so the bus moved slowly.
words.exZh: 濃霧籠罩道路，所以公車開得很慢。

words.zh: 儘管（片語用法）；惡意、怨恨
words.ex: In spite of the rain, we still went hiking in the mountains.
words.exZh: 儘管下雨，我們還是去山上健行了。

words.zh: 沒希望的、絕望的；很不擅長的、很差的
words.ex: Things looked hopeless after we lost our map in the forest.
words.exZh: 我們在森林裡弄丟地圖後，情況看起來毫無希望。

words.ex: I dread the moment when the teacher hands back the tests.
words.exZh: 我很怕老師發還考卷的那一刻。

words.ex: You can ask the tourist bureau for a free map of the city.
words.exZh: 你可以向旅遊服務處要一份免費的市區地圖。

words.ex: After the long hike, I craved a cold glass of water.
words.exZh: 走了很久的山路後，我好想喝一杯冰水。

words.ex: Classes will resume next Monday after the long holiday.
words.exZh: 長假過後，課程將在下週一恢復。

words.ex: Cleaning the yard is a family affair on Sunday mornings.
words.exZh: 週日早上打掃院子是全家人一起做的事。

words.ex: The small island gets heavy rainfall every summer.
words.exZh: 這座小島每年夏天的降雨量都很大。

words.ex: She helps her grandfather manage his money and other affairs.
words.exZh: 她幫爺爺處理錢和其他事務。

words.zh: 痛苦的、難受的；（天氣等）糟糕的
words.ex: I felt miserable when my best friend moved to another city.
words.exZh: 好朋友搬到別的城市時，我覺得很難過。

words.ex: Talking to a counselor can help people recover from trauma.
words.exZh: 和輔導老師談談能幫助人們從創傷中復原。

words.ex: What percentage of the class walks to school?
words.exZh: 班上有百分之多少的人走路上學？

words.ex: The toy had a small defect, so the shop gave me a new one.
words.exZh: 這個玩具有個小瑕疵，所以店家給了我一個新的。

words.ex: An electrical problem made all the lights in the room go out.
words.exZh: 電路故障讓房間裡的燈全都熄了。

words.ex: It is absurd to wear a heavy coat on such a hot day.
words.exZh: 這麼熱的天穿厚外套真是荒謬。

words.ex: I only watched the first segment of the show.
words.exZh: 我只看了節目的第一段。

words.zh: 訂婚；約定、事先的安排；參與、投入
words.ex: My cousin announced her engagement at a small family dinner.
words.exZh: 我表姊在一場小小的家庭晚餐上宣布她訂婚了。

words.ex: Learning to ride a bike was a big milestone for the boy.
words.exZh: 學會騎腳踏車對那個男孩來說是個重要的里程碑。

words.ex: The young pianist made her debut at the school concert.
words.exZh: 這位年輕的鋼琴家在學校音樂會上首次登台。

words.ex: The Ministry of Education announced a new plan for high schools.
words.exZh: 教育部宣布了一項新的高中計畫。

words.ex: The tiny robot amazed everyone at the science fair.
words.exZh: 那個小機器人讓科展上的每個人都很驚訝。

words.ex: Loud phone calls on the bus really annoy other passengers.
words.exZh: 在公車上大聲講電話，真的會讓其他乘客很煩。

words.ex: Thunder often frightens our dog, so it hides under the bed.
words.exZh: 打雷常把我們的狗嚇到，所以牠會躲到床底下。

words.zh: 壯麗的、華麗的；極好的、很棒的
words.ex: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the train.
words.exZh: 我們從火車上可以看到壯麗的山景。

words.ex: Our school has a literary club that meets every Friday.
words.exZh: 我們學校有一個每週五聚會的文學社。

words.ex: Taking the bus is more economical than taking a taxi every day.
words.exZh: 搭公車比每天搭計程車更省錢。

words.ex: The brutal winter made it hard for animals to find food.
words.exZh: 嚴酷的冬天讓動物很難找到食物。

words.ex: The team refused to surrender even though they were far behind.
words.exZh: 即使遠遠落後，這支隊伍仍拒絕認輸。

words.ex: The town's geographical location makes it warm in winter.
words.exZh: 這座城鎮的地理位置使它冬天很溫暖。

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of a fox behind the tree.
words.exZh: 我瞥見樹後面有一隻狐狸。

words.ex: The fertile soil in this valley is perfect for growing rice.
words.exZh: 這個山谷肥沃的土壤非常適合種稻。

words.zh: 企業、公司；進取心、事業心
words.ex: The family's small enterprise sells handmade bags online.
words.exZh: 這家人的小企業在網路上販售手工袋子。

words.ex: The bank keeps a record of every transaction.
words.exZh: 銀行會記錄每一筆交易。

words.ex: Please write your name and nationality on the first line.
words.exZh: 請在第一行寫下你的姓名和國籍。

words.ex: The strong sunlight could not penetrate the thick clouds.
words.exZh: 強烈的陽光無法穿透厚厚的雲層。

words.zh: 打碎、粉碎；使（希望等）破滅
words.ex: The glass fell off the table and shattered on the floor.
words.exZh: 玻璃杯從桌上掉下來，在地板上摔碎了。

words.ex: A mighty river flows through the middle of the country.
words.exZh: 一條浩大的河流從這個國家的中央流過。

words.zh: 凶猛的；惡毒的；惡性（循環）的
words.ex: The vicious dog barked and pulled hard on its rope.
words.exZh: 那隻凶猛的狗一邊吠一邊用力扯繩子。

words.ex: Our day in the mountains was the most memorable part of summer.
words.exZh: 我們在山上度過的那一天，是整個暑假最難忘的回憶。

words.ex: I accidentally left my umbrella on the bus this morning.
words.exZh: 我今天早上不小心把雨傘忘在公車上。

words.ex: The accidental spill of milk made a mess on the table.
words.exZh: 不小心打翻牛奶，把桌子弄得一團亂。

words.zh: 抓住、抓取；匆忙拿、隨便吃點
words.ex: The boy grabs his mother's hand when they cross the street.
words.exZh: 過馬路時，男孩會抓住媽媽的手。

words.ex: She looked at my new bike with envy.
words.exZh: 她羨慕地看著我的新腳踏車。

words.zh: 使驚嘆、使傾倒；（強光）使目眩
words.ex: The young pianist dazzled the audience with her fast fingers.
words.exZh: 那位年輕鋼琴家飛快的指法讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

words.ex: I have faith that you can pass the test.
words.exZh: 我相信你能通過這次考試。

words.ex: Please clean up the mess in your room today.
words.exZh: 今天請把你房間裡的髒亂收拾乾淨。

words.ex: We watched a documentary about whales in science class.
words.exZh: 我們在自然課上看了一部關於鯨魚的紀錄片。

words.ex: We shivered at the bus stop on the cold winter morning.
words.exZh: 寒冷的冬天早上，我們在公車站冷得發抖。

words.ex: We heard a faint sound of music from the next room.
words.exZh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來微弱的音樂聲。

words.ex: We had a delightful picnic under the trees.
words.exZh: 我們在樹下辦了一場愉快的野餐。

words.ex: The museum shows exquisite jade carvings from hundreds of years ago.
words.exZh: 博物館展出幾百年前精緻的玉雕。

words.ex: Without any food, the lost animals could starve in winter.
words.exZh: 沒有食物的話，這些走失的動物冬天可能會餓死。

words.ex: My parents forbid me from playing video games on school nights.
words.exZh: 我爸媽不准我在隔天要上學的晚上打電動。

words.ex: Please whisper in the library so others can study.
words.exZh: 在圖書館請小聲說話，讓別人能念書。

words.ex: The walls are so thin that I often overhear my neighbors talking.
words.exZh: 牆壁太薄了，我常不小心聽到鄰居講話。

words.ex: Write a short summary of the story in three sentences.
words.exZh: 用三句話寫出這個故事的簡短摘要。

words.ex: Many families stroll through the night market on weekends.
words.exZh: 很多家庭週末會到夜市閒逛。

words.ex: The teacher explained the usage of this word with three examples.
words.exZh: 老師用三個例子說明這個字的用法。

words.ex: Our flight leaves from Terminal 2, so we took the airport train there.
words.exZh: 我們的班機從第二航廈出發，所以我們搭機場捷運過去。

words.ex: After a long illness, my grandpa looked thin and frail.
words.exZh: 久病之後，我爺爺看起來又瘦又虛弱。

words.ex: His refusal to share the toys made the little girl cry.
words.exZh: 他不肯分享玩具，讓小女孩哭了。

words.ex: Clean water is one of the most important needs of humankind.
words.exZh: 乾淨的水是人類最重要的需求之一。

words.ex: Scientists believe the universe is still growing bigger.
words.exZh: 科學家相信宇宙仍在變大。

words.ex: Keep the bottle upright so the juice does not spill.
words.exZh: 把瓶子直立放好，果汁才不會灑出來。

words.ex: The police are looking into a bicycle theft near the park.
words.exZh: 警方正在調查公園附近的一起腳踏車失竊案。

words.ex: Divers found many colorful fish living around the coral reef.
words.exZh: 潛水員發現許多色彩繽紛的魚住在珊瑚礁附近。

words.ex: It is ridiculous to wear a heavy coat on a hot day.
words.exZh: 大熱天穿厚外套實在太荒謬了。

words.ex: The cake has a soft and smooth texture.
words.exZh: 這個蛋糕的口感柔軟綿密。

words.ex: The whole family sat down to a big feast on New Year's Eve.
words.exZh: 全家人在除夕坐下來享用一頓豐盛的大餐。

words.ex: The farmer gets up at dawn to feed his chickens.
words.exZh: 農夫在天剛亮時就起床餵他的雞。

words.zh: 等候、期待；（事物）等待著（某人）
words.ex: Many fans await the new season of their favorite show.
words.exZh: 很多粉絲都在等他們最愛節目的新一季。

words.ex: The bike rolled down the steep slope very fast.
words.exZh: 腳踏車沿著陡坡飛快地滾下去。

words.ex: As a new student, he felt like an outsider for the first month.
words.exZh: 身為新來的學生，他第一個月覺得自己像個外人。

words.ex: The little monkey clings to its mother as she climbs the tree.
words.exZh: 小猴子在媽媽爬樹時緊緊抓著她。

words.zh: 可惜的事、遺憾；同情、憐憫
words.ex: It is a pity that you cannot come to the picnic.
words.exZh: 你不能來野餐真是可惜。

words.ex: The kids looked at the giant whale in awe.
words.exZh: 孩子們驚嘆地看著那頭巨大的鯨魚。

words.zh: 奇怪的、不尋常的；特有的、獨特的
words.ex: There was a peculiar smell coming from the refrigerator this morning.
words.exZh: 今天早上冰箱傳出一股怪味。

words.ex: We sat on the roof and gazed at the stars.
words.exZh: 我們坐在屋頂上凝視星空。

words.ex: Plants reproduce by making seeds that grow into new plants.
words.exZh: 植物藉由製造種子來繁殖，種子會長成新的植物。

words.ex: She does not eat dairy, so she drinks soy milk instead.
words.exZh: 她不吃乳製品，所以改喝豆漿。

words.ex: Bees pollinate many of the fruits and vegetables we eat.
words.exZh: 蜜蜂替我們吃的許多蔬果授粉。

words.ex: She glanced at the clock and quickly packed her bag.
words.exZh: 她瞄了一眼時鐘，就趕快收拾書包。

words.ex: The children adore their kind and gentle grandmother.
words.exZh: 孩子們非常愛他們慈祥的奶奶。

words.ex: The old man shows great affection for his little dog.
words.exZh: 那位老先生對他的小狗充滿疼愛。

words.zh: 同伴的、同處境的；傢伙、男人
words.ex: I talked to a fellow student about the homework after class.
words.exZh: 下課後我和一位同學聊了聊作業。

words.ex: The smell of fresh bread lured us into the small bakery.
words.exZh: 新鮮麵包的香味把我們吸引進那家小麵包店。

words.ex: The king showed mercy and let the poor thief go home.
words.exZh: 國王心懷仁慈，放那個可憐的小偷回家了。

words.ex: The school will designate one room for the reading club.
words.exZh: 學校將指定一間教室給閱讀社使用。

words.ex: The thief was sentenced to two years of imprisonment.
words.exZh: 那個小偷被判了兩年徒刑。

words.ex: In the old story, the princess was imprisoned in a tall tower.
words.exZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，公主被關在一座高塔裡。

words.ex: The prisoner was finally set free after ten years.
words.exZh: 那名囚犯十年後終於獲釋。

words.ex: My dog is my best companion on long walks.
words.exZh: 在長途散步時，我的狗是我最好的夥伴。

words.zh: 狼吞虎嚥地吃；如飢似渴地閱讀；吞噬
words.ex: The hungry players devoured three large pizzas after the game.
words.exZh: 比賽結束後，餓壞的球員狼吞虎嚥吃掉三個大披薩。

words.ex: The detective in this book solves a murder in each chapter.
words.exZh: 這本書裡的偵探在每一章都會破解一樁謀殺案。

words.zh: 厭惡、噁心；使厭惡、使噁心
words.ex: She looked at the dirty bathroom with disgust.
words.exZh: 她厭惡地看著那間髒浴室。

words.zh: 徒勞的、白費的；自負的、愛虛榮的
words.ex: We tried in vain to fix the old radio.
words.exZh: 我們試著修那臺舊收音機，結果白費力氣。

words.ex: Many young fans worship the singer and copy her style.
words.exZh: 許多年輕歌迷崇拜那位歌手，還模仿她的穿著打扮。

words.ex: Solar panels on the roof help us save electricity.
words.exZh: 屋頂上的太陽能板幫我們節省用電。

words.ex: Each practice session at the pool lasts about one hour.
words.exZh: 在游泳池的每一節練習大約持續一小時。

words.zh: 淹死、溺水；（聲音）蓋過、淹沒
words.ex: Never swim alone in a river, or you may drown.
words.exZh: 千萬不要一個人在河裡游泳，否則可能會溺水。

words.ex: Thick vegetation covered the hills after the rainy season.
words.exZh: 雨季過後，茂密的草木覆蓋了山丘。

words.ex: After winning the gold medal, the young athlete became a household name.
words.exZh: 奪得金牌後，那位年輕選手變得家喻戶曉。

words.ex: A guardian must sign this form for students under eighteen.
words.exZh: 未滿十八歲的學生，需要由監護人簽署這份表格。

words.ex: Fresh mangoes are plentiful in summer, so they are cheap.
words.exZh: 夏天新鮮芒果很充足，所以很便宜。

words.ex: Without food from the volunteers, the stray dogs would face starvation.
words.exZh: 如果沒有志工送來的食物，這些流浪狗就會挨餓。

words.ex: The men tried to smuggle rare birds across the border.
words.exZh: 那些人企圖把稀有的鳥走私出境。

words.ex: The ambulance arrived within five minutes and took him to the hospital.
words.exZh: 救護車五分鐘內就到了，把他送到醫院。

words.ex: The execution of the new plan started on Monday.
words.exZh: 這項新計畫從星期一開始執行。

words.ex: The team will execute the plan step by step.
words.exZh: 團隊會一步一步執行這個計畫。

words.ex: Our coach changed tactics in the second half of the game.
words.exZh: 我們教練在下半場改變了戰術。

words.ex: Our class held an election to choose a new team leader.
words.exZh: 我們班舉辦了一場選舉來選出新的小組長。

words.ex: I like to browse the shelves of the small bookstore.
words.exZh: 我喜歡在那家小書店的書架間隨意翻看。

words.zh: 家務、例行瑣事；苦差事、麻煩事
words.ex: Washing the dishes is my least favorite household chore.
words.exZh: 洗碗是我最不喜歡的家事。

words.ex: The bold girl walked up to the stage and started singing.
words.exZh: 那個大膽的女孩走上舞台開始唱歌。

words.zh: 驚嘆、讚嘆；奇蹟、奇妙的事物
words.ex: Visitors often marvel at the beautiful old bridge.
words.exZh: 遊客常常對這座美麗的古橋讚嘆不已。

words.ex: The tenant pays rent to the owner on the first of every month.
words.exZh: 房客每個月一號付租金給屋主。

words.zh: 部分的、不完全的；偏愛的、特別喜歡
words.ex: Only a partial list of names was posted on the wall.
words.exZh: 牆上只貼出了一份不完整的名單。

words.ex: He despises people who tell lies to get ahead.
words.exZh: 他看不起靠說謊往上爬的人。

words.ex: She almost gave up in despair after failing the test twice.
words.exZh: 她考試連續失敗兩次後，幾乎絕望得想放棄。

words.zh: 消化（食物）；理解、吸收（資訊）
words.ex: It takes several hours to digest a big meal.
words.exZh: 消化一頓大餐要花好幾個小時。

words.ex: My grandfather enjoys a solitary walk along the river every morning.
words.exZh: 我爺爺每天早上喜歡獨自沿著河邊散步。

words.ex: I borrowed a biography of a famous scientist from the library.
words.exZh: 我從圖書館借了一本知名科學家的傳記。

words.zh: 核心；果核；核心的、主要的
words.ex: Teamwork is at the core of our school club.
words.exZh: 團隊合作是我們學校社團的核心。

words.zh: 熱鬧的；活潑的、充滿活力的
words.ex: The night market was lively and full of music.
words.exZh: 夜市很熱鬧，到處都是音樂。

words.ex: The sunset over the sea was absolutely gorgeous tonight.
words.exZh: 今晚海上的夕陽美極了。

words.zh: 茂盛的、蒼翠的；華美的、豪華的
words.ex: After the rainy season, the hills are lush and green.
words.exZh: 雨季過後，山丘一片青翠茂盛。

words.ex: My mother bustled around the kitchen before the guests arrived.
words.exZh: 客人到之前，我媽媽在廚房裡忙進忙出。

words.ex: Most of the island is mountainous, so many people live near the coast.
words.exZh: 這座島大部分是山地，所以很多人住在海岸附近。

words.zh: （精神上的）痛苦、折磨；使痛苦、折磨
words.ex: Waiting for the exam results was a real torment for me.
words.exZh: 等考試成績對我來說真是一種煎熬。

words.ex: I am allergic to peanuts, so I check every snack label.
words.exZh: 我對花生過敏，所以我會檢查每包零食的標示。

words.ex: I have an allergy to peanuts, so I check every label.
words.exZh: 我對花生過敏，所以每個標示都會看。

words.ex: We spent a tranquil afternoon fishing by the lake.
words.exZh: 我們在湖邊釣魚，度過一個寧靜的下午。

words.ex: The village sits at an elevation of two thousand meters.
words.exZh: 這個村莊位於海拔兩千公尺的地方。

words.ex: In the past, some schools segregated students by the color of their skin.
words.exZh: 過去有些學校依膚色把學生隔開。

words.zh: 搶劫；剝奪（rob sb. of sth.）
words.ex: Two men tried to rob a convenience store late last night.
words.exZh: 昨晚深夜有兩名男子企圖搶劫一家便利商店。

words.ex: In the legend, a greedy lord oppressed the farmers with heavy taxes.
words.exZh: 在傳說中，一位貪婪的領主用重稅壓迫農民。

words.ex: The orchestra played a long symphony with four parts.
words.exZh: 管弦樂團演奏了一首有四個樂章的長篇交響曲。

words.ex: Our class leader gave an eloquent speech at the graduation ceremony.
words.exZh: 我們班長在畢業典禮上發表了一場精彩動人的演說。

words.ex: The brave warrior in the old story protected his village.
words.exZh: 古老故事裡那位勇敢的戰士保護了他的村莊。

words.zh: 豎立、搭建；直立的、挺直的
words.ex: The workers erected a large tent in the field for the fair.
words.exZh: 工人們在空地上搭起一座大帳篷供市集使用。

words.zh: 閃耀、閃閃發亮；光彩、閃光
words.ex: The lake seemed to sparkle in the morning sun.
words.exZh: 湖面在晨光中彷彿閃閃發亮。

words.zh: 接待處、櫃檯；歡迎會；（手機等）收訊
words.ex: Please wait in the reception area until the doctor calls you.
words.exZh: 請在接待區等候，直到醫生叫你。

words.ex: The cat tried to sneak into the kitchen for some fish.
words.exZh: 那隻貓想偷偷溜進廚房找魚吃。

words.ex: A stranger assaulted the night guard but ran away when the police came.
words.exZh: 一名陌生人襲擊夜班警衛，但警察來時就逃走了。

words.ex: Students showed solidarity by helping their classmates after the flood.
words.exZh: 水災過後，學生們團結起來幫助同學。

words.ex: Rice, noodles, and bread are all rich in carbohydrates.
words.exZh: 米飯、麵和麵包都富含碳水化合物。

words.ex: Good hydration is important when you run on hot days.
words.exZh: 大熱天跑步時，補充足夠水分很重要。

words.ex: Farmers on the hill feed their livestock twice a day.
words.exZh: 山坡上的農夫一天餵家畜兩次。

words.ex: Your room is messy, so please clean it before dinner.
words.exZh: 你的房間很亂，晚餐前請整理乾淨。

words.ex: The abbreviation for Monday on our class schedule is Mon.
words.exZh: 我們課表上 Monday 的縮寫是 Mon。

words.ex: This is the newest edition of the school dictionary.
words.exZh: 這是學校字典的最新版本。

words.ex: In the past, many farm families slaughtered a pig for the New Year.
words.exZh: 以前很多農家會在過年時殺一頭豬。

words.zh: 放逐、驅逐；消除、趕走（念頭）
words.ex: The king banished the dishonest minister to a faraway island.
words.exZh: 國王把那位不誠實的大臣流放到遙遠的島上。

words.ex: It was torture to wait in a hot room for two hours.
words.exZh: 在悶熱的房間裡等兩個小時真是折磨。

words.ex: Flex your knees a little before you jump into the pool.
words.exZh: 跳進泳池前，把膝蓋稍微彎曲一下。

words.ex: The receptionist smiled and asked us to wait a moment.
words.exZh: 櫃檯接待人員微笑著請我們稍等一下。

words.ex: The bamboo leaves rustled softly in the evening breeze.
words.exZh: 竹葉在傍晚的微風中沙沙作響。

words.ex: I fell off my bike and got a big bruise on my knee.
words.exZh: 我從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋瘀青了一大塊。

words.zh: 閃爍、閃耀；（眼中的）閃光、光芒
words.ex: Thousands of stars twinkle above the mountain on clear nights.
words.exZh: 晴朗的夜裡，山頂上有成千上萬顆星星閃爍。

words.ex: Pilgrims from many countries walk the old mountain path every year.
words.exZh: 每年都有來自許多國家的朝聖者走那條古老的山路。

words.ex: A throng of fans waited outside the airport for the singer.
words.exZh: 一大群歌迷在機場外等那位歌手。

words.ex: The sharp nail can pierce the tire easily.
words.exZh: 那根尖釘子很容易就能刺破輪胎。

words.ex: The boy had to kneel down to look for his coin under the bed.
words.exZh: 那個男孩得跪下來，找掉在床底下的硬幣。

words.ex: We walked under a stone arch to enter the old garden.
words.exZh: 我們走過一座石造拱門，進入那座古老的花園。

words.ex: He carried a heavy sack of rice into the kitchen.
words.exZh: 他把一大袋沉重的米扛進廚房。

words.ex: Customs officers caught a smuggler hiding rare birds in his bag.
words.exZh: 海關人員抓到一名把稀有鳥類藏在包包裡的走私者。

words.ex: Our class visited the presidential office building on a school trip.
words.exZh: 我們班校外教學時參觀了總統府。

words.ex: The baby sleeps in the nursery next to our bedroom.
words.exZh: 寶寶睡在我們臥室隔壁的育嬰室。

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken heater last week.
words.exZh: 房東上週修好了壞掉的暖氣。

words.ex: A bike rental shop is near the park entrance.
words.exZh: 公園入口附近有一家腳踏車出租店。

words.ex: My grandma believes it is a sin to waste even one grain of rice.
words.exZh: 我奶奶認為浪費一粒米都是罪過。

words.ex: The widow lived alone in a small house by the river.
words.exZh: 那位寡婦獨自住在河邊的一間小房子裡。

words.ex: The jury needed two days to reach a decision.
words.exZh: 陪審團花了兩天才做出決定。

words.ex: After two hours, the judge finally announced the verdict to everyone.
words.exZh: 兩小時後，法官終於向大家宣布判決。

words.ex: Farmers keep cattle on the green hills for milk and meat.
words.exZh: 農夫在青翠的山坡上養牛，取牛奶和牛肉。

words.ex: The incidence of flu rises sharply every winter.
words.exZh: 每年冬天流感的發生率都會急遽上升。

words.ex: Our teacher taught us that racism hurts many people.
words.exZh: 我們的老師教導我們，種族歧視會傷害許多人。

words.ex: Making jokes about skin color is racist and unkind.
words.exZh: 拿膚色開玩笑是種族歧視，也很不友善。

words.ex: In the past, segregation kept students of different races in separate schools.
words.exZh: 過去的種族隔離讓不同種族的學生讀不同的學校。

words.ex: The king lived in exile for many years after leaving his country.
words.exZh: 國王離開祖國後，流亡在外好多年。

words.ex: The police are looking into a robbery at the small shop.
words.exZh: 警方正在調查那家小店的搶案。

words.ex: History books describe how ordinary people struggled against oppression.
words.exZh: 歷史書描寫一般老百姓如何對抗壓迫。

words.zh: 反問的；修辭的、講究辭藻的
words.ex: My mom asked a rhetorical question, so I knew she did not want an answer.
words.exZh: 媽媽問的是反問句，所以我知道她不需要我回答。

words.zh: 修辭（技巧）；空話、花言巧語
words.ex: In speech class, we study rhetoric to make our arguments stronger.
words.exZh: 在演講課上，我們學習修辭技巧，讓論點更有說服力。

words.ex: She got a nice tan after a week at the beach.
words.exZh: 她在海邊待了一個星期，曬出了漂亮的古銅膚色。

words.ex: Kitchen towels get dark from the grease on the stove.
words.exZh: 廚房抹布被爐子上的油汙弄得黑黑的。

words.ex: She teaches a craft class on Saturday afternoons.
words.exZh: 她在星期六下午教手工藝課。

words.ex: The main station is a busy hub for buses and trains.
words.exZh: 總站是公車和火車的繁忙樞紐。

words.ex: Newborns sleep for most of the day and night.
words.exZh: 新生兒白天晚上大部分時間都在睡覺。

words.ex: This software helps students learn how to type faster.
words.exZh: 這套軟體能幫助學生學會更快地打字。

words.ex: The old bell in the town square is made of bronze.
words.exZh: 鎮上廣場那口古老的鐘是用青銅做的。

words.ex: The company sent an internal message to all its workers.
words.exZh: 公司發了一封內部訊息給所有員工。

words.ex: The tall tower has become an iconic sight in the city.
words.exZh: 那座高塔已成為城市裡的標誌性景觀。

words.ex: His obsession with video games worried his parents.
words.exZh: 他對電玩的著迷讓父母很擔心。

words.ex: The two small rivers merge and become one large river.
words.exZh: 兩條小河匯合後成為一條大河。

words.ex: Traffic congestion is a big problem in the city center.
words.exZh: 交通壅塞是市中心的一大問題。

words.ex: Babies learn to speak through imitation of the people around them.
words.exZh: 嬰兒透過模仿身邊的人學會說話。

words.ex: Listening to English songs helped me improve my pronunciation.
words.exZh: 聽英文歌幫助我改善了發音。

words.ex: The farm covers about fifty hectares of land near the river.
words.exZh: 這座農場占地大約五十公頃，就在河邊。

words.ex: Scratching will only exacerbate the itch from a mosquito bite.
words.exZh: 抓癢只會讓蚊子叮咬的地方更癢。

words.ex: Let's split the pizza into four equal pieces.
words.exZh: 我們把披薩分成四等份吧。

words.ex: My grandmother told us an old tale about a clever fox.
words.exZh: 奶奶告訴我們一個關於聰明狐狸的古老故事。

words.ex: Tap the small icon on the screen to open the camera.
words.exZh: 點一下螢幕上的小圖示就能打開相機。

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent on Earth, with many countries.
words.exZh: 亞洲是地球上最大的洲，有許多國家。

words.ex: We buy fresh fruit at the grocery store near our home.
words.exZh: 我們在家附近的雜貨店買新鮮水果。

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree trunk very quickly.
words.exZh: 松鼠很快地跑上樹幹。

words.ex: Our teacher told us that water is made of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.exZh: 老師告訴我們，水是由氫和氧組成的。

words.ex: The writer sent her manuscript to a publisher last month.
words.exZh: 那位作家上個月把手稿寄給了出版社。

words.ex: Travelers had to stay in quarantine for a few days.
words.exZh: 旅客必須隔離檢疫幾天。

words.ex: The young filmmaker showed her first short movie to the class.
words.exZh: 那位年輕的電影製作人在班上放映她的第一部短片。

words.ex: My little cousin loves to mimic the sounds of farm animals.
words.exZh: 我的小表弟很愛模仿農場動物的叫聲。

words.ex: Please simplify the rules so that young children can follow them.
words.exZh: 請把規則簡化，讓小朋友也能遵守。

words.ex: Many of our daily habits are subconscious, like touching our hair.
words.exZh: 我們很多日常習慣是潛意識的，例如摸頭髮。

words.zh: 職業選手、高手；優點、好處
words.ex: My cousin can fix bikes like a real pro.
words.exZh: 我表哥修腳踏車就像真正的高手一樣。

words.zh: 極好的、絕妙的；聰明的、有才華的；燦爛的、明亮的
words.ex: She had a brilliant idea for the science project.
words.exZh: 她為自然科學專題想到了一個絕妙的點子。

words.ex: A long silence followed the teacher's question about the broken window.
words.exZh: 老師問起破掉的窗戶後，是一陣長長的沉默。

words.ex: I need a needle and thread to fix my shirt.
words.exZh: 我需要針和線來縫補我的襯衫。

words.ex: It was hard to drag the heavy box up the stairs.
words.exZh: 要把那個重箱子拖上樓很吃力。

words.ex: This filter keeps dirt out of our drinking water.
words.exZh: 這個濾網能擋住髒東西，不讓它進入我們的飲用水。

words.ex: You should upgrade your phone software to the latest version.
words.exZh: 你應該把手機軟體升級到最新版本。

words.zh: 神的、神聖的；極好的、美妙的
words.ex: In the old story, a divine light shines on the village.
words.exZh: 在古老的故事裡，一道神聖的光照亮了村莊。

words.ex: My favorite genre of movie is science fiction.
words.exZh: 我最喜歡的電影類型是科幻片。

words.ex: Draw a vertical line down the middle of the page.
words.exZh: 在這頁的正中央畫一條垂直線。

words.ex: The activist gave a speech about keeping our river clean.
words.exZh: 那位行動者發表了一場關於保持河川乾淨的演講。

words.ex: The clean streets are a testament to the workers' hard work.
words.exZh: 乾淨的街道證明了工人的辛勤。

words.ex: She made a quick sketch of the old house.
words.exZh: 她很快地畫了一張那棟老房子的素描。

words.ex: The school has clear rules against harassment of any kind.
words.exZh: 學校對任何形式的騷擾都有明確的規定。

words.ex: Climbing that tall mountain in one day was a great feat.
words.exZh: 一天內爬上那座高山是一大壯舉。

words.zh: 殘骸；毀壞、破壞；身心俱疲的人
words.ex: Divers found the wreck of an old ship at the bottom of the sea.
words.exZh: 潛水員在海底發現一艘老船的殘骸。

words.ex: At high altitude, the air is thin and it is hard to breathe.
words.exZh: 在高海拔的地方，空氣稀薄，呼吸困難。

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted light blue.
words.exZh: 這棟房子的外牆漆成淺藍色。

words.ex: Brushing your teeth after meals helps stop tooth decay.
words.exZh: 飯後刷牙有助於防止蛀牙。

words.ex: Riding a bike fast without a helmet is reckless.
words.exZh: 不戴安全帽騎快車是很魯莽的。

words.ex: He tried to stab the potato with a fork.
words.exZh: 他試著用叉子戳那顆馬鈴薯。

words.ex: Modern irrigation systems save water by sending it straight to plant roots.
words.exZh: 現代的灌溉系統把水直接送到植物根部，可以節省用水。

words.ex: Several doctors endorse this simple exercise for a healthy back.
words.exZh: 好幾位醫師都認可這個保護背部的簡單運動。

words.zh: 口述（讓人記下）；決定、支配
words.ex: The manager dictated a short letter, and the assistant typed it.
words.exZh: 經理口述了一封短信，助理把它打了出來。

words.ex: Poor sanitation in crowded areas helps diseases spread quickly.
words.exZh: 擁擠地區的環境衛生不佳，會讓疾病迅速傳播。

words.zh: 削弱、使變弱；（風雨等）減弱
words.ex: Not eating enough can weaken your body and mind.
words.exZh: 吃得不夠會讓你的身心變虛弱。

words.zh: 引起興趣、激起好奇；陰謀、密謀
words.ex: The strange old map intrigued the whole class.
words.exZh: 那張奇怪的舊地圖引起了全班的好奇。

words.ex: A teacher will supervise the students during the science experiment.
words.exZh: 做科學實驗時，會有一位老師在旁監督學生。

words.ex: Don't let the size of the other team intimidate you.
words.exZh: 別讓對方球員的體型把你嚇到了。

words.ex: The report delves into the causes of air pollution.
words.exZh: 這份報告深入探討空氣汙染的成因。

words.ex: Fallen leaves decompose and make the soil rich.
words.exZh: 落葉分解後讓土壤變得肥沃。

words.ex: Her honesty and hard work exemplify the values our school teaches.
words.exZh: 她的誠實和努力正是我們學校所教導的價值的典範。

words.ex: A tall crane lifted the heavy boxes onto the ship.
words.exZh: 一部高大的起重機把沉重的箱子吊上船。

words.zh: 磨碎、研磨；苦差事、單調的工作
words.ex: Grind the coffee beans before you pour in the hot water.
words.exZh: 倒熱水之前先把咖啡豆磨碎。

words.ex: Science is not my domain, so I asked my brother for help.
words.exZh: 自然科學不是我擅長的領域，所以我請哥哥幫忙。

words.ex: Everyone felt tense before the final game began.
words.exZh: 決賽開始前，每個人都覺得很緊張。

words.ex: My brother yawned three times in math class after staying up late.
words.exZh: 我哥哥熬夜之後，在數學課上打了三次呵欠。

words.ex: Grandma ferments cabbage in a big jar to make pickles.
words.exZh: 奶奶把高麗菜放進大罐子裡發酵，做成泡菜。

words.ex: The colorful fish in the tank captivated the young visitors.
words.exZh: 水族箱裡五顏六色的魚讓年幼的參觀者看得入迷。

words.ex: Washing your hands with soap removes many harmful microbes.
words.exZh: 用肥皂洗手可以去除許多有害的微生物。

words.ex: In summer, small purple flowers cover the alpine meadows near the peak.
words.exZh: 夏天，山頂附近的高山草原開滿了紫色小花。

words.ex: The class wrote a heartfelt thank-you card to the retiring teacher.
words.exZh: 全班寫了一張真誠的感謝卡給即將退休的老師。

words.zh: 酥脆的、清脆的；（天氣）涼爽清新的
words.ex: The fresh apple from the fridge was cold and crisp.
words.exZh: 冰箱裡拿出來的新鮮蘋果又冰又脆。

words.zh: 輕快的、快步的；（空氣、風）涼爽清新的
words.ex: The doctor suggests a brisk walk for thirty minutes every day.
words.exZh: 醫生建議每天快走三十分鐘。

words.ex: The bakery sells an assortment of cookies in a pretty gift box.
words.exZh: 那家麵包店賣裝在漂亮禮盒裡的什錦餅乾。

words.ex: Music is an important facet of her daily life.
words.exZh: 音樂是她日常生活中很重要的一個面向。

words.ex: The student council orchestrated the whole school fair in just two weeks.
words.exZh: 學生會只花兩週就精心策劃了整個園遊會。

words.zh: 粗糙的、粗的；粗俗的、粗魯的
words.ex: Dad rubbed the old table with coarse sandpaper before painting it.
words.exZh: 爸爸在油漆舊桌子之前，先用粗砂紙把它磨過一遍。
