words.zh: 恰當的、貼切的；有…傾向、容易…
words.ex: Turtle is an apt nickname for my slow but steady brother.
words.exZh: 對我那個慢吞吞但很穩的弟弟來說，「烏龜」是個很貼切的綽號。

words.zh: 發出嘎吱聲；嘎吱嘎吱地嚼
words.ex: The snow began to crunch under our boots.
words.exZh: 雪在我們的靴子底下開始嘎吱作響。

words.ex: She keeps her old buttons in a round tin on the shelf.
words.exZh: 她把舊鈕扣放在架子上一個圓形的鐵罐裡。

words.ex: We packed a first-aid kit for the hiking trip.
words.exZh: 我們為了健行準備了一個急救箱。

words.ex: My uncle bought a new fishing rod for the trip.
words.exZh: 我叔叔為了這趟旅行買了一支新釣竿。

words.ex: Be careful not to prick your finger on the needle.
words.exZh: 小心別讓針扎到你的手指。

words.ex: Make a loop with the rope and pull the end through.
words.exZh: 用繩子打一個圈，再把尾端穿過去。

words.ex: The strap of my bag broke on the way to school.
words.exZh: 我的包包背帶在上學途中斷了。

words.ex: Her voice has a very high pitch, like a small bird.
words.exZh: 她的聲音音調很高，像小鳥一樣。

words.ex: Hold the rail when you go down the stairs.
words.exZh: 下樓梯時要扶著欄杆。

words.ex: He has a small tattoo of a bird on his arm.
words.exZh: 他手臂上有一個小小的鳥形刺青。

words.ex: I can sing the song, but I forgot some of the lyrics.
words.exZh: 我會唱這首歌，但忘了一些歌詞。

words.ex: The ship stayed at the dock for two days.
words.exZh: 那艘船在碼頭停了兩天。

words.zh: 乘船遊覽；（車、船）緩緩行駛
words.ex: My grandparents took a cruise around the islands last summer.
words.exZh: 我爺爺奶奶去年夏天搭郵輪遊覽了那幾座島。

words.ex: The whole clan gathers at the farm every spring.
words.exZh: 每年春天整個家族都會聚在農場。

words.zh: 刀刃、刀片；葉片（草葉、扇葉）
words.ex: Be careful, because the blade of this knife is very sharp.
words.exZh: 小心，這把刀的刀刃非常鋒利。

words.ex: My brother plays in a youth baseball league every Saturday.
words.exZh: 我哥哥每週六都參加青少年棒球聯賽。

words.ex: In old stories, a lord lived in a big castle on a hill.
words.exZh: 在古老的故事裡，一位領主住在山丘上的大城堡裡。

words.ex: She put a scoop of ice cream in each bowl.
words.exZh: 她在每個碗裡都放了一球冰淇淋。

words.ex: The union of the two small towns made a bigger city.
words.exZh: 這兩個小鎮合併成了一座較大的城市。

words.ex: I found a dime under the sofa and put it in my pocket.
words.exZh: 我在沙發下找到一枚十美分硬幣，放進了口袋。

words.zh: 標籤、吊牌；鬼抓人（遊戲）；標記（照片中的人）
words.ex: The price tag on the shirt fell off.
words.exZh: 襯衫上的價格吊牌掉了。

words.ex: He tightened the bolt with a wrench so the chair would not shake.
words.exZh: 他用扳手鎖緊螺栓，讓椅子不會晃動。

words.ex: The cop told the drivers to slow down near the school.
words.exZh: 警察要駕駛人在學校附近放慢速度。

words.ex: I watched the latest episode of that cartoon last night.
words.exZh: 我昨晚看了那部卡通的最新一集。

words.ex: Ten plus five is fifteen, and fifteen plus one is sixteen.
words.exZh: 十加五等於十五，十五加一等於十六。

words.ex: The school administration decided to start classes later in winter.
words.exZh: 學校行政單位決定冬天延後上課時間。

words.ex: The city set up a commission to study the traffic problem.
words.exZh: 市政府成立了一個委員會來研究交通問題。

words.ex: The hotel has a grand hall with a very high ceiling.
words.exZh: 這間旅館有一座天花板很高的宏偉大廳。

words.zh: （美國）國會；代表大會、大型會議
words.ex: A new law must be passed by Congress before it takes effect.
words.exZh: 新法律必須經過國會通過才能生效。

words.ex: The farm covers about ten acres of flat land.
words.exZh: 這座農場佔地大約十英畝的平地。

words.ex: Turn the dial to the right to make the radio louder.
words.exZh: 把旋鈕往右轉，收音機就會變大聲。

words.ex: Many people travel a long way to visit this holy mountain.
words.exZh: 許多人長途跋涉來參訪這座神聖的山。

words.zh: 報名、註冊；註冊人數、學生人數
words.ex: Enrollment for the summer art class opens on Monday morning.
words.exZh: 暑期美術班的報名在星期一早上開始。

words.zh: 漿糊；（電腦）貼上；糊狀物、醬
words.ex: Use paste to stick the picture onto the paper.
words.exZh: 用漿糊把圖片黏在紙上。

words.zh: 接駁車；往返運送；太空梭
words.ex: A free shuttle takes visitors from the station to the museum.
words.exZh: 免費接駁車會載遊客從車站到博物館。

words.ex: Soft music can calm the soul after a long, busy day.
words.exZh: 忙了一整天之後，輕柔的音樂能讓心靈平靜下來。

words.ex: This milk smells weird, so please don't drink it.
words.exZh: 這牛奶聞起來怪怪的，所以請別喝。

words.ex: Flip the pancake when the bottom turns light brown.
words.exZh: 等鬆餅底部變成淺褐色時就把它翻面。

words.zh: 研究機構、學院；設立、實施（制度）
words.ex: My aunt works at a science institute near the city center.
words.exZh: 我阿姨在市中心附近的一間科學研究所工作。

words.zh: （坐著時的）大腿；（跑道等的）一圈
words.ex: The cat jumped onto my lap and fell asleep.
words.exZh: 貓跳到我的大腿上睡著了。

words.ex: The physician told my grandfather to walk every day.
words.exZh: 醫師要我爺爺每天散步。

words.zh: （鳥的）啾啾聲；（在社群網站）發文
words.ex: The little bird gave a soft tweet outside my window.
words.exZh: 小鳥在我窗外輕輕啁啾了一聲。

words.ex: Please be frank and tell me what you really think.
words.exZh: 請坦白告訴我你真正的想法。

words.ex: The parliament building is a famous place for tourists to visit.
words.exZh: 那棟議會大樓是遊客常去的知名景點。

words.ex: Small boats were resting quietly in the bay.
words.exZh: 小船靜靜地停泊在海灣裡。

words.ex: The poet wrote about the eternal beauty of the sea and sky.
words.exZh: 那位詩人描寫大海與天空永恆的美。

words.ex: Lying is a vice that can hurt friendships.
words.exZh: 說謊是一種會傷害友誼的壞習慣。

words.ex: A tall pine tree stands beside our school gate.
words.exZh: 我們的校門旁邊有一棵高大的松樹。

words.ex: Iron will rust if it stays wet for too long.
words.exZh: 鐵如果長時間潮濕就會生鏽。

words.ex: Use a singular verb after words like everyone and nobody.
words.exZh: 在 everyone 和 nobody 這類字後面要用單數動詞。

words.ex: The attorney explained the rules to the family.
words.exZh: 律師向那一家人說明了規定。

words.ex: A ray of sunlight came through the small window.
words.exZh: 一道陽光從小窗戶照了進來。

words.zh: 極大的、極度的；最高的（地位、權力）
words.ex: The team gave a supreme effort in the final match.
words.exZh: 這支隊伍在決賽中付出了極大的努力。

words.ex: I need to update the software on my phone.
words.exZh: 我需要更新手機上的軟體。

words.ex: We had a fire drill at school this morning.
words.exZh: 我們今天早上在學校做了火災演習。

words.ex: Our school basketball squad practices twice a week.
words.exZh: 我們學校的籃球隊每週練習兩次。

words.ex: He wore a red jersey with the number ten in the basketball game.
words.exZh: 他在籃球比賽中穿著十號紅色球衣。

words.ex: In the story, a little demon lived deep inside the cave.
words.exZh: 故事裡，有一隻小惡魔住在山洞深處。

words.ex: The nurse checked my pulse after I ran.
words.exZh: 我跑完步後，護理師量了我的脈搏。

words.ex: He likes to dip his French fries in sweet sauce.
words.exZh: 他喜歡把薯條沾甜醬吃。

words.zh: 靜止的、不變的；靜電；（收音機等的）雜訊
words.ex: The picture stays static instead of moving like a video.
words.exZh: 這張圖片是靜止的，不像影片會動。

words.ex: It was my fault that we missed the bus.
words.exZh: 我們錯過公車是我的錯。

words.ex: A small chapel stands quietly at the edge of the village.
words.exZh: 一座小禮拜堂靜靜地立在村子的邊緣。

words.zh: 獨奏、獨唱；單獨的、獨自的
words.ex: She played a piano solo at the school concert.
words.exZh: 她在學校音樂會上表演鋼琴獨奏。

words.zh: 便條本、一疊紙；墊子、護墊
words.ex: She wrote the phone number on a small pad.
words.exZh: 她把電話號碼寫在一本小便條本上。

words.ex: The senator visited our school to talk about the library.
words.exZh: 那位參議員來我們學校談圖書館的事。

words.ex: He bought a bunch of bananas at the market.
words.exZh: 他在市場買了一串香蕉。

words.ex: My uncle served in the navy for many years.
words.exZh: 我舅舅在海軍服役了很多年。

words.ex: The baby slaps the water with both hands in the bath.
words.exZh: 寶寶洗澡時用雙手拍打水面。

words.zh: 圓形的、環形的；傳單、通知單
words.ex: We sat around a circular table and shared the snacks.
words.exZh: 我們圍坐在圓桌旁，分享點心。

words.zh: 全體人員、員工；人事部門
words.ex: All personnel must wear a badge inside the building.
words.exZh: 所有員工在大樓內都必須佩戴識別證。

words.zh: 首要的、最好的；總理、首相
words.ex: This is the premier music festival for young players.
words.exZh: 這是年輕演奏者最重要的音樂節。

words.ex: The deputy will lead the meeting while the manager is away.
words.exZh: 經理不在時，由副手主持會議。

words.ex: I need a longer cable to charge my phone.
words.exZh: 我需要一條更長的線來幫手機充電。

words.ex: The designer showed her client three different logos.
words.exZh: 設計師給她的客戶看了三個不同的標誌。

words.zh: 清醒的、沒喝醉的；嚴肅的、冷靜的
words.ex: Every driver must stay sober before getting behind the wheel.
words.exZh: 每位駕駛開車前都必須保持清醒。

words.ex: Sit up straight to keep your spine healthy.
words.exZh: 坐直才能讓你的脊椎保持健康。

words.ex: The door squeaks because the hinge needs some oil.
words.exZh: 門會嘎吱響，是因為鉸鏈需要上點油。

words.ex: Children played near the fountain in the middle of the square.
words.exZh: 孩子們在廣場中央的噴水池附近玩耍。

words.ex: The stadium has a large dome that keeps out the rain.
words.exZh: 這座體育場有個大圓頂，可以遮雨。

words.ex: A tiny particle of dust got into my eye on the windy street.
words.exZh: 在颳風的街上，一粒小灰塵跑進了我的眼睛。

words.ex: Visitors can walk into the ancient tomb with a guide.
words.exZh: 遊客可以跟著導遊走進那座古代陵墓。

words.ex: The audio of this video is too quiet to hear clearly.
words.exZh: 這支影片的聲音太小，聽不清楚。

words.ex: The old castle has a secret chamber behind the wall.
words.exZh: 那座古堡的牆後面有一間祕密的房間。

words.ex: The teacher drew a chart to show our test scores.
words.exZh: 老師畫了一張圖表來呈現我們的考試成績。

words.ex: A battery, a bulb, and some wire make a simple circuit.
words.exZh: 一顆電池、一個燈泡加上一些電線，就能組成簡單的電路。

words.ex: My mother had her hair cut at a small salon.
words.exZh: 我媽媽在一間小美髮院剪了頭髮。

words.zh: 商品、原物料；寶貴的東西
words.ex: Rice is an important commodity that many countries buy and sell.
words.exZh: 米是許多國家買賣的重要商品。

words.ex: All living things are mortal, but memories can last for years.
words.exZh: 所有生物都終將死去，但回憶可以延續很多年。

words.ex: She does administrative work in the school office.
words.exZh: 她在學校辦公室做行政工作。

words.ex: The workers received a bonus at the end of the year.
words.exZh: 員工在年底拿到了一筆獎金。

words.ex: The children built a fort out of pillows and blankets.
words.exZh: 孩子們用枕頭和毯子蓋了一座堡壘。

words.ex: There is a small crack on the rim of my cup.
words.exZh: 我杯子的杯緣有一道小裂痕。

words.ex: The health commissioner visited our school to check the kitchen.
words.exZh: 衛生局長來我們學校檢查廚房。

words.ex: The naughty puppy chewed up my new slippers.
words.exZh: 那隻頑皮的小狗把我的新拖鞋咬爛了。

words.ex: My aunt works for a startup that makes learning apps.
words.exZh: 我阿姨在一家開發學習應用程式的新創公司工作。

words.ex: His face turned red with anger when he lost the game.
words.exZh: 他輸掉比賽時氣得臉都紅了。

words.ex: An enzyme in your mouth begins to break down food.
words.exZh: 你口中的一種酵素會開始分解食物。

words.ex: We play hockey on the frozen pond every winter.
words.exZh: 我們每年冬天都在結冰的池塘上打曲棍球。

words.ex: We stood on the deck and watched the sunset.
words.exZh: 我們站在甲板上看夕陽。

words.ex: In the story, a saint helped the poor people in the village.
words.exZh: 故事中，一位聖人幫助了村裡的窮人。

words.ex: The two schools formed an alliance to hold a big sports day.
words.exZh: 兩所學校結盟，共同舉辦一場大型運動會。

words.ex: Several people bid for the old painting at the auction.
words.exZh: 好幾個人在拍賣會上競標那幅舊畫。

words.ex: Bring a buddy when you go swimming at the lake.
words.exZh: 去湖邊游泳時要找個夥伴一起去。

words.ex: The dean of the college gave a speech to new students.
words.exZh: 學院院長對新生發表了談話。

words.zh: 像樣的、還不錯的；正派的、得體的
words.ex: This small restaurant serves decent food at a low price.
words.exZh: 這家小餐廳以低價供應還不錯的餐點。

words.ex: It sounds insane to walk to the city, but he did it.
words.exZh: 走路去市區聽起來很瘋狂，但他真的做到了。

words.ex: Our class reads poetry aloud every Friday afternoon.
words.exZh: 我們班每週五下午都會大聲朗讀詩。

words.ex: My cousin plays rugby on a school team.
words.exZh: 我表哥在學校的球隊打橄欖球。

words.ex: Our history teacher explained how communism spread in the last century.
words.exZh: 歷史老師解釋了共產主義在上個世紀是如何傳播的。

words.ex: Waiting for the bus in the rain felt like an eternity.
words.exZh: 在雨中等公車感覺像等了一輩子。

words.ex: A cricket sang loudly outside my window all night.
words.exZh: 一隻蟋蟀整晚在我窗外大聲鳴叫。

words.ex: My parents pay the mortgage on our house every month.
words.exZh: 我父母每個月繳我們房子的房貸。

words.ex: A street vendor sells hot corn near the night market.
words.exZh: 一位街頭小販在夜市附近賣熱玉米。

words.ex: The club made one amendment to its rules last week.
words.exZh: 社團上週對規則做了一項修訂。

words.ex: Exercise can speed up your metabolism and help you use energy.
words.exZh: 運動可以加快新陳代謝，幫助身體使用能量。

words.ex: The old mill by the river once ground wheat into flour.
words.exZh: 河邊那座舊磨坊以前把小麥磨成麵粉。

words.ex: The team worked hard to conquer the highest mountain in the area.
words.exZh: 這支隊伍努力想征服這個地區最高的山。

words.ex: We saw small fish swimming in the creek behind the farm.
words.exZh: 我們看見小魚在農場後面的小溪裡游著。

words.ex: Each country has its own currency, so we changed our money at the airport.
words.exZh: 每個國家都有自己的貨幣，所以我們在機場換了錢。

words.ex: The floral curtains made the small room look bright and fresh.
words.exZh: 花朵圖案的窗簾讓小房間看起來明亮又清新。

words.ex: The actors read the script before the first practice.
words.exZh: 演員們在第一次排練前先讀了劇本。

words.ex: The ambassador welcomed guests from many countries at the dinner.
words.exZh: 大使在晚宴上歡迎來自許多國家的賓客。

words.ex: I cooked chicken breast with rice for dinner.
words.exZh: 我晚餐煮了雞胸肉配白飯。

words.ex: We read an ancient Greek epic about a long journey home.
words.exZh: 我們讀了一部關於漫長返鄉旅程的古希臘史詩。

words.zh: 民意調查、意見調查；對…做調查
words.ex: A class poll showed that most students prefer pizza.
words.exZh: 一項班級調查顯示大部分學生比較喜歡披薩。

words.ex: The pyramid took thousands of workers many years to build.
words.exZh: 建造這座金字塔花了數千名工人許多年的時間。

words.ex: After the accident, the man stayed in a coma for a week.
words.exZh: 意外發生後，那名男子昏迷了一個星期。

words.zh: 集會、大會；召集、重振（士氣）；（網球等）來回對打
words.ex: Fans gathered for a rally to cheer for the team before the final.
words.exZh: 決賽前，球迷聚集參加為球隊加油的大會。

words.ex: Everyone in our class is excited about the upcoming trip.
words.exZh: 我們班每個人都對即將到來的旅行感到興奮。

words.ex: Thousands of fans filled the arena to watch the game.
words.exZh: 數千名球迷擠滿體育館看比賽。

words.ex: The small shop went bankrupt after a slow year.
words.exZh: 那家小店在生意清淡的一年後破產了。

words.ex: This shop sells premium chocolate made from the best beans.
words.exZh: 這家店賣用最好的豆子做成的高級巧克力。

words.ex: The old priest walked slowly through the quiet garden.
words.exZh: 那位年長的神父慢慢走過安靜的花園。

words.zh: 一陣（強風）；爆炸、爆炸聲；非常愉快的經驗
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit my face at the bus stop.
words.exZh: 在公車站，一陣冷風迎面吹來。

words.ex: On the eve of the big test, I went to bed early.
words.exZh: 大考前一晚，我很早就上床睡覺了。

words.zh: （全體）教職員；（身心的）能力、機能
words.ex: The faculty meets every Monday to talk about school plans.
words.exZh: 教職員每週一開會討論學校的計畫。

words.ex: My motto is simple: never give up before you try.
words.exZh: 我的座右銘很簡單：還沒試之前絕不放棄。

words.ex: An old railroad runs through the middle of this small town.
words.exZh: 一條老鐵路穿過這個小鎮的中心。

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty to keep the sea clean.
words.exZh: 兩國簽下一項條約，要讓海洋保持乾淨。

words.zh: 增為三倍；三倍的、三重的
words.ex: The price of the concert ticket will triple next month.
words.exZh: 演唱會的票價下個月會漲成三倍。

words.ex: The young apprentice learned to bake bread from the old baker.
words.exZh: 那位年輕學徒跟著老麵包師傅學烤麵包。

words.ex: The little girl wore a red cape for the school play.
words.exZh: 小女孩在學校的戲劇表演中穿了一件紅色披風。

words.ex: In the old tale, the devil tricked a greedy farmer.
words.exZh: 在那個古老的故事裡，魔鬼騙了一個貪心的農夫。

words.zh: 公平、公正；股權、資產淨值
words.ex: The new program aims to bring more equity to students from poor families.
words.exZh: 這個新計畫的目標是讓清寒家庭的學生得到更公平的機會。

words.ex: The computer's hardware is fine, but the software needs an update.

words.ex: Sugar will dissolve quickly if you stir it in hot water.
words.exZh: 糖放進熱水裡攪拌，很快就會溶解。

words.ex: Habitual snacking late at night can lead to weight gain.
words.exZh: 習慣在深夜吃零食可能會讓體重增加。

words.ex: My father put a worm on the hook as bait.
words.exZh: 我爸爸在魚鉤上掛了一條蟲當魚餌。

words.ex: The old carriage was pulled by two brown horses through the village.
words.exZh: 那輛舊馬車由兩匹棕色的馬拉著穿過村莊。

words.ex: The teacher drew a simple diagram of the water cycle.
words.exZh: 老師畫了一張水循環的簡單示意圖。

words.ex: Please scrub the dirty pot with a hard brush.
words.exZh: 請用硬毛刷把髒鍋子刷乾淨。

words.ex: The car needs more gasoline before it can go any further.
words.exZh: 這輛車得再加些汽油才能繼續開。

words.ex: The genesis of the project was a simple talk between two friends.
words.exZh: 這個專案的起源，是兩位朋友之間的一次簡單談話。

words.ex: Selling ivory is against the law in many countries.
words.exZh: 在許多國家，販賣象牙是違法的。

words.ex: The city plans to levy a small fee on plastic bags.
words.exZh: 市政府打算對塑膠袋徵收一小筆費用。

words.zh: 坐墊、靠墊；緩衝、減輕衝擊
words.ex: I put a soft cushion on the hard wooden chair.
words.exZh: 我在硬木椅上放了一個軟軟的坐墊。

words.ex: We sat on the porch and watched the rain fall.
words.exZh: 我們坐在門廊上看雨落下。

words.zh: 螺旋、螺旋形；急遽上升、失控
words.ex: Smoke rose in a spiral from the small campfire.
words.exZh: 煙從小營火裡呈螺旋狀往上升。

words.ex: Do not spit on the street; it is rude and dirty.
words.exZh: 不要在街上吐口水，那既沒禮貌又骯髒。

words.zh: 擴大、擴建；放大（照片、圖片）
words.ex: The city plans to enlarge the train station next year.
words.exZh: 市政府計畫明年擴建火車站。

words.zh: 括號；（年齡、收入的）級距、層
words.ex: Put the extra note in brackets at the end of the line.
words.exZh: 把補充說明放進這一行結尾的括號裡。

words.ex: Wild flowers abound in the valley every spring.
words.exZh: 每年春天，山谷裡到處都是野花。

words.ex: One company had a monopoly on water in the small town.
words.exZh: 一家公司壟斷了那個小鎮的供水。

words.ex: Frogs and snakes live in the wet swamp behind the farm.
words.exZh: 青蛙和蛇住在農場後面潮濕的沼澤裡。

words.ex: A neighbor came to testify that she saw the boy at home.
words.exZh: 一位鄰居前來作證，說她看到那男孩在家。

words.ex: The museum keeps an ancient artifact found near the river.
words.exZh: 博物館收藏了一件在河邊發現的古代文物。

words.ex: He bought an ice cream cone on a hot afternoon.
words.exZh: 在炎熱的午後，他買了一支冰淇淋甜筒。

words.ex: The teacher wrote a short critique of each student's drawing.
words.exZh: 老師為每位學生的畫寫了一小段評語。

words.ex: My grandfather walks slowly with a wooden cane.
words.exZh: 我爺爺拄著一根木頭手杖慢慢地走。

words.zh: 惱怒、煩躁；（皮膚等）刺激、發炎
words.ex: She could not hide her irritation when the bus was late again.
words.exZh: 公車又誤點了，她掩飾不住心中的惱怒。

words.ex: The building has a ramp so wheelchairs can go inside.
words.exZh: 這棟建築有坡道，輪椅可以進去。

words.ex: A tall stone pillar holds up the roof of the old hall.
words.exZh: 一根高高的石柱撐著老禮堂的屋頂。

words.ex: My father shaves every morning before he goes to work.
words.exZh: 我爸爸每天早上上班前都會刮鬍子。

words.ex: The statute says that every child must go to school.
words.exZh: 這條法規規定每個孩子都必須上學。

words.zh: 拉近、放大（鏡頭）；疾駛、快速移動
words.ex: This camera can zoom in on a bird far away.
words.exZh: 這台相機可以把遠處的鳥拉近拍攝。

words.ex: Mom added a little soy sauce, made from beans, to the fried rice.
words.exZh: 媽媽在炒飯裡加了一點用黃豆做成的醬油。

words.ex: Milk is a good source of calcium for strong bones.
words.exZh: 牛奶是很好的鈣質來源，能讓骨頭強壯。

words.ex: The young director's first film won wide acclaim from critics.
words.exZh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影獲得影評人一致的好評。

words.ex: The teacher will coordinate the work of the four groups.
words.exZh: 老師會協調這四個小組的工作。

words.ex: Cut the tofu into small cubes before you put it in the soup.
words.exZh: 先把豆腐切成小方塊，再放進湯裡。

words.ex: The long boat ride gave me a feeling of nausea.
words.exZh: 長時間搭船讓我覺得噁心想吐。

words.ex: The company pays a dividend to its shareholders every year.
words.exZh: 這間公司每年發放股息給股東。

words.ex: She made a bracelet by putting colorful beads on a string.
words.exZh: 她把彩色珠子串在線上，做成一條手環。

words.zh: 孵化、孵出；策劃、想出（計畫）
words.ex: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
words.exZh: 這些蛋大約三週後就會孵化。

words.ex: Your body makes a hormone that helps you grow taller.
words.exZh: 你的身體會製造一種幫助你長高的荷爾蒙。

words.ex: Her dress had white lace along the sleeves.
words.exZh: 她的洋裝袖子邊有白色蕾絲。

words.ex: I found a nickel under the sofa and put it in my piggy bank.
words.exZh: 我在沙發下找到一枚五分硬幣，把它放進撲滿。

words.zh: 請再說一次（客氣說法）；原諒、寬恕
words.ex: I beg your pardon, but could you repeat the question?
words.exZh: 不好意思，可以請你把問題再說一次嗎？

words.ex: Fishermen sat at the end of the pier and waited for a bite.
words.exZh: 漁夫們坐在碼頭盡頭等魚上鉤。

words.ex: The new teacher thanked her predecessor for the useful notes.
words.exZh: 新老師感謝她的前任留下的實用筆記。

words.zh: 前提、假設；場所、範圍內（複數）
words.ex: The whole plan is based on the premise that everyone will help.
words.exZh: 整個計畫是以每個人都會幫忙為前提。

words.ex: Old houses in the village have roofs made of gray slate.
words.exZh: 村子裡的老房子屋頂是用灰色石板做的。

words.ex: Beware of slippery rocks when you walk along the river.
words.exZh: 沿著河邊走的時候，要小心濕滑的石頭。

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
words.exZh: 植物吸收二氧化碳並釋放氧氣。

words.ex: A feeling of doom came over us when the sky turned black.
words.exZh: 天空變黑時，我們有種大難臨頭的感覺。

words.ex: We used special glasses to watch the eclipse of the sun.
words.exZh: 我們戴著特殊眼鏡觀看日蝕。

words.ex: A hawk circled slowly over the field, looking for food.
words.exZh: 一隻老鷹在田野上空緩緩盤旋，尋找食物。

words.ex: Forgetting my passport at home was a terrible blunder.
words.exZh: 把護照忘在家裡真是個糟糕的大錯。

words.ex: Helping a stranger carry heavy bags is a kind deed.
words.exZh: 幫陌生人提重物是一種善行。

words.ex: Wearing a mask helps protect you from respiratory infections in winter.
words.exZh: 冬天戴口罩有助於預防呼吸道感染。

words.zh: 脾氣、性情；冷靜、情緒的控制
words.ex: He has a quick temper, but he always says sorry later.
words.exZh: 他脾氣很急，但事後總會道歉。

words.ex: In the museum, we saw an ancient coffin covered with paintings.
words.exZh: 我們在博物館看到一具畫滿圖案的古代棺材。

words.ex: I ordered a chicken combo with fries and a cold drink.
words.exZh: 我點了一份附薯條和冷飲的雞肉套餐。

words.ex: The idiom a piece of cake means something is very easy.
words.exZh: 慣用語 a piece of cake 的意思是某件事非常簡單。

words.ex: Please flush the toilet and wash your hands afterward.
words.exZh: 請沖馬桶，然後把手洗乾淨。

words.ex: Please choose a large font so everyone can read it.
words.exZh: 請選用大一點的字型，讓大家都能讀得到。

words.ex: The cake recipe needs only one ounce of butter.
words.exZh: 這份蛋糕食譜只需要一盎司的奶油。

words.ex: In the story, the girl has a psychic power to hear thoughts.
words.exZh: 故事裡的女孩有能聽見別人想法的超能力。

words.ex: The little girl made a puppet from an old sock.
words.exZh: 小女孩用一隻舊襪子做了一個布偶。

words.ex: People around the world watched fireworks at the start of the new millennium.
words.exZh: 新千禧年開始時，世界各地的人都在看煙火。

words.ex: The museum has a huge dinosaur skeleton in its main hall.
words.exZh: 博物館的主展廳裡有一副巨大的恐龍骨架。

words.ex: A bee can sting you if you frighten it.
words.exZh: 如果你嚇到蜜蜂，牠可能會螫你。

words.ex: The only sound in the room was the tick of the clock.
words.exZh: 房間裡唯一的聲音是時鐘的滴答聲。

words.ex: She felt destined to become a teacher like her mother.
words.exZh: 她覺得自己注定要像媽媽一樣成為老師。

words.ex: An old proverb says that practice makes perfect.
words.exZh: 有一句古老的諺語說：熟能生巧。

words.ex: We bought fresh fruit from a stall at the night market.
words.exZh: 我們在夜市的一個攤位買了新鮮水果。

words.ex: A trillion is a very big number with twelve zeros.
words.exZh: 一兆是個很大的數字，後面有十二個零。

words.ex: My legs trembled with fear when I stood on the high bridge.
words.exZh: 站在高高的橋上時，我的雙腿因為害怕而發抖。

words.zh: 月球的、月亮的；農曆的、陰曆的
words.ex: Scientists studied rocks brought back from the lunar surface.
words.exZh: 科學家研究從月球表面帶回來的岩石。

words.ex: Scientists study cosmic dust that travels through space.
words.exZh: 科學家研究在太空中飄移的宇宙塵埃。

words.ex: Most millennials grew up using computers and the internet.
words.exZh: 大多數千禧世代的人是用著電腦和網路長大的。

words.ex: The waves left white foam on the sand.
words.exZh: 海浪在沙灘上留下白色的泡沫。

words.ex: The two schools forged a strong friendship through sports.
words.exZh: 兩所學校透過運動建立了深厚的友誼。

words.ex: Grandma wears a smooth green jade bracelet on her wrist.
words.exZh: 奶奶的手腕上戴著光滑的綠色玉鐲。

words.ex: The government plans to enact a new law to protect wild birds.
words.exZh: 政府打算制定一項保護野鳥的新法律。

words.zh: 極重要的、必要的；祈使的（文法）
words.ex: It is imperative that all passengers wear seat belts during takeoff.
words.exZh: 起飛時所有乘客都必須繫好安全帶。

words.zh: 爭搶；（手腳並用地）攀爬；炒（蛋）
words.ex: The kids scrambled to pick up the candy on the floor.
words.exZh: 孩子們爭搶著撿起地上的糖果。

words.ex: Thick fog made visibility very low on the mountain road.
words.exZh: 濃霧讓山路上的能見度變得很低。

words.ex: In algebra class, we use letters to stand for unknown numbers.
words.exZh: 在代數課上，我們用字母來代表未知的數。

words.ex: Table etiquette is different in every country, so learn it before you travel.
words.exZh: 每個國家的餐桌禮儀都不同，所以旅行前要先學。

words.ex: Chop the onions into small pieces before you cook them.
words.exZh: 煮之前先把洋蔥切成小塊。

phrases.ex: Each member of the team is responsible for one part of the project.
phrases.exZh: 團隊的每位成員各自負責專題的一個部分。
phrases.note: for 後接負責的事；對象是人時用 to

phrases.ex: Why not walk to school instead of taking the bus every morning?
phrases.exZh: 每天早上何不走路上學，而不是搭公車呢？
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；單獨的 instead 是副詞

phrases.ex: More and more people now shop online instead of going to stores.
phrases.exZh: 現在越來越多人在網路上購物，而不是去實體商店。
phrases.note: 可當形容詞修飾名詞，也可修飾形容詞

phrases.ex: Eating too much sugar can lead to serious health problems.
phrases.exZh: 攝取過多糖分可能導致嚴重的健康問題。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing；主詞是原因

phrases.ex: The movie was so moving that many viewers cried in the theater.
phrases.exZh: 這部電影感人到讓許多觀眾在戲院裡落淚。
phrases.note: so 後接形容詞或副詞，that 後接結果子句

phrases.ex: The wetland is not only a tourist spot but also a home for many wild birds.
phrases.exZh: 這片溼地不只是觀光景點，也是許多野鳥的家。
phrases.note: 前後結構要對等；not only 放句首時後半要倒裝
phrases.trap: not only a tourist spot and also

phrases.ex: In recent years, electric buses have appeared on the streets of many cities.
phrases.exZh: 近年來，電動公車已出現在許多城市的街道上。
phrases.note: 常搭配現在完成式；放句首，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: Cycling is one of the most eco-friendly ways to travel in a city.
phrases.exZh: 騎腳踏車是在城市裡最環保的出行方式之一。
phrases.note: 後接複數名詞，但主詞是 one 時動詞用單數
phrases.trap: one of the most eco-friendly way

phrases.phrase: play an important role in sth./V-ing
phrases.ex: Sleep plays an important role in helping students remember what they have learned.
phrases.exZh: 睡眠對幫助學生記住所學的內容扮演著重要的角色。
phrases.note: 後面接名詞或 V-ing；role 前可換 key、vital 等形容詞
phrases.trap: plays an important role in help

phrases.phrase: It is … for sb. to V
phrases.ex: It is difficult for young children to sit still for a long time.
phrases.exZh: 年幼的孩子很難長時間靜坐。
phrases.note: 形容詞描述事情本身（難、易、必要）時用 for
phrases.trap: It is difficult of young children to

phrases.ex: To my surprise, the shy boy at the back of the room sang the whole song perfectly.
phrases.exZh: 令我驚訝的是，坐在教室後面那個害羞的男生把整首歌唱得完美無缺。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；my 可換成 his、her 等

phrases.ex: Teenagers need to learn how to deal with stress.
phrases.exZh: 青少年需要學會如何應付壓力。
phrases.note: 可指處理問題或與人相處

phrases.ex: Every student is encouraged to take part in the science fair this spring.
phrases.exZh: 我們鼓勵每位學生參加今年春天的科學展。
phrases.note: in 後接活動名稱；同義 participate in

phrases.ex: Please pay attention to the road signs when you ride a bike at night.
phrases.exZh: 晚上騎腳踏車時，請留意路標。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing
phrases.trap: pay attention on the road signs

phrases.ex: The team practiced every day, and as a result, they won the final match.
phrases.exZh: 這支隊伍每天練習，結果贏得了決賽。
phrases.note: 副詞片語，放句首，後面加逗號，連接前後兩句

phrases.ex: In addition to English, many students are learning Japanese or Korean.
phrases.exZh: 除了英文之外，許多學生也在學日文或韓文。
phrases.note: 介系詞片語，後接名詞或 V-ing；表示「另外還有」

phrases.ex: Students can improve their grades as long as they study a little every day.
phrases.exZh: 只要每天讀一點書，學生就能提升成績。
phrases.note: 引導條件子句，語氣比 if 強調「只要」；子句用現在式表未來

phrases.phrase: have a negative impact on sth.
phrases.ex: Too much noise from traffic may have a negative impact on people's health.
phrases.exZh: 過多的交通噪音可能對人們的健康造成負面影響。
phrases.note: impact 後用 on；可與 positive 對換，論述缺點時常用

phrases.ex: You can save a lot of paper by printing on both sides.
phrases.exZh: 雙面列印可以省下很多紙。
phrases.note: by 後接 V-ing 表方法；不可接原形動詞

phrases.phrase: on the one hand … on the other hand …
phrases.ex: On the one hand, phones keep us connected; on the other hand, they can distract us.
phrases.exZh: 一方面，手機讓我們保持聯繫；另方面，它們也可能使我們分心。
phrases.note: 用於對照兩個面向；第二部分常放句首並加逗號

phrases.ex: Standing on the top of the mountain, he felt a sense of freedom.
phrases.exZh: 站在山頂上，他感到一股自由的感覺。
phrases.note: of 後接抽象名詞，如 pride、relief、achievement

phrases.ex: Parents are proud of their children when they work hard and stay honest.
phrases.exZh: 孩子努力又誠實時，父母會引以為傲。
phrases.note: 近義：take pride in

phrases.ex: You should not give up learning just because one test was hard.
phrases.exZh: 不要只因為一次考試很難就放棄學習。
phrases.note: 後面接名詞或 V-ing；give up on 表示對人或事不再抱希望

phrases.ex: The picnic turned out to be a great success despite the cloudy sky.
phrases.exZh: 儘管天空多雲，這次野餐最後非常成功。
phrases.note: 常接 to be 或 that 子句；表示結果出乎意料
phrases.trap: turned out be a great success

phrases.ex: The teacher pointed out several mistakes in the essay.
phrases.exZh: 老師指出了作文中的幾個錯誤。
phrases.note: 後面可接名詞或 that 子句

phrases.ex: Grandpa used to walk to the market every morning before breakfast.
phrases.exZh: 爺爺以前每天早餐前都會走路去市場。
phrases.note: 表過去的習慣或狀態，現在已不是；後接原形
phrases.trap: used to walking to the market

phrases.ex: Students should spend more time reading than watching short videos.
phrases.exZh: 學生應該花更多時間閱讀，而不是看短影片。
phrases.note: in 可省略；主詞是人，不用 It takes 的句型

phrases.ex: Each part of the brain plays a role in how we think and feel.
phrases.exZh: 大腦的每個部位，都對我們的思考和感受發揮作用。
phrases.note: 常寫成 play an important role in sth.

phrases.ex: Smart learners take advantage of free online courses to improve their skills.
phrases.exZh: 聰明的學習者會利用免費的線上課程來提升技能。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；也可帶「趁機占便宜」的負面意思
phrases.trap: take advantage on free online courses

phrases.ex: Friends can have an influence on how teenagers think and act.
phrases.exZh: 朋友會影響青少年的想法和行為。
phrases.note: on 後接人或事物；也可說 influence sb./sth.

phrases.ex: She chose to take the MRT rather than drive downtown.
phrases.exZh: 她選擇搭捷運，而不是開車到市區。
phrases.note: 前後要對稱，詞性或形式一致

phrases.ex: Many students enjoy group projects; however, some prefer to work alone.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生喜歡做小組報告；然而也有些人比較喜歡獨自完成。
phrases.note: 正式；放句首時後加逗號，放句中前用分號、後用逗號

phrases.ex: Although the test was difficult, most students finished it on time.
phrases.exZh: 雖然這次考試很難，大多數學生還是準時寫完了。
phrases.note: 後接完整子句；不可和 but 同時連接同一句
phrases.trap: Although the test was difficult, but

phrases.ex: Even though it was raining heavily, the hikers kept climbing the mountain.
phrases.exZh: 儘管雨下得很大，登山客仍繼續往山上爬。
phrases.note: 語氣比 although 強，後接的是已發生的事實

phrases.ex: Despite the noise outside, the students stayed focused on their reading.
phrases.exZh: 儘管外面很吵，學生們仍專心閱讀。
phrases.note: 介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing，不能直接接子句

phrases.ex: Several flights were delayed because of the heavy fog this morning.
phrases.exZh: 好幾個航班因為今天早上的大霧而延誤了。
phrases.note: 介系詞片語，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接子句

phrases.ex: Plastic bags harm the sea; therefore, many stores now charge for them.
phrases.exZh: 塑膠袋會危害海洋，因此許多商店現在都要收費。
phrases.note: 正式；不能像 so 直接連接兩子句，前面用分號或句號

phrases.ex: Teenagers can develop useful skills through activities such as cooking, volunteering, or playing in a band.
phrases.exZh: 青少年可以透過一些活動培養實用的技能，像是烹飪、志工服務或組樂團。
phrases.note: 後面接名詞或 V-ing，直接接在被舉例的名詞後；不可單獨放句首

phrases.ex: Many people believe online shopping is always cheaper, but in fact the price is sometimes higher.
phrases.exZh: 許多人認為網路購物一定比較便宜，但事實上價格有時更高。
phrases.note: 常用來指出真實情況，與前面的想法形成對比

phrases.ex: Please call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
phrases.exZh: 你一到車站就請打電話給我。
phrases.note: 連接詞，後接子句；表示未來時，子句用現在式，不用 will
phrases.trap: as soon as you will arrive

phrases.ex: Nowadays, many teenagers check their phones before they even get out of bed.
phrases.exZh: 現在許多青少年連下床前都會先看手機。
phrases.note: 副詞；放句首，後面加逗號，指「現今的狀況」

phrases.ex: More and more people are choosing to ride bicycles to work instead of driving.
phrases.exZh: 越來越多人選擇騎腳踏車上班，而不是開車。
phrases.note: people 視為複數，動詞用複數；常搭配進行式

phrases.ex: The best way to improve your English is to read a little every day.
phrases.exZh: 增進英文的最佳方法就是每天讀一點。
phrases.note: 後面常接 is to V；to 後是原形動詞，不是介系詞
phrases.trap: The best way to improving your English

phrases.ex: Many people take public transport in order to reduce air pollution.
phrases.exZh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸，以減少空氣汙染。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；可放句首，也可放句中表目的

phrases.ex: The days grow shorter and shorter as winter approaches.
phrases.exZh: 隨著冬天接近，白天變得越來越短。
phrases.note: 常搭配 get／grow／become；多音節改用 more and more

phrases.phrase: have a positive impact on sth.
phrases.ex: Regular exercise can have a positive impact on teenagers' mood and grades.
phrases.exZh: 規律運動能對青少年的心情和成績帶來正面影響。
phrases.note: impact 後用 on；可與 negative 對換，論述優點時常用

phrases.ex: It was not until midnight that the storm finally began to weaken.
phrases.exZh: 直到半夜，暴風雨才終於開始減弱。
phrases.note: that 後面用肯定句，不再用否定
phrases.trap: It was not until midnight did

phrases.ex: It takes new students a few weeks to get used to the daily schedule.
phrases.exZh: 新生需要幾週才能習慣每天的課表。
phrases.note: it 是虛主詞；不能用人當主詞
phrases.trap: It spends new students a few weeks to

phrases.ex: One of the best ways to learn a language is to use it every day.
phrases.exZh: 學習語言最好的方法之一，就是每天使用它。
phrases.note: of 後接複數名詞，但動詞用單數

phrases.ex: It turned out that the strange noise came from a tiny kitten under the car.
phrases.exZh: 結果那個怪聲是來自車子底下的一隻小貓。
phrases.note: 用來交代出乎意料的結果；用過去式

phrases.ex: Many senior students are willing to tutor younger kids for free.
phrases.exZh: 許多高年級學生願意免費幫學弟妹補習。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；相反為 be unwilling to V

phrases.phrase: have no choice but to V
phrases.ex: When the bus broke down, the passengers had no choice but to walk home.
phrases.exZh: 公車拋錨時，乘客們不得不走路回家。
phrases.note: but 後接原形動詞，不接 V-ing
phrases.trap: the passengers had no choose but to

phrases.ex: Many new students find it hard to remember all the teachers' names.
phrases.exZh: 許多新生覺得很難記住所有老師的名字。
phrases.note: it 是虛受詞不能省；中間用形容詞不用副詞

phrases.ex: At the start of each semester, our teacher asks us to set a goal.
phrases.exZh: 每學期一開始，我們的老師都會要我們設定一個目標。
phrases.note: 也可說 set goals；達成用 achieve／reach a goal

phrases.ex: Many people regard reading as the best way to relax.
phrases.exZh: 許多人把閱讀視為最好的放鬆方式。
phrases.note: as 不可省略；同型：think of A as B、see A as B

phrases.ex: The doctor suggested that he get more exercise and sleep.
phrases.exZh: 醫生建議他多運動、多睡覺。
phrases.note: that 子句用原形動詞或 should V；不接 to V

phrases.ex: The key to success is not luck but hard work.
phrases.exZh: 成功的關鍵不是運氣，而是努力。
phrases.note: 連接兩個對等詞語，but 後面才是重點，前後結構要對稱

phrases.ex: Thanks to the new bridge, the trip to the island takes only ten minutes.
phrases.exZh: 多虧了新橋，前往那座島只需要十分鐘。
phrases.note: 多用於好的原因；後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: In the end, hard work mattered more than natural talent.
phrases.exZh: 最後，努力比天分更重要。
phrases.note: 指事情的最終結果，常和過程對比；不同於 at the end of

phrases.ex: Some young people share every detail of their lives on social media without thinking about privacy.
phrases.exZh: 有些年輕人在社群媒體上分享生活的每個細節，卻沒想到隱私問題。
phrases.note: 不可數，不加 s；「在社群媒體上」用介系詞 on

phrases.ex: After a long summer vacation, the children were eager to see their classmates again.
phrases.exZh: 放了一個漫長的暑假，孩子們都急著想再見到同學。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；接名詞時用 be eager for sth.

phrases.ex: At that moment, the lights went out and the whole classroom became silent.
phrases.exZh: 就在那時，燈突然熄了，整間教室安靜下來。
phrases.note: 敘事用，配過去式；別和 at the moment（目前）搞混

phrases.ex: While shopping at the night market, she bumped into an old friend from elementary school.
phrases.exZh: 她在逛夜市時巧遇一位國小的老朋友。
phrases.note: 偏口語，等於 run into；可指巧遇人或撞上東西

phrases.ex: The small bakery did not make a profit until its third year of business.
phrases.exZh: 這家小麵包店直到開業第三年才開始獲利。
phrases.note: 也可說 make profits；反義可說 lose money

phrases.ex: Standing on the crowded bus, the boy held the rail tightly to keep his balance.
phrases.exZh: 站在擁擠的公車上，男孩緊抓扶手保持平衡。
phrases.note: one's 要配合主詞；反義 lose one's balance 是失去平衡

phrases.ex: Just because videos go viral doesn't mean the information in them is true.
phrases.exZh: 不能因為影片爆紅，就認為裡面的資訊是真的。
phrases.note: 反駁常用；Just because 子句當主詞，後面不加逗號
phrases.trap: Just because of videos go viral doesn't mean

phrases.ex: The city plants trees along busy roads, and in this way it keeps the streets cooler in summer.
phrases.exZh: 這座城市在繁忙的道路旁種樹，如此一來夏天街道就比較涼爽。
phrases.note: 承接上文提到的方法，引出結果；放句首時後加逗號

phrases.ex: My father was in a bad mood after a long day at work, so we kept quiet.
phrases.exZh: 爸爸工作了一整天心情不好，所以我們都保持安靜。
phrases.note: mood 前要加 a；不說 have a bad mood

phrases.ex: Volunteering at the library gave him a chance to get to know people with similar interests.
phrases.exZh: 在圖書館當志工讓他有機會認識興趣相同的人。
phrases.note: 表示逐漸認識；know sb. 是已經認識，不能表示「去認識」

phrases.zh: 需要幫助的人；有困難的人
phrases.ex: Every winter, the club collects warm clothes for people in need.
phrases.exZh: 每年冬天，這個社團都會為需要幫助的人募集保暖衣物。
phrases.note: in need 放名詞後修飾；不說 needed people

phrases.phrase: become part of one's daily life
phrases.zh: 成為日常生活的一部分
phrases.ex: Online shopping has become part of our daily life over the past decade.
phrases.exZh: 過去十年來，網路購物已成為我們日常生活的一部分。
phrases.note: part 前可加 a；常搭配現在完成式
phrases.trap: become part in our daily life

phrases.ex: The small village is surrounded by rice fields and tall mountains.
phrases.exZh: 這個小村莊四周被稻田和高山環繞。
phrases.note: 描寫景物常用被動；人也可以 be surrounded by friends

phrases.ex: The excited children sang all the way home from the beach.
phrases.exZh: 興奮的孩子們從海邊一路唱歌回家。
phrases.note: all the way home 的 home 前不加 to

phrases.ex: An old man was knocked down by a speeding scooter on his way to the market.
phrases.exZh: 一位老先生在去市場的路上被一輛超速的機車撞倒。
phrases.note: 車禍常用被動 be knocked down by；受詞代名詞放中間

phrases.ex: Taking a short walk after dinner helps me relieve stress before exams.
phrases.exZh: 晚餐後散散步能幫我在考前紓解壓力。
phrases.note: 也可說 reduce stress；stress 不可數

phrases.ex: Don't be too hard on yourself; after all, everyone makes mistakes.
phrases.exZh: 別對自己太苛刻，畢竟每個人都會犯錯。
phrases.note: 放句首表「畢竟」補理由；放句尾表「終究」

phrases.ex: Online shopping is convenient; on the other hand, it may lead to careless spending.
phrases.exZh: 網路購物很方便；另一方面，它可能讓人亂花錢。
phrases.note: 放句首，後加逗號；常與 on the one hand 搭配

phrases.ex: In addition, the library now offers quiet study rooms for students.
phrases.exZh: 此外，圖書館現在也提供讓學生使用的安靜自習室。
phrases.note: 放句首，後面加逗號；書面常用，語氣中性

phrases.ex: Small habits can protect the environment; for example, turning off unused lights saves a lot of energy.
phrases.exZh: 小習慣就能保護環境，例如隨手關掉不用的燈就能省下許多能源。
phrases.note: 插入語，前後常加逗號；比 for instance 更常見

phrases.ex: Volunteers gain new skills, make friends, and, most importantly, learn to care about others.
phrases.exZh: 志工學到新技能、交到朋友，而且最重要的是學會關心他人。
phrases.note: 用在列舉的最後一項前，前後常加逗號

phrases.ex: First of all, students need enough sleep to stay focused in class.
phrases.exZh: 首先，學生需要足夠的睡眠，才能在課堂上保持專注。
phrases.note: 放句首列點的第一項，後面加逗號；常搭配 second、finally

phrases.ex: In conclusion, reading widely helps students improve both their vocabulary and their thinking skills.
phrases.exZh: 總之，廣泛閱讀能幫助學生提升字彙量與思考能力。
phrases.note: 正式；放全文最後一段句首，後面接逗號

phrases.ex: In my opinion, students should learn how to manage their time before entering senior high school.
phrases.exZh: 依我看，學生在進入高中前就應該學會管理時間。
phrases.note: 最常用的表態語；放句首，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: The road was icy, and to make matters worse, our car ran out of gas.
phrases.exZh: 路面結冰，更糟的是，我們的車還沒油了。
phrases.note: 用來補充更壞的情況；前後用逗號隔開

phrases.ex: From then on, she practiced the piano for an hour every evening.
phrases.exZh: 從那時起，她每天晚上都練習一小時的鋼琴。
phrases.note: 敘述過去時用，與現在用的 from now on 相對；放句首或句尾

phrases.ex: All in all, learning a second language opens many doors for young people.
phrases.exZh: 總而言之，學習第二外語為年輕人開啟許多扇門。
phrases.note: 語氣較口語，適合一般作文結尾；放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: At first, the new student felt shy, but he soon made friends.
phrases.exZh: 起初那位新同學覺得害羞，但他很快就交到朋友。
phrases.note: 常與 later、then 對照；不等於 first

phrases.ex: The new student gets along with everyone in our class.
phrases.exZh: 新來的學生和我們班上每個人都相處得很好。
phrases.note: 英式也說 get on with；with 後面接人

phrases.ex: Take your time and make up your mind after you compare all the plans.
phrases.exZh: 慢慢來，比較完所有計畫後再做決定。
phrases.note: one's 隨主詞變化；後可接 to V

phrases.ex: New technology has brought about great changes in the way we learn.
phrases.exZh: 新科技已經為我們學習的方式帶來了很大的改變。
phrases.note: 正式；受詞多為變化或結果
phrases.trap: has brought about to great changes

phrases.ex: The students came up with a clever way to save water at school.
phrases.exZh: 學生們想出一個在學校節約用水的聰明辦法。
phrases.note: 後接 idea、plan、solution 等名詞

phrases.ex: Please find out what time the museum opens on Sunday.
phrases.exZh: 請查一下博物館星期日幾點開門。
phrases.note: 後面可接 what、whether 等子句；find 則指找到具體東西

phrases.ex: It took the students an hour to figure out the answer to the puzzle.
phrases.exZh: 學生們花了一個小時才想出這個謎題的答案。
phrases.note: 受詞可放中間：figure it out

phrases.ex: Try to focus on your work instead of your phone.
phrases.exZh: 試著專心做功課，不要一直看手機。
phrases.note: on 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Many students are looking forward to joining the summer camp.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生都很期待參加暑期營隊。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing 或名詞，不接原形動詞

phrases.ex: A broken bridge prevented the villagers from crossing the river.
phrases.exZh: 一座損壞的橋讓村民無法過河。
phrases.note: from 不能省略；後接 V-ing

phrases.ex: Good teachers encourage students to ask questions in class.
phrases.exZh: 好老師會鼓勵學生在課堂上發問。
phrases.note: 受詞後接 to V；名詞是 encouragement

phrases.phrase: it takes sb. time to V
phrases.ex: It takes about thirty minutes to walk from my home to the station.
phrases.exZh: 從我家走到車站大約要花三十分鐘。
phrases.note: 主詞用 it；接 to V，不接 V-ing
phrases.trap: It spends about thirty minutes to walk

phrases.ex: A lack of exercise is one reason why so many office workers feel tired.
phrases.exZh: 缺乏運動是許多上班族常覺得疲倦的原因之一。
phrases.note: 後接名詞；也可用 lack sth. 或 be lacking in sth.

phrases.ex: It took the students a long time to make a decision about the class trip.
phrases.exZh: 同學們花了很長的時間，才決定班遊要去哪裡。
phrases.note: 也可說 decide；後面常接 about 或 to V

phrases.ex: With daily practice, the beginners made progress in just a few weeks and won their first match.
phrases.exZh: 每天練習之下，這些初學者只花幾週就進步了，還贏了第一場比賽。
phrases.note: progress 不可數，不加 a；常接 in sth.

phrases.ex: If you make an effort every day, your English will get better.
phrases.exZh: 如果你每天努力，英文就會變好。
phrases.note: 後面接 to V；effort 前用 an

phrases.ex: Even a small kind act can make a difference in someone's day.
phrases.exZh: 即使是一個小小的善舉，也能為某人的一天帶來改變。
phrases.note: 常接 to 或 in；表示「產生正面影響」

phrases.ex: Team leaders must take responsibility for the results of their group project.
phrases.exZh: 小組長必須為小組專題的成果負責。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；也可說 be responsible for

phrases.ex: The night market sells a variety of snacks at low prices.
phrases.exZh: 夜市以便宜的價格賣各式各樣的小吃。
phrases.note: 後接複數名詞，動詞通常用複數

phrases.ex: Students who stay up late often feel tired the next day.
phrases.exZh: 熬夜的學生隔天常常覺得很累。
phrases.note: late 是副詞；stay up all night 是整夜不睡

phrases.ex: Reading builds imagination, while video games train quick reactions.
phrases.exZh: 閱讀能培養想像力，而電玩則能訓練反應速度。
phrases.note: 放句中表對比，前面常加逗號；也可表「當…時」，要看語境

phrases.ex: No matter how tired she was, she finished the science report that night.
phrases.exZh: 不管有多累，她當晚還是完成了那份自然科學報告。
phrases.note: 後接形容詞或副詞再接子句，如 no matter how hard
phrases.trap: No matter how she was tired,

phrases.ex: Even if the bus is late, the tour will still begin on time.
phrases.exZh: 就算公車誤點，導覽仍會準時開始。
phrases.note: even if 假設可能不會發生的情況，even though 則表示事實
phrases.trap: Even if the bus will be late,

phrases.ex: The school festival was cancelled due to the sudden typhoon warning.
phrases.exZh: 由於突然發布颱風警報，校慶被取消了。
phrases.note: 後接名詞；較正式，常放在句中

phrases.ex: It was such a heavy rain that the match had to be stopped.
phrases.exZh: 雨大到比賽不得不中止。
phrases.note: such 後接名詞片語（a + adj. + n.），that 後接結果

phrases.ex: A growing number of teenagers spend hours playing online games every day.
phrases.exZh: 越來越多青少年每天花好幾個小時玩線上遊戲。
phrases.note: 後接複數可數名詞，動詞用複數；勿與 the number of 混淆

phrases.ex: When it comes to protecting the environment, small daily habits really matter.
phrases.exZh: 談到保護環境，日常的小習慣真的很重要。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing
phrases.trap: When it comes to protect the environment,

phrases.ex: Plants will not grow well unless they get enough sunlight.
phrases.exZh: 除非有足夠的陽光，否則植物長不好。
phrases.note: 等於 if ... not；後面不再加 not，子句用現在式

phrases.ex: When you learn a language, the more you speak, the more confident you become.
phrases.exZh: 學語言時，你越常開口說，就會越有自信。
phrases.note: 前後兩個子句都以 the + 比較級開頭，中間用逗號
phrases.trap: the more you speak, the most confident

phrases.ex: People in modern cities often take clean drinking water for granted.
phrases.exZh: 現代都市的人常把乾淨的飲用水視為理所當然。
phrases.note: 受詞放中間，如 take it for granted；也可接 that 子句
phrases.trap: often take clean drinking water as granted.

phrases.ex: It was the heavy rain that forced the outdoor concert to end early.
phrases.exZh: 是那場大雨迫使戶外音樂會提早結束的。
phrases.note: 強調被強調的部分；可強調主詞、受詞或副詞
phrases.trap: It was the heavy rain what

phrases.phrase: leave a deep impression on sb.
phrases.ex: The kind words of the bus driver left a deep impression on me.
phrases.exZh: 公車司機親切的話語在我心中留下深刻的印象。
phrases.note: 過去式為 left；也可寫 make a deep impression on
phrases.trap: left a deep impression to me.

phrases.ex: She could not help but smile at the little boy's funny dance.
phrases.exZh: 她看到小男孩滑稽的舞蹈，忍不住微笑。
phrases.note: but 後接原形動詞；同義句型 cannot help V-ing

phrases.ex: Teenagers who stay up late are likely to feel sleepy in morning classes.
phrases.exZh: 熬夜的青少年在早上的課很可能會想睡覺。
phrases.note: 主詞可以是人或事；比較時寫 more/less likely to V

phrases.ex: Her dream of becoming a nurse finally came true last summer.
phrases.exZh: 她當護理師的夢想終於在去年夏天實現了。
phrases.note: 不及物，不能用被動；主詞是夢想或願望

phrases.ex: The box of old textbooks was too heavy for me to carry alone.
phrases.exZh: 那箱舊課本太重了，我一個人搬不動。
phrases.note: 已含否定意思，不可再加 not；行為者用 for sb.
phrases.trap: was so heavy for me to

phrases.ex: My little sister is now tall enough to ride the roller coaster.
phrases.exZh: 我妹妹現在夠高，可以坐雲霄飛車了。
phrases.note: enough 放形容詞後面，但放名詞前面

phrases.ex: Thanks to the new recycling bins, plastic bottles are no longer thrown everywhere.
phrases.exZh: 多虧有新的回收桶，寶特瓶不再被到處亂丟了。
phrases.note: 放 be 動詞後或一般動詞前；同 not … anymore

phrases.ex: A declining birth rate has forced several small schools to close their doors.
phrases.exZh: 少子化迫使好幾所小型學校關門。
phrases.note: 不寫 few children；也可說 a low fertility rate

phrases.ex: In general, small cities are quieter than big ones.
phrases.exZh: 一般來說，小城市比大城市安靜。
phrases.note: 放句首時後接逗號；也可放句尾

phrases.ex: Good teachers really care about how their students feel.
phrases.exZh: 好老師真的很在乎學生的感受。
phrases.note: 多用於否定與疑問；照顧是 care for 或 take care of

phrases.ex: There is no need to worry about the test results now.
phrases.exZh: 現在不必擔心考試結果。
phrases.note: about 後接名詞、V-ing 或 wh- 子句

phrases.ex: It is hard to concentrate on reading in such a noisy room.
phrases.exZh: 在這麼吵的房間裡很難專心閱讀。
phrases.note: 近義 focus on，語氣稍強調全神貫注

phrases.zh: 把 A 與 B 相比
phrases.ex: Students often compare their scores with those of their classmates.
phrases.exZh: 學生常比較自己的分數與同學的分數。
phrases.note: with 側重比較異同；compare A to B 常用於比喻

phrases.ex: This school is known for its strong music program.
phrases.exZh: 這所學校以強大的音樂課程聞名。
phrases.note: 與 be famous for 同義，for 後接特色

phrases.ex: Some teenagers are addicted to online games and lose sleep.
phrases.exZh: 有些青少年沉迷於線上遊戲，因而睡眠不足。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: With the help of a map, the tourists found the old tower easily.
phrases.exZh: 憑著一張地圖，遊客輕易找到了那座古塔。
phrases.note: of 後接人或物；也可說 with sb.'s help
phrases.trap: With the helps of a map,

phrases.ex: Some people work better under pressure, but others feel nervous.
phrases.exZh: 有些人在壓力下表現更好，但也有人會緊張。
phrases.note: pressure 為不可數名詞，前面不加 a

phrases.ex: Playing games all night only wastes time and makes you tired the next day.
phrases.exZh: 整晚打電動只是浪費時間，還會讓你隔天很累。
phrases.note: 常接 V-ing：waste time V-ing；反義 save time

phrases.ex: Compared with last year, this summer is much hotter.
phrases.exZh: 和去年相比，今年夏天熱多了。
phrases.note: 常放句首，後面接逗號；也可寫 compared to

phrases.ex: More than half of the students in our club like hiking.
phrases.exZh: 我們社團超過半數的學生喜歡健行。
phrases.note: 接數字時通常不含該數字本身

phrases.ex: Air is cleaner in the mountains, and that is why many families like to go hiking there.
phrases.exZh: 山上的空氣比較乾淨，這就是為什麼許多家庭喜歡到那裡健行。
phrases.note: 前句是原因，後面接結果子句；不要與 because 連用

phrases.ex: The reason why many teenagers feel tired is that they sleep too late.
phrases.exZh: 許多青少年覺得疲倦的原因是他們太晚睡。
phrases.note: is 後面接 that 子句，不用 because

phrases.ex: It is worth visiting the old market at least once during your stay.
phrases.exZh: 你停留期間，值得去逛逛那個老市場，至少去一次。
phrases.note: worth 後接 V-ing，用主動形式表被動意義

phrases.ex: Whatever happens, you should stick to your study plan.
phrases.exZh: 無論發生什麼事，你都應該堅持你的讀書計畫。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；也可指黏在某物上

phrases.ex: Before you blame him, try to put yourself in his shoes for a minute.
phrases.exZh: 在你責怪他之前，先將心比心，設身處地替他想一想。
phrases.note: 反身代名詞要隨主詞變化，如 put myself / himself

phrases.ex: Teenagers tend to stay up late when they have too much homework.
phrases.exZh: 青少年功課太多的時候往往會熬夜。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；描述一般傾向，比 usually 更有論說語氣

phrases.ex: The old street has become a popular tourist attraction because of its traditional snacks.
phrases.exZh: 這條老街因為傳統小吃而成了熱門的觀光景點。
phrases.note: 可數名詞；常與 popular、major 連用

phrases.ex: Sweet drinks are fine in moderation, but having them every day can harm your health.
phrases.exZh: 含糖飲料適量喝沒關係，但每天喝會傷害健康。
phrases.note: 常放句尾或動詞後，修飾吃喝、上網等行為

phrases.ex: With the popularity of smartphones, people can read the news anywhere at any time.
phrases.exZh: 隨著智慧型手機的普及，人們隨時隨地都能看新聞。
phrases.note: 放句首，後接名詞，再用逗號接主要子句

phrases.ex: Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities, and our hometown is no exception.
phrases.exZh: 空氣污染是許多大城市的嚴重問題，我們的家鄉也不例外。
phrases.note: 接在描述普遍現象之後；主詞放前面，不寫 no exception is

phrases.ex: In a rapidly changing world, students must keep learning new skills to stay competitive.
phrases.exZh: 在瞬息萬變的世界裡，學生必須不斷學習新技能才能保有競爭力。
phrases.note: 多放句首，用來點出時代背景；開頭或結尾都適用

phrases.ex: Some shoppers bring their own bags to the market; by doing so, they reduce plastic waste.
phrases.exZh: 有些購物的人自備袋子去市場；這樣做可以減少塑膠垃圾。
phrases.note: so 指前面提到的做法；後接逗號再說結果

phrases.phrase: From this experience, I learned that …
phrases.ex: From this experience, I learned that asking for help is not a sign of weakness.
phrases.exZh: 從這次經驗我學到，向別人求助並不代表軟弱。
phrases.note: 經驗類作文結尾用；learned 用過去式，that 後接完整子句
phrases.trap: From this experience, I was learned that

phrases.ex: From my point of view, wearing uniforms makes students pay less attention to fashion and more to study.
phrases.exZh: 依我看，穿制服能讓學生少花心思在打扮上，多用心在讀書上。
phrases.note: 同 in my opinion；不可寫 in my point of view

phrases.phrase: One reason is that … another is that …
phrases.ex: One reason is that public transportation is cheap; another is that it reduces traffic jams.
phrases.exZh: 一個原因是大眾運輸便宜；另一個是它能減少塞車。
phrases.note: 分點說明理由；前面常先寫 There are two reasons why …

phrases.ex: To lead a healthy life, people should exercise regularly and get enough sleep.
phrases.exZh: 想過健康的生活，人們應該規律運動並睡飽。
phrases.note: lead 在此是「過（生活）」；也可說 live a healthy life

phrases.ex: In many families, parents and children now share household chores such as cooking and cleaning.
phrases.exZh: 在許多家庭裡，父母和孩子現在會分擔煮飯、打掃等家事。
phrases.note: 通常用複數；動詞搭 do 或 share，不用 make

phrases.ex: Because of peer pressure, some teenagers buy things they do not really need.
phrases.exZh: 因為同儕壓力，有些青少年會買自己其實不需要的東西。
phrases.note: 不可數；常搭 face、give in to

phrases.ex: Whenever she feels down, she listens to her favorite songs to cheer herself up.
phrases.exZh: 每當她心情低落，就會聽最喜歡的歌讓自己振作。
phrases.note: 偏口語，比 sad 自然；反義可用 cheer up

phrases.ex: Most senior high students are stressed out in the months before the college entrance exam.
phrases.exZh: 大多數高中生在大學入學考試前幾個月都壓力很大。
phrases.note: 主詞是人；別寫成 be stressful（令人有壓力的）

phrases.ex: Harsh comments online can hurt people's feelings more deeply than we expect.
phrases.exZh: 網路上刻薄的留言可能比我們想像的更傷人。
phrases.note: hurt 三態同形；feelings 要用複數

phrases.ex: Last night, many passers-by felt sorry for the old man selling vegetables in the cold rain.
phrases.exZh: 昨晚，許多路人都很同情那位在冷雨中賣菜的老先生。
phrases.note: 表同情、覺得某人可憐；feel sorry for oneself 是自憐
phrases.trap: felt sorry to the old man

phrases.ex: After shouting at his younger brother, the boy felt guilty about losing his temper.
phrases.exZh: 對弟弟大吼之後，那個男孩對自己發脾氣感到內疚。
phrases.note: about 後接名詞或 V-ing；也可說 feel guilty for

phrases.ex: Looking back, I am ashamed of having lied to my best friend.
phrases.exZh: 回想起來，我對自己曾向最好的朋友說謊感到羞愧。
phrases.note: 指道德上的羞愧，比 embarrassed（尷尬）重

phrases.ex: At first glance, the two pictures look the same, but they differ in several details.
phrases.exZh: 乍看之下，這兩張圖一模一樣，但有好幾處細節不同。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號，後面常用 but 轉折

phrases.ex: Students who start their reports at the last minute often make careless mistakes.
phrases.exZh: 拖到最後一刻才開始寫報告的學生常會犯粗心的錯誤。
phrases.note: 常放句尾；拖延、臨時取消的情境常用

phrases.ex: Before sharing a news story online, we should think twice about whether it is true.
phrases.exZh: 在網路上分享新聞前，我們應該再三確認它是否屬實。
phrases.note: 常接 before V-ing 或 about sth.；勸說語氣

phrases.ex: Good teachers encourage students to think for themselves instead of memorizing answers.
phrases.exZh: 好老師會鼓勵學生獨立思考，而不是死背答案。
phrases.note: oneself 要隨主詞變化，如 themselves

phrases.ex: Joining the speech contest helped my shy cousin face her fears.
phrases.exZh: 參加演講比賽幫助我害羞的表妹面對了她的恐懼。
phrases.note: fears 常用複數；one's 隨主詞變化

phrases.ex: After volunteering at the animal shelter, he gained confidence in talking to strangers.
phrases.exZh: 在動物收容所當志工後，他跟陌生人說話變得更有自信。
phrases.note: 可接 in sth./V-ing；同義 build confidence

phrases.ex: Turning off phone notifications is a simple way to stay focused while studying.
phrases.exZh: 關掉手機通知是讀書時保持專注的簡單方法。
phrases.note: stay 後接形容詞；專注於某事加 on sth.

phrases.ex: A simple app can help people keep track of how much water they drink each day.
phrases.exZh: 一個簡單的應用程式就能幫人們記錄每天喝了多少水。
phrases.note: 後接名詞或 wh- 子句；反義 lose track of

phrases.ex: Many elderly people struggle to use online services without help.
phrases.exZh: 許多長者沒有人幫忙，就很難使用線上服務。
phrases.note: 強調做得很吃力；接名詞用 struggle with sth.

phrases.ex: Because of a bad cold, she missed the chance to perform on stage.
phrases.exZh: 因為重感冒，她錯過了上台表演的機會。
phrases.note: 也可說 miss the chance of V-ing；遺憾敘事常用

phrases.ex: Things did not go as planned when heavy rain flooded our campsite.
phrases.exZh: 大雨淹沒我們的營地時，事情就沒有照計畫進行了。
phrases.note: 主詞是事情；常用否定 not go as planned

phrases.ex: Travelers who plan ahead can avoid long lines and higher prices.
phrases.exZh: 事先規劃的旅客可以避開大排長龍和較高的價格。
phrases.note: 不直接接受詞；要接用 plan ahead for sth.

phrases.ex: Children may lose interest in reading if they are forced to finish long books.
phrases.exZh: 孩子如果被逼著讀完厚重的書，可能會對閱讀失去興趣。
phrases.note: in 後接名詞或 V-ing；interest 不加 s

phrases.ex: The new library was designed to meet the needs of readers of all ages.
phrases.exZh: 新圖書館的設計是為了滿足各年齡層讀者的需求。
phrases.note: meet 在此是「滿足」；也說 meet the needs of sb.

phrases.ex: Wearing a hat can protect your skin from strong sunlight.
phrases.exZh: 戴帽子可以保護皮膚不受強烈陽光傷害。
phrases.note: from 後接危害；也可用 against

phrases.ex: Instead of destroying forests, humans should learn to live in harmony with nature.
phrases.exZh: 人類不該破壞森林，而應學會與自然和諧共處。
phrases.note: with 後接人或自然；書面、作文常用
phrases.trap: to live in harmony to nature.

phrases.phrase: make the world a better place
phrases.ex: Small acts of kindness, like smiling at strangers, can make the world a better place.
phrases.exZh: 小小的善意，像是對陌生人微笑，就能讓世界變得更美好。
phrases.note: 作文結尾常用；make＋受詞＋名詞補語
phrases.trap: can make the world better place.

phrases.ex: Visitors should show respect for local customs when traveling abroad.
phrases.exZh: 出國旅行時，遊客應該尊重當地的習俗。
phrases.note: for 後接人或事物；也可說 show respect to sb.

phrases.ex: Every citizen has the right to express opinions about public policies.
phrases.exZh: 每位公民都有權利對公共政策表達意見。
phrases.note: right 前要加 the；後接原形動詞，也可接 to + 名詞

phrases.ex: Freedom of speech is important, but it does not allow people to spread false information online.
phrases.exZh: 言論自由很重要，但它不代表人們可以在網路上散布假訊息。
phrases.note: 不可數，前面不加 a；也可說 free speech

phrases.ex: For many elderly people in rural areas, the bus is the only means of transportation.
phrases.exZh: 對許多住在鄉下的長者來說，公車是唯一的交通工具。
phrases.note: means 單複數同形，單數說 a means of；英式用 transport

phrases.ex: The number of traffic accidents near schools has dropped since the speed limit was lowered.
phrases.exZh: 自從速限降低後，學校附近的車禍數量減少了。
phrases.note: 可數名詞；出車禍說 be in a traffic accident

phrases.ex: The city installed more street lights to ensure the safety of people walking at night.
phrases.exZh: 市政府加裝了更多路燈，以確保夜間行人的安全。
phrases.note: 正式；ensure 等於 make sure，常用在政策、措施的目的

phrases.ex: After the heavy rain, shops along the river closed one after another.
phrases.exZh: 大雨過後，河邊的商店一家接著一家關門。
phrases.note: 當副詞多放句尾；指三個以上接連發生

phrases.ex: Within minutes, all the concert tickets were sold out online.
phrases.exZh: 短短幾分鐘內，演唱會的門票就在網路上全部賣光了。
phrases.note: 強調速度快；放句首加逗號，within seconds 更誇張

phrases.ex: Curiosity has always been the driving force behind scientific progress.
phrases.exZh: 好奇心一直是科學進步背後的驅動力。
phrases.note: 正式；behind 後接被推動的事物

phrases.ex: Studying online at home and meeting classmates once a week gives students the best of both worlds.
phrases.exZh: 在家上網課、每週再和同學見一次面，讓學生得以兩全其美。
phrases.note: 常接在 get、have、enjoy、give 後；worlds 用複數

phrases.zh: 補做（睡眠、功課）；趕完落後的事
phrases.ex: During the long weekend, many tired workers simply stay home to catch up on sleep.
phrases.exZh: 連假期間，許多疲憊的上班族乾脆待在家補眠。
phrases.note: 常說 catch up on sleep；別跟 catch up with 混淆

phrases.ex: Even a small cough should not be taken lightly during flu season.
phrases.exZh: 在流感季節，即使是輕微的咳嗽也不該輕忽。
phrases.note: 多用否定或被動：should not be taken lightly

phrases.ex: A few minutes of deep breathing can help you clear your mind before a big test.
phrases.exZh: 深呼吸幾分鐘，能幫你在大考前理清思緒。
phrases.note: one's 依主詞換成 my、his 等；比 relax 更強調理清頭緒

phrases.ex: When nobody in the group knew what to do, a quiet student took the lead.
phrases.exZh: 當組裡沒人知道該怎麼做時，一位安靜的同學挺身帶頭。
phrases.note: 後可接 in V-ing；比賽中也表示「取得領先」

phrases.ex: Since my grandmother lives alone, our family members take turns keeping her company on weekends.
phrases.exZh: 因為奶奶獨居，我們家人週末輪流陪她。
phrases.note: company 指陪伴，不加 a；sb. 放中間

phrases.ex: The friendly host family made the exchange student feel at home right away.
phrases.exZh: 親切的寄宿家庭讓那位交換學生馬上就感到很自在。
phrases.note: 常用 make sb. feel at home；at home 不加 the
phrases.trap: to feel at home right away.

phrases.ex: The team came close to winning the championship but lost in the final minute.
phrases.exZh: 這支隊伍差點拿下冠軍，卻在最後一分鐘輸了。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing 或名詞，不接原形

phrases.ex: Standing at the top of the mountain, I could hardly believe how beautiful the view was.
phrases.exZh: 站在山頂上，我幾乎不敢相信眼前的景色有多美。
phrases.note: hardly 已含否定，不可再加 not；過去式用 could hardly

phrases.ex: Many students dare not ask questions in class because they are afraid of looking foolish.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生不敢在課堂上發問，因為怕自己看起來很笨。
phrases.note: 後接原形；較書面，口語多說 don't dare (to) V
phrases.trap: dare not to ask questions in class

phrases.ex: The boy pretended not to notice the mess on the floor and kept playing his game.
phrases.exZh: 男孩假裝沒看到地上一團亂，繼續玩他的遊戲。
phrases.note: 否定的 not 放在 to 前面；也可接 that 子句

phrases.ex: Signs on the train remind passengers to keep their voices down.
phrases.exZh: 車廂裡的標示提醒乘客降低音量。
phrases.note: 提醒去做；remind sb. of sth. 是使想起

phrases.ex: On the way to school, a girl stopped to help an old man pick up his oranges.
phrases.exZh: 上學途中，一個女孩停下來幫一位老先生撿起他的柳丁。
phrases.note: stop to V 是停下來去做；stop V-ing 是停止正在做的事
phrases.trap: stopped to helping an old man

phrases.ex: Now that he lives in a big city, he often finds himself missing the quiet life in the countryside.
phrases.exZh: 他現在住在大城市，常常發現自己很想念鄉下寧靜的生活。
phrases.note: oneself 依主詞換；表示不知不覺發現自己的狀態

phrases.phrase: cannot take one's eyes off sth.
phrases.ex: Visitors at the aquarium could not take their eyes off the huge whale shark.
phrases.exZh: 水族館的遊客都目不轉睛地盯著那隻巨大的鯨鯊。
phrases.note: 固定用否定；one's 依主詞換，off 後接看的對象
phrases.trap: could not take their eyes of

phrases.ex: During our hike, one minute it was sunny, the next it was pouring rain.
phrases.exZh: 我們健行時，前一刻還是晴天，下一刻就下起了傾盆大雨。
phrases.note: 強調變化突然；the next 後可加 minute，常省略重複的字
phrases.trap: one minute it was sunny, the other

phrases.ex: The friends we make in high school may stay with us for life.
phrases.exZh: 我們在高中交到的朋友，可能會陪伴我們一輩子。
phrases.note: 多放句尾；形容詞說 lifelong，如 lifelong friends

phrases.ex: Making mistakes is not harmful in itself; refusing to learn from them is.
phrases.exZh: 犯錯本身並沒有害處；拒絕從錯誤中學習才有害。
phrases.note: 放在名詞或形容詞後，強調事物本身的性質

phrases.ex: Judging from the chart, more teenagers now get their news online than from newspapers.
phrases.exZh: 從圖表來看，現在從網路取得新聞的青少年比看報紙的多。
phrases.note: 放句首當獨立片語，後加逗號；同 judging by

phrases.ex: It is unfair to judge people by their appearance or the way they speak.
phrases.exZh: 以外表或說話方式來評斷別人並不公平。
phrases.note: by 後接評斷依據；常用於勸告：不要以貌取人

phrases.phrase: mean different things to different people
phrases.ex: Success may mean different things to different people, such as wealth, health, or freedom.
phrases.exZh: 成功可能對不同的人意義不同，例如財富、健康或自由。
phrases.note: 常用在論說文開頭；主詞多是抽象名詞
phrases.trap: means different things to different people,

phrases.zh: 用言語表達；用文字形容
phrases.ex: The beauty of the sunrise on the mountain was hard to put into words.
phrases.exZh: 山上日出的美難以用言語形容。
phrases.note: 常與 hard to、can't 連用，表示難以言喻

phrases.zh: 某人起碼能做的；至少該做的
phrases.ex: After all the help from our neighbors, thanking them in person is the least we can do.
phrases.exZh: 鄰居幫了我們這麼多，當面道謝是我們起碼能做的。
phrases.note: 多當補語，表示這是最起碼的回報或責任
phrases.trap: is the less we can do.

phrases.ex: History has shown that societies that value education tend to develop faster.
phrases.exZh: 歷史證明，重視教育的社會往往發展得比較快。
phrases.note: 論說文舉證用；也可說 History has proven that

phrases.ex: Free exercise classes in the new park aim to promote the well-being of residents.
phrases.exZh: 新公園的免費運動課程旨在增進居民的福祉。
phrases.note: 正式用語；well-being 不可數，指身心健康與幸福

phrases.zh: 親切地對待某人；善待某人
phrases.ex: Volunteers at the center treat elderly visitors with kindness and patience.
phrases.exZh: 中心的志工以親切和耐心對待年長的來訪者。
phrases.note: with 後可換 respect、care 等抽象名詞

phrases.ex: With its clean beaches and friendly locals, this island has become the first choice for many travelers.
phrases.exZh: 這座島有乾淨的海灘和友善的居民，已成為許多旅客的首選。
phrases.note: for 後接人；也可說 the top choice for
phrases.trap: the first choose for many travelers.

phrases.ex: No child should be forced to join a club against his or her will.
phrases.exZh: 不應強迫任何孩子違背自己的意願參加社團。
phrases.note: 常接在 be forced to V 之後，放句尾

phrases.ex: Parents who spend all evening on their phones may neglect their responsibilities at home.
phrases.exZh: 整晚都在滑手機的父母，可能會疏忽在家中的責任。
phrases.note: 及物動詞，不加 of；也說 neglect one's duties
phrases.trap: may neglect of their responsibilities at home.

phrases.ex: To reduce traffic accidents, the city has decided to strictly enforce the speed limit near schools.
phrases.exZh: 為了減少交通事故，市政府決定嚴格執行學校附近的速限。
phrases.note: 受詞是法規、規定；被動 be strictly enforced 很常見
phrases.trap: to strict enforce the speed limit

phrases.ex: A firefighter risked his life to carry a little girl out of the burning building.
phrases.exZh: 一名消防員冒著生命危險，把小女孩從失火的大樓裡抱出來。
phrases.note: 後常接 to V 表目的；也說 risk one's life for sb.

phrases.ex: Dozens of people lost their lives in the earthquake that struck the area last year.
phrases.exZh: 去年襲擊該地區的地震造成數十人喪生。
phrases.note: 比 die 委婉正式；主詞為複數時用 lives

phrases.ex: On a crowded bus, a high school student offered her seat to a pregnant woman.
phrases.exZh: 在擁擠的公車上，一名高中生把座位讓給一位孕婦。
phrases.note: 也說 offer sb. one's seat；to 後接讓座對象

phrases.ex: When the air quality is poor, children and the elderly are advised to stay indoors.
phrases.exZh: 空氣品質不佳時，建議孩童和長者待在室內。
phrases.note: indoors 是副詞，前面不加 in；反義 go outdoors

phrases.ex: Local tea from this region is popular at home and abroad for its rich flavor.
phrases.exZh: 這個地區產的茶風味濃郁，在國內外都很受歡迎。
phrases.note: 當副詞片語；表來源時用 from home and abroad

phrases.ex: Many small bookstores around the country have closed in recent years.
phrases.exZh: 近年來，全國各地有許多小書店歇業。
phrases.note: 同 across the country；可放名詞後或句尾

phrases.ex: Closed for two years of repairs, the old train station is now open to the public.
phrases.exZh: 經過兩年的整修，這座老火車站現在對外開放了。
phrases.note: open 是形容詞；動詞說 open sth. to the public

phrases.ex: Good communication skills are just as important in the workplace as professional knowledge.
phrases.exZh: 在職場上，良好的溝通能力和專業知識一樣重要。
phrases.note: workplace 前要加 the；可放句中或句尾

phrases.ex: My mother often goes on business trips, so my brother and I cook dinner ourselves.
phrases.exZh: 我媽媽常出差，所以我和弟弟都自己煮晚餐。
phrases.note: 正在出差說 be on a business trip

phrases.ex: Feeling stressed and tired, many young workers quit their jobs to travel for a year.
phrases.exZh: 許多年輕上班族感到壓力大又疲憊，於是辭職去旅行一年。
phrases.note: quit 三態同形；比 resign 口語

phrases.ex: Instead of choosing a high-paying job, she decided to teach in a small village.
phrases.exZh: 她沒有選擇高薪工作，而是決定到一個小村莊教書。
phrases.note: high-paying 要加連字號；反義 a low-paying job

phrases.ex: Sharing housework such as doing the laundry teaches children to be responsible.
phrases.exZh: 分擔洗衣服之類的家事，能教孩子負起責任。
phrases.note: laundry 不可數，不加 s；同類有 do the dishes

phrases.ex: In a modern family, both parents should share the responsibility for housework.
phrases.exZh: 在現代家庭裡，父母雙方都應該分擔家事的責任。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；也可用 of V-ing

phrases.zh: 大量湧入；源源不絕而來
phrases.ex: After the earthquake, donations poured in from all over the world.
phrases.exZh: 地震過後，捐款從世界各地湧入。
phrases.note: 不及物；主詞常是人潮、捐款、信件，可加 from 表來源

phrases.ex: Every rule in the school handbook serves a purpose, even if students do not see it at first.
phrases.exZh: 校規手冊裡的每條規定都有其用意，即使學生一開始看不出來。
phrases.note: 也常說 serve a useful purpose

phrases.ex: Parents should set a limit on how much time their children spend on their phones.
phrases.exZh: 父母應該限制孩子使用手機的時間。
phrases.note: on 後接名詞或 wh- 子句；也可說 set a time limit

phrases.ex: Through hard work, the young farmer turned the empty land into a green garden.
phrases.exZh: 靠著努力，這位年輕農夫把荒地變成了一片綠色的園地。
phrases.note: through 表「藉由」；可加 determination

phrases.ex: Some plants are sensitive to changes in temperature and light.
phrases.exZh: 有些植物對溫度和光線的變化很敏感。
phrases.note: to 後接名詞；別把 sensitive（敏感）和 sensible（明智）搞混

phrases.ex: When the fire alarm rang, the teacher kept a cool head and led everyone outside.
phrases.exZh: 火災警報響起時，老師保持冷靜，帶大家到外面。
phrases.note: 多用在緊急狀況；同義 stay calm、keep calm

phrases.ex: By midnight, the strong wind had finally died down.
phrases.exZh: 到了午夜，強風終於漸漸平息了。
phrases.note: 不及物、不用被動；主詞是風、聲音、掌聲、情緒等

phrases.ex: My little brother was upset about losing his favorite toy at the park.
phrases.exZh: 我弟弟因為在公園弄丟最喜歡的玩具而很難過。
phrases.note: 後接名詞或 V-ing；也可說 get upset over

phrases.ex: Many companies now require applicants to show proof of their English proficiency.
phrases.exZh: 現在許多公司要求應徵者出示英語能力的證明。
phrases.note: 正式名詞片語；同義 proficiency in English

phrases.ex: Online courses allow people in remote areas to learn new skills at a low cost.
phrases.exZh: 線上課程讓偏遠地區的人能以低成本學習新技能。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 at；反義 at a high cost

phrases.ex: During the summer sale, all the shoes in the store are sold at half price.
phrases.exZh: 夏季特賣期間，店裡所有的鞋子都以半價出售。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 at，price 前不加 a；口語也說 half off

phrases.ex: In early spring, the cherry trees on the hill are in full bloom.
phrases.exZh: 早春時，山坡上的櫻花樹盛開。
phrases.note: 描寫花盛開，常接在 be 動詞後；bloom 不加 s

phrases.ex: After working in the city for ten years, she decided to return to her hometown.
phrases.exZh: 在城市工作十年後，她決定返鄉。
phrases.note: return 已含「回」，不要說 return back

phrases.ex: Leaving home for college taught him how to manage his own money.
phrases.exZh: 離家上大學讓他學會管理自己的錢。
phrases.note: home、college 前都不加 the；home 前不加 to

phrases.ex: After a long day at work, my father likes to relax by listening to music.
phrases.exZh: 工作了一整天之後，我爸爸喜歡聽音樂放鬆。
phrases.note: 常接 at work、at school；放句首後面接逗號

phrases.ex: Long before smartphones were invented, people wrote letters to keep in touch.
phrases.exZh: 早在智慧型手機發明之前，人們就靠寫信保持聯絡。
phrases.note: 別跟 before long（不久之後）搞混

phrases.ex: The city launched a new policy to reduce plastic waste in night markets.
phrases.exZh: 市政府推出新政策，減少夜市的塑膠垃圾。
phrases.note: launch 較正式；也可用 introduce a policy

phrases.ex: Drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians are all road users who must follow traffic rules.
phrases.exZh: 駕駛、自行車騎士和行人都是必須遵守交通規則的用路人。
phrases.note: 統稱駕駛、騎士與行人；翻譯「用路人」直接用它

phrases.ex: The two sisters often fight over the TV remote control.
phrases.exZh: 那兩姊妹常常為了電視遙控器吵架。
phrases.note: over 接爭執的東西或原因；只動口不動手也可說 argue over

phrases.ex: The player fell to the ground and cried out in pain after twisting his ankle.
phrases.exZh: 那名球員扭傷腳踝後倒在地上，痛得大叫。
phrases.note: cry out 是大叫，不是哭；in pain 表「痛苦地」

phrases.ex: The heavy rain in the south was reported on the news last night.
phrases.exZh: 南部的豪雨昨晚上了新聞。
phrases.note: 電視、廣播新聞用 on；報紙用 in the newspaper

phrases.ex: I learned a lesson from losing my phone on the bus last month.
phrases.exZh: 上個月在公車上弄丟手機，讓我學到了教訓。
phrases.note: 經驗敘述作文常用；from 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.phrase: step out of one's comfort zone
phrases.ex: Joining the debate club helped my shy friend step out of her comfort zone.
phrases.exZh: 加入辯論社幫助我害羞的朋友走出舒適圈。
phrases.note: one's 依主詞改 my/her；也可說 get out of

phrases.ex: The kids couldn't wait to open the gifts from their grandparents.
phrases.exZh: 孩子們迫不及待要打開祖父母送的禮物。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；過去式寫 couldn't wait to

phrases.phrase: keep a balance between A and B
phrases.ex: It is not easy to keep a balance between schoolwork and club activities.
phrases.exZh: 要在課業和社團活動之間取得平衡並不容易。
phrases.note: 也可用 strike/find a balance
phrases.trap: keep a balance between schoolwork or

phrases.ex: The plan is cheap and simple; moreover, it is good for the environment.
phrases.exZh: 這個計畫既便宜又簡單，而且對環境也有益。
phrases.note: 正式；連接兩個子句，前用分號或句點，後接逗號

phrases.ex: The library is closed on Mondays; in other words, you cannot borrow any books that day.
phrases.exZh: 圖書館星期一休館；換句話說，那天你不能借任何書。
phrases.note: 用來重述前一句；常接在分號或句號後，後面接逗號

phrases.ex: All of a sudden, the lights went out, and the whole classroom fell silent.
phrases.exZh: 突然間，燈全都熄了，整間教室安靜下來。
phrases.note: 描寫突發狀況；放句首時後面加逗號，也可放句中

phrases.ex: The road was closed; nevertheless, the bus driver found another way to the museum.
phrases.exZh: 道路封閉了，儘管如此，公車司機還是找到另一條路前往博物館。
phrases.note: 正式；連接兩個分句，前用分號、後加逗號

phrases.ex: Finally, we should remember that healthy habits take time to build.
phrases.exZh: 最後，我們要記得，健康的習慣需要時間養成。
phrases.note: 放句首列點最後一項時，後面加逗號；也可表示「終於」

phrases.ex: In short, small daily habits can lead to big changes over time.
phrases.exZh: 簡言之，每天的小習慣久了能帶來很大的改變。
phrases.note: 比 in conclusion 簡短口語；用來把前文濃縮成一句

phrases.ex: Many classmates like busy cities, but as for me, I enjoy the calm of a small town.
phrases.exZh: 很多同學喜歡熱鬧的城市，至於我，我喜歡小鎮的寧靜。
phrases.note: 轉換話題或跟前面對比，放在子句開頭、後加逗號；as for me 至於我

phrases.phrase: the advantages and disadvantages of sth.
phrases.ex: Let us first look at the advantages and disadvantages of online classes.
phrases.exZh: 讓我們先來看看線上課程的優缺點。
phrases.note: 常用於開頭或分析段；of 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: As time went by, the two neighbors became good friends.
phrases.exZh: 隨著時間過去，兩位鄰居成了好朋友。
phrases.note: 敘事常用，過去式；現在式寫成 as time goes by

phrases.ex: We need to get rid of these old newspapers before moving house.
phrases.exZh: 搬家前我們得把這些舊報紙處理掉。
phrases.note: of 後面接名詞或 V-ing；常見在整理與清除的情境

phrases.ex: Extra practice this week will make up for the lessons she missed.
phrases.exZh: 本週多做練習，就能彌補她錯過的課。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: The class picnic was put off until next weekend because of the typhoon.
phrases.exZh: 因為颱風，班遊被延到下週末。
phrases.note: 延後義後接 V-ing，不接 to V

phrases.ex: Residents cannot put up with the loud noise from the construction site any longer.
phrases.exZh: 居民再也無法忍受工地傳來的巨大噪音。
phrases.note: 常用於否定；口語，較 tolerate 隨性
phrases.trap: put up to the loud noise

phrases.ex: A group of parents set up a small library for the village children.
phrases.exZh: 一群家長為村裡的孩子成立了一間小圖書館。
phrases.note: 可拆開：set the tent up；名詞為 setup

phrases.ex: The quiet village has turned into a popular tourist spot in recent years.
phrases.exZh: 這個安靜的村莊近年來已變成熱門的觀光景點。
phrases.note: 後接名詞；表示徹底改變
phrases.trap: has turn into a popular tourist spot

phrases.ex: When you feel worried, you can always turn to your teachers for advice.
phrases.exZh: 你感到擔心時，隨時都可以求助於老師，聽聽他們的建議。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；常搭配 for 表示求助的內容

phrases.ex: Many teenagers go through a difficult period when they start high school.
phrases.exZh: 許多青少年剛進高中時會經歷一段困難的時期。
phrases.note: 指經歷困難或逐項檢查；接名詞

phrases.ex: The cafeteria ran out of rice before the last class arrived.
phrases.exZh: 餐廳在最後一班學生到達之前就把飯賣完了。
phrases.note: 及物用法，主詞是人或地方；物品當主詞時用 run out

phrases.ex: It is hard to keep up with the fast changes in technology.
phrases.exZh: 要跟上科技的快速變化並不容易。
phrases.note: 後接人或事物，指跟上速度、潮流或進度

phrases.ex: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar and salt.
phrases.exZh: 醫生要他減少糖和鹽的攝取量。
phrases.note: on 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不可省略

phrases.ex: He ended up doing the whole project by himself.
phrases.exZh: 他最後變成一個人做完整份專題。
phrases.note: 後面接 V-ing 或介系詞片語；常帶非預期的結果

phrases.ex: Whether we go hiking tomorrow depends on the weather.
phrases.exZh: 我們明天是否去健行，取決於天氣。
phrases.note: 主詞是第三人稱單數時用 depends；不用進行式

phrases.ex: You can rely on my sister to finish the report on time.
phrases.exZh: 你可以信賴我姊姊會準時完成報告。
phrases.note: 可接 sb. to V；近義 count on，rely on 稍正式

phrases.ex: Every student is encouraged to participate in the science fair.
phrases.exZh: 學校鼓勵每位學生參加科學展覽。
phrases.note: 比 join 正式，多用於活動或比賽

phrases.ex: It takes time to adapt to a new school.
phrases.exZh: 適應新學校需要時間。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；強調為配合環境而改變

phrases.ex: Young learners benefit from reading a little every day.
phrases.exZh: 年輕的學習者從每天閱讀一點點中受益。
phrases.note: benefit 當動詞時，其後用 from 引出獲益來源

phrases.ex: This year, the school provides us with free lunch boxes every Friday.
phrases.exZh: 今年學校每週五都提供我們免費的便當。
phrases.note: 也可寫成 provide sth. for sb.，介系詞不同

phrases.ex: After living abroad for years, he is used to cooking for himself.
phrases.exZh: 在國外住了幾年後，他已習慣自己煮飯。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing；與 used to V 不同

phrases.ex: Elderly people often have difficulty climbing stairs without a handrail.
phrases.exZh: 老年人沒有扶手時常常很難爬樓梯。
phrases.note: difficulty 不可數；in 常省略，後接 V-ing
phrases.trap: often have difficulty to climb stairs

phrases.ex: Online maps enable travelers to find their way in unfamiliar cities.
phrases.exZh: 線上地圖讓旅客能在陌生的城市裡找到路。
phrases.note: 主詞常是事物；比 allow 更強調「有能力做到」

phrases.ex: You should sleep at least eight hours every night to stay healthy.
phrases.exZh: 你每晚至少要睡八小時，才能保持健康。
phrases.note: 後接數字表示不少於；反義為 at most

phrases.ex: A number of students, almost half the class, stayed after school to clean the science room.
phrases.exZh: 有不少學生，幾乎是半個班，放學後留下來打掃自然教室。
phrases.note: 後接複數可數名詞，動詞用複數

phrases.ex: Please send the form back as soon as possible.
phrases.exZh: 請盡快把表格寄回來。
phrases.note: 中間放形容詞或副詞，如 as early as possible

phrases.ex: The museum has old paintings as well as modern sculptures.
phrases.exZh: 這間博物館有古老的畫作，也有現代雕塑。
phrases.note: 連接對等成分；主詞用它連接時，動詞看前面的主詞

phrases.ex: The two neighbors often help each other with shopping.
phrases.exZh: 這兩位鄰居常常互相幫忙購物。
phrases.note: 只指兩者之間；所有格用 each other's

phrases.ex: Using public transportation is greener than driving a car alone.
phrases.exZh: 搭乘大眾運輸比自己開車更環保。
phrases.note: 不可數；英式常說 public transport

phrases.ex: The park was closed, so the children went to the library instead.
phrases.exZh: 公園關閉了，孩子們於是改去圖書館。
phrases.note: 副詞，多放句尾，也可放句首並加逗號；後面不直接接名詞

phrases.ex: The team won the final game in spite of a sudden injury to its captain.
phrases.exZh: 儘管隊長臨時受傷，這支隊伍還是贏得了決賽。
phrases.note: 用法同 despite，後接名詞或 V-ing；of 不能省略

phrases.ex: Careless driving on rainy days often results in terrible traffic accidents.
phrases.exZh: 下雨天粗心駕駛常常造成嚴重的車禍。
phrases.note: 主詞是原因、受詞是結果，與 result from 相反

phrases.ex: Regular exercise contributes to both a strong body and a clear mind.
phrases.exZh: 規律運動有助於強健身體和清晰的頭腦。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing；表示部分原因

phrases.ex: After many tries, the team eventually found a way to solve the problem.
phrases.exZh: 經過許多次嘗試，這個團隊終於找到解決問題的方法。
phrases.note: 強調經過一段過程或拖延後才發生的結果

phrases.ex: With the development of technology, shopping without leaving home has become easy.
phrases.exZh: 隨著科技的發展，足不出戶就能購物已變得很容易。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞，後面加逗號再接主要子句

phrases.ex: Many students see volunteer work as a waste of time, but I regard it as a chance to grow.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生認為志工服務是浪費時間，但我把它視為成長的機會。
phrases.note: as 後接名詞或形容詞，不可省略 as

phrases.phrase: it is necessary (for sb.) to V
phrases.ex: It is necessary for teenagers to learn how to manage their money wisely.
phrases.exZh: 青少年有必要學會如何聰明地管理金錢。
phrases.note: for sb. 可省略；不可寫成 sb. is necessary to
phrases.trap: It is necessary of teenagers to learn

phrases.ex: Being honest is as important as being smart.
phrases.exZh: 誠實和聰明一樣重要。
phrases.note: 中間放原級形容詞或副詞；否定可用 not as／so … as

phrases.ex: Few teenagers are aware of how much time they spend online.
phrases.exZh: 很少有青少年意識到自己花了多少時間上網。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 wh- 子句；也可說 be aware that …

phrases.ex: Schools should pay more attention to students' mental health.
phrases.exZh: 學校應該更加重視學生的心理健康。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞

phrases.ex: Before leaving the lab, please make sure that all the gas valves are closed.
phrases.exZh: 離開實驗室前，請務必確認所有瓦斯開關都已關上。
phrases.note: 後接子句常用現在式表未來；也可說 make sure of sth.

phrases.ex: After failing the swimming test, my cousin was determined to practice every morning.
phrases.exZh: 游泳測驗沒過之後，我表妹下定決心每天早上練習。
phrases.note: 強調決心堅定；名詞是 determination

phrases.ex: Studying abroad for a semester can broaden your horizons.
phrases.exZh: 出國讀一學期書能讓你開闊眼界。
phrases.note: horizons 用複數；同義 widen one's horizons

phrases.ex: Our class takes pride in keeping the campus garden clean and green.
phrases.exZh: 我們班以把校園花園維持得乾淨又翠綠為傲。
phrases.note: in 後接名詞或 V-ing；同義 be proud of

phrases.ex: It took me a month to get used to waking up at six.
phrases.exZh: 我花了一個月才習慣六點起床。
phrases.note: 表變習慣的過程；to 是介系詞，接 V-ing

phrases.ex: With the help of her classmates, the transfer student overcame many difficulties.
phrases.exZh: 在同學的幫助下，這位轉學生克服了許多困難。
phrases.note: 過去式 overcame；也可接 obstacles、challenges

phrases.ex: My uncle quit his office job to pursue his dream of opening a bakery.
phrases.exZh: 我叔叔辭掉辦公室工作，去追求開麵包店的夢想。
phrases.note: 夢想內容用 of + V-ing；也可說 follow one's dream

phrases.ex: To achieve her goal of running a marathon, my aunt trains every weekend.
phrases.exZh: 為了達成跑完馬拉松的目標，我阿姨每個週末都在練習。
phrases.note: 也可用 reach；不說 finish one's goal

phrases.ex: An aging population puts more pressure on hospitals and young taxpayers.
phrases.exZh: 高齡化讓醫院和年輕納稅人的壓力更大。
phrases.note: 美式 aging，英式 ageing；aging society 也常見

phrases.ex: My aunt looks after our neighbor's cat while they are away on holiday.
phrases.exZh: 我阿姨在鄰居出國度假時幫忙照顧他們的貓。
phrases.note: 及物；語氣比 take care of 口語，受詞放後面
phrases.trap: looks after of our neighbor's cat

phrases.ex: Students who miss many classes may easily fall behind.
phrases.exZh: 缺很多課的學生很容易跟不上進度。
phrases.note: 可接 in sth. 或 with sth.

phrases.ex: Students take turns cleaning up the classroom after lunch.
phrases.exZh: 學生們輪流在午餐後把教室打掃乾淨。
phrases.note: 強調徹底整理乾淨，比 clean 更完整
phrases.trap: take turns clean up the classroom

phrases.ex: Children grow up quickly, so enjoy every moment with them.
phrases.exZh: 孩子長得很快，所以要珍惜和他們相處的每一刻。
phrases.note: 不及物，不能用被動；grow up to be 表示長大後成為

phrases.ex: Staying up late every night is bad for your health.
phrases.exZh: 每天熬夜對你的健康不好。
phrases.note: stay up late 表示很晚才睡；相反是 go to bed early

phrases.ex: After many tries, she finally succeeded in solving the puzzle.
phrases.exZh: 試了很多次之後，她終於成功解開了謎題。
phrases.note: in 後接 V-ing；名詞是 success，形容詞是 successful

phrases.ex: Don't be shy to ask for help when the task is too hard.
phrases.exZh: 任務太難時，別不好意思開口求助。
phrases.note: 後接想得到的東西；問問題用 ask sb. a question

phrases.ex: Some tourists communicate with local people using simple gestures.
phrases.exZh: 有些遊客用簡單的手勢和當地人溝通。
phrases.note: 溝通的內容用 about 或直接說明

phrases.ex: Dad is busy preparing dinner in the kitchen right now.
phrases.exZh: 爸爸現在正忙著在廚房準備晚餐。
phrases.note: busy 後直接接 V-ing，不加 in 也不加 to

phrases.ex: This old museum is worth visiting if you have a free afternoon.
phrases.exZh: 如果你有一個下午的空閒，這間老博物館值得參觀。
phrases.note: worth 後接 V-ing，用主動形式表被動意義

phrases.ex: Our school does not allow students to bring phones into the exam room.
phrases.exZh: 我們學校不允許學生把手機帶進考場。
phrases.note: 後接 to V；被動為 be allowed to V
phrases.trap: does not allow students bring phones

phrases.ex: This small town is famous for its delicious street food.
phrases.exZh: 這個小鎮以美味的街頭小吃聞名。
phrases.note: for 後接出名的原因；比 be known for 更常見

phrases.ex: The library was full of students preparing for final exams.
phrases.exZh: 圖書館裡擠滿了準備期末考的學生。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；不可接 with

phrases.ex: That old bridge is known as the oldest structure in the village.
phrases.exZh: 那座老橋被公認是村裡最古老的建築。
phrases.note: as 後接身分或稱號；接原因要用 known for

phrases.ex: Board games are popular with students during the long lunch break.
phrases.exZh: 在漫長的午休時間，桌遊在學生之間很受歡迎。
phrases.note: with 後接人；也可用 popular among

phrases.ex: The oldest student was in charge of the whole cleaning team today.
phrases.exZh: 今天由年紀最大的學生負責整個打掃小組。
phrases.note: 常用 be in charge of sth.；of 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: She had a reason for being late: her bike had a flat tire.
phrases.exZh: 她遲到是有理由的：她的腳踏車爆胎了。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；常用 the main reason for

phrases.ex: Watching the same video ten times is a waste of time.
phrases.exZh: 同一支影片看十次是浪費時間。
phrases.note: 常見 a waste of time/money；動詞為 waste
