phrases.ex: Joining a club is a great way to make friends in a new school.
phrases.exZh: 加入社團是在新學校交朋友的好方法。
phrases.note: friends 要用複數；常接 with sb.
phrases.trap: to make friend in a new school

phrases.ex: The two cousins take turns washing the dishes after dinner.
phrases.exZh: 這兩位堂兄弟晚餐後輪流洗碗。
phrases.note: turns 用複數，後面接 V-ing 或 to V

phrases.ex: Working together often helps us solve a problem more quickly.
phrases.exZh: 團隊合作常能幫助我們更快解決問題。
phrases.note: 動詞用 solve；也可說 deal with a problem

phrases.ex: It takes about a month to form a habit of reading every night.
phrases.exZh: 養成每晚閱讀的習慣大約需要一個月。
phrases.note: 後接 of V-ing；也可說 develop a habit

phrases.ex: Yesterday my cousin rode a horse for the first time.
phrases.exZh: 昨天我表哥第一次騎馬。
phrases.note: 第二次為 for the second time；與 at first 不同

phrases.ex: Self-driving buses may appear on our streets in the near future.
phrases.exZh: 自動駕駛公車在不久的將來可能會出現在我們的街上。
phrases.note: 多用於預測，可放句首或句尾

phrases.ex: The pianist practiced the difficult part again and again.
phrases.exZh: 鋼琴家一遍又一遍地練習那段困難的部分。
phrases.note: 強調反覆多次，＝ over and over

phrases.ex: Making a cake takes a great deal of patience and a little luck.
phrases.exZh: 做蛋糕需要非常多的耐心，還要有一點運氣。
phrases.note: 後接不可數名詞

phrases.ex: Life in a small town is different from life in a big city in many ways.
phrases.exZh: 小鎮的生活和大城市的生活在很多方面都不一樣。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 from；英式也有 different to
phrases.trap: is different with life in a big city

phrases.ex: The number of cars in the city keeps growing each year.
phrases.exZh: 這座城市的汽車數量逐年增加。
phrases.note: 主詞是 number，動詞用單數；與 a number of 不同
phrases.trap: The number of car in the city

phrases.ex: She did well in the speech contest thanks to careful practice.
phrases.exZh: 多虧細心練習，她在演講比賽中表現很好。
phrases.note: well 是副詞；不要說 do good in

phrases.ex: Customers wait in line for hours to taste the famous snack.
phrases.exZh: 顧客為了品嚐那款有名的小吃，排隊等上好幾個小時。
phrases.note: 美式用 in line，英式用 in a queue

phrases.ex: The plan sounds simple, but it takes a lot of time to carry out.
phrases.exZh: 這個計畫聽起來很簡單，但實行起來很花時間。
phrases.note: 連接兩個對等子句，前面常加逗號；不要與 although 並用

phrases.ex: Unlike most of his classmates, the boy walks to school every morning.
phrases.exZh: 和大多數同學不同，這個男孩每天早上走路上學。
phrases.note: 介系詞，後接名詞；放句首時，後面加逗號
phrases.trap: Unlike to most of his classmates,

phrases.ex: Students must hand in the homework today; otherwise, they will lose some points.
phrases.exZh: 學生今天必須交作業，否則會被扣分。
phrases.note: 前面用分號或句號，後加逗號；後句常表不好的結果

phrases.ex: No matter what people say, you should follow your own dream.
phrases.exZh: 不管別人怎麼說，你都應該追隨自己的夢想。
phrases.note: 引導讓步子句，意思同 whatever；放句首要加逗號

phrases.ex: Most cases of the flu are caused by viruses that spread easily in crowded places.
phrases.exZh: 大多數流感起因於容易在擁擠場所傳播的病毒。
phrases.note: 被動語態，by 後接原因；主詞是結果

phrases.ex: Since the roads were icy, most people chose to stay at home.
phrases.exZh: 由於路面結冰，大多數人選擇待在家裡。
phrases.note: 連接詞，原因是對方已知；放句首，後加逗號
phrases.trap: Since the roads were icy, so

phrases.ex: Sleep is important for everyone, especially students who have to get up early for class.
phrases.exZh: 睡眠對每個人都很重要，尤其是必須早起上課的學生。
phrases.note: 放在要強調的對象前，不能直接放句首當連接詞

phrases.ex: The library offers many free services, including online databases, quiet study rooms, and weekend workshops.
phrases.exZh: 圖書館提供許多免費服務，包括線上資料庫、安靜的自習室和週末工作坊。
phrases.note: 介系詞，後接名詞；表示所列項目是整體的一部分

phrases.ex: Needless to say, clean air is necessary for everyone living in a big city.
phrases.exZh: 不用說，乾淨的空氣對每個住在大城市的人都很必要。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；後面說的是眾所周知的事

phrases.ex: Technology saves time, but at the same time, it may make us lonely.
phrases.exZh: 科技幫我們節省時間，但同時也可能讓我們感到孤單。
phrases.note: 可表同時發生，也可引出對照的另一面（相當於 however）

phrases.ex: At last, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
phrases.exZh: 雨終於停了，太陽也出來了。
phrases.note: 強調久等後的結果，常帶如釋重負的語氣；不用於列點

phrases.ex: From now on, I will spend less time on my phone.
phrases.exZh: 從現在起，我要減少玩手機的時間。
phrases.note: 放句首，用於決心或規定；動詞多用未來式或現在式

phrases.ex: At the beginning of the semester, we made a plan for our reading.
phrases.exZh: 學期一開始，我們訂了閱讀計畫。
phrases.note: 後接名詞，指某段時間或事物的起點；反義為 at the end of
phrases.trap: At the begin of the semester,

phrases.ex: At the end of the speech, everyone stood up and clapped.
phrases.exZh: 演講結束時，所有人都站起來鼓掌。
phrases.note: 後接名詞；in the end 則是獨立的副詞片語，別混用
phrases.trap: In the end of the speech,

phrases.ex: Whenever I feel nervous, I take a few deep breaths.
phrases.exZh: 每當我覺得緊張，就會做幾次深呼吸。
phrases.note: 連接詞，後接子句，表示每次；也可表示「任何時候」

phrases.ex: There is no doubt that regular exercise keeps both the body and the mind healthy.
phrases.exZh: 毫無疑問，規律運動能讓身體與心靈都保持健康。
phrases.note: that 後接完整子句；語氣肯定，適合開頭立論

phrases.ex: Parents should make an effort to spend more time with their children.
phrases.exZh: 父母應該努力多花一些時間陪伴孩子。
phrases.note: effort 前可加 great、real 等字；to 後接原形動詞

phrases.ex: Local governments need to take action to protect rivers from waste.
phrases.exZh: 地方政府需要採取行動，保護河川不受廢棄物汙染。
phrases.note: action 為不可數名詞，不加 a；常與 immediately、now 連用

phrases.phrase: it is one's responsibility to V
phrases.ex: It is our responsibility to leave a clean earth for the next generation.
phrases.exZh: 為下一代留下乾淨的地球是我們的責任。
phrases.note: one's 依主詞換成 my、our、their；語氣莊重
phrases.trap: It is our responsibility of leaving

phrases.ex: Cyclists should wear helmets so as to protect their heads.
phrases.exZh: 騎腳踏車的人應該戴安全帽以保護頭部。
phrases.note: 不能放句首；後接原形動詞，語氣比 in order to 稍簡潔

phrases.ex: Reading every day is beneficial to our vocabulary and our imagination.
phrases.exZh: 每天閱讀對我們的字彙量和想像力都有益處。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing；也可用 beneficial for

phrases.ex: Staying up late is harmful to both our bodies and our minds.
phrases.exZh: 熬夜對我們的身體和心理都有害。
phrases.note: 與 beneficial 相反；to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Heavy rain can cause damage to crops and roads in a short time.
phrases.exZh: 大雨能在短時間內對農作物和道路造成損害。
phrases.note: damage 為不可數名詞，不加 a；to 後接受損的對象

phrases.ex: High school only lasts three years, so make the most of your school life.
phrases.exZh: 高中只有三年，所以要好好把握你的校園生活。
phrases.note: the most 不可換成 most；常用於勸勉或建議

phrases.phrase: have a great influence on sb./sth.
phrases.ex: Parents often have a great influence on the way children think.
phrases.exZh: 父母常常對孩子的思考方式有很大的影響。
phrases.note: influence 後用 on；great 可換 strong、deep

phrases.ex: Planting more trees can improve the quality of the air in our city.
phrases.exZh: 多種一些樹可以提升我們城市的空氣品質。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；常搭配 life、education、air

phrases.ex: Giving students too much homework may do more harm than good.
phrases.exZh: 給學生太多功課可能弊大於利。
phrases.note: 固定說法，不加冠詞；常放在句尾表達否定評價
phrases.trap: may make more harm than good.

phrases.ex: Mobile payment has brought convenience to shoppers of all ages.
phrases.exZh: 行動支付為各年齡層的消費者帶來了便利。
phrases.note: convenience 不可數，前面不加 a

phrases.ex: The campaign aims to raise awareness of the need to save water.
phrases.exZh: 這項活動的目的是提高大家對節約用水必要性的認識。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；常用於活動、宣導的說明

phrases.ex: A single strange photo can attract attention and spread across the Internet within hours.
phrases.exZh: 一張怪異的照片就能引起關注，並在幾小時內傳遍網路。
phrases.note: attract 是及物動詞，可加 much、public 修飾；不加 to

phrases.ex: Many young people depend heavily on their phones for news and entertainment.
phrases.exZh: 許多年輕人在取得新聞和娛樂時高度依賴手機。
phrases.note: on 後接名詞或 V-ing；也可說 rely heavily on

phrases.ex: Staying up late to watch videos is becoming a social phenomenon among teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 熬夜看影片正逐漸成為青少年之間的一種社會現象。
phrases.note: phenomenon 的複數是 phenomena；常用來描述普遍現象

phrases.ex: Too many exams can put pressure on young students.
phrases.exZh: 過多的考試可能會給年幼的學生帶來壓力。
phrases.note: pressure 不可數，前面不加 a

phrases.ex: Short videos have quickly gained popularity among people of all ages.
phrases.exZh: 短影片迅速在各年齡層之間受到歡迎。
phrases.note: popularity 不可數；可加 rapidly 修飾 gain

phrases.ex: Children are exposed to all kinds of information the moment they go online.
phrases.exZh: 孩子一上網就會接觸到各式各樣的資訊。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；可指好或壞的接觸，視上下文判斷

phrases.ex: Parents must strike the right balance between giving freedom and setting rules.
phrases.exZh: 父母必須在給予自由與訂立規矩之間拿捏得恰到好處。
phrases.note: 後面常接 between … and …；balance 前多用 right

phrases.ex: Many people overlook the fact that small habits shape a person's future.
phrases.exZh: 許多人忽略了一個事實：小習慣會塑造一個人的未來。
phrases.note: that 子句說明 fact 的內容，整體當名詞片語

phrases.ex: I suggest that you join a sports club to make new friends.
phrases.exZh: 我建議你加入運動社團來結交新朋友。
phrases.note: 建議信常用；that 子句用原形動詞（should 可省）

phrases.ex: The moment I opened the box, a tiny puppy jumped into my arms.
phrases.exZh: 就在我掀開箱蓋的那一刻，一隻小小的幼犬跳進了我懷裡。
phrases.note: 當連接詞用，同 as soon as，前面不加介系詞
phrases.trap: The moments I opened the box,

phrases.ex: Online shopping saves time and money; thus, it becomes more popular every year.
phrases.exZh: 網路購物省時又省錢，因此每年都更受歡迎。
phrases.note: 書面語，語氣比 therefore 更簡潔

phrases.ex: Students may ask their teachers for extra help if necessary.
phrases.exZh: 學生必要時可以向老師尋求額外協助。
phrases.note: 省略形式，等於 if it is necessary；可放句中或句尾

phrases.ex: Many passengers on the train are glued to their phones and never look up.
phrases.exZh: 火車上許多乘客都是低頭族，從不抬頭。
phrases.note: glued 是黏住；口語常用，低頭族不譯 bow head tribe

phrases.ex: On hot afternoons, a cup of bubble tea with less sugar is my favorite treat.
phrases.exZh: 炎熱的午後，一杯微糖的手搖飲是我最愛的享受。
phrases.note: 手搖飲泛指現場調製的茶飲，不只珍珠奶茶

phrases.ex: Tourists love wandering through the night market, trying snacks and playing simple games.
phrases.exZh: 遊客喜歡逛夜市，邊吃小吃邊玩簡單的遊戲。
phrases.note: 固定說法，不要說 night street；重點是攤販與小吃

phrases.ex: The night market was bustling with activity, and every stall had a long line of hungry customers.
phrases.exZh: 夜市裡好熱鬧，每個攤位前都排著長長的人龍。
phrases.note: 描述地點人多有生氣；不能直譯成 hot and noisy，那會變成吵鬧

phrases.ex: Everyone in the hall was deeply moved by the old man's simple speech.
phrases.exZh: 禮堂裡的每個人都深深感動於老先生樸實的演講。
phrases.note: 被動語態；後接名詞，感動的原因用 by

phrases.ex: I should have checked the weather before going hiking yesterday.
phrases.exZh: 我昨天去爬山之前早該先查看天氣的。
phrases.note: 表對過去的後悔或責備；否定 shouldn't have p.p.

phrases.phrase: I will never forget the day when …
phrases.ex: I will never forget the day when I first volunteered at the animal shelter.
phrases.exZh: 我永遠不會忘記那一天，那天我第一次去動物收容所當志工。
phrases.note: 經驗敘述作文開頭常用；when 可換 that 或省略
phrases.trap: I will never forget the day which

phrases.ex: In his free time, my father enjoys growing vegetables on the balcony.
phrases.exZh: 我爸爸空閒時喜歡在陽台種菜。
phrases.note: 同義 in one's spare time；介系詞用 in 不用 at

phrases.phrase: the + superlative + S have ever p.p.
phrases.ex: This is the most beautiful sunrise I have ever seen.
phrases.exZh: 這是我看過最美的日出。
phrases.note: 最高級後接現在完成式子句；ever 表至今

phrases.phrase: If S were …, S would V
phrases.ex: If I were the principal, I would build a bigger library.
phrases.exZh: 如果我是校長，我會蓋一座更大的圖書館。
phrases.note: 與現在事實相反；be 動詞一律用 were

phrases.ex: Despite the heavy rain, the volunteers managed to finish cleaning the beach.
phrases.exZh: 儘管下大雨，志工們還是設法完成了淨灘。
phrases.note: 強調克服困難而成功；後接原形動詞

phrases.ex: When he looks back on his school days, he feels very thankful.
phrases.exZh: 當他回想求學時光，心中充滿感謝。
phrases.note: 指回想過去；後面接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Years of hard work finally paid off when she won the prize.
phrases.exZh: 多年的努力終於在她得獎時有了回報。
phrases.note: 不及物時指努力有成果；及物時指還清債務

phrases.ex: To sum up, the trip was tiring but very rewarding.
phrases.exZh: 總而言之，這趟旅行雖然累，卻很有收穫。
phrases.note: To sum up 可放句首當結論用語，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: I agree with you that we should recycle more.
phrases.exZh: 我同意你的看法，我們應該多做資源回收。
phrases.note: 對象是人或意見；同意計畫用 agree to／on

phrases.ex: Saving a little money each week will help you in the long run.
phrases.exZh: 每週存一點錢，長遠來看對你會有幫助。
phrases.note: 談長期結果；常與 in the short run 對比

phrases.ex: A large dog, for instance, cannot live happily in a tiny apartment.
phrases.exZh: 比方說，大型犬無法在狹小的公寓裡過得快樂。
phrases.note: 可放句首、句中或句尾，用逗號隔開；語氣與 for example 相近

phrases.ex: The park gives people a place to rest and, more importantly, a reason to go outdoors.
phrases.exZh: 公園讓人有地方休息，更重要的是，給人走到戶外的理由。
phrases.note: 用來把後一項提到比前一項更重要

phrases.ex: To sum up, a balanced diet and regular exercise are the keys to a healthy life.
phrases.exZh: 總結來說，均衡飲食與規律運動是健康生活的關鍵。
phrases.note: 用於整合前面幾點；放句首加逗號，語氣不像 in conclusion 那麼正式

phrases.ex: What matters most is not the score but the effort you put into learning.
phrases.exZh: 最重要的不是分數，而是你在學習上付出的努力。
phrases.note: 名詞子句當主詞；is 後可接名詞、to V 或 that 子句

phrases.ex: What impresses me most is the way the villagers work together.
phrases.exZh: 最讓我印象深刻的是村民們齊心合作的方式。
phrases.note: 表達個人感受；可換成 What surprises me most is

phrases.ex: There is no denying that social media has changed how we make friends.
phrases.exZh: 不可否認，社群媒體改變了我們交朋友的方式。
phrases.note: denying 是動名詞；同 It cannot be denied that

phrases.ex: From that day on, he practiced the piano for an hour every evening.
phrases.exZh: 從那天起，他每天晚上都練一小時鋼琴。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；動詞用過去式，不寫 from that day

phrases.ex: Even now, I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen on rainy afternoons.
phrases.exZh: 即使到現在，我仍記得下雨的午後外婆廚房裡的味道。
phrases.note: 用於回憶開頭；後接名詞或 how／that 子句

phrases.ex: Planting more trees may be a solution to the heat problem in cities.
phrases.exZh: 多種一些樹也許是都市高溫問題的解決辦法。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 to，不用 for

phrases.ex: Even after graduation, the two friends promised to keep in touch through video calls.
phrases.exZh: 即使畢業後，這兩位朋友仍約定要用視訊通話保持聯絡。
phrases.note: 常接 with sb.，如 with old friends
phrases.trap: to keep on touch through video calls.

phrases.ex: The runner rushed to the station, only to find that the train had left.
phrases.exZh: 跑者衝到車站，卻發現火車已經開走了。
phrases.note: 表示出乎意料的結果，to 後接原形動詞，常見 find、discover

phrases.ex: The museum is free to enter, and what is more, it opens late on Fridays.
phrases.exZh: 這間博物館免費入場，而且星期五還開到很晚。
phrases.note: 用來追加更有力的一點；前後常加逗號，也可說 what's more

phrases.ex: Without a doubt, teamwork makes a school project easier to finish.
phrases.exZh: 毫無疑問，團隊合作能讓學校的專題更容易完成。
phrases.note: 語氣肯定，放句首加逗號；也可放句中

phrases.ex: Last but not least, we need to respect people who think differently.
phrases.exZh: 最後但同樣重要的是，我們要尊重想法不同的人。
phrases.note: 用在列點最後一項，放句首；強調這點不比前面的次要

phrases.ex: More often than not, failure is the first step toward success.
phrases.exZh: 失敗往往是邁向成功的第一步。
phrases.note: 書面用語，放句首時後面接逗號，比 often 肯定

phrases.ex: The table in our classroom is made of solid wood.
phrases.exZh: 我們教室裡的桌子是用實木做的。
phrases.note: 成品仍看得出材料；材料變質用 made from

phrases.ex: The doctor advised him to drink more water and get enough sleep.
phrases.exZh: 醫生建議他多喝水、睡飽一點。
phrases.note: advice 是名詞；suggest 不能接 sb. to V

phrases.ex: The new library is located in the center of the town.
phrases.exZh: 新圖書館位於鎮中心。
phrases.note: 大地點用 in，小地點或定點用 at

phrases.ex: Many people fail to realize how much plastic they throw away every day.
phrases.exZh: 很多人沒有意識到自己每天丟掉多少塑膠。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞，比 not 正式、強調沒做到；反義是 manage to V

phrases.ex: Our club needs someone to take over as leader next year.
phrases.exZh: 我們社團明年需要有人接任社長。
phrases.note: 可不接受詞；接受詞時是接管某事物

phrases.ex: Many students put in extra hours of study before the big exam.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生在大考前多花了好幾個小時讀書。
phrases.note: 受詞常為時間、努力或申請
phrases.trap: put into extra hours of study

phrases.ex: Members of a team should trust one another.
phrases.exZh: 團隊成員應該彼此信任。
phrases.note: 與 each other 意思相同，常用於三者以上

phrases.ex: Teenagers' stress often stems from too much pressure to get high scores.
phrases.exZh: 青少年的壓力常常源自要拿高分的巨大壓力。
phrases.note: 主詞是結果，from 後是根本原因；不用被動

phrases.ex: You have to go to the office in person to pick up your new ID card.
phrases.exZh: 你必須親自到辦公室領取新的身分證。
phrases.note: 強調本人到場，不是透過電話或他人

phrases.ex: Everyone ought to take responsibility for keeping public places clean.
phrases.exZh: 每個人都應該負起責任，維持公共場所整潔。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；語氣比 should 稍強，否定為 ought not to

phrases.ex: Young children and the elderly are especially vulnerable to the flu in winter.
phrases.exZh: 冬天時，幼童和長者特別容易感染流感。
phrases.note: 形容詞前接 be；比 be sensitive to 更強調易受害
phrases.trap: are especially vulnerable for the flu

phrases.ex: After the summer camp, the children went back to their own homes.
phrases.exZh: 夏令營結束後，孩子們各自回家了。
phrases.note: 不及物；可接 to 表示回到某處或某時間

phrases.ex: Taking public transportation is a simple and environmentally friendly way to get around the city.
phrases.exZh: 搭乘大眾運輸是在市區移動既簡單又環保的方式。
phrases.note: 不寫 environmental friendly；同 eco-friendly
phrases.trap: is a simple and environmental friendly way

phrases.ex: The committee is composed of five students and two teachers.
phrases.exZh: 這個委員會由五名學生和兩名老師組成。
phrases.note: 近義：consist of；用被動形式

phrases.ex: Life in a big city differs from life in a village in many ways.
phrases.exZh: 大城市的生活和鄉下的生活在許多方面都不一樣。
phrases.note: 多用主動語態；形容詞是 different from
phrases.trap: differs than life in a village

phrases.ex: The little dog escaped from the yard through a hole in the fence.
phrases.exZh: 那隻小狗從籬笆的洞口逃出了院子。
phrases.note: escape 也可直接接名詞，如 escape danger

phrases.ex: Many young people are faced with the pressure of finding a stable job.
phrases.exZh: 許多年輕人面臨找到穩定工作的壓力。
phrases.note: 被動，後面要有 with；主動用 face 直接接受詞，不加 with

phrases.zh: 是…的所在地；是…的棲息地
phrases.ex: Tropical rainforests are home to more than half of the world's plant and animal species.
phrases.exZh: 熱帶雨林是全世界超過一半動植物物種的棲息地。
phrases.note: 主詞是地方，home 前不加 a 或 the；表示某地有某物存在或生活

phrases.ex: The heavy rains prompted many families to leave their homes near the river.
phrases.exZh: 豪雨促使許多家庭離開河邊的家。
phrases.note: 較正式，主詞常是事件；encourage sb. to V 是鼓勵
phrases.trap: prompted many families leave their homes

phrases.ex: Does the question you just asked relate to today's lesson?
phrases.exZh: 你剛才問的問題和今天的課有關嗎？
phrases.note: 被動 be related to 更常見，意為「與……有關」

phrases.ex: Over the years, the small fishing village has turned into a busy tourist town.
phrases.exZh: 這些年來，這個小漁村已經變成熱鬧的觀光小鎮。
phrases.note: 常配完成式；over time 是久而久之，不是這些年來

phrases.ex: There were a lot of bikes parked outside the library.
phrases.exZh: 圖書館外面停了許多腳踏車。
phrases.note: 口語常用，可接可數與不可數名詞

phrases.ex: Feeling tired all the time can be a sign of poor sleep habits.
phrases.exZh: 老是覺得累，可能是睡眠習慣不好的徵兆。
phrases.note: 常用 be/see sth. as a sign of；複數 signs of

phrases.ex: Many students are reluctant to ask questions in class because they fear looking silly.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生不太願意在課堂上發問，因為怕看起來很蠢。
phrases.note: 後接原形，比 not want to 正式；反義 be willing to
phrases.trap: are reluctant asking questions in class

phrases.ex: Passengers must get on the train before the doors close.
phrases.exZh: 乘客必須在車門關上之前上車。
phrases.note: get off 的反義；也可指事情進展

phrases.zh: 在某種程度上；就某方面來說
phrases.ex: In a way, losing the game taught the team more than winning would have.
phrases.exZh: 就某方面來說，輸掉這場比賽讓球隊學到的比贏球還多。
phrases.note: 常放句首加逗號，語氣較口語；作文正式可用 to some extent

phrases.ex: Through club activities, students learn to interact with people from different backgrounds.
phrases.exZh: 透過社團活動，學生學會和不同背景的人互動。
phrases.note: 不及物，要加 with；比 communicate with 範圍廣，指各種往來

phrases.ex: The school will look into the matter and give everyone an answer by Friday.
phrases.exZh: 學校會調查這件事，並在週五前給大家答覆。
phrases.note: 及物；比 investigate 口語，受詞不可放中間

phrases.ex: The teacher was more than willing to explain the problem again.
phrases.exZh: 老師非常樂意再把這個問題講解一次。
phrases.note: more than 後接形容詞表示「非常」，語氣比 very 強

phrases.ex: Most of the fruit in this shop comes from farms in the south.
phrases.exZh: 這家店的水果大多來自南部的農場。
phrases.note: 不用進行式；問來歷可說 Where does it come from?

phrases.ex: This umbrella belongs to the girl sitting by the window.
phrases.exZh: 這把傘屬於坐在窗邊的那個女孩。
phrases.note: 不用進行式或被動語態

phrases.ex: In response to the students' request, the school added more water fountains.
phrases.exZh: 為了回應學生的要求，學校增設了更多飲水機。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；多放句首
phrases.trap: In response of the students' request,

phrases.ex: It is not easy to take in so much new information at once.
phrases.exZh: 一次要吸收這麼多新資訊並不容易。
phrases.note: 被騙常用被動：be taken in

phrases.ex: Please refer to the map on page ten for details.
phrases.exZh: 詳情請參閱第十頁的地圖。
phrases.note: refer to A as B 表示把 A 稱作 B

phrases.ex: Students should hand in the form by Friday, that is, three days before the trip.
phrases.exZh: 學生應在週五前交回表格，也就是旅行前三天。
phrases.note: 前後常加逗號，用來換個說法或補充精確資訊；縮寫為 i.e.

phrases.ex: When she heard the good news, she burst into tears of joy.
phrases.exZh: 聽到這個喜訊時，她喜極而泣。
phrases.note: 不及物；同義可寫 burst out crying

phrases.ex: Cities are crowded and noisy; in contrast, small villages are quiet and peaceful.
phrases.exZh: 城市擁擠又吵雜；相對地，小村莊安靜又平和。
phrases.note: 放句首，後加逗號，用來對比兩件事物

phrases.ex: Sunlight helps our bodies make vitamin D; for this reason, doctors advise us to go outside.
phrases.exZh: 陽光幫助身體製造維生素 D，因此醫師建議我們到戶外走走。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號，承接前一句所說的原因

phrases.ex: Besides being cheap, bicycles are also good for the environment.
phrases.exZh: 腳踏車除了便宜之外，對環境也有益。
phrases.note: 作介系詞後接 V-ing；別和 beside（在旁邊）搞混

phrases.ex: Taking public libraries as an example, we can see how shared resources benefit an entire community.
phrases.exZh: 以公共圖書館為例，我們可以看出共用的資源如何讓所有居民受益。
phrases.note: 常以 Taking … as an example 放句首，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: A healthy lifestyle needs many things, but above all it needs a regular daily routine.
phrases.exZh: 健康的生活方式需要很多條件，但最重要的是規律的作息。
phrases.note: 列舉多項後強調最重要的一項；可放句首或句中

phrases.ex: To begin with, plastic bags cause serious harm to sea animals.
phrases.exZh: 首先，塑膠袋對海洋動物造成嚴重的傷害。
phrases.note: 放句首，後面加逗號；常與 in addition 或 finally 搭配

phrases.ex: For these reasons, schools should give students more time to rest between classes.
phrases.exZh: 基於這些原因，學校應該讓學生在課與課之間有更多休息時間。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；前文須已列出理由

phrases.phrase: as far as I am concerned
phrases.ex: As far as I am concerned, keeping a pet can teach a child to take responsibility.
phrases.exZh: 就我而言，養寵物能教孩子負起責任。
phrases.note: 放句首；concerned 不可寫成 concern
phrases.trap: As far as I am concerning,

phrases.ex: After years of playing team sports, I firmly believe that cooperation matters more than winning.
phrases.exZh: 多年參加團體運動之後，我堅信合作比勝利更重要。
phrases.note: 語氣強；that 後接完整子句

phrases.ex: In my experience, students learn faster when they explain ideas to their classmates.
phrases.exZh: 根據我的經驗，學生向同學解釋想法時學得更快。
phrases.note: 以親身經歷支持看法，適合放在主張之前

phrases.zh: 雙面刃；利弊兼具的事物
phrases.ex: Social media is a double-edged sword that brings both fun and pressure.
phrases.exZh: 社群媒體是把雙面刃，既帶來樂趣也帶來壓力。
phrases.note: 比喻用法，可放在句尾點出主題；常用於論述科技

phrases.ex: In my view, the benefits of travel outweigh the costs.
phrases.exZh: 依我之見，旅行的好處勝過它的花費。
phrases.note: 及物動詞，直接接受詞；常寫成 A outweighs B

phrases.ex: Some people argue that homework takes away time students could spend on hobbies.
phrases.exZh: 有些人主張，回家作業佔走了學生原本可用來培養興趣的時間。
phrases.note: 引出一方觀點，常與 others 對照；argue 後接 that 子句

phrases.phrase: The best thing about … is that …
phrases.ex: The best thing about living in a small town is that everyone knows each other.
phrases.exZh: 住在小鎮最棒的一點，就是大家都彼此認識。
phrases.note: about 後接名詞或 V-ing；is that 後接完整子句

phrases.zh: 我寫這封信是要…；來信目的是…
phrases.ex: I am writing to ask about the summer English camp advertised on your website.
phrases.exZh: 我來信是想詢問貴網站上刊登的暑期英語營。
phrases.note: 正式或半正式書信的開頭句；to 後接原形動詞，說明來信目的

phrases.ex: To his disappointment, the concert was canceled because of the typhoon.
phrases.exZh: 令他失望的是，演唱會因颱風而取消了。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；用名詞 disappointment

phrases.ex: Many students are worried about their test scores.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生擔心自己的考試成績。
phrases.note: 近義：be concerned about；about 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: The whole class was excited about the coming science fair.
phrases.exZh: 全班都對即將到來的科學展感到興奮。
phrases.note: 主詞是人；令人興奮的事物用 exciting

phrases.phrase: be grateful to sb. for sth.
phrases.ex: Passengers felt grateful to the driver for waiting a few extra minutes.
phrases.exZh: 乘客很感謝司機多等了幾分鐘。
phrases.note: 對人用 to，對事用 for；語氣正式
phrases.trap: felt grateful with the driver for waiting

phrases.ex: The coach never loses his temper, even when the players make mistakes.
phrases.exZh: 即使球員犯錯，教練也從不發脾氣。
phrases.note: one's 隨主詞變化；反義 keep one's temper

phrases.ex: Students should feel free to express their opinion in class.
phrases.exZh: 學生應該可以自在地在課堂上表達意見。
phrases.note: one's 隨主詞變化；也可說 express an opinion

phrases.ex: Volunteering at the animal shelter helped him gain experience with pets.
phrases.exZh: 在動物收容所當志工幫助他累積了照顧寵物的經驗。
phrases.note: experience 表「經驗」時不可數；也可說 get experience

phrases.phrase: feel a weight lifted off one's shoulders
phrases.ex: When the exams finally ended, I felt a weight lifted off my shoulders.
phrases.exZh: 考試終於結束時，我整個人鬆了一口氣。
phrases.note: 也可說 be relieved；此說法較生動，適合作文
phrases.trap: felt a weight lifted on my shoulders.

phrases.ex: I had mixed feelings about moving to a new city, excited yet a little afraid.
phrases.exZh: 要搬到新城市，我心裡五味雜陳，既興奮又有點害怕。
phrases.note: about 後接事情；感受複雜但不一定苦，也可用 mixed emotions

phrases.ex: Joining the school band gave the shy new student a sense of belonging.
phrases.exZh: 加入學校樂隊，讓害羞的新生找到了歸屬感。
phrases.note: 名詞用 belonging；動詞是 belong to

phrases.ex: Many students look up to their coach because he never gives up.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生很敬佩他們的教練，因為他從不放棄。
phrases.note: 反義是 look down on；受詞為人

phrases.ex: The students will carry out a simple experiment in the lab today.
phrases.exZh: 學生今天要在實驗室進行一個簡單的實驗。
phrases.note: 受詞是名詞時可放中間或後面：carry it out
phrases.trap: carry it out a simple experiment

phrases.ex: Could you pick up your clothes from the floor before dinner?
phrases.exZh: 晚餐前你可以把衣服從地上撿起來嗎？
phrases.note: 代名詞要放中間：pick it up

phrases.ex: Many people suffer from back pain after sitting all day.
phrases.exZh: 許多人整天坐著之後會受背痛所苦。
phrases.note: from 後接疾病或問題

phrases.ex: Many beginners have trouble pronouncing the letter r correctly.
phrases.exZh: 許多初學者很難正確發出字母 r 的音。
phrases.note: 後面直接接 V-ing，不加 to；也可用 in V-ing

phrases.ex: A balanced diet includes vegetables, fruit, grains, and enough protein.
phrases.exZh: 均衡飲食包含蔬菜、水果、穀類和足夠的蛋白質。
phrases.note: diet 在此指日常飲食；balanced 不可省略

phrases.ex: The town looked as if it had been asleep for a hundred years.
phrases.exZh: 這座小鎮看起來彷彿已沉睡了一百年。
phrases.note: 與事實相反時，子句用過去式或過去完成式；as though 同義
phrases.trap: as like it had been asleep

phrases.ex: Students are supposed to return library books within two weeks.
phrases.exZh: 學生照理說應該在兩週內歸還圖書館的書。
phrases.note: 表規定或預期；過去式常暗示「本來該做卻沒做」

phrases.zh: 各年齡層的人；男女老少
phrases.ex: The new riverside park is popular with people of all ages.
phrases.exZh: 新的河濱公園深受各年齡層民眾喜愛。
phrases.note: ages 用複數；people 可換成 visitors、readers

phrases.ex: Our school makes use of rainwater to water the plants on campus.
phrases.exZh: 我們學校利用雨水來澆灌校園裡的植物。
phrases.note: 可加 good/full 修飾 use；比 use 稍正式

phrases.ex: Don't take on more work than you can finish.
phrases.exZh: 不要承擔超過你能完成的工作量。
phrases.note: 可指承擔責任、僱人或帶有某種面貌

phrases.ex: The concert went on for three hours, but nobody wanted to leave.
phrases.exZh: 演唱會持續了三個小時，但沒有人想離開。
phrases.note: go on V-ing 是繼續做同一件事；go on to V 是接著做另一件

phrases.ex: Yesterday my mother ran into an old classmate at the night market.
phrases.exZh: 昨天我母親在夜市巧遇一位老同學。
phrases.note: 偶遇人時等於 meet by chance；也可指撞上東西
phrases.trap: ran into with an old classmate

phrases.ex: Do not throw away old clothes that other people can still wear.
phrases.exZh: 不要把別人還能穿的舊衣服丟掉。
phrases.note: 受詞可放中間或後面；也可指浪費機會

phrases.ex: Neighbors should cooperate with each other to keep the street clean.
phrases.exZh: 鄰居應該彼此合作，讓街道保持乾淨。
phrases.note: 名詞是 cooperation；也可寫作 co-operate

phrases.ex: My cousin spends most of his money on comic books.
phrases.exZh: 我的表哥大部分的錢都花在漫畫書上。
phrases.note: 用 on 接東西；接動作時用 (in) V-ing
phrases.trap: spends most of his money for

phrases.ex: My younger sister is good at drawing cartoon animals.
phrases.exZh: 我妹妹很會畫卡通動物。
phrases.note: at 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Many teenagers are interested in learning how to make short videos.
phrases.exZh: 許多青少年對學習如何製作短影片很感興趣。
phrases.note: 人當主詞用 interested；事物當主詞用 interesting

phrases.ex: Doctors are concerned about the amount of sugar in children's drinks.
phrases.exZh: 醫師擔心兒童飲料中的含糖量。
phrases.note: be concerned with 則表示「與…有關」

phrases.ex: Many volunteers were involved in cleaning the beach last weekend.
phrases.exZh: 上週末有許多志工參與了淨灘活動。
phrases.note: in 後接活動或 V-ing
phrases.trap: were involving in cleaning the beach

phrases.ex: The film is based on a true story about a lost dog.
phrases.exZh: 這部電影改編自一個關於走失小狗的真實故事。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 on，不用 in

phrases.ex: Young children are curious about everything around them.
phrases.exZh: 小孩子對周遭的一切都很好奇。
phrases.note: 也可接 wh- 子句：curious about why …

phrases.ex: An increase in the number of cars has made the city noisier.
phrases.exZh: 汽車數量增加，使這座城市變得更吵。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 in，不用 of；相反為 a decrease in

phrases.ex: Sunlight is a source of energy for almost every plant on Earth.
phrases.exZh: 陽光是地球上幾乎所有植物的能量來源。
phrases.note: of 後接所提供的東西，如 energy、information

phrases.ex: Not every child has easy access to clean water and good books.
phrases.exZh: 不是每個孩子都能輕易取得乾淨的水和好書。
phrases.note: 名詞，to 後接名詞或 V-ing；不可數

phrases.ex: Not everyone has a chance to study abroad during high school.
phrases.exZh: 不是每個人在高中時都有機會出國讀書。
phrases.note: 後面接 to V；也可說 have the chance to V
phrases.trap: has a chance to studying abroad

phrases.ex: Taking the express train can save time on the way to school.
phrases.exZh: 搭乘快車可以在上學途中節省時間。
phrases.note: 反義：waste time；time 前不加冠詞

phrases.ex: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not be afraid to try.
phrases.exZh: 每個人偶爾都會犯錯，所以別怕嘗試。
phrases.note: 動詞用 make，不用 do 或 have

phrases.ex: Starting a small business means you have to take a risk.
phrases.exZh: 創業就代表你得冒險。
phrases.note: 也可說 run a risk；risk 前用 a

phrases.ex: It started to rain, so he changed his mind about going hiking.
phrases.exZh: 開始下雨了，所以他改變主意，不去健行了。
phrases.note: 常接 about sth.；mind 用單數

phrases.ex: Most students today have access to a computer at home.
phrases.exZh: 現在大部分學生在家都能使用電腦。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；access 不可數

phrases.ex: A large number of birds gather at the lake in winter.
phrases.exZh: 冬天有大量的鳥聚集在這座湖。
phrases.note: 後接複數可數名詞，動詞用複數

phrases.phrase: be stuck in a traffic jam
phrases.ex: The bus was stuck in a traffic jam for almost an hour.
phrases.exZh: 公車在車陣中被困了將近一個小時。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 in；jam 是名詞
phrases.trap: was stuck in a traffic jams

phrases.ex: You should see a doctor if the cough lasts more than a week.
phrases.exZh: 如果咳嗽持續超過一週，你應該去看醫生。
phrases.note: 也可說 go to the doctor；不要說 look a doctor

phrases.ex: Teenagers need to get enough sleep to stay focused in class.
phrases.exZh: 青少年需要睡眠充足，上課才能保持專注。
phrases.note: enough 放在名詞前；sleep 不可數

phrases.ex: The museum was small, though every room had something interesting to see.
phrases.exZh: 那間博物館雖然不大，但每個展間都有值得一看的東西。
phrases.note: 可放句首或句中；句尾的 though 是口語副詞，意為「不過」

phrases.ex: Whether it rains or not, the school sports day will go ahead.
phrases.exZh: 不論下不下雨，學校運動會都會照常舉行。
phrases.note: 引導讓步子句；or not 可緊接 whether，也可放在子句後
phrases.trap: Whether does it rain or not,

phrases.ex: Most traffic jams result from too many private cars on the road.
phrases.exZh: 大多數塞車是因為路上的私家車太多。
phrases.note: 主詞是結果，from 後面接原因；不用被動語態
phrases.trap: result of too many private cars

phrases.ex: Sea levels are rising as a result of global warming.
phrases.exZh: 由於全球暖化，海平面正在上升。
phrases.note: 介系詞片語，後接名詞；與 as a result 用法不同

phrases.ex: Smartphones can be distracting in class, not to mention harmful to our eyes.
phrases.exZh: 手機在課堂上會使人分心，更不用說對眼睛有害了。
phrases.note: 後面接名詞或形容詞，補上更明顯的一點；語氣稍口語

phrases.ex: Apart from tests, students should be judged by their effort and attitude.
phrases.exZh: 除了考試以外，學生也應該依據努力與態度來評量。
phrases.note: 可表「除外」或「另外還有」，依上下文判斷；同 aside from

phrases.ex: Both parents and teachers should guide children in using the Internet wisely.
phrases.exZh: 父母和老師都應該引導孩子明智地使用網路。
phrases.note: 連接兩個對等的成分，主詞用複數動詞；不可寫成 both … or

phrases.ex: Since then, the number of visitors to the park has doubled.
phrases.exZh: 從那時以來，這座公園的遊客數量增加了一倍。
phrases.note: 常與現在完成式連用，說明某時間點之後的變化

phrases.ex: In today's society, a good command of English opens many doors for young people.
phrases.exZh: 在當今社會，英文能力好為年輕人開啟許多扇門。
phrases.note: 正式；點出時代背景，可換成 in modern society

phrases.ex: It is essential that every student get enough sleep during exam weeks.
phrases.exZh: 考試週期間，每位學生都必須睡得足夠。
phrases.note: that 子句用原形動詞（或 should + 原形），不加 s

phrases.phrase: it is time (for sb.) to V
phrases.ex: It is time for us to think about how we treat our planet.
phrases.exZh: 我們該想一想自己是怎麼對待地球的了。
phrases.note: 後接 to V；比 It is high time that 語氣平和
phrases.trap: It is time for us thinking about

phrases.phrase: it is up to sb. to V
phrases.ex: It is up to us to keep the neighborhood clean, not just the street cleaners.
phrases.exZh: 該由我們自己保持社區整潔，而不只是清潔隊員。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後面的 to V 是真正的動詞不定詞；強調個人責任
phrases.trap: It is up for us to keep

phrases.ex: Neighbors should work together to keep the community safe.
phrases.exZh: 鄰居們應該攜手合作，維護居住環境的安全。
phrases.note: 強調合作；也可寫 work together with sb. to V

phrases.ex: Take an umbrella with you in case it rains this afternoon.
phrases.exZh: 帶把傘以防今天下午下雨。
phrases.note: 表示預先準備，不是「如果」；子句用現在式表未來

phrases.phrase: if it were not for sth.
phrases.ex: If it were not for the internet, distance learning would be much harder.
phrases.exZh: 要不是有網路，遠距學習會困難得多。
phrases.note: 與現在事實相反；可倒裝成 Were it not for
phrases.trap: If it were not the internet,

phrases.ex: Some commuters would rather walk to work than sit in heavy traffic.
phrases.exZh: 有些通勤者寧可走路上班，也不願困在壅塞的車陣裡。
phrases.note: would rather 與 than 後面都接原形動詞
phrases.trap: would rather to walk to work than

phrases.zh: 喜歡 A 勝過 B
phrases.ex: Most teenagers prefer reading e-books to carrying heavy paper books.
phrases.exZh: 大多數青少年比較喜歡讀電子書，而不愛帶厚重的紙本書。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，A、B 用名詞或 V-ing，不接 than

phrases.ex: Modern life is far more convenient than it was fifty years ago.
phrases.exZh: 現代生活比五十年前方便得多。
phrases.note: far／much／even 可加強比較級，不能用 very

phrases.ex: Big cities are not as quiet as small villages.
phrases.exZh: 大城市不像小村莊那麼安靜。
phrases.note: 也可寫 not so … as；表示前者程度較低

phrases.ex: Air pollution poses a threat to the health of city residents.
phrases.exZh: 空氣污染對都市居民的健康構成威脅。
phrases.note: 較正式；threat 前可加 serious、great；to 後接名詞

phrases.ex: Washing hands often helps reduce the risk of catching a cold.
phrases.exZh: 經常洗手有助於降低感冒的風險。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；相反用 increase the risk of

phrases.ex: Not until the bell rang did the students stop talking.
phrases.exZh: 直到鈴聲響起，學生們才停止交談。
phrases.note: Not until 放句首，主要子句倒裝，動詞用肯定式
phrases.trap: Not until the bell rang didn't

phrases.ex: It is no wonder that the students were tired after such a long trip.
phrases.exZh: 經過這麼長的旅程，學生們會累也難怪。
phrases.note: that 後面接大家可理解的結果或現象

phrases.ex: Our house is close to the night market, so it can be noisy.
phrases.exZh: 我們家離夜市很近，所以有時會很吵。
phrases.note: 距離與關係皆可用；to 是介系詞
phrases.trap: is close from the night market,

phrases.ex: Many students wish they had more time to sleep in the morning.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生真希望能有更多早上睡覺的時間。
phrases.note: 與現在事實相反用過去式；與過去相反用 had p.p.

phrases.ex: The government must take measures to reduce air pollution in big cities.
phrases.exZh: 政府必須採取措施來減少大城市的空氣汙染。
phrases.note: measures 通常用複數；也可說 take steps to V

phrases.ex: Volunteering helps others and also teaches young people useful life skills.
phrases.exZh: 當志工能幫助別人，也能教年輕人實用的生活技能。
phrases.note: 放 be 動詞之後、一般動詞之前；不放句尾，句尾用 too
phrases.trap: and as well teaches young people

phrases.ex: The percentage of families owning a car has risen steadily over the past decade.
phrases.exZh: 過去十年來，擁有汽車的家庭百分比穩定上升。
phrases.note: 只談比例不談實際數量；用法近 proportion

phrases.ex: Heavy traffic is a burden on the city and on its people.
phrases.exZh: 擁擠的交通對這個城市和居民來說是個負擔。
phrases.note: on 之後接負擔的承受者；也可用 burden to

phrases.phrase: turn a blind eye to sth.
phrases.ex: Some drivers turn a blind eye to the rules and park wherever they like.
phrases.exZh: 有些駕駛人對規定視而不見，想停哪裡就停哪裡。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；帶批評意味，指明知有問題卻不理會

phrases.ex: Regular exercise helps build up your strength and confidence.
phrases.exZh: 規律運動有助於增強你的體力與自信。
phrases.note: 強調慢慢累積；受詞可放中間

phrases.ex: My brother often argues with me about who should wash the dishes.
phrases.exZh: 我哥哥常和我爭論該由誰洗碗。
phrases.note: 與人爭論用 with，爭論的事用 about／over

phrases.zh: 把 A 當作 B 對待
phrases.ex: Good friends treat each other as equals, not as rivals.
phrases.exZh: 好朋友把彼此當作平等的人來對待，而不是當作對手。
phrases.note: as 後接身分或角色；treat A to B 是請客

phrases.ex: The station is crowded with travelers during the holiday.
phrases.exZh: 假期期間，車站裡擠滿了旅客。
phrases.note: with 後接擠在其中的人或物

phrases.ex: The bus slid on the wet road and went out of control for a moment.
phrases.exZh: 公車在濕滑的路面上打滑，一度失控。
phrases.note: 常見 get/go out of control

phrases.ex: The ambulance arrived in time to save the injured cyclist.
phrases.exZh: 救護車及時趕到，救了受傷的腳踏車騎士。
phrases.note: 後常接 to V 或 for sth.；與 on time 不同

phrases.ex: Joining extracurricular activities helps students make friends and learn new skills.
phrases.exZh: 參加課外活動能幫助學生交朋友並學習新技能。
phrases.note: 通常用複數；形容詞 extracurricular 較長，注意拼字

phrases.ex: Please ask your friends before you post a photo of them online.
phrases.exZh: 在網路上張貼照片之前，如果照片裡有朋友，請先徵求他們同意。
phrases.note: 也可說 upload a photo；of 後接照片中的人
phrases.trap: before you post a photos of them

phrases.ex: Half of my classmates followed the herd and bought the same water bottle.
phrases.exZh: 班上一半的同學跟風買了同一款水壺。
phrases.note: 跟風帶貶義；中性的追流行是 follow the trend

phrases.ex: That social media influencer earns money by recommending books to teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 那位網紅靠向青少年推薦書籍賺錢。
phrases.note: 可簡稱 influencer；不要說 net red，那是中式直譯

phrases.ex: The dance video went viral overnight and made the students famous.
phrases.exZh: 那支舞蹈影片一夜爆紅，讓那些學生出了名。
phrases.note: 內容像病毒般被大量轉傳；人紅用 overnight sensation

phrases.ex: Children usually receive a red envelope with lucky money from their grandparents at the start of the new year.
phrases.exZh: 新年一開始，孩子通常會從爺爺奶奶那裡拿到裝著壓歲錢的紅包。
phrases.note: 不要直譯 red bag；可加 with lucky money 說明裡面是錢
phrases.trap: a red envelop with lucky money

phrases.ex: Everyone travels home to share a family reunion dinner on the last night of the lunar year.
phrases.exZh: 大家都會回家吃除夕這一天的團圓飯。
phrases.note: 團圓飯與年夜飯可通用；要交代是農曆年前夕才清楚
phrases.trap: to share a family reunited dinner

phrases.ex: Students who cram at the last minute often forget everything a few days after the test.
phrases.exZh: 臨時抱佛腳的學生常在考完幾天後就全忘了。
phrases.note: cram 是不及物，也可 cram for an exam
phrases.trap: Students who cram at last minute

phrases.ex: The train was about to leave when my brother finally ran onto the platform.
phrases.exZh: 火車正要開的時候，我弟弟終於跑上了月台。
phrases.note: 表馬上要發生；常接 when 子句，不與明確時間連用

phrases.ex: Keep in mind that the museum closes early on Mondays.
phrases.exZh: 請記住，博物館週一提早關門。
phrases.note: 也可寫 keep sth. in mind；同義 bear in mind

phrases.ex: The boy was absorbed in a science book and missed his bus stop.
phrases.exZh: 那個男孩專心看科學書，結果坐過站了。
phrases.note: 被動形式；常與 so … that 連用

phrases.ex: My new desk mate and I have a lot in common, including a love of drawing.
phrases.exZh: 我和新同桌有很多共同點，包括都喜歡畫畫。
phrases.note: 中間放 much、a lot、nothing 表程度

phrases.ex: Furthermore, online learning saves time for students who live far from school.
phrases.exZh: 此外，線上學習能替住得離學校很遠的學生節省時間。
phrases.note: 比 moreover 更正式；放句首，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: The driver apologized to the passengers for the long delay.
phrases.exZh: 司機為長時間的延誤向乘客道歉。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；向誰道歉用 to

phrases.ex: Ever since she was little, she has dreamed of becoming a pilot.
phrases.exZh: 她從小就夢想成為飛行員。
phrases.note: of 後接 V-ing 或名詞；也可用 dream about

phrases.ex: As time goes by, old customs slowly change or even disappear.
phrases.exZh: 隨著時間過去，舊習俗慢慢改變，甚至消失。
phrases.note: 放句首或句尾；描述長期的變化趨勢，動詞用現在式

phrases.ex: A short phone call from her friend really cheered her up.
phrases.exZh: 朋友的一通短短電話真的讓她振作了起來。
phrases.note: 可及物也可不及物；祈使句 Cheer up! 意思是「別難過」

phrases.ex: The team promised not to let their fans down this season.
phrases.exZh: 球隊承諾這個球季不會讓球迷失望。
phrases.note: 受詞放中間；代名詞一定放中間：let me down

phrases.ex: After the test was over, the students let out a sigh of relief.
phrases.exZh: 考試結束後，學生們都鬆了一口氣。
phrases.note: 常搭配 let out 或 heave；表示擔心解除

phrases.ex: The dress looks expensive in the photo, but in reality it costs very little.
phrases.exZh: 這件洋裝在照片裡看起來很貴，實際上卻很便宜。
phrases.note: 指與外表或想像不同的真實情況，可放句首加逗號或句中

phrases.ex: Older citizens deserve respect, and likewise, the young deserve to be heard.
phrases.exZh: 年長者值得被尊重，同樣地，年輕人也值得被傾聽。
phrases.note: 副詞，表示前後情況相同；正式，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: Similarly, schools in rural areas face a shortage of qualified teachers.
phrases.exZh: 同樣地，鄉下地區的學校也面臨合格師資不足的問題。
phrases.note: 放句首，承接前一個類似的例子，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: Take bicycle sharing for example: it reduces traffic and gives commuters a cheap, healthy choice.
phrases.exZh: 以共用腳踏車為例，它減少了交通量，也讓通勤者有便宜又健康的選擇。
phrases.note: for example 放在受詞後；後面常接冒號或另起一句說明

phrases.ex: Some foods are bad for health; sugary drinks in particular should be limited.
phrases.exZh: 有些食物對健康不好，尤其是含糖飲料應該少喝。
phrases.note: 置於被強調的名詞之後或句尾；比 especially 稍正式

phrases.ex: Reading is a good habit; indeed, it may be the best way to enlarge your vocabulary.
phrases.exZh: 閱讀是好習慣；的確，它可能是擴充字彙量的最佳方法。
phrases.note: 用來加強或補充前一句的看法，前面常有分號或句號

phrases.ex: First and foremost, a good leader must listen to other people's ideas.
phrases.exZh: 首要的是，好的領導者必須傾聽別人的想法。
phrases.note: 放句首，強調第一點也是最重要的一點

phrases.ex: The rice was cooking; meanwhile, Mom prepared some fresh soup.
phrases.exZh: 飯在煮的時候，媽媽同時準備了新鮮的湯。
phrases.note: 副詞，連接兩件同時進行的事；前面可用分號，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: Overall, most classmates enjoyed the science fair and hoped to join it again next year.
phrases.exZh: 整體而言，多數同學都很喜歡這場科展，也希望明年能再參加。
phrases.note: 單字副詞；放句首加逗號，也可修飾形容詞，如 the overall result

phrases.ex: In my view, printed books help young children concentrate better than short videos do.
phrases.exZh: 依我之見，紙本書比短影片更能幫助年幼的孩子專心。
phrases.note: 比 in my opinion 稍簡短；放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: Our school plans to start classes later, and I strongly agree with this idea.
phrases.exZh: 我們學校打算延後上課時間，我非常同意這個想法。
phrases.note: with 後接名詞或 the idea that 子句

phrases.ex: I would suggest that you write down new words in a small notebook.
phrases.exZh: 我會建議你把新單字寫在一本小筆記本裡。
phrases.note: 比 I suggest 委婉；suggest 後接 that 子句時動詞用原形

phrases.ex: To her delight, the shop still had one last cake on the shelf.
phrases.exZh: 令她高興的是，店裡的架上還剩最後一個蛋糕。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；one's 依主詞變化

phrases.ex: Before walking onto the stage, she took a deep breath and smiled.
phrases.exZh: 走上舞臺前，她深吸一口氣，然後微微一笑。
phrases.note: 名詞是 breath（不是 breathe）；常表示緊張時冷靜下來

phrases.ex: To be honest, I find group projects more useful than written tests.
phrases.exZh: 老實說，我覺得小組專題比紙筆測驗更有用。
phrases.note: 偏口語；放句首加逗號，正式作文少用

phrases.ex: Second, online tools make it easier for people to share their ideas.
phrases.exZh: 第二，網路工具讓人們更容易分享想法。
phrases.note: 放句首並加逗號；也可寫 secondly

phrases.ex: Wash the vegetables first, and then cut them into small pieces.
phrases.exZh: 先把蔬菜洗乾淨，然後切成小塊。
phrases.note: 副詞，連接動作先後；連接兩個子句時前面要用逗號加連接詞或分號

phrases.ex: After that, the whole class walked to the science museum together.
phrases.exZh: 在那之後，全班一起走路去科學博物館。
phrases.note: 放句首，後面常加逗號；that 指前面提到的事

phrases.ex: After dinner, the children helped to put away the dishes.
phrases.exZh: 晚餐後，孩子們幫忙把碗盤收好。
phrases.note: 代名詞受詞要放中間：put them away
phrases.trap: to put them away the dishes.

phrases.ex: The boy thanked me for helping him find his lost bag.
phrases.exZh: 那個男孩謝謝我幫他找到遺失的書包。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；感謝的對象是人

phrases.ex: The room was filled with the smell of fresh bread.
phrases.exZh: 房間裡充滿了新鮮麵包的香味。
phrases.note: with 後接內容物；也可指情緒

phrases.ex: The players were disappointed with the result of the game.
phrases.exZh: 球員們對比賽結果感到失望。
phrases.note: 也可用 at 或 in；令人失望的事物用 disappointing

phrases.ex: Most students feel nervous about speaking in front of a large crowd.
phrases.exZh: 大部分學生在許多人面前說話會覺得緊張。
phrases.note: about 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: I bought a sandwich on the way to the train station.
phrases.exZh: 我在去火車站的路上買了一個三明治。
phrases.note: to 後接地點；地點若是 home、there 則省略 to

phrases.ex: The tourists stopped on the bridge to take a photo of the sunset.
phrases.exZh: 遊客們停在橋上，為夕陽拍了一張照片。
phrases.note: 也可說 take a picture；拍某物用 of

phrases.ex: Whoever cooks dinner does not have to do the dishes afterward.
phrases.exZh: 誰煮晚餐，之後就不必洗碗。
phrases.note: dishes 用複數；也可說 wash the dishes

phrases.ex: Whatever the result is, just do your best and be proud of it.
phrases.exZh: 不論結果如何，只要盡力就好，並為此感到驕傲。
phrases.note: one's 隨主詞變化；不加 to

phrases.ex: When a scholarship was offered, he seized the opportunity to study abroad.
phrases.exZh: 獎學金一提供，他就抓住機會出國讀書。
phrases.note: 後接 to V；也可說 take the opportunity

phrases.ex: To some extent, social media has changed the way teens talk.
phrases.exZh: 在某種程度上，社群媒體改變了青少年交談的方式。
phrases.note: 表示部分成立，語氣保留；some 可換 a large

phrases.ex: Tourists can easily get lost in the old streets without a map.
phrases.exZh: 遊客如果沒有地圖，很容易在老街裡迷路。
phrases.note: 單獨說 Get lost! 是叫人走開，很不禮貌

phrases.ex: Students who study a little every day usually get good grades on exams.
phrases.exZh: 每天讀一點書的學生，考試通常都能拿到好成績。
phrases.note: grades 常用複數；也可說 get a good grade in 科目

phrases.phrase: be easy to get along with
phrases.ex: Our new classmate is easy to get along with, so everyone likes working with him.
phrases.exZh: 新同學很隨和，所以大家都喜歡跟他一組。
phrases.note: easygoing 也可，但偏指不計較；此說法強調相處愉快

phrases.phrase: be at a loss for words
phrases.ex: The teacher was at a loss for words when she saw how much the class had improved.
phrases.exZh: 老師看到全班進步這麼多，簡直傻眼，說不出話來。
phrases.note: 驚訝到說不出話，正負面皆可；傻眼帶負面時可加上下文
phrases.trap: was at a loss of words

phrases.ex: Take an umbrella with you, since it is better safe than sorry.
phrases.exZh: 帶把傘吧，有備無患。
phrases.note: 諺語，常單獨成句；指小心預防比事後後悔好

phrases.ex: By morning, the hills were covered with a thick layer of snow.
phrases.exZh: 到了早上，山丘都覆蓋著厚厚一層雪。
phrases.note: 也可用 covered in；主詞是被覆蓋的東西

phrases.phrase: make it possible for sb. to V
phrases.ex: Online classes make it possible for sick students to keep learning at home.
phrases.exZh: 線上課程讓生病的學生也能在家繼續學習。
phrases.note: it 是虛受詞；possible 不可用人當主詞
phrases.trap: make possible for sick students to

phrases.ex: Your poor sleep may have something to do with using your phone late at night.
phrases.exZh: 你睡不好可能跟深夜滑手機有關。
phrases.note: 無關說 have nothing to do with
phrases.trap: may have something to do of

phrases.ex: This bridge is longer than any other bridge in the country.
phrases.exZh: 這座橋比國內其他任何一座橋都長。
phrases.note: 前接比較級；other 後接單數名詞

phrases.ex: Many young people can't afford to buy a house in big cities.
phrases.exZh: 許多年輕人負擔不起在大城市買房子。
phrases.note: 也可接名詞；也指承受不起後果

phrases.ex: She worked hard so that she could get into a good high school.
phrases.exZh: 她很用功，好讓自己能考上一所好高中。
phrases.note: 可接學校、麻煩、習慣等
phrases.trap: getting into a good high school.

phrases.ex: It is hard not to give in to the smell of fresh bread.
phrases.exZh: 很難不屈服於剛出爐麵包的香味。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: He made up a story about his dog to explain why he was late.
phrases.exZh: 他編了一個關於他的狗的故事，來解釋為什麼遲到。
phrases.note: 編造義可拆開用：make a story up
phrases.trap: He made up of a story

phrases.ex: Firefighters worked for hours to put out the fire in the old warehouse.
phrases.exZh: 消防員花了好幾個小時，才撲滅那座舊倉庫的大火。
phrases.note: 可拆開：put the fire out

phrases.ex: The teacher's funny joke set off a wave of laughter across the classroom.
phrases.exZh: 老師好笑的笑話引起全班一陣哄堂大笑。
phrases.note: 出發義不接受詞；觸發警報等則需受詞
phrases.trap: sat off a wave of laughter

phrases.ex: Try to set aside thirty minutes each day for quiet reading.
phrases.exZh: 試著每天留出三十分鐘安靜閱讀。
phrases.note: 可指留下時間、金錢，或把歧見擱置

phrases.ex: She was brought up by her grandparents in a small town.
phrases.exZh: 她在一個小鎮由祖父母養大。
phrases.note: 養育義常用被動；提起話題也可用此
phrases.trap: was bring up by her grandparents

phrases.ex: It is unkind to look down on people just because they are poor.
phrases.exZh: 只因為別人貧窮就瞧不起他們是不友善的。
phrases.note: 三個字不可拆開；帶貶義

phrases.ex: He turned down the job offer because the office was too far from home.
phrases.exZh: 他拒絕了那份工作，因為辦公室離家太遠。
phrases.note: 也可指把音量調低；受詞為代名詞時放中間
phrases.trap: turned it down the job offer

phrases.ex: My dad always reminds us to turn off the computer when we finish using it.
phrases.exZh: 爸爸總是提醒我們，電腦用完要關機。
phrases.note: 反義是 turn on；受詞為代名詞時放中間

phrases.ex: I came across an old letter while cleaning my desk yesterday.
phrases.exZh: 我昨天整理書桌時無意中發現一封舊信。
phrases.note: 指意外遇到，不是刻意尋找；不可用被動

phrases.ex: Her grandfather passed away peacefully in his sleep last winter.
phrases.exZh: 她的祖父去年冬天在睡夢中安詳地離世了。
phrases.note: 委婉說法，比 die 婉轉；不用被動

phrases.ex: The school called off the sports day because of the typhoon.
phrases.exZh: 學校因為颱風取消了運動會。
phrases.note: 受詞是代名詞時要放中間：call it off
phrases.trap: called it off the sports day

phrases.ex: This difficult problem calls for careful thought and patience.
phrases.exZh: 這個困難的問題需要仔細思考和耐心。
phrases.note: 主詞多為事物；也可表示公開呼籲

phrases.ex: Even after failing twice, he kept on practicing the piano every day.
phrases.exZh: 即使失敗了兩次，他仍然每天持續練習鋼琴。
phrases.note: 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V；帶有不放棄的語氣

phrases.ex: Doctors advise children to keep away from too many sugary drinks.
phrases.exZh: 醫師建議孩子少碰過多含糖飲料。
phrases.note: from 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Please pass on the good news to your classmates.
phrases.exZh: 請把這個好消息轉告你的同學。
phrases.note: 也可指把病菌或特質傳給他人；受詞是代名詞放中間
phrases.trap: pass it on the good news

phrases.ex: Our bus broke down on the way to the mountain.
phrases.exZh: 我們的公車在前往山上的途中拋錨了。
phrases.note: 不及物，機器或車輛故障最常用

phrases.ex: The two brothers worked out a plan to clean the garage.
phrases.exZh: 這兩兄弟想出了一個打掃車庫的計畫。
phrases.note: 可及物（想出）或不及物（運動、順利）

phrases.ex: A fire broke out in the kitchen late at night.
phrases.exZh: 深夜廚房裡突然起火。
phrases.note: 不及物，主詞多為火災、戰爭、疾病
phrases.trap: was broken out in the kitchen

phrases.ex: Her bright yellow raincoat made her stand out in the crowd.
phrases.exZh: 她亮黃色的雨衣讓她在人群中特別顯眼。
phrases.note: 不及物；可接 from 表示與誰不同

phrases.ex: A good friend will always stand up for you.
phrases.exZh: 好朋友總是會為你挺身而出。
phrases.note: 與 stand up to（面對強者）不同

phrases.ex: The class is working on a science project this week.
phrases.exZh: 這個班級這週正在做一項科學專題。
phrases.note: on 後面接進行中的工作或待改進的事
phrases.trap: is work on a science project

phrases.ex: Because of budget cutbacks, the company had to cut back on travel costs this year.
phrases.exZh: 因為預算縮減，公司今年不得不削減差旅費用。
phrases.note: 與 cut down on 相近，較常用於經費
phrases.trap: cut back to travel costs this year.

phrases.ex: The team's score fell short of the coach's goal.
phrases.exZh: 這支隊伍的得分未達到教練設定的目標。
phrases.note: of 後接期望、目標或標準

phrases.ex: She studied hard over the summer to catch up with her classmates.
phrases.exZh: 她暑假很用功，想趕上同學的進度。
phrases.note: 三個字都不能省；只說 catch up 是不及物

phrases.ex: Some students often complain about the amount of homework.
phrases.exZh: 有些學生常常抱怨作業太多。
phrases.note: 向某人抱怨用 complain to sb. about sth.

phrases.ex: It took her a while to cope with the heavy schedule.
phrases.exZh: 她花了一段時間才應付得來繁重的行程。
phrases.note: 多用於困難或壓力，帶有「勉強應付」之意

phrases.ex: New students soon adjust to the rules of the dormitory.
phrases.exZh: 新生很快就適應了宿舍的規定。
phrases.note: 與 adapt to 相近，adjust 偏「稍作調整」

phrases.ex: Students may apply for a library card at the front desk.
phrases.exZh: 學生可以在櫃檯申請借書證。
phrases.note: 申請的事物前用 for；向某單位申請用 apply to
phrases.trap: may apply to a library card

phrases.ex: It took the old man two weeks to recover from the flu.
phrases.exZh: 那位老先生花了兩週才從流感中康復。
phrases.note: from 後接疾病、傷痛或打擊

phrases.ex: Teenagers who engage in sports usually sleep better.
phrases.exZh: 從事運動的青少年通常睡得比較好。
phrases.note: 比 do 正式；in 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Wearing a helmet can keep you from getting badly hurt in a fall.
phrases.exZh: 戴安全帽可以避免你在跌倒時受重傷。
phrases.note: 與 prevent、stop 用法相同，語氣較口語

phrases.ex: The loud noise could not stop her from finishing the test.
phrases.exZh: 吵雜的聲音沒能阻止她完成考試。
phrases.note: from 常被誤刪；stop V-ing 則是「停止做」

phrases.ex: The little girl insisted on wearing her yellow raincoat to school.
phrases.exZh: 小女孩堅持要穿她的黃色雨衣去上學。
phrases.note: on 後接 V-ing 或名詞，不接 to V

phrases.ex: Because the roads are icy, my dad would rather stay home today.
phrases.exZh: 因為路面結冰，我爸爸今天寧願待在家裡。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞；否定放 rather 後面：would rather not V
phrases.trap: would rather to stay home today.

phrases.ex: This old photo reminds me of the happy summers at my grandma's house.
phrases.exZh: 這張舊照片讓我想起在外婆家度過的快樂夏天。
phrases.note: of 後接被想起的事；提醒做事用 remind sb. to V

phrases.ex: After a long talk, she persuaded her parents to buy a puppy.
phrases.exZh: 經過一番長談，她說服父母買了一隻小狗。
phrases.note: 成功說服才用 persuade；試圖說服用 try to persuade

phrases.ex: Yesterday's heavy storm forced the players to leave the field.
phrases.exZh: 昨天的大風暴迫使球員離開球場。
phrases.note: 後接 to V；被動 be forced to V 也很常見

phrases.ex: The school plans to replace the old desks with new ones this summer.
phrases.exZh: 學校計畫今年暑假把舊課桌換成新的。
phrases.note: 被取代的是 A，新的是 B；別把順序弄反
phrases.trap: to replace the old desks to new ones

phrases.ex: For thirty years, the doctor devoted herself to helping patients in remote villages.
phrases.exZh: 三十年來，那位醫生致力於幫助偏遠村莊的病人。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing 或名詞

phrases.ex: Her idea for the poster is similar to mine, but the colors are different.
phrases.exZh: 她的海報構想和我的很像，但顏色不同。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 to，不用 with

phrases.ex: Bus drivers are familiar with every corner of the city.
phrases.exZh: 公車司機對城市的每個角落都很熟悉。
phrases.note: 主詞是人；若說 sth. is familiar to sb. 則主詞是事物

phrases.ex: A young child is capable of learning two languages at the same time.
phrases.exZh: 小孩子有能力同時學會兩種語言。
phrases.note: of 後接 V-ing 或名詞，不接 to V

phrases.ex: The customer was satisfied with the quality of the new headphones.
phrases.exZh: 顧客對新耳機的品質很滿意。
phrases.note: with 後接滿意的對象

phrases.ex: Newborn babies are dependent on their parents in every way.
phrases.exZh: 新生兒在各方面都得依賴父母。
phrases.note: 反義：be independent of；動詞為 depend on

phrases.ex: This movie isn't suitable for children under ten.
phrases.exZh: 這部電影不適合十歲以下的兒童。
phrases.note: for 後接對象或用途；近義：be fit for

phrases.ex: The doctor is devoted to caring for patients in remote villages.
phrases.exZh: 這位醫師一心照顧偏遠村莊的病患。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing

phrases.ex: Most students in our class are in favor of a shorter summer homework list.
phrases.exZh: 我們班上大多數同學贊成縮短暑假作業清單。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；英式拼法為 favour

phrases.ex: Grandpa gave up salty snacks for the sake of his health.
phrases.exZh: 爺爺為了健康，戒掉了鹹的零食。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞，表示為了某人或某事的利益

phrases.ex: This old bridge is in need of repair before the rainy season begins.
phrases.exZh: 這座舊橋在雨季開始前需要修繕。
phrases.note: 常用 be in need of sth.；比 need 正式

phrases.ex: It is polite to keep your voice low when talking on the phone in public.
phrases.exZh: 在公共場合講電話時，把音量放低是有禮貌的。
phrases.note: 相反為 in private

phrases.ex: Regular exercise and a balanced diet help many people lose weight safely.
phrases.exZh: 規律運動與均衡飲食能幫助許多人安全地減重。
phrases.note: 反義：gain weight；weight 不可數

phrases.ex: His explanation was so clear that the whole problem finally made sense.
phrases.exZh: 他的解釋非常清楚，整個問題終於說得通了。
phrases.note: 主詞是事物；口語常用 That makes sense.

phrases.ex: No wonder the streets are empty, since it has been raining heavily all day.
phrases.exZh: 難怪街上都沒人，因為雨已經下了一整天。
phrases.note: 後面接完整子句，表示終於明白原因

phrases.ex: The morning train left exactly on time, so several passengers missed it.
phrases.exZh: 早班火車準時開出，所以有幾位乘客沒趕上。
phrases.note: 指按預定時間；與 in time（及時）不同

phrases.ex: My grandmother visits the night market from time to time.
phrases.exZh: 奶奶偶爾會去逛夜市。
phrases.note: 表示偶爾發生，可放句首、句中或句尾

phrases.ex: This exam is by no means easy, so prepare carefully.
phrases.exZh: 這次考試絕對不簡單，所以要仔細準備。
phrases.note: 語氣強烈；放句首時主詞與助動詞倒裝

phrases.ex: You must book the tickets a week in advance.
phrases.exZh: 你必須提前一週訂票。
phrases.note: 常接在時間量詞之後

phrases.ex: Little by little, he learned to speak in front of people.
phrases.exZh: 他漸漸學會在眾人面前說話。
phrases.note: 與 gradually 相近，較口語

phrases.ex: By the time the bell rang, most students had finished the quiz.
phrases.exZh: 等到鈴聲響起時，大多數學生已經寫完小考了。
phrases.note: 後接子句；主句常用完成式
phrases.trap: By the times the bell rang,

phrases.ex: So far, this term has been busier than I expected.
phrases.exZh: 到目前為止，這學期比我預期的更忙。
phrases.note: 常與現在完成式連用

phrases.ex: Ever since the storm, the old bridge has been closed.
phrases.exZh: 自從那場暴風雨後，那座老橋就一直封閉著。
phrases.note: 常與現在完成式連用；可單獨當副詞

phrases.ex: There is plenty of time, so please do not run.
phrases.exZh: 時間很充裕，所以請不要用跑的。
phrases.note: 可接不可數名詞或複數名詞，多用於肯定句

phrases.ex: The majority of my classmates walk to school every morning.
phrases.exZh: 我的同學大多數每天早上走路上學。
phrases.note: 後接複數名詞時，動詞多用複數

phrases.ex: As many as two hundred people joined the beach clean-up last Sunday.
phrases.exZh: 上週日多達兩百人參加了淨灘活動。
phrases.note: 強調數量之多，後接可數名詞的數字
phrases.trap: As much as two hundred people

phrases.ex: My bag looks exactly the same as yours.
phrases.exZh: 我的包包看起來和你的一模一樣。
phrases.note: the same 前面一定要有 the，後接 as

phrases.ex: The taste of this fruit is similar to that of a peach.
phrases.exZh: 這種水果的味道和水蜜桃相似。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 to，不是 with

phrases.ex: A series of small earthquakes, one after another, shook the island last night.
phrases.exZh: 昨晚一連串的小地震接二連三地搖晃這座島。
phrases.note: 後接複數名詞；series 單複數同形

phrases.ex: Factories use a large amount of water every day.
phrases.exZh: 工廠每天使用大量的水。
phrases.note: 後接不可數名詞，可數名詞要改用 a large number of

phrases.ex: He drank half of the juice and gave the rest of it to his sister.
phrases.exZh: 他喝了一半的果汁，把剩下的給了妹妹。
phrases.note: 動詞單複數依後面的名詞決定

phrases.ex: Less and less rain falls in this region every year.
phrases.exZh: 這個地區每年的降雨越來越少。
phrases.note: 接不可數名詞；接可數名詞用 fewer and fewer

phrases.ex: Fewer and fewer young people read printed newspapers these days.
phrases.exZh: 現在看紙本報紙的年輕人越來越少。
phrases.note: 後接複數可數名詞

phrases.ex: Hundreds of lanterns floated into the sky during the festival.
phrases.exZh: 慶典期間，數以百計的燈籠飄向天空。
phrases.note: 泛指大約數量；確切數字用 two hundred，不加 s 和 of

phrases.ex: Please make a reservation early, because the restaurant is always full on weekends.
phrases.exZh: 請早點訂位，因為那家餐廳週末總是客滿。
phrases.note: 後面常接 for＋人數／時間；訂餐廳也可說 book a table

phrases.ex: Her doctor advised her to go on a diet and eat fewer sweets.
phrases.exZh: 醫生建議她節食，少吃甜食。
phrases.note: be on a diet 表示正在節食的狀態

phrases.ex: Teenagers often surf the Internet for hours after finishing their homework.
phrases.exZh: 青少年寫完功課後常常上網好幾個小時。
phrases.note: 也可說 browse the web；Internet 常大寫

phrases.ex: More and more people shop online because it saves time and offers more choices.
phrases.exZh: 越來越多人在網路上購物，因為省時又有更多選擇。
phrases.note: shop 在此是不及物動詞，不接 in the Internet

phrases.ex: The MRT is crowded during rush hour, so many workers leave home early.
phrases.exZh: 捷運在尖峰時段很擁擠，所以許多上班族提早出門。
phrases.note: 常與 during 或 in 連用，如 during rush hour

phrases.ex: Everyone should obey traffic rules to keep the roads safe for children.
phrases.exZh: 每個人都應遵守交通規則，讓孩子在路上更安全。
phrases.note: obey、follow 後面直接接規則，不加 to

phrases.ex: Junk food is tasty, but eating too much of it is bad for you.
phrases.exZh: 垃圾食物很好吃，但吃太多對身體不好。
phrases.note: 不可數名詞，不加 a

phrases.ex: Whatever difficulties you meet, never stop trying to improve yourself.
phrases.exZh: 不論遇到什麼困難，都不要停止努力提升自己。
phrases.note: 等於 no matter what，後面可直接接名詞

phrases.ex: The club welcomes new members regardless of their age or experience.
phrases.exZh: 這個社團歡迎新成員加入，不論年齡或經驗。
phrases.note: 介系詞，後接名詞；regardless 後面要有 of

phrases.ex: Now that summer vacation has started, students can finally stay up late.
phrases.exZh: 既然暑假開始了，學生終於可以熬夜了。
phrases.note: 連接詞，引導子句，表示已成立的事實作為原因
phrases.trap: Now what summer vacation has started,

phrases.ex: The success of the project is attributed to good teamwork.
phrases.exZh: 這個計畫的成功歸功於良好的團隊合作。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；主動為 attribute A to B

phrases.ex: Along with the rise in prices, the demand for cheap food has grown.
phrases.exZh: 隨著物價上漲，人們對平價食物的需求也增加了。
phrases.note: 介系詞片語，後接名詞；放句首時後面加逗號
phrases.trap: Along to the rise in prices,

phrases.ex: Neither the price nor the location of the hotel pleased the travelers.
phrases.exZh: 這間旅館的價格和地點都沒有讓旅客滿意。
phrases.note: 動詞與靠近的名詞一致；本身已是否定，不可再加 not
phrases.trap: Neither the price or the location

phrases.ex: Students can either join a club or take an extra course after school.
phrases.exZh: 學生放學後可以參加社團，或是再修一門課。
phrases.note: 連接兩個對等的選項，動詞與靠近的名詞一致
phrases.trap: either join a club nor take an extra course

phrases.ex: Many teens cannot cook a simple meal, let alone prepare a whole dinner.
phrases.exZh: 許多青少年連簡單的一餐都不會煮，更別說準備一整頓晚餐了。
phrases.note: 用在否定句後，補上程度更高的事；不可用於肯定句

phrases.ex: The new bus route is particularly helpful for older residents who cannot walk long distances.
phrases.exZh: 新的公車路線對無法長途步行的年長居民特別有幫助。
phrases.note: 副詞，修飾形容詞或後面的片語；語氣比 very 更具體

phrases.ex: Once you learn the basic rules, the game becomes very easy.
phrases.exZh: 一旦你學會基本規則，這個遊戲就變得很簡單。
phrases.note: 連接詞，引導條件或時間子句；未來的事用現在式
phrases.trap: Once you will learn the basic rules,

phrases.ex: These days, students can find almost any answer online within seconds.
phrases.exZh: 現在學生幾秒鐘內就能在網路上找到幾乎任何答案。
phrases.note: 比 nowadays 口語；後面加逗號，多用現在式

phrases.ex: With the rapid advance of science, people now live much longer than before.
phrases.exZh: 隨著科學的快速進步，人們現在的壽命比以前長得多。
phrases.note: 句首用；主要子句不可再用 with 開頭
phrases.trap: With the rapid advanced of science,

phrases.ex: As far as public transport is concerned, our city has made great progress.
phrases.exZh: 就大眾運輸而言，我們的城市已有很大的進步。
phrases.note: 中間放名詞；主要子句前要加逗號
phrases.trap: As far as public transport is concerning,

phrases.ex: Over the past few decades, the number of cars on our roads has risen sharply.
phrases.exZh: 過去幾十年來，我們道路上的汽車數量急遽上升。
phrases.note: 句子多用現在完成式，不用過去式

phrases.ex: It is widely believed that reading books helps children develop a rich imagination.
phrases.exZh: 一般認為閱讀能幫助孩子培養豐富的想像力。
phrases.note: 常先陳述普遍看法，再用 however 轉折提出己見

phrases.ex: In the age of social media, it is easy to share news with friends instantly.
phrases.exZh: 在社群媒體的時代，要即時與朋友分享訊息很容易。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞，如 in the age of the Internet
phrases.trap: In the age for social media,

phrases.ex: Online safety has become a hot topic among parents and teachers.
phrases.exZh: 網路安全在家長與老師之間已成為熱門話題。
phrases.note: 常用現在完成式；可接 among 或 in 表示範圍

phrases.ex: According to a recent survey, most teenagers sleep less than they need.
phrases.exZh: 根據最近的一項調查，大多數青少年的睡眠比所需的少。
phrases.note: 放句首引出數據或現象；後面加逗號

phrases.ex: It is high time that the city built more safe bike lanes for students.
phrases.exZh: 這座城市早該為學生多建一些安全的腳踏車道了。
phrases.note: that 子句用過去式（表示早該做了）；語氣強烈，用於呼籲
phrases.trap: It is high time for that

phrases.ex: The school will spare no effort to keep every student safe on campus.
phrases.exZh: 學校將不遺餘力地確保每位學生在校園裡的安全。
phrases.note: 正式、書面；也可寫 spare no effort in V-ing

phrases.ex: Students are encouraged to join clubs and try new activities.
phrases.exZh: 學校鼓勵學生參加社團並嘗試新活動。
phrases.note: 被動式；後接 to V，公告與作文中都常見

phrases.ex: Doctors urge teenagers to limit their daily screen time.
phrases.exZh: 醫師力勸青少年限制每天看螢幕的時間。
phrases.note: 語氣比 advise 強；後接 sb. + to V

phrases.phrase: it would be better to V
phrases.ex: It would be better to walk to school than to ask parents for a ride.
phrases.exZh: 與其請父母載你，走路上學會比較好。
phrases.note: 語氣委婉的建議；比較時用 than 接同型態的 to V
phrases.trap: It would be better to walking to school

phrases.phrase: set a good example for sb.
phrases.ex: Adults should set a good example for children by obeying traffic rules.
phrases.exZh: 大人應該遵守交通規則，為孩子樹立好榜樣。
phrases.note: example 前用 a；也可寫 set an example
phrases.trap: set a good example of children

phrases.ex: In case of fire, please leave the building by the stairs.
phrases.exZh: 如遇火災，請走樓梯離開大樓。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞，不接子句；常見於公告與規定

phrases.ex: Please speak quietly so as not to disturb other readers in the library.
phrases.exZh: 請小聲說話，以免打擾圖書館裡的其他讀者。
phrases.note: 否定的目的用法，not 放在 to 前面；不說 so as to not

phrases.ex: For students preparing for exams, nothing is more precious than time.
phrases.exZh: 對準備考試的學生來說，沒有什麼比時間更寶貴。
phrases.note: 用比較級表達最高級的意思，語氣強烈

phrases.ex: The weather often has an effect on how people feel.
phrases.exZh: 天氣常常會影響人們的心情。
phrases.note: effect 為名詞；動詞 affect 直接接受詞，不加 on

phrases.ex: Plastic bags left on the beach often do harm to sea animals.
phrases.exZh: 遺留在海灘上的塑膠袋常常對海洋動物造成傷害。
phrases.note: harm 前可加 great、much；不可說 do harm for

phrases.ex: Students should make full use of their time in the library.
phrases.exZh: 學生應該充分利用待在圖書館的時間。
phrases.note: use 為不可數名詞，前面不加 a；語氣正面

phrases.ex: Some students improve their scores at the expense of their sleep.
phrases.exZh: 有些學生犧牲睡眠來提高成績。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；多用於說明代價

phrases.ex: Sitting too long can increase the risk of back pain.
phrases.exZh: 坐太久會提高背痛的風險。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；相反為 reduce the risk of

phrases.ex: Talking openly is the best way to reduce the generation gap at home.
phrases.exZh: 坦誠溝通是縮小家中代溝的最好方法。
phrases.note: 固定用法，前面加 the；常搭配 bridge、narrow、reduce

phrases.phrase: the gap between the rich and the poor
phrases.ex: Education can help narrow the gap between the rich and the poor.
phrases.exZh: 教育有助於縮小貧富差距。
phrases.note: 常搭配 widen、narrow；the rich 指「有錢人」，是複數概念
phrases.trap: the gap among the rich and the poor.

phrases.ex: Schools must keep pace with rapid changes in technology.
phrases.exZh: 學校必須跟上科技的快速變化。
phrases.note: with 後接名詞；也可寫 keep up with，前者較書面

phrases.ex: Experts hope to inform the general public about the dangers of fake news.
phrases.exZh: 專家希望讓一般大眾明白假新聞的危害。
phrases.note: the public 的較完整說法；視為集合名詞，動詞可單可複

phrases.phrase: There is no need to V
phrases.ex: There is no need to buy a new phone when your old one still works.
phrases.exZh: 舊手機還能用的時候，沒必要買新的。
phrases.note: 語氣中性，意思同 need not V

phrases.ex: Only when we lose something do we realize how valuable it was.
phrases.exZh: 只有在失去某樣東西時，我們才明白它有多珍貴。
phrases.note: 放句首時，主要子句的助動詞與主詞要倒裝
phrases.trap: Only when do we lose something

phrases.phrase: It is … of sb. to V
phrases.ex: It was kind of the neighbor to water our plants while we were away.
phrases.exZh: 鄰居人真好，在我們出遠門時幫忙澆花。
phrases.note: 形容詞描述人的品性（kind、wise）時用 of
phrases.trap: It was kind for the neighbor to

phrases.ex: Whether it rains or not, the school sports day will go on as planned.
phrases.exZh: 不論下不下雨，校慶運動會都會照原訂計畫舉行。
phrases.note: 可引導讓步副詞子句，也可引導名詞子句

phrases.phrase: It will not be long before …
phrases.ex: It will not be long before electric cars become a common sight on our roads.
phrases.exZh: 不久之後，電動車就會成為我們路上的常見景象。
phrases.note: before 子句用現在式表示未來

phrases.ex: The little boy was looking for his lost umbrella in the classroom.
phrases.exZh: 小男孩正在教室裡找他遺失的雨傘。
phrases.note: 強調「尋找」的動作；找到了要用 find

phrases.ex: The result is far from perfect, but the team did its best.
phrases.exZh: 結果遠稱不上完美，但團隊已盡了全力。
phrases.note: far from 後接形容詞，表示「絕不」

phrases.ex: Children who skip breakfast may be at risk of feeling tired all morning.
phrases.exZh: 不吃早餐的孩子整個早上可能都容易覺得疲倦。
phrases.note: 常用 be at risk of sth./V-ing

phrases.ex: Some museums let visitors in for free on the first Sunday of each month.
phrases.exZh: 有些博物館在每月第一個星期日讓遊客免費入場。
phrases.note: 口語；正式一點可說 free of charge

phrases.ex: Last weekend, we paid a visit to our grandparents in the countryside.
phrases.exZh: 上週末，我們去鄉下拜訪了祖父母。
phrases.note: to 後接人或地點；較正式，口語常說 visit

phrases.ex: In comparison with paper books, e-books are lighter and easier to carry around.
phrases.exZh: 和紙本書相比，電子書更輕，也更方便攜帶。
phrases.note: with 後接名詞；可放句首或句尾，也可用 to

phrases.ex: Teenagers need enough sleep, and they should eat a good breakfast as well.
phrases.exZh: 青少年需要充足的睡眠，也應該吃一頓豐盛的早餐。
phrases.note: 副詞，放句尾；語氣比 also 口語，與 too 相近

phrases.ex: In the case of rare animals, even a small change in habitat can be dangerous.
phrases.exZh: 就稀有動物而言，即使棲息地只有一點小改變也可能造成危險。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；用來把討論範圍限縮到特定對象，放句首後加逗號
phrases.trap: On the case of rare animals,

phrases.ex: The old bridge is said to be more than two hundred years old.
phrases.exZh: 據說這座老橋已有兩百多年的歷史。
phrases.note: 被動語態；to 後接原形，指過去用 to have p.p.

phrases.ex: She was so absorbed in her painting that she lost track of time.
phrases.exZh: 她太專注於畫畫，結果忘了時間。
phrases.note: time 前不加 the；常搭配 so … that … 句型
phrases.trap: that she lost track with time.

phrases.ex: It occurred to me that I had forgotten to lock the door.
phrases.exZh: 我突然想到自己忘了鎖門。
phrases.note: 主詞是 it，想到的人放 to 後；不能用人當主詞

phrases.ex: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out of the classroom.
phrases.exZh: 鈴聲一響，學生們就衝出了教室。
phrases.note: No sooner 放句首要倒裝，前句用過去完成式，後接 than
phrases.trap: No sooner had the bell rung when

phrases.ex: The teacher, together with her students, cleaned up the beach last weekend.
phrases.exZh: 老師連同她的學生們，上週末把海灘打掃乾淨了。
phrases.note: 接在主詞後時，動詞仍與原主詞一致，前後常加逗號

phrases.phrase: in many parts of the world
phrases.ex: In many parts of the world, clean drinking water is still hard to find.
phrases.exZh: 在世界許多地方，乾淨的飲用水仍然很難取得。
phrases.note: 用於談全球性議題；後面加逗號
phrases.trap: In many part of the world,

phrases.ex: In the eyes of many parents, good grades are the most important sign of success.
phrases.exZh: 在許多家長眼中，好成績是成功最重要的標誌。
phrases.note: of 後接人；表示某群人的看法，較有變化感
phrases.trap: On the eyes of many parents,

phrases.phrase: the gap between A and B
phrases.zh: A 與 B 之間的差距
phrases.ex: The gap between boys and girls in reading time has become smaller.
phrases.exZh: 男孩與女孩在閱讀時間上的差距已經縮小了。
phrases.note: 可搭配 narrow、widen、close 等動詞
phrases.trap: The gap of boys and girls

phrases.ex: Cutting down forests can have serious consequences for wildlife.
phrases.exZh: 砍伐森林可能對野生動物造成嚴重的後果。
phrases.note: consequences 多用複數；for 後接受影響的對象

phrases.ex: The Internet lets students gain access to a huge amount of information.
phrases.exZh: 網路讓學生能取得大量的資訊。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；常用來說明科技的好處

phrases.ex: Clean water is indispensable to all living things.
phrases.exZh: 乾淨的水對所有生物都是不可或缺的。
phrases.note: 比 necessary 語氣強；也可用 indispensable for

phrases.ex: Posters in the hallway draw people's attention to the problem of littering.
phrases.exZh: 走廊上的海報讓大家注意到亂丟垃圾的問題。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；people's 可換 the public's

phrases.ex: The new rule about mobile phones in class has sparked a debate about fairness.
phrases.exZh: 課堂手機新規定引發了關於公平性的辯論。
phrases.note: spark 也可接 controversy；about 可換 on
phrases.trap: has spark a debate about fairness.

phrases.ex: I am interested in the guitar lessons mentioned on your poster.
phrases.exZh: 我感興趣的是你們海報上提到的吉他課。
phrases.note: in 後接名詞或 V-ing；表示有興趣，不是 interesting

phrases.ex: Please give back the pen you borrowed from me yesterday.
phrases.exZh: 請把你昨天向我借的筆還給我。
phrases.note: 與 return 同義，較口語

phrases.ex: Fresh milk can be made into cheese, butter, and yogurt.
phrases.exZh: 鮮奶可以做成起司、奶油和優格。
phrases.note: 常用被動：be made into

phrases.ex: Hold on to the handrail when the bus is moving.
phrases.exZh: 公車行駛時要抓緊扶手。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；也可指留著不放棄：hold on to hope

phrases.ex: Traditional recipes are often passed down from parents to children.
phrases.exZh: 傳統食譜常常由父母傳給孩子。
phrases.note: 常用被動，後接 from … to …

phrases.ex: Workers cut down several old trees beside the road.
phrases.exZh: 工人們砍倒了路邊幾棵老樹。
phrases.note: 砍樹用 cut down；減少則多加 on
phrases.trap: were cut down several old trees

phrases.ex: She has been working toward a place in the national team.
phrases.exZh: 她一直朝著入選國家隊的目標努力。
phrases.note: toward 也可寫 towards；接目標

phrases.ex: Most students wake up before seven o'clock on school days.
phrases.exZh: 大多數學生在上學日七點前就會醒來。
phrases.note: 可作不及物（醒來）或及物（叫醒某人，受詞放中間）

phrases.ex: Detectives searched for clues in every corner of the room.
phrases.exZh: 偵探在房間的每個角落搜尋線索。
phrases.note: 強調尋找的過程；search a place 是搜查某地

phrases.ex: Something strange happened to my bike this morning.
phrases.exZh: 我的腳踏車今天早上發生了怪事。
phrases.note: happen 不用被動；happen to V 是「碰巧」

phrases.ex: How did the audience react to the surprise ending?
phrases.exZh: 觀眾對這個出人意料的結局有什麼反應？
phrases.note: 名詞是 reaction，後面也用 to

phrases.ex: She never responds to messages sent late at night.
phrases.exZh: 她從不回覆深夜傳來的訊息。
phrases.note: 比 reply to 稍正式；名詞是 response

phrases.ex: My cousin will graduate from junior high school next June.
phrases.exZh: 我表哥明年六月將從國中畢業。
phrases.note: 畢業的學校前用 from，不加 in
phrases.trap: will graduate of junior high school

phrases.ex: Who will pay for the tickets to the concert?
phrases.exZh: 誰要付音樂會的門票錢？
phrases.note: 付款對象用 pay sb.；付的東西前要加 for

phrases.ex: It is unkind to laugh at someone who makes a mistake.
phrases.exZh: 嘲笑犯錯的人是不友善的。
phrases.note: 帶嘲笑意味；被人嘲笑用 be laughed at

phrases.ex: The delegation arrived in the capital just before midnight.
phrases.exZh: 代表團在午夜前不久抵達首都。
phrases.note: 小地點用 at，大城市或國家用 in

phrases.ex: If the current trend continues, online learning will most likely become common in rural schools.
phrases.exZh: 如果目前的趨勢持續下去，線上學習很可能會在鄉下學校普及。
phrases.note: 副詞，放動詞前或句首；be likely to V 是形容詞用法，主詞後接 be

phrases.ex: Too much noise can interfere with your sleep.
phrases.exZh: 太多噪音可能會妨礙你睡眠。
phrases.note: 干預他人事務用 interfere in

phrases.ex: The baby stopped crying as soon as she heard the lullaby.
phrases.exZh: 寶寶一聽到搖籃曲就停止哭泣了。
phrases.note: stop to V 是「停下來去做」，意思不同

phrases.ex: It is not wise to blame others for your own mistakes.
phrases.exZh: 因為自己犯的錯而責怪別人並不明智。
phrases.note: 也可用 blame sth. on sb.，介系詞不同

phrases.ex: Repairing the old computer would cost you more than buying a new one.
phrases.exZh: 修理這部舊電腦所花的錢會比買新的還多。
phrases.note: 主詞是事物；三態同形 cost；人不當主詞

phrases.ex: The little boy was afraid of walking home alone in the dark.
phrases.exZh: 那個小男孩害怕在黑暗中獨自走路回家。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Despite many difficulties, the volunteers continued to help the families affected by the flood.
phrases.exZh: 儘管困難重重，志工們仍繼續幫助受水災影響的家庭。
phrases.note: 後接原形動詞，也可接 V-ing；go on to V 是「接著做另一件事」

phrases.ex: The bus was so slow that we were late for the first class.
phrases.exZh: 公車太慢，我們第一堂課遲到了。
phrases.note: for 後接活動或場合，如 class、school

phrases.ex: Are you ready for the final exam on Friday?
phrases.exZh: 你準備好迎接星期五的期末考了嗎？
phrases.note: for 接事物；後接動作時用 be ready to V

phrases.ex: Many residents are opposed to building a factory near the river.
phrases.exZh: 許多居民反對在河邊蓋工廠。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing，不接原形
phrases.trap: are opposed to build a factory

phrases.ex: A good teacher is patient with students who learn slowly.
phrases.exZh: 好老師會對學得慢的學生有耐心。
phrases.note: 對人用 with，對事可用 with 或 about

phrases.ex: Many popular board games originated in ancient times as a way to teach strategy.
phrases.exZh: 許多受歡迎的桌遊起源於古代，是用來教策略的方式。
phrases.note: 不及物不用被動；in 接地點時代，from 接來源

phrases.ex: Some students study alone while others join study groups; the former enjoy the quiet, while the latter value discussion.
phrases.exZh: 有些學生獨自讀書，有些則參加讀書會；前者喜歡安靜，後者重視討論。
phrases.note: 只用在前面剛提過的兩者；三項以上改用 the first／the last

phrases.ex: Healthy eating has created a demand for fresh vegetables at the summer market.
phrases.exZh: 健康飲食的風氣帶動了夏季市場對新鮮蔬菜的需求。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 for；常與 growing、great 連用

phrases.ex: Many sea turtles are in danger because plastic bags look like food to them.
phrases.exZh: 許多海龜身處危險，因為塑膠袋在牠們眼中像食物。
phrases.note: in danger of sth. 表示有…的危險

phrases.ex: A long line of people was waiting in front of the new bakery.
phrases.exZh: 一長排人正在新開的麵包店前面等候。
phrases.note: 指在外部的前面；in the front of 是在內部的前部

phrases.ex: There is a small fountain in the middle of the school yard.
phrases.exZh: 校園的中央有一座小噴泉。
phrases.note: 可指空間中央或事情進行到一半

phrases.ex: Too much screen time is associated with poor sleep and weaker concentration among teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 使用螢幕時間過長和青少年睡不好、專注力變差有關。
phrases.note: 接 with 不接 to；比 be related to 多了聯想義

phrases.ex: Too much screen time can be a cause of poor eyesight.
phrases.exZh: 看螢幕的時間過長可能是視力變差的原因之一。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 of；指造成結果的原因

phrases.ex: A shortage of water forced the village to limit daily showers.
phrases.exZh: 水源短缺迫使這個村莊限制每天的洗澡用水。
phrases.note: 後接資源或物資；語氣比 a lack of 更像供應不足

phrases.ex: There is a need for more bike lanes near the school gate.
phrases.exZh: 學校大門附近需要更多腳踏車道。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 for；也可說 the need to V

phrases.ex: A decrease in rainfall this year has made the rice fields dry.
phrases.exZh: 今年雨量減少，讓稻田變得乾旱。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 in；相反為 an increase in

phrases.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the roof of the old house.
phrases.exZh: 暴風雨對那棟老房子的屋頂造成嚴重的損壞。
phrases.note: damage 不可數，不加 s；to 後接受損的事物

phrases.ex: Our team was in trouble when the bus broke down halfway to the stadium.
phrases.exZh: 公車在前往體育場的半路上拋錨，我們的隊伍陷入了困境。
phrases.note: 常見 get into trouble；trouble 不加冠詞

phrases.ex: Daily walks in the park keep my grandmother in good shape.
phrases.exZh: 每天在公園散步讓我的奶奶保持良好的體態。
phrases.note: 可指人的體能，也可指物品狀態；相反為 out of shape

phrases.ex: Instead of feeling ashamed of our mistakes, we should learn from them and try again.
phrases.exZh: 與其為自己的錯誤感到羞愧，我們應該從中學習，再試一次。
phrases.note: 接經驗、錯誤或人；learn a lesson from 強調教訓

phrases.ex: Some teenagers make money by selling handmade cards at weekend markets.
phrases.exZh: 有些青少年靠在週末市集賣手工卡片賺錢。
phrases.note: money 不可數；口語常用，正式可說 earn money

phrases.ex: It is always better to tell the truth, even when it is hard.
phrases.exZh: 即使很困難，說實話總是比較好。
phrases.note: 動詞用 tell，不用 say；truth 前用 the

phrases.ex: May I make a suggestion about how to decorate the classroom?
phrases.exZh: 關於怎麼裝飾教室，我可以提個建議嗎？
phrases.note: suggestion 是可數名詞；動詞是 suggest

phrases.ex: Eating too much fast food may cause you to gain weight.
phrases.exZh: 吃太多速食可能讓你變胖。
phrases.note: 反義：lose weight；weight 不可數

phrases.ex: The baby cries all the time when her mother leaves the room.
phrases.exZh: 媽媽一離開房間，寶寶就一直哭。
phrases.note: 表示始終如此；有時帶抱怨語氣

phrases.ex: The students walked into the hall one by one.
phrases.exZh: 學生們一個接一個走進禮堂。
phrases.note: 強調個別依序，也可放句首

phrases.ex: This is by far the cheapest way to travel around the island.
phrases.exZh: 這絕對是環島旅行最省錢的方式。
phrases.note: 修飾最高級或比較級，強調差距很大

phrases.ex: The walk to the station takes less than ten minutes.
phrases.exZh: 走到車站不用十分鐘。
phrases.note: 後接不可數名詞或數量；可數名詞常用 fewer than

phrases.ex: After years of hard work, she finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a nurse.
phrases.exZh: 經過多年努力，她終於實現了當護理師的夢想。
phrases.note: 主詞是人；pursue 是追求，come true 是成真
phrases.trap: she finally fulfilled to her dream

phrases.ex: Too much screen time can hurt your eyes and your sleep.
phrases.exZh: 太長的螢幕使用時間會傷害眼睛，也影響睡眠。
phrases.note: 不可數名詞，用 much 而非 many

phrases.ex: My brother has no patience for long queues, so he always leaves the shop right away.
phrases.exZh: 我哥哥對排長隊很沒耐性，總是立刻離開那家店。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞；對人說 have no patience with sb.
phrases.trap: My brother has no patient for long queues,

phrases.ex: My mother nags me about my messy desk almost every single morning.
phrases.exZh: 媽媽幾乎每天早上都愛碎念我凌亂的書桌。
phrases.note: nag 是貶義，指反覆唸；一般提醒用 remind

phrases.ex: Some critics always find fault with new ideas instead of offering any better solution.
phrases.exZh: 有些批評者總是對新想法吹毛求疵，卻提不出更好的辦法。
phrases.note: 貶義；nitpick 是口語單字。與 criticize 不同，強調挑剔小處
phrases.trap: always find fault on new ideas

phrases.ex: She always speaks her mind, even when her opinion is not what people want to hear.
phrases.exZh: 她向來心直口快，即使意見不是大家想聽的也照說。
phrases.note: 中性偏褒；太直接可說 be blunt。outspoken 是形容詞

phrases.ex: Cutthroat competition in cram schools leaves many teenagers tired and stressed.
phrases.exZh: 補習班裡的內捲讓許多青少年又累又有壓力。
phrases.note: 直譯 involution 多數人看不懂；改描述惡性競爭

phrases.ex: My cousin stayed up all night to binge-watch a series about time travel.
phrases.exZh: 我表哥熬夜一口氣追完一部影集，內容是關於時空旅行。
phrases.note: binge 指短時間內大量觀看；跟播可說 keep up with a show
phrases.trap: to binge-watching a series about time travel.

phrases.ex: The school camp offered a digital detox, so nobody could use a phone for three days.
phrases.exZh: 學校營隊辦了數位排毒，三天內大家都不能用手機。
phrases.note: 指刻意一段時間不用電子產品；detox 原為戒除毒素的意思

phrases.ex: Teachers who work late every night can easily burn out within a few years.
phrases.exZh: 每晚加班的老師很容易在幾年內過勞。
phrases.note: 不及物；名詞是 burnout，過勞死是 death from overwork

phrases.ex: Studying until midnight left the whole group hungry, so a late-night snack sounded perfect.
phrases.exZh: 念書念到半夜，大家都餓了，這時吃份宵夜再適合不過。
phrases.note: 宵夜是一種習慣，snack 泛指小吃；不要說 night meal

phrases.ex: The breakfast shop near the station sells egg pancakes and soy milk to hurrying commuters.
phrases.exZh: 車站附近的早餐店賣蛋餅和豆漿給趕時間的通勤族。
phrases.note: 指街角小店，不是 restaurant；可加 neighborhood
phrases.trap: The breakfast shops near the station

phrases.ex: Some shoppers spend hours hunting for bargains just to save a few dollars.
phrases.exZh: 有些人為了省幾塊錢，會花好幾個小時撿便宜。
phrases.note: bargain 是划算的東西；含努力找折扣的意思，未必貶義

phrases.ex: Fans lined up early to snap up the limited-edition notebooks before they sold out.
phrases.exZh: 粉絲們一早排隊，搶購限量筆記本，怕賣完。
phrases.note: 及物片語，可接 sth.；強調搶著買且很快賣完，不要用 rush to buy
phrases.trap: to snapping up the limited-edition notebooks

phrases.ex: Every year my family pays a New Year visit to relatives living in the countryside.
phrases.exZh: 每年我家都會到鄉下拜年，探望親戚。
