phrases.note: 拜年是新年走訪親友；也可說 make New Year calls

phrases.ex: Before the new year begins, the whole family does the spring cleaning together.
phrases.exZh: 新年開始前，全家人會一起大掃除。
phrases.note: 臺灣多在年前大掃除，英文仍慣用 spring cleaning

phrases.ex: Many engineers had to work overtime last week to fix the problem before the product launch.
phrases.exZh: 上週許多工程師為了在產品上市前修好問題，只好加班。
phrases.note: overtime 是副詞；名詞 overtime 指加班費或加班時數

phrases.ex: Learning grammar rules by rote is far less useful than practicing them in real conversations.
phrases.exZh: 死背文法規則遠不如在真實對話中練習來得有用。
phrases.note: by rote 含貶義，指不求理解；作文可搭配 rote learning
phrases.trap: Learning grammar rules by the rote

phrases.phrase: when in Rome, do as the Romans do
phrases.ex: You should try the local food on this trip; as the saying goes, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
phrases.exZh: 這趟旅行你該試試當地的食物，俗話說得好，入鄉隨俗嘛。
phrases.note: 整句諺語，常整句引用；也可說 follow local customs
phrases.trap: when in Rome, do as the Roman do.

phrases.ex: Do not give up halfway, even when the project feels endless.
phrases.exZh: 就算專題看似沒完沒了，也不要半途而廢。
phrases.note: 後面可加 through sth.；正式可用 abandon midway

phrases.ex: Cooking dinner for his tired parents is one way he shows filial piety.
phrases.exZh: 為疲累的父母煮晚餐，是他表達孝順的方式之一。
phrases.note: filial 偏書面；口語可說 be good to one's parents

phrases.zh: 換位思考；從對方角度想
phrases.ex: Good communicators try to see things from the other person's perspective before replying.
phrases.exZh: 善於溝通的人在回應之前，會先換位思考。
phrases.note: 重點在思考角度，比 shoes 那句更適合作文
phrases.trap: see things on the other person's perspective

phrases.ex: After graduating, he moved back home to care for his aging parents.
phrases.exZh: 畢業後，他搬回家奉養年邁的父母，盡一份孝心。
phrases.note: care for 比 take care of 稍正式
phrases.trap: to care of his aging parents.

phrases.phrase: hand sth. down from generation to generation
phrases.ex: This family recipe has been handed down from generation to generation.
phrases.exZh: 這道家傳食譜一代一代傳承下來。
phrases.note: 常用被動；傳承精神、文化可說 carry on a tradition
phrases.trap: handed down from generation to generations.

phrases.ex: It took my sister a week to get over her bad cold.
phrases.exZh: 我姊姊花了一週才從重感冒中康復。
phrases.note: 後面接病痛、打擊或困難

phrases.ex: My cousin decided to take up the violin after watching a concert.
phrases.exZh: 我表哥看完一場音樂會後，決定開始學小提琴。
phrases.note: take up space/time 是佔用空間／時間

phrases.ex: Grandpa sat on the sofa with his eyes closed, listening to the radio.
phrases.exZh: 爺爺閉著眼睛坐在沙發上聽收音機。
phrases.note: 主動用 V-ing；被動或狀態用 p.p.

phrases.phrase: If S had p.p., S would have p.p.
phrases.ex: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the first bus.
phrases.exZh: 要是我們早點出門，就能搭上第一班公車了。
phrases.note: 與過去事實相反；if 子句用過去完成式

phrases.ex: Although our team lost the game, the coach told us to look on the bright side.
phrases.exZh: 雖然我們隊輸了比賽，教練要我們往好處想。
phrases.note: 常用在安慰或勸告；後面可加 of sth.

phrases.ex: If you have any questions about the event, feel free to email me.
phrases.exZh: 如果對活動有任何問題，儘管寄電子郵件給我。
phrases.note: 書信結尾常用；後接原形動詞，語氣友善

phrases.ex: The problem is that most students do not have time to cook healthy meals.
phrases.exZh: 問題在於大部分學生沒有時間煮健康的餐點。
phrases.note: 議論文點出問題用；後接完整子句

phrases.phrase: This is the first time (that) S have p.p.
phrases.ex: This is the first time our class has planted trees together.
phrases.exZh: 這是我們班第一次一起種樹。
phrases.note: 後面子句用現在完成式，不用現在式

phrases.ex: The school play really lived up to our expectations.
phrases.exZh: 這次校園話劇真的符合我們的期待。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；否定為 fail to live up to

phrases.phrase: have a positive attitude toward sth.
phrases.ex: Students who have a positive attitude toward mistakes often learn faster.
phrases.exZh: 對錯誤抱持正面態度的學生通常學得比較快。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 toward 或 to；反義 negative
phrases.trap: Students who have a positive attitudes toward

phrases.ex: We called the shop all morning, but we could not get through.
phrases.exZh: 我們整個早上都打電話給那家店，但一直打不通。
phrases.note: get through sth. 是熬過或完成；電話接通後接 to 某人

phrases.ex: Her kindness and honesty set her apart from the other candidates.
phrases.exZh: 她的善良與誠實使她與其他候選人不同。
phrases.note: 常用 set sb./sth. apart from …

phrases.ex: Let us go over the main points once more before the test.
phrases.exZh: 考試前我們把重點再複習一遍吧。
phrases.note: 比 review 口語；受詞為代名詞時放後面

phrases.ex: Everyone must hand in the report before Friday afternoon.
phrases.exZh: 每個人都必須在星期五下午前交出報告。
phrases.note: 指把作業或文件交給老師或主管；受詞可放中間

phrases.ex: Our guest showed up twenty minutes late because of the traffic.
phrases.exZh: 我們的客人因為塞車而遲到二十分鐘才出現。
phrases.note: 不及物，口語；不接受詞

phrases.ex: Many students sign up for the swimming class in summer.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生在夏天報名參加游泳課。
phrases.note: 不及物片語動詞，後面接 for 再接課程或活動
phrases.trap: sign up of the swimming class

phrases.ex: The clown looked so silly that the kids couldn't help laughing.
phrases.exZh: 那個小丑看起來太滑稽了，孩子們忍不住大笑。
phrases.note: help 後接 V-ing；同義：can't help but V

phrases.ex: As we all know, sleeping enough is important for doing well at school.
phrases.exZh: 眾所周知，睡眠充足對在學校表現良好很重要。
phrases.note: 放句首或句中，用逗號隔開；語氣稍口語

phrases.ex: It is often said that time is more valuable than money.
phrases.exZh: 人們常說時間比金錢更寶貴。
phrases.note: 可用來引出諺語或常見說法，再提出自己的看法

phrases.ex: It goes without saying that clean air is essential to human health.
phrases.exZh: 不言而喻，清淨的空氣對人體健康不可或缺。
phrases.note: 用於顯而易見的事實；別接有爭議的看法

phrases.ex: No one can deny that sports bring people of different ages closer together.
phrases.exZh: 沒有人能否認運動能拉近不同年齡層人們的距離。
phrases.note: 語氣強烈；後接完整子句，不用 not 再否定

phrases.ex: Looking back, I must admit that I once thought online friends could never be real friends.
phrases.exZh: 回想起來，我必須承認自己曾經認為網友不可能成為真正的朋友。
phrases.note: 先承認再轉折，讓論點更有說服力

phrases.ex: The smell of fresh bread brought back memories of my childhood.
phrases.exZh: 剛出爐麵包的香味喚起了我童年的回憶。
phrases.note: 可拆開：bring the memories back

phrases.ex: Exercise does not make you tired all day; on the contrary, it gives you more energy.
phrases.exZh: 運動不會讓你整天疲倦；相反地，它會讓你更有精神。
phrases.note: 用來否定前一句再提出相反看法，和 on the other hand 不同

phrases.ex: The new subway line is not crowded at all; as a matter of fact, most seats are empty at noon.
phrases.exZh: 新的捷運線一點也不擁擠；事實上，中午時大部分座位都是空的。
phrases.note: 比 in fact 口語，常用來補充或更正；後接逗號

phrases.ex: Teenagers like to hang out at the park after school.
phrases.exZh: 青少年喜歡放學後在公園閒晃。
phrases.note: 口語；hang out with sb. 表示和某人一起玩

phrases.ex: Let's rest under this tree for a while before we go on.
phrases.exZh: 我們在這棵樹下休息一會兒再繼續走吧。
phrases.note: 指一小段時間，多與持續動詞連用

phrases.ex: Later on, the little town became a popular place for tourists.
phrases.exZh: 後來，這個小鎮成了熱門的觀光地點。
phrases.note: 比 later 更強調時間一段距離之後；多用於敘述過去或未來

phrases.ex: Before long, the small shop had become known across the whole city.
phrases.exZh: 不久之後，這家小店在全市就出了名。
phrases.note: 多用於敘述過去或未來，放句首；不接 of

phrases.ex: In the beginning, the new students felt shy and quiet.
phrases.exZh: 一開始，新同學都覺得害羞而安靜。
phrases.note: 指過程的起點，常與 later 或 in the end 對照

phrases.ex: The whole class burst out laughing when the teacher slipped on the banana peel.
phrases.exZh: 老師踩到香蕉皮滑了一跤時，全班都笑了出來。
phrases.note: 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V；表示忍不住笑出聲

phrases.ex: He will never forget seeing the ocean for the first time.
phrases.exZh: 他永遠忘不了第一次看到大海的情景。
phrases.note: forget V-ing 是忘了做過；forget to V 是忘了去做

phrases.ex: At the sight of the huge waves, the little girl held her father's hand tightly.
phrases.exZh: 一看到巨大的浪，小女孩就緊緊握住爸爸的手。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；表示看到後立即產生的反應
phrases.trap: On the sight of the huge waves,

phrases.ex: The test was very difficult, yet most of the class passed it.
phrases.exZh: 這次考試非常困難，然而多數同學還是及格了。
phrases.note: 比 but 正式，語氣較強，連接兩個子句，前面加逗號

phrases.ex: Some people prefer cities, whereas others enjoy the quiet of the countryside.
phrases.exZh: 有些人偏好城市，而另一些人則喜歡鄉間的寧靜。
phrases.note: 連接詞，引導對比子句，比 while 更明確表示對比；偏書面

phrases.ex: Despite the fact that fast food is unhealthy, it remains popular among teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 儘管速食不健康，它在青少年之間依然很受歡迎。
phrases.note: despite 後要接子句時，必須加 the fact that

phrases.ex: The river was badly polluted; consequently, many fish disappeared within a week.
phrases.exZh: 那條河嚴重受到汙染，因此許多魚在一週內死亡。
phrases.note: 正式；放句首加逗號，或放句中前後加逗號

phrases.ex: Additionally, students are required to hand in a short report after the trip.
phrases.exZh: 此外，學生在旅行後必須繳交一份簡短的報告。
phrases.note: 正式；放句首加逗號，用法同 in addition

phrases.ex: Students should learn to manage time, that is to say, they should plan each day carefully.
phrases.exZh: 學生應該學會管理時間，也就是說，要仔細規劃每一天。
phrases.note: 比 in other words 稍正式；前後常加逗號

phrases.ex: Smartphones have undoubtedly changed the way young people communicate.
phrases.exZh: 智慧型手機無疑改變了年輕人溝通的方式。
phrases.note: 副詞，語氣強；可放助動詞後或句首

phrases.ex: To tell the truth, fast food is convenient but not good for our health.
phrases.exZh: 說實話，速食很方便，但對我們的健康並不好。
phrases.note: 偏口語；正式作文少用，放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: The students cleaned the classroom and played basketball afterwards.
phrases.exZh: 學生們打掃完教室，之後去打籃球。
phrases.note: 副詞，放句尾或句首；美式也可寫 afterward

phrases.ex: As mentioned above, plastic bags cause serious harm to sea animals.
phrases.exZh: 如上所述，塑膠袋對海洋動物造成嚴重的傷害。
phrases.note: 回顧前文再下結論；用於總結段，不要在第一段使用

phrases.ex: From my perspective, a short walk after dinner does more good than watching television all evening.
phrases.exZh: 就我的觀點來看，晚餐後散個步，比整晚看電視更有益處。
phrases.note: 偏正式；perspective 是可數名詞，前面用 my

phrases.ex: Having seen how much food the cafeteria throws away, I am convinced that schools must reduce waste.
phrases.exZh: 看到餐廳丟掉那麼多食物後，我深信學校必須減少浪費。
phrases.note: convinced 後接 that 子句，表示經過思考而確信

phrases.ex: It seems to me that homework should be shorter, so that teenagers can get enough sleep.
phrases.exZh: 在我看來，功課應該少一點，這樣青少年才能睡得夠。
phrases.note: 語氣較委婉；不要寫成 It seems me

phrases.ex: Some people say money brings happiness, but I strongly disagree with that statement.
phrases.exZh: 有些人說金錢帶來快樂，但我強烈不同意這種說法。
phrases.note: disagree 後用 with，不可直接接受詞

phrases.ex: Having read the report, I have no doubt that recycling saves energy.
phrases.exZh: 讀過報告後，我毫不懷疑資源回收能節省能源。
phrases.note: 語氣肯定；後面接 that 子句

phrases.phrase: one possible solution is to V
phrases.zh: 一個可行的解決辦法是……
phrases.ex: One possible solution is to set up more recycling bins near schools.
phrases.exZh: 一個可行的解決辦法是在學校附近多擺放一些回收桶。
phrases.note: 寫作提出對策時放句首；solution 後面用 to V
phrases.trap: One possible solution is to setting up

phrases.phrase: What we should do is (to) V
phrases.ex: What we should do is to sort our trash before throwing it away.
phrases.exZh: 我們該做的是先把垃圾分類再丟棄。
phrases.note: 名詞子句當主詞；is 後的 to 可省略
phrases.trap: What we should do is to sorting

phrases.ex: Lack of sleep is often the root cause of poor performance at school.
phrases.exZh: 睡眠不足往往是在校表現不佳的根本原因。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；比 reason 更強調「最根本」
phrases.trap: is often the root causes of

phrases.ex: Local governments need new ways to tackle the problem of traffic jams.
phrases.exZh: 地方政府需要新方法來處理交通堵塞的問題。
phrases.note: tackle 為及物動詞，後直接接受詞；比 solve 更強調積極處理
phrases.trap: to tackle with the problem of

phrases.ex: Animal testing remains a controversial issue in many countries.
phrases.exZh: 動物實驗在許多國家仍是個有爭議的議題。
phrases.note: controversial 是形容詞；名詞為 controversy

phrases.phrase: I look forward to hearing from you.
phrases.ex: Please reply before Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.
phrases.exZh: 請在週五前回覆，我期待收到你的來信。
phrases.note: 書信常見結尾句；to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing，不接原形
phrases.trap: I look forward to hear from you.

phrases.phrase: I would like to express my thanks for …
phrases.ex: I would like to express my thanks for your warm help during my stay.
phrases.exZh: 我要表達我的謝意，感謝你在我停留期間的熱心協助。
phrases.note: 較正式的道謝；for 後接名詞或 V-ing
phrases.trap: I would like to express my thank for

phrases.ex: Thank you very much for the lovely birthday present you sent me.
phrases.exZh: 非常感謝你寄給我這份可愛的生日禮物。
phrases.note: 日常道謝；for 後接名詞或 V-ing，也可加 so much

phrases.ex: She was overwhelmed with joy when she saw her family at the airport.
phrases.exZh: 她在機場看到家人時，整個人被喜悅淹沒。
phrases.note: 後接強烈情緒，如 joy、grief；也可用 by

phrases.ex: Soon after the meeting started, the lights suddenly went out.
phrases.exZh: 會議開始後不久，燈突然全滅了。
phrases.note: 可當連接詞後接子句，也可當副詞單獨使用；動詞多用過去式

phrases.ex: Contrary to what many people think, learning a language is not just memorizing words.
phrases.exZh: 與許多人的想法相反，學語言不只是背單字。
phrases.note: 放句首，to 後接名詞或 what 子句，表與預期相反
phrases.trap: Contrary of what many people think,

phrases.ex: Plants need sunlight to grow, and in the same way, children need love.
phrases.exZh: 植物需要陽光才能生長，同樣地，孩子也需要愛。
phrases.note: 常用於類比；後面加逗號，也可放句尾

phrases.ex: The park needs more care; to be specific, it needs new benches and cleaner paths.
phrases.exZh: 這座公園需要更多維護，具體來說，需要新的長椅和更乾淨的步道。
phrases.note: 先概述再具體說明；前面用分號或句號，後面加逗號

phrases.ex: Bubble tea is a typical example of how food trends spread quickly among teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 珍珠奶茶正是飲食潮流在青少年之間快速流行的典型例子。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 how 子句；也可換成 a good example of

phrases.ex: Obviously, no one can learn a language well without practicing every day.
phrases.exZh: 顯然，沒有人不每天練習就能把一種語言學好。
phrases.note: 指出顯而易見的事；避免用在需要證明的論點

phrases.ex: Of course, parents cannot solve every problem for their children, but they can offer support.
phrases.exZh: 父母固然不能替孩子解決每個問題，但可以在一旁鼓勵與陪伴。
phrases.note: 作文中常先承認一點，再用 but 轉折

phrases.ex: The exam looked difficult, but it was actually easier than everyone had expected.
phrases.exZh: 這場考試看起來很難，其實比大家預期的簡單。
phrases.note: 放在動詞前或句尾；用來指出與預期不同的真相

phrases.ex: Technology can certainly make learning more fun if teachers use it wisely.
phrases.exZh: 如果老師運用得當，科技當然能讓學習更有趣。
phrases.note: 副詞，放助動詞後加強肯定語氣

phrases.ex: In the first place, exercise keeps our bodies strong and healthy.
phrases.exZh: 首先，運動能讓我們的身體強壯又健康。
phrases.note: 放句首，語氣稍口語；也可指「一開始就」

phrases.ex: To start with, we should reduce the amount of food we waste every day.
phrases.exZh: 首先，我們應該減少每天浪費的食物量。
phrases.note: 與 to begin with 同義，語氣較口語，放句首

phrases.ex: Next, the teacher asked everyone to write down three questions about the story.
phrases.exZh: 接下來，老師請每個人寫下三個關於這則故事的問題。
phrases.note: 放句首，後面加逗號；用於步驟或說明流程

phrases.ex: On the whole, the plan is practical, although a few details still need to be improved.
phrases.exZh: 整體而言，這個計畫是可行的，不過有幾個細節還需要改進。
phrases.note: 表示整體評價，常帶保留語氣，後面可接 although 補充缺點

phrases.ex: All things considered, walking to school is a healthy and low-cost choice for many students.
phrases.exZh: 綜合考量之後，走路上學對許多學生來說是既健康又省錢的選擇。
phrases.note: 正式；用於權衡各方面後給出判斷，放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: Personally, I would rather spend a free weekend in a quiet library than in a crowded mall.
phrases.exZh: 就個人而言，我寧可在安靜的圖書館度過空閒的週末，也不想待在擁擠的購物中心。
phrases.note: 副詞，強調這是個人看法；常放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: Like many teachers, I share the view that schools should teach students how to save money.
phrases.exZh: 和許多老師一樣，我認同學校應該教學生如何存錢。
phrases.note: 表示與他人看法一致，適合附和論點

phrases.ex: Too many tests each week only cause stress, so I am against giving students more of them.
phrases.exZh: 每週太多考試只會造成壓力，所以我反對再給學生更多考試。
phrases.note: against 後接名詞或 V-ing；正式度比 oppose 低

phrases.ex: Reading habits should be encouraged among young children at home and in school.
phrases.exZh: 在家裡和學校都應該鼓勵幼童培養閱讀習慣。
phrases.note: 被動語態；作文中提出建議的常用說法，主詞是被鼓勵的事物

phrases.ex: Cyberbullying should be taken seriously by schools and parents alike.
phrases.exZh: 網路霸凌應該被認真看待，學校和家長都一樣。
phrases.note: 被動語態；用來呼籲重視某個問題，語氣較強

phrases.phrase: the pros and cons of sth.
phrases.ex: Everyone should learn the pros and cons of using a smartphone.
phrases.exZh: 每個人都應該了解使用智慧型手機的利弊。
phrases.note: 口語較常用，寫作可換成 advantages and disadvantages

phrases.ex: Before making a big choice, it is wise to weigh the pros and cons.
phrases.exZh: 在做重大決定前，權衡利弊是明智的。
phrases.note: weigh 後接 the pros and cons；可再加 of sth.
phrases.trap: to weigh the pro and cons

phrases.zh: 一般認為；普遍接受的是
phrases.ex: It is generally accepted that regular exercise helps students concentrate in class.
phrases.exZh: 一般認為，規律運動能幫助學生在課堂上專心。
phrases.note: 正式；that 後接完整子句，常放在段落開頭

phrases.ex: Others hold the view that daily homework builds good study habits.
phrases.exZh: 另一些人則認為，每天寫作業能養成良好的讀書習慣。
phrases.note: 接在 some people 之後表示對立看法；比 think 正式
phrases.trap: Others hold the view of that

phrases.ex: The issue of plastic waste has become more serious than ever.
phrases.exZh: 塑膠垃圾的問題已變得比以往任何時候都嚴重。
phrases.note: 後接形容詞或名詞，如 has become a hot topic；用於引入話題
phrases.trap: The issue of plastic waste has became

phrases.ex: The heavy flood served as a wake-up call for the whole city.
phrases.exZh: 那場大水災對整座城市來說是一記警鐘。
phrases.note: 常搭配 serve as；指促人正視問題的事件

phrases.phrase: It would be a good idea to V
phrases.ex: It would be a good idea to write down new words every day.
phrases.exZh: 每天把新單字寫下來會是個好主意。
phrases.note: 委婉提出建議；to 後接原形動詞
phrases.trap: It would be a good idea of

phrases.ex: With tears in her eyes, she thanked everyone who had helped her.
phrases.exZh: 她眼中含著淚，感謝每一位幫助過她的人。
phrases.note: 放句首或句尾當伴隨狀況；one's 依主詞變化

phrases.ex: My brother finds it hard to get up early on cold mornings.
phrases.exZh: 我弟弟覺得在寒冷的早晨很難早起。

phrases.ex: Remember to get off the bus at the stop near the library.
phrases.exZh: 記得在圖書館附近那一站下公車。
phrases.note: get on 的反義；用於公車、火車、飛機、腳踏車

phrases.ex: Our family likes to get together for a big dinner on holidays.
phrases.exZh: 我們一家人喜歡在假日聚在一起吃頓大餐。
phrases.note: 名詞是 get-together（小型聚會）

phrases.ex: Sometimes we need to get away from our phones and enjoy nature.
phrases.exZh: 有時我們需要遠離手機，好好享受大自然。
phrases.note: from 後面接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Put on a warm coat before you go out into the cold.
phrases.exZh: 出門去冷的地方前，先穿上一件保暖的外套。
phrases.note: put on 是穿的動作；wear 是穿著的狀態

phrases.zh: 把…追溯到…；追查出源頭是…
phrases.ex: The history of this small town can be traced back to the seventeenth century.
phrases.exZh: 這個小鎮的歷史可以追溯到十七世紀。
phrases.note: 常用被動；date back to 不用被動

phrases.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are busy doing what you love.
phrases.exZh: 當你忙著做喜歡的事，時間就過得特別快。
phrases.note: 主詞常為 time；也可指從旁經過

phrases.ex: Take a deep breath and calm down before the speech.
phrases.exZh: 演講前先深呼吸讓自己冷靜下來。
phrases.note: 可及物（使冷靜）或不及物；常用祈使句

phrases.ex: Please speak up because the students at the back cannot hear you.
phrases.exZh: 請大聲一點，因為後面的學生聽不到你說話。
phrases.note: 也可指鼓起勇氣表達意見

phrases.ex: We had to wait for the next bus because the first one was full.
phrases.exZh: 因為第一班公車客滿，我們只好等下一班。
phrases.note: wait 不及物，後面一定要加 for 才能接受詞

phrases.ex: He likes to listen to soft music while he studies.
phrases.exZh: 他念書時喜歡聽輕柔的音樂。
phrases.note: listen 不及物，後面要加 to

phrases.ex: You should believe in yourself and keep trying.
phrases.exZh: 你應該相信自己，並且持續努力。
phrases.note: 相信存在或價值；believe sb. 是相信某人說的話

phrases.ex: Kids count on their parents for love and support.
phrases.exZh: 孩子仰賴父母給予愛與照顧。
phrases.note: 口語常用；可接 sb. to V

phrases.ex: I haven't heard from my pen pal since last winter.
phrases.exZh: 從去年冬天起，我就沒接到筆友的音訊了。
phrases.note: 指收到來信、來電；hear of 是聽說過

phrases.ex: You had better take an umbrella because it may rain this afternoon.
phrases.exZh: 你最好帶把傘，因為今天下午可能會下雨。
phrases.note: 後接原形；否定為 had better not V；帶有警告意味

phrases.ex: Now she regrets not studying harder before the final exam.
phrases.exZh: 她現在後悔期末考前沒有更用功讀書。
phrases.note: regret to V 是遺憾地要（告知壞消息）

phrases.ex: Their coach praised them for never giving up during the match.
phrases.exZh: 教練稱讚他們在比賽中從不放棄。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞或 V-ing；同型：thank、blame、forgive
phrases.trap: praised them of never giving up

phrases.ex: There is no point in arguing about something that cannot be changed.
phrases.exZh: 爭論一件無法改變的事是沒有意義的。
phrases.note: in 可省略；口語與作文都能用
phrases.trap: There is no point in argue

phrases.ex: Everyone was surprised at the sudden change in the weather.
phrases.exZh: 天氣突然轉變，大家都很驚訝。
phrases.note: 也可用 be surprised by；感到驚訝的是人

phrases.ex: After a week of rain, people were tired of staying indoors.
phrases.exZh: 下了一週的雨後，大家受夠了待在室內。
phrases.note: be tired from 才是「因勞累而累」

phrases.ex: Grandma taught us to always feel thankful for the food on our table.
phrases.exZh: 奶奶教我們永遠要對餐桌上的食物心存感謝。
phrases.note: for 後接感謝的事物

phrases.ex: In terms of price, this small bike is much better than the red one.
phrases.exZh: 就價格而言，這輛小型腳踏車比紅色那輛好得多。
phrases.note: 多放句首，後面接逗號；of 後接名詞

phrases.ex: The man was in a hurry and forgot to lock his bike.
phrases.exZh: 那個男人很匆忙，忘了把腳踏車上鎖。
phrases.note: 常用 be in a hurry to V

phrases.ex: A friendly smile helped the shy new student feel at ease.
phrases.exZh: 友善的微笑讓害羞的新同學覺得自在。
phrases.note: 常見 feel at ease、put sb. at ease

phrases.ex: The tourist was at a loss when he saw the confusing subway map.
phrases.exZh: 那位遊客看到複雜難懂的捷運路線圖時不知所措。
phrases.note: 常接 what to do、what to say

phrases.ex: On sunny evenings, my grandfather likes to take a walk along the river.
phrases.exZh: 晴朗的傍晚，我祖父喜歡沿著河邊散步。
phrases.note: 也可說 go for a walk
phrases.trap: take a walking along the river

phrases.ex: The children had a good time at the science museum yesterday.
phrases.exZh: 孩子們昨天在科學博物館玩得很開心。
phrases.note: 也可說 have fun；後面接 V-ing 時不加 to

phrases.ex: The counselor had a talk with the shy boy about his worries.
phrases.exZh: 輔導老師和那位害羞的男孩談了談他的煩惱。
phrases.note: 談論的主題用 about；也可說 talk to sb.
phrases.trap: had a talking with the shy boy

phrases.ex: Her short story was good enough to win a prize in the national contest.
phrases.exZh: 她的短篇故事好到足以在全國比賽中得獎。
phrases.note: win 後接獎項；比賽用 win a game
phrases.trap: win a price in the national contest

phrases.ex: Let us make a plan for the summer vacation before it starts.
phrases.exZh: 讓我們在暑假開始之前先訂好計畫。
phrases.note: 後面可接 for sth. 或 to V

phrases.ex: When a new game becomes popular, many teens jump on the bandwagon.
phrases.exZh: 當新遊戲變得熱門，許多青少年就會跟風加入。
phrases.note: 略帶貶義，指看別人做才跟著做

phrases.ex: Why don't you ask the librarian if she has any books about space?
phrases.exZh: 你何不問問圖書館員有沒有關於太空的書？
phrases.note: 用來委婉建議；don't 後面用原形動詞，語氣溫和

phrases.ex: As usual, the bakery near my house opened at six this morning.
phrases.exZh: 和往常一樣，我家附近的麵包店今天早上六點開門。
phrases.note: 說明情況一如既往；可放句首或句尾

phrases.ex: Call the doctor right away if the fever gets worse.
phrases.exZh: 如果發燒更嚴重，要馬上打電話給醫生。
phrases.note: 口語，語氣比 at once 輕

phrases.ex: Follow the instructions step by step to build the model.
phrases.exZh: 請依照說明一步一步組裝模型。
phrases.note: 強調按順序進行；作形容詞要寫 step-by-step

phrases.ex: If you miss the bus, you will be late for the first class.
phrases.exZh: 如果你錯過公車，第一節課就會遲到。
phrases.note: 反義是 catch the bus；可換成 train、flight 等
phrases.trap: If you miss to the bus,

phrases.ex: She is saving up for a new bicycle by working part-time on weekends.
phrases.exZh: 她週末打工，存錢要買一輛新腳踏車。
phrases.note: for 後接想買的東西；接 to V 時用 save up to buy
phrases.trap: She is saving up of a new bicycle

phrases.ex: Teenagers often confide in a close friend rather than in their parents.
phrases.exZh: 青少年通常會向好友傾訴，而不是告訴父母。
phrases.note: 不及物，後面接 in；不說 confide sb.

phrases.ex: Although she felt nervous, she put on a brave face and walked onto the stage.
phrases.exZh: 她雖然很緊張，還是逞強擺出鎮定的樣子走上舞臺。
phrases.note: 表面裝作沒事；不是真的勇敢。可接 for sb. 指為誰而撐
phrases.trap: she put on a bravely face

phrases.ex: A warm bowl of noodles on a rainy day is one of life's small pleasures.
phrases.exZh: 下雨天吃一碗熱麵，是一種小確幸。
phrases.note: 也可說 simple pleasures；不直譯 small happiness
phrases.trap: is one of life's small pleasure.

phrases.ex: Most students eat a boxed lunch that arrives at the classroom just before noon.
phrases.exZh: 多數學生在中午前吃送到教室的便當。
phrases.note: 自己帶去的可說 packed lunch；bento 多指日式便當

phrases.ex: Even though he needed nothing, he went to the sale just to join in the fun.
phrases.exZh: 雖然什麼也不需要，他還是去特賣會湊熱鬧。
phrases.note: 含隨大家一起參與的意思；不帶貶義，貶義可用 follow the crowd
phrases.trap: just to join on the fun.

phrases.phrase: get a lump in one's throat
phrases.ex: I got a lump in my throat when the whole class sang for our teacher.
phrases.exZh: 全班為老師唱歌時，我感動得喉嚨發緊。
phrases.note: 感動到說不出話；moved 較通用，此說法強調身體反應
phrases.trap: got a lump in my throats

phrases.ex: We were on pins and needles while waiting for the exam results to come out.
phrases.exZh: 等成績出爐的時候，我們都坐立不安。
phrases.note: 焦急等待結果的心情；不是身體不舒服
phrases.trap: We were on pins and needle

phrases.phrase: take a trip down memory lane
phrases.ex: Looking through our old photo albums felt like taking a trip down memory lane.
phrases.exZh: 翻著老相簿，就像走了一趟回憶之旅，讓人懷舊。
phrases.note: 回味過往的溫暖感；不用 recall the past 直譯，那太生硬
phrases.trap: taking a trip down the memory lane.

phrases.phrase: kill two birds with one stone
phrases.ex: Walking to the library kills two birds with one stone, because it saves money and keeps me fit.
phrases.exZh: 走路去圖書館是一石二鳥，既省錢又能健身。
phrases.note: 通用諺語；不要直譯成 one stone two birds
phrases.trap: kills two bird with one stone,

phrases.ex: The exam may be hard, but she decided to give it her all.
phrases.exZh: 考試也許很難，但她決定盡力而為。
phrases.note: 比 do one's best 更有全力以赴的感覺

phrases.phrase: stand up for what is right
phrases.ex: Even as a teenager, he stood up for what is right when others stayed silent.
phrases.exZh: 即使只是少年，他也在別人沉默時見義勇為。
phrases.note: 強調為正義發聲；救人現場可用 come to sb.'s rescue
phrases.trap: he stood up for that is right

phrases.ex: Missing the bus turned out to be a blessing in disguise, because I met an old friend.
phrases.exZh: 錯過公車反而是塞翁失馬，因為我遇到了老朋友。
phrases.note: 常與 turn out to be 連用
phrases.trap: turned out to be a blessing on disguise,

phrases.ex: Persistence is key when you are learning to play the piano.
phrases.exZh: 學彈鋼琴貴在堅持。
phrases.note: key 當形容詞；正式作文可換 perseverance

phrases.phrase: be content with what one has
phrases.ex: Grandpa is content with what he has, so he rarely complains about anything.
phrases.exZh: 爺爺很知足，所以幾乎從不抱怨任何事。
phrases.note: satisfied 只是當下滿意；content 帶知足的心境
phrases.trap: is content of what he has,

phrases.ex: The old farmer makes a living by growing tea on the hillside.
phrases.exZh: 那位老農夫靠在山坡上種茶維生。
phrases.note: 常接 by V-ing；living 是名詞

phrases.ex: Yesterday, the teacher divided the class into four small groups for the activity.
phrases.exZh: 昨天老師為了活動把全班分成四個小組。
phrases.note: into 後接分出的部分；被動為 be divided into
phrases.trap: divided the class to four small groups

phrases.ex: More and more parents attach great importance to their children's mental health.
phrases.exZh: 越來越多家長重視孩子的心理健康。
phrases.note: 正式；可加 great/little 修飾 importance

phrases.ex: Careless use of plastic can give rise to serious ocean pollution.
phrases.exZh: 不小心使用塑膠可能造成嚴重的海洋汙染。
phrases.note: 正式；後接不好的或重大的結果，等於 cause

phrases.ex: She put aside a little money every month for her dream trip.
phrases.exZh: 她每個月都存一點錢，留給夢想中的旅行。
phrases.note: 意近 set aside；受詞可放中間
phrases.trap: put aside of a little money

phrases.ex: Keep up the good work, and you will pass the exam.
phrases.exZh: 繼續保持好表現，你就能通過考試。
phrases.note: 及物；常用來鼓勵人：Keep it up!

phrases.ex: However difficult the task seems, a clear plan can make it easier.
phrases.exZh: 不論任務看起來多麼困難，清楚的計畫都能讓它變得容易些。
phrases.note: however 後直接接形容詞或副詞，再接主詞與動詞

phrases.ex: She owes her strong vocabulary to years of reading stories aloud.
phrases.exZh: 她把豐富的字彙量歸功於多年來大聲朗讀故事。
phrases.note: 表示成果來自某人或某事，帶感謝的語氣

phrases.ex: Good study habits pave the way for future success.
phrases.exZh: 良好的讀書習慣為未來的成功鋪路。
phrases.note: 比喻用法，後接名詞或 V-ing，指促成後續結果

phrases.ex: The clean streets are the result of everyone's daily effort.
phrases.exZh: 乾淨的街道是源自於大家每天的努力。
phrases.note: 主詞是結果，of 後接原因；複數為 results of

phrases.ex: The rising cost of housing has aroused public concern across the country.
phrases.exZh: 房價上漲已在全國引起大眾關注。
phrases.note: arouse 是及物動詞，不加介系詞；也可用 draw attention

phrases.ex: This year's science fair drew twice as many visitors as last year's.
phrases.exZh: 今年的科學展吸引的參觀者是去年的兩倍。
phrases.note: 倍數 + as + 原級 + as；名詞可數用 many，不可數用 much

phrases.ex: In this report, the letters UN stand for United Nations.
phrases.exZh: 在這份報告中，UN 這兩個字母代表聯合國。
phrases.note: 表「容忍」時多用於否定：won't stand for

phrases.ex: The crowd began to break up after the concert ended.
phrases.exZh: 音樂會結束後，人群開始散去。
phrases.note: 可指人群散去或關係結束

phrases.ex: New machines can speed up the whole process of making bread.
phrases.exZh: 新機器能加快製作麵包的整個過程。
phrases.note: 相反是 slow down；可及物或不及物

phrases.ex: She wasn't sure about the answer, so she checked the dictionary.
phrases.exZh: 她對答案沒把握，所以查了字典。
phrases.note: 也可接 that 子句：be sure that …

phrases.ex: The early loss made the team all the more determined to win the last game.
phrases.exZh: 這次的挫折使球隊更加下定決心要贏下最後一場比賽。
phrases.note: 後接形容詞或副詞，常搭配 because 或 for 子句說明原因

phrases.ex: Careless users are to blame for the spread of false news online.
phrases.exZh: 網路假新聞的擴散要怪粗心的使用者。
phrases.note: 帶責備語氣，多用於不好的結果；for 後接名詞

phrases.ex: Learning a language is not just memorizing words but understanding a culture.
phrases.exZh: 學語言不只是背單字，更是認識一種文化。
phrases.note: 近似 not only … but also；口氣較平易，前後結構要對等
phrases.trap: is not just memorize words but

phrases.ex: Throughout history, people have looked to the stars for guidance and wonder.
phrases.exZh: 縱觀歷史，人們總是仰望星空尋求指引與驚奇。
phrases.note: 多搭配現在完成式；用於帶出長遠的視野

phrases.ex: It is suggested that schools offer more lessons on personal finance.
phrases.exZh: 有人建議學校多開一些個人理財的課程。
phrases.note: that 子句用原形動詞（或 should + 原形）；語氣客觀正式

phrases.ex: If only I had more time, I could finish reading this novel.
phrases.exZh: 要是我有更多時間，就能把這本小說讀完。
phrases.note: 表遺憾或願望；現在事實相反用過去式，過去用過去完成式
phrases.trap: If only I have more time,

phrases.ex: Exercise helps our health only if we do it regularly.
phrases.exZh: 只有規律運動，對健康才有幫助。
phrases.note: 置於句首時主要子句須倒裝，如 Only if ... can we ...

phrases.ex: The club was founded with the aim of protecting local rivers.
phrases.exZh: 這個社團成立的目的是保護當地的河川。
phrases.note: of 後接 V-ing 或名詞；常放句尾說明目的

phrases.phrase: prefer to V rather than V
phrases.ex: Some students prefer to study alone rather than join a group.
phrases.exZh: 有些學生寧願獨自念書，而不參加小組。
phrases.note: 兩個動詞都用原形；比 prefer A to B 更強調選擇
phrases.trap: prefer to study alone rather join

phrases.ex: Reading is by far the best way to enlarge your vocabulary.
phrases.exZh: 要擴充字彙量，閱讀是目前為止最好的方法。
phrases.note: by far 用來加強最高級語氣，放在 the 之前

phrases.ex: The number of online courses doubled within just three years.
phrases.exZh: 線上課程的數量在短短三年內成長了一倍。
phrases.note: 可作及物或不及物動詞；之後不必加 by

phrases.ex: The playground is twice as large as the one in the old school.
phrases.exZh: 這個操場的大小是舊學校那個操場的兩倍。
phrases.note: 倍數放在第一個 as 前；三倍以上用 three times as … as

phrases.ex: The price of fuel rose sharply after the storm.
phrases.exZh: 暴風雨過後，燃料價格大幅攀升。
phrases.note: rise 是不及物動詞，不用被動；副詞可換 dramatically

phrases.ex: It is no use crying over spilled milk, so let us learn from the mistake.
phrases.exZh: 為打翻的牛奶哭泣也沒用，不如從錯誤中學習。
phrases.note: use 後面接 V-ing，不接 to V

phrases.ex: Poor sleep, coupled with too much homework, left many students exhausted.
phrases.exZh: 睡眠不足再加上功課太多，讓許多學生精疲力盡。
phrases.note: 正式書面語；常插在主詞與動詞之間，前後加逗號

phrases.ex: A sharp decline in the birth rate has worried many experts.
phrases.exZh: 出生率的急遽下降讓許多專家擔憂。
phrases.note: 後接 in 說明項目；同義 a sharp drop／fall
phrases.trap: A sharp decline on the birth rate

phrases.ex: Kids can make toys out of old boxes and bottles.
phrases.exZh: 孩子可以用舊紙箱和瓶子做玩具。
phrases.note: 強調材料被加工成另一種東西

phrases.ex: The price of vegetables always goes up after a heavy typhoon.
phrases.exZh: 颱風過後蔬菜價格總是會上漲。
phrases.note: 反義是 go down；主詞常為價格、溫度

phrases.ex: You must check out of your room before noon tomorrow.
phrases.exZh: 你明天中午前必須辦理退房。
phrases.note: 退房常寫 check out of；口語可指「看看」

phrases.ex: All the concert tickets sold out within two hours.
phrases.exZh: 所有演唱會門票在兩小時內就賣完了。
phrases.note: 常用被動形容詞 be sold out，表示賣光

phrases.ex: The campers used up all their water by the second day.
phrases.exZh: 露營的人到第二天就把水全部用完了。
phrases.note: 強調用到一點不剩；受詞可放中間

phrases.ex: Farmers are hoping for rain after weeks of dry weather.
phrases.exZh: 經過幾週的乾燥天氣，農夫們都盼著下雨。
phrases.note: for 後接名詞；後接子句時直接用 hope that

phrases.ex: The company remains committed to protecting the environment.
phrases.exZh: 這家公司始終致力於保護環境。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing；語氣正式

phrases.ex: Every classroom in the building is equipped with a projector.
phrases.exZh: 這棟大樓的每間教室都配有投影機。
phrases.note: with 後接設備

phrases.ex: The boy spilled juice on his notebook by accident and felt terrible.
phrases.exZh: 那個男孩不小心把果汁灑在筆記本上，覺得很糟糕。
phrases.note: 與 on purpose 相反；不說 by an accident

phrases.ex: The firefighters quickly brought the fire under control before it spread to the houses.
phrases.exZh: 消防員迅速把火勢控制住，沒有蔓延到住家。
phrases.note: 常見 bring/keep sth. under control

phrases.ex: They tried in vain to start the old car on the freezing morning.
phrases.exZh: 在寒冷的早晨，他們試著發動那輛舊車，卻徒勞無功。
phrases.note: 表示努力沒有結果；可放句中或句尾

phrases.ex: In recent years, the number of people who choose to live alone is on the rise.
phrases.exZh: 近年來，選擇獨居的人數正在增加。
phrases.note: 描述趨勢的書面說法，主詞是數量或現象；rise sharply 則講升幅

phrases.phrase: go to great lengths to V
phrases.zh: 竭盡全力做…；費盡心思做…
phrases.ex: Many parents go to great lengths to find good schools for their children.
phrases.exZh: 許多父母費盡心思為孩子找好學校。
phrases.note: lengths 要複數；比 spare no effort 多了費盡心思的意味
phrases.trap: go to great length to find

phrases.ex: A person who always keeps his word earns everyone's trust.
phrases.exZh: 總是守信用的人會贏得大家的信任。
phrases.note: one's 隨主詞變化；反義 break one's word

phrases.ex: Several studies point to a strong link between lack of sleep and poor grades.
phrases.exZh: 好幾項研究都顯示，睡眠不足和成績不好有很強的關聯。
phrases.note: 後接名詞，表「顯示、暗示」；point out 是「指出」，常接 that 子句

phrases.ex: The teacher told everyone to stop talking at once.
phrases.exZh: 老師要大家立刻停止講話。
phrases.note: ＝ immediately；all at once 則指「突然」

phrases.zh: 本來是要…；用意是…；注定要…
phrases.ex: The new bridge was meant to open last year, but heavy storms delayed the work.
phrases.exZh: 新橋原本預定去年通車，但幾場大暴風雨延誤了工程。
phrases.note: 強調原本的目的、設計或命中注定；be supposed to 偏「照規定應該」
phrases.trap: was meant to opening last year,

phrases.ex: Other than a bottle of water, she carried nothing on the hike.
phrases.exZh: 除了一瓶水，她健行時什麼都沒帶。
phrases.note: 常用於否定句或 nobody、nothing 之後
phrases.trap: Other from a bottle of water,

phrases.zh: 撥出時間給…；騰出時間做…
phrases.ex: Even with a busy schedule, we should make time for exercise every day.
phrases.exZh: 即使行程再忙，我們每天都應該撥出時間運動。
phrases.note: for 接名詞，接動詞用 make time to V
phrases.trap: we should make time of exercise

phrases.ex: After graduating, she hopes to pursue a career in medicine and help people in rural areas.
phrases.exZh: 畢業後，她希望投身醫療工作，幫助偏鄉的人。
phrases.note: in 後接領域（music、science）；接職稱要用 a career as
phrases.trap: to pursue a career on medicine

phrases.ex: As a child, I was attached to an old teddy bear and took it everywhere.
phrases.exZh: 小時候，我很依戀一隻舊泰迪熊，走到哪裡都帶著它。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；比 be fond of（喜歡）多了「捨不得分開」的感情
phrases.trap: I was attached with an old teddy bear

phrases.ex: He refused to apologize only to save face in front of his classmates.
phrases.exZh: 他只是為了在同學面前顧全面子，才不肯道歉。
phrases.note: lose face 是丟臉；give face 是中式英文，不能用

phrases.ex: Doctors advise people with weak lungs to stay away from crowded places during flu season.
phrases.exZh: 醫生建議肺功能較弱的人在流感季節遠離人多的地方。
phrases.note: 自己不靠近；keep sb. away from 是讓別人遠離
phrases.trap: to stay away of crowded places

phrases.phrase: I find it hard to believe that …
phrases.ex: I find it hard to believe that a single test can show how smart a student is.
phrases.exZh: 我很難相信單靠一次考試就能看出一個學生有多聰明。
phrases.note: it 是虛受詞，真受詞是 that 子句
phrases.trap: I find hard to believe that

phrases.ex: The plane will take off in ten minutes, so please turn off your phone.
phrases.exZh: 飛機十分鐘後就要起飛，請關掉你的手機。
phrases.note: 受詞是代名詞時放中間：take it off

phrases.ex: Luckily, the runner made it to the finish line before the rain began.
phrases.exZh: 幸好，那位跑者在下雨前抵達了終點線。
phrases.note: it 固定；表示成功趕到或成功進入

phrases.ex: Students put up colorful posters on the wall to welcome the new term.
phrases.exZh: 學生們在牆上貼了彩色海報來迎接新學期。
phrases.note: 可指搭帳篷、掛海報，也可指提高價格

phrases.ex: Good teachers often go the extra mile to help students who feel lost.
phrases.exZh: 好老師常常額外多付出，去幫助覺得迷惘的學生。
phrases.note: 讚美人肯做超出本分的事，常接 to V

phrases.ex: Believe it or not, this small robot can climb stairs faster than a person.
phrases.exZh: 信不信由你，這個小機器人爬樓梯比人還快。
phrases.note: 放句首，後面接逗號，再說出令人意外的事實

phrases.ex: Last summer was extremely hot; by contrast, this year has been cool and rainy.
phrases.exZh: 去年夏天酷熱；相比之下，今年既涼爽又多雨。
phrases.note: 與 in contrast 相近，稍偏書面；放句首並加逗號

phrases.ex: The bus will arrive soon, and in the meantime, you can rest here.
phrases.exZh: 公車很快就到，這段時間你可以先在這裡休息。
phrases.note: 指兩件事之間的空檔；與 meanwhile 相近但較常指等待的期間

phrases.zh: 對…造成損害；使…付出代價
phrases.ex: Long hours of screen time can take a toll on your eyes.
phrases.exZh: 長時間盯著螢幕會對你的眼睛造成損傷。
phrases.note: 多指逐漸累積的負面影響；語氣偏生動

phrases.ex: In contrast to the busy weekdays, Sundays in the town are calm and slow.
phrases.exZh: 與忙碌的平日相比，小鎮的星期天平靜又悠閒。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；也可寫 in contrast with
phrases.trap: In contrast of the busy weekdays,

phrases.ex: To conclude, public transport is cheaper, cleaner and more convenient than driving alone in a big city.
phrases.exZh: 總之，在大城市裡，大眾運輸比獨自開車更便宜、更乾淨也更方便。
phrases.note: 正式；放句首加逗號，常用於結尾段，不要放在段落中間

phrases.ex: In summary, the survey shows that most teenagers spend more than two hours online every day.
phrases.exZh: 總之，這項調查顯示大多數青少年每天上網超過兩小時。
phrases.note: 偏書面，常用於報告與圖表作文結尾；後面接逗號

phrases.ex: If you begin a letter with the reader's name, close it with Yours sincerely, and your own name.
phrases.exZh: 如果信的開頭寫了收信人的姓名，結尾就寫謹上，再加上自己的名字。
phrases.note: 知道收信人姓名時的結尾敬語；後面換行寫自己的名字

phrases.ex: Not long after he moved to the countryside, he made many new friends.
phrases.exZh: 他搬到鄉下後沒多久，就交了許多新朋友。
phrases.note: 後接時間子句或名詞；放句首時後面加逗號

phrases.ex: The store opens next month, but until then, please use the old entrance.
phrases.exZh: 商店下個月開幕，但在那之前，請使用舊的入口。
phrases.note: 指到某個時間點前的這段期間；then 是前面提過的時間

phrases.ex: The film ends at ten, but by then the last train will have left.
phrases.exZh: 電影十點結束，但到那時最後一班火車已經開走了。
phrases.note: 表示「不晚於那時」，常與完成式連用；until then 則是持續到那時

phrases.ex: The medicine tasted awful; even so, the patient took it every morning.
phrases.exZh: 這藥味道很糟，即使如此，病人還是每天早上服用。
phrases.note: 承接前一句，語氣比 nevertheless 口語

phrases.ex: Small as the village was, it had a library full of interesting books.
phrases.exZh: 這座村子雖小，卻有一間藏書豐富有趣的圖書館。
phrases.note: 形容詞移到句首的倒裝讓步，as 前不再加 though
phrases.trap: Small as the village it was,

phrases.ex: Many old buildings are being restored, and the historic train station is a case in point.
phrases.exZh: 許多老建築正在整修，歷史悠久的火車站就是一個恰當的例子。
phrases.note: 放在陳述之後，以單句舉出具體例子；語氣正式

phrases.ex: Young people have countless hobbies, from photography to skateboarding, to name a few.
phrases.exZh: 年輕人有無數的嗜好，從攝影到滑板，僅舉幾例。
phrases.note: 放在列舉之後，暗示還有更多；語氣偏口語

phrases.phrase: serve as an example of sth.
phrases.ex: Today, the old market serves as an example of how tradition and modern life can exist together.
phrases.exZh: 如今，這座老市場正是傳統與現代生活能夠並存的範例。
phrases.note: serve 隨主詞變化；as 後接名詞表示「作為」

phrases.ex: As can be seen from the chart, sales of e-books rose steadily over the past decade.
phrases.exZh: 從圖表可以看出，電子書的銷量在過去十年穩定成長。
phrases.note: 常接 from 指出依據；圖表作文常用，不要說 As can see
phrases.trap: As can be saw from the chart,

phrases.ex: To put it simply, honesty is the foundation of any lasting friendship.
phrases.exZh: 簡單地說，誠實是任何長久友誼的基礎。
phrases.note: 用白話重述結論；放句首加逗號，語氣較親切

phrases.ex: In a word, patience is what every beginner needs most.
phrases.exZh: 一言以蔽之，耐心是每位初學者最需要的。
phrases.note: 後面通常只接很短的一句；語氣強烈，慎用於長句

phrases.ex: It is recommended that visitors bring plenty of water when hiking in summer.
phrases.exZh: 建議遊客夏天健行時多帶一些水。
phrases.note: 書面、公告常見；that 子句用原形動詞或 should + 原形

phrases.ex: Free plastic bags should be banned in every supermarket and shop.
phrases.exZh: 每家超市和商店都應該禁止提供免費塑膠袋。
phrases.note: 語氣強硬的呼籲；ban 的被動常接 in／from 地點

phrases.ex: You are tired today; in that case, you had better go to bed early.
phrases.exZh: 你今天很累；那樣的話，最好早點上床睡覺。
phrases.note: 承接前句的情況；多放句首或分號後，後加逗號

phrases.ex: As shown in the chart, most students prefer to study at home.
phrases.exZh: 如圖表所示，大多數學生偏好在家讀書。
phrases.note: 常放句首並加逗號；chart 可換成 graph、table

phrases.phrase: have a far-reaching effect on sth.
phrases.ex: New technology has had a far-reaching effect on how we study.
phrases.exZh: 新科技對我們的學習方式有深遠的影響。
phrases.note: far-reaching 為形容詞；正式，適合談長期影響
phrases.trap: has had a far-reaching affect on

phrases.phrase: be of great benefit to sb.
phrases.ex: A healthy diet is of great benefit to growing teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 健康的飲食對成長中的青少年大有益處。
phrases.note: of + 名詞 = 形容詞；benefit 前可加 great、much

phrases.ex: Little did they realize how much the trip would teach them.
phrases.exZh: 他們完全沒想到這趟旅行會讓他們學到那麼多。
phrases.note: 否定副詞放句首，主詞與助動詞倒裝；偏書面

phrases.ex: She ended her note to an old friend with Best wishes, and a small drawing of a flower.
phrases.exZh: 她給老朋友的短箋以祝好作結，還附了一幅小小的花朵圖畫。
phrases.note: 半正式或朋友間的結尾敬語，比 Yours sincerely 親切

phrases.phrase: I am sorry to hear that …
phrases.ex: I am sorry to hear that your grandmother is in the hospital.
phrases.exZh: 我很遺憾聽到你奶奶住院了。
phrases.note: 慰問信開頭；that 子句說明對方遇到的不幸
phrases.trap: I am sorry to hearing that

phrases.ex: The children jumped for joy when they saw the snow.
phrases.exZh: 孩子們看到雪時高興得跳了起來。
phrases.note: 表示非常開心；for 後接 joy，不加冠詞

phrases.ex: Everyone held their breath as the last runner approached the finish line.
phrases.exZh: 最後一位跑者接近終點線時，大家都屏住了呼吸。
phrases.note: 過去式為 held；表示緊張或期待，one's 依主詞變

phrases.ex: She turned pale when she realized she had left her wallet on the train.
phrases.exZh: 她發現錢包忘在火車上時，臉色都白了。
phrases.note: turn 在此是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞，不加 to

phrases.ex: Please take out your notebooks and open them to page ten.
phrases.exZh: 請拿出你們的筆記本，翻到第十頁。
phrases.note: 代名詞放中間：take it out；美式外帶也說 take out

phrases.ex: The teacher will give out the test papers after the bell rings.
phrases.exZh: 鐘聲響起後，老師會發下考卷。
phrases.note: 也可指用完：My energy gave out
phrases.trap: give out of the test papers

phrases.ex: A strong wind blew through the window, and all the candles went out.
phrases.exZh: 一陣強風從窗戶吹進來，所有的蠟燭都熄滅了。
phrases.note: 可指外出社交，也可指火或燈熄滅
phrases.trap: and all the candles went out of.

phrases.ex: Many students pass by this small bookstore on their way home.
phrases.exZh: 許多學生放學回家途中會經過這家小書店。
phrases.note: 不及物；後面接地點時可直接 pass by + 地點

phrases.ex: The frightened puppy ran away when the fireworks began.
phrases.exZh: 煙火開始時，受驚嚇的小狗跑掉了。
phrases.note: 常接 from：run away from home

phrases.ex: All the students stand up when the principal walks in.
phrases.exZh: 校長走進來時，所有學生都會起立。
phrases.note: be stood up 表被放鴿子；口語

phrases.ex: After the test, let us move on to the next chapter.
phrases.exZh: 考試之後，我們繼續進入下一章吧。
phrases.note: move on to sth. 表示轉到下一項；也可指走出過去
phrases.trap: move on for the next chapter.

phrases.ex: He likes to show off his new phone in front of friends.
phrases.exZh: 他喜歡在朋友面前炫耀他的新手機。
phrases.note: 帶貶義；不及物時可單用，名詞是 show-off

phrases.ex: People around the world fight for a cleaner environment.
phrases.exZh: 世界各地的人為了更乾淨的環境而努力奮鬥。
phrases.note: for 後接目標；對抗的對象用 fight against

phrases.ex: After high school, I intend to study abroad and learn about different cultures.
phrases.exZh: 高中畢業後，我打算出國念書，認識不同的文化。
phrases.note: 比 plan to 正式，後接原形；名詞是 intention

phrases.ex: The children were dressed in bright costumes for the school parade.
phrases.exZh: 孩子們穿著鮮豔的服裝參加校園遊行。
phrases.note: in 後接衣物或顏色；表狀態，穿上的動作用 get dressed

phrases.ex: The boy ran up the stairs and was completely out of breath at the top.
phrases.exZh: 男孩一路跑上樓梯，到了頂端時完全喘不過氣。
phrases.note: 常用 be/get out of breath
phrases.trap: and was completely out of breathe

phrases.ex: The principal will give a speech at the opening of the new library.
phrases.exZh: 校長將在新圖書館的開幕典禮上致詞。
phrases.note: 動詞用 give 或 make；speech 是名詞

phrases.ex: It helps to take notes while the teacher is explaining new grammar.
phrases.exZh: 老師講解新文法時做筆記很有幫助。
phrases.note: notes 用複數；不說 make notes

phrases.ex: A funny question from the teacher helped break the ice on the first day of class.
phrases.exZh: 老師一個有趣的問題，讓開學第一天的氣氛不再僵硬。
phrases.note: 用於陌生人初次見面時緩和尷尬

phrases.zh: 警告某人…；提醒某人注意…
phrases.ex: The teacher warned us about the slippery stairs after the heavy rain.
phrases.exZh: 大雨過後，老師提醒我們樓梯很滑要小心。
phrases.note: about 接危險本身；叫人別做用 warn sb. against
phrases.trap: warned us for the slippery stairs

phrases.ex: A basketball team on the court consists of five players.
phrases.exZh: 球場上的一支籃球隊由五名球員組成。
phrases.note: 主動語態，不用被動；含「組成」之意

phrases.zh: 對…不可或缺；對…極為重要
phrases.ex: Enough sleep is essential for teenagers to stay healthy and focused in class.
phrases.exZh: 充足的睡眠對青少年保持健康、上課專心是不可或缺的。
phrases.note: 也可用 essential to；語氣比 important 強

phrases.ex: Carrying a heavy box, the boy lost his balance and fell down the stairs.
phrases.exZh: 那個男孩搬著一個很重的箱子，一個重心不穩就摔下樓梯。
phrases.note: 相反是 keep one's balance；one's 隨主詞換

phrases.ex: This stone bridge dates back to the seventeenth century and still attracts many visitors today.
phrases.exZh: 這座石橋可以追溯到十七世紀，至今仍吸引許多遊客。
phrases.note: 主動不用被動（不說 is dated back to）；同 go back to
phrases.trap: dates back in the seventeenth century

phrases.ex: The teacher said it depends on how quickly everyone finishes the group report.
phrases.exZh: 老師說那要看大家多快能完成小組報告。
phrases.note: 單獨說 It depends. 是很常見的口語回答

phrases.ex: Sooner or later, every careless driver will get into trouble.
phrases.exZh: 每個粗心的駕駛遲早都會惹上麻煩。
phrases.note: 可放句首或句尾；放句首時後面加逗號

phrases.ex: The company is trying out a new app with a small group of users.
phrases.exZh: 這家公司正讓一小群使用者試用一款新的應用程式。
phrases.note: 指實際試試看是否好用；受詞可放中間
phrases.trap: is try out a new app

phrases.ex: The heavy rain was accompanied by strong winds, so all classes were canceled.
phrases.exZh: 大雨伴隨著強風，所以所有課程都停課了。
phrases.note: 被動，by 後接伴隨的事物或陪同的人；主動是 A accompany B

phrases.ex: The price of a train ticket varies from fifty to two hundred dollars.
phrases.exZh: 火車票的價格從五十元到兩百元不等。
phrases.note: A、B 是範圍兩端；隨某因素而變用 vary with
phrases.trap: varies between fifty to two hundred dollars.

phrases.ex: All players must abide by the rules, or they will be asked to leave the game.
phrases.exZh: 所有球員都必須遵守規則，否則會被要求離開比賽。
phrases.note: 比 obey、follow 正式；by 不能省

phrases.ex: The key to success lies in hard work and a positive attitude.
phrases.exZh: 成功的關鍵在於努力和積極的態度。
phrases.note: 主詞常是 key、problem；過去式是 lay 不是 laid

phrases.ex: Too much exposure to strong sunlight can damage your skin.
phrases.exZh: 過度曝曬在強烈的陽光下會傷害你的皮膚。
phrases.note: 名詞，to 是介系詞；動詞說法是 be exposed to
phrases.trap: Too much exposed to strong sunlight

phrases.ex: The new library will be named after a teacher who served the town for forty years.
phrases.exZh: 新圖書館將以一位在鎮上服務了四十年的老師命名。
phrases.note: after 後接人名或事物；主動是 name A after B
phrases.trap: will be name after a teacher

phrases.ex: The new rule applies to all students, including those in the first grade.
phrases.exZh: 新規定適用於所有學生，包括一年級的學生。
phrases.note: 適用於用 to；apply for 是申請，別混用

phrases.ex: Butter is made from milk, and it takes a lot of milk to make a little.
phrases.exZh: 奶油是用牛奶做的，而且要很多牛奶才能做出一點點。
phrases.note: 原料經加工已看不出原樣，如奶油、紙

phrases.ex: Last summer, crowds of visitors were drawn to the small village by its colorful festival.
phrases.exZh: 去年夏天，成群的遊客被那個小村莊色彩繽紛的節慶吸引而來。
phrases.note: draw 的過去分詞是 drawn；同 be attracted to
phrases.trap: crowds of visitors were drawn for the small village

phrases.ex: The child let go of the balloon, and it floated up into the sky.
phrases.exZh: 那個孩子一放手，氣球就飄上了天空。
phrases.note: of 不能寫成 off；相反是 hold on to

phrases.ex: When choosing a career, we should take our own interests into account.
phrases.exZh: 選擇職業時，我們應該把自己的興趣列入考慮。
phrases.note: 同 take … into consideration；account 不加 s
phrases.trap: take our own interests into accounts.

phrases.zh: 緊湊的行程；很趕的時間表
phrases.ex: With such a tight schedule, the band had no time to rest between shows.
phrases.exZh: 在這麼緊湊的行程下，樂團在兩場表演之間沒時間休息。
phrases.note: 常說 be on a tight schedule，介系詞用 on

phrases.ex: Many English words used in science are derived from Latin or Greek.
phrases.exZh: 許多科學上使用的英文字源自拉丁文或希臘文。
phrases.note: 同主動的 derive from；derive A from B 是從B得到A
phrases.trap: are derive from Latin or Greek.

phrases.ex: The concert came to an end with a song that everyone in the hall sang together.
phrases.exZh: 音樂會在全場一起合唱的一首歌中結束。
phrases.note: 不及物、不用被動；要說「終結某事」用 put an end to sth.

phrases.ex: The train always passes through a long tunnel before reaching the coast.
phrases.exZh: 火車在抵達海岸前，總會穿過一條長長的隧道。
phrases.note: 後接地點；也可指經歷一段時期

phrases.ex: The class was divided into four groups for the science project.
phrases.exZh: 為了科學專題，全班被分成四組。
phrases.note: into 後接分成的份數或類別

phrases.ex: The committee put forward a plan to reduce plastic waste at school.
phrases.exZh: 委員會提出了一項減少校園塑膠垃圾的計畫。
phrases.note: 正式；受詞多為計畫、意見、建議

phrases.ex: She set out to learn ten new words every single day.
phrases.exZh: 她打定主意每天學十個新單字。
phrases.note: 表示一開始就有的目標，常用過去式

phrases.ex: The company will bring out a new phone next spring.
phrases.exZh: 那家公司明年春天會推出一支新手機。
phrases.note: 也可指帶出特色：bring out the best in sb.

phrases.ex: He could not hold back his laughter during the funny show.
phrases.exZh: 看那場好笑的表演時，他忍不住笑了出來。
phrases.note: 可指忍住情緒，也可指阻礙某人前進

phrases.ex: Our time is running out, so please finish the test quickly.
phrases.exZh: 我們的時間快用完了，所以請盡快寫完考卷。
phrases.note: 不及物，主詞是被用完的東西，後面不接 of

phrases.ex: The two movies are more or less the same length.
phrases.exZh: 這兩部電影的長度大致相同。
phrases.note: 修飾形容詞或數量，表示大致如此

phrases.ex: The library is closed for repairs at present.
phrases.exZh: 圖書館目前因整修而關閉。
phrases.note: 較正式，書面常見

phrases.ex: The children finished the puzzle in no time.
phrases.exZh: 孩子們很快就完成了拼圖。
phrases.note: ＝ very quickly，常與 finish、get 連用

phrases.ex: The elevator can carry up to eight people at a time.
phrases.exZh: 這部電梯一次最多能載八個人。
phrases.note: 表示上限；也可指「由……決定」

phrases.ex: Owing to a lack of sleep, many students cannot focus in class.
phrases.exZh: 由於睡眠不足，許多學生在課堂上無法專心。
phrases.note: 正式書面語，常放句首，與 due to 意思相近
phrases.trap: Owing of a lack of sleep,

phrases.ex: The air was polluted to such an extent that people wore masks outdoors.
phrases.exZh: 空氣汙染到這種程度，以致於人們在戶外都得戴口罩。
phrases.note: 書面語，強調程度；that 後接結果子句

phrases.ex: Aside from saving money, cooking at home is a healthier choice.
phrases.exZh: 除了省錢之外，在家煮飯也是比較健康的選擇。
phrases.note: 同 apart from；美式較常見，後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.zh: 把 A 誤認為 B
phrases.ex: In the dark room, he mistook his coat for a person sitting on the chair.
phrases.exZh: 在黑暗的房間裡，他把自己的外套誤認成坐在椅子上的人。
phrases.note: 三態 mistake, mistook, mistaken；for 不可省
phrases.trap: he mistook his coat as a person

phrases.ex: Turn down the music, or else the neighbors will complain again.
phrases.exZh: 把音樂關小聲一點，否則鄰居又要抱怨了。
phrases.note: 口語，前面不用分號，語氣比 otherwise 直接

phrases.ex: Whoever wins the contest, everyone will remember the effort of the whole class.
phrases.exZh: 不論誰贏得比賽，大家都會記得全班的努力。
phrases.note: 等於 no matter who，書面與口語皆可

phrases.ex: Wherever you travel, showing good manners will always win respect.
phrases.exZh: 無論你去到哪裡，有禮貌的舉止永遠會贏得尊重。
phrases.note: 等於 no matter where，引導讓步子句

phrases.ex: The guide explains in detail how to sort garbage and where to leave it.
phrases.exZh: 這份指南詳細介紹如何分類廢棄物，以及該把它們放在哪裡。
phrases.note: 常接 explain、describe；不可寫成 in details

phrases.ex: All the students in our class, without exception, enjoy the weekly reading hour.
phrases.exZh: 我們班上的學生無一例外，都喜歡每週的閱讀時間。
phrases.note: 強調全部都是；常夾在逗號間或放句尾

phrases.ex: The mayor called on citizens to use public transport more often.
phrases.exZh: 市長呼籲市民更常搭乘大眾運輸。
phrases.note: call on 常見於新聞式的正式呼籲；也可指短暫拜訪某人

phrases.ex: The charity appealed to the public to donate warm clothes for winter.
phrases.exZh: 這個慈善團體呼籲民眾捐贈冬季保暖的衣物。
phrases.note: 也可表示「吸引」；此義後面不接 to V，別混用

phrases.ex: Visitors may use the garden provided that they keep it clean.
phrases.exZh: 訪客只要保持整潔，就可以使用這座花園。
phrases.note: 較正式；that 可省略，用於提出必要條件

phrases.ex: The school lends laptops to students on condition that they return them on time.
phrases.exZh: 學校借筆電給學生的條件是要準時歸還。
phrases.note: 正式；強調「以此為條件」，常見於規定與協議

phrases.ex: The rules were changed in order that everyone might have an equal chance.
phrases.exZh: 規則被修改，為的是讓每個人都有平等的機會。
phrases.note: 正式；後接子句，常搭配 may／might／can

phrases.ex: But for the volunteers' help, the festival could not have run smoothly.
phrases.exZh: 若非志工幫忙，這場慶典無法順利進行。
phrases.note: 正式；後接名詞，主要子句用 would／could (have)

phrases.phrase: for fear of V-ing / for fear that
phrases.ex: Some parents check their children's homework daily for fear that they will fall behind.
phrases.exZh: 有些家長每天檢查孩子的作業，唯恐孩子落後。
phrases.note: 偏書面；of 後接 V-ing 或名詞，that 後接子句（常搭配 might）

phrases.ex: If you want to master a skill, the sooner you start, the better.
phrases.exZh: 如果你想精通一項技能，越早開始越好。
phrases.note: the + 比較級 … the + 比較級 的省略型，可單獨使用
phrases.trap: the sooner you start, the best.

phrases.ex: This is the second largest lake in the country.
phrases.exZh: 這是全國第二大的湖泊。
phrases.note: 序數放在 the 與最高級之間，如 third longest

phrases.ex: A quarter of the people surveyed chose to travel by train.
phrases.exZh: 四分之一的受訪者選擇搭火車旅行。
phrases.note: 其他分數如 a third of、half of；動詞看 of 後的名詞

phrases.ex: The survey shows an increase of five percent in the number of readers.
phrases.exZh: 調查顯示讀者人數增加了百分之五。
phrases.note: of 後接幅度，in 後接項目；動詞為 increase by

phrases.ex: Absences dropped significantly once the school changed its start time.
phrases.exZh: 學校更改上課時間後，缺席人數明顯下降。
phrases.note: 不及物；副詞可換 slightly、gradually、dramatically

phrases.ex: The number of members increased by half after the summer camp.
phrases.exZh: 夏令營之後，成員人數增加了一半。
phrases.note: by 後接增加的幅度，to 後接最後的數值

phrases.ex: Bicycles rank first among the vehicles used for short trips in the town.
phrases.exZh: 在這個小鎮的短程交通工具中，腳踏車排名第一。
phrases.note: 後接序數；也可寫 rank second、rank third

phrases.ex: A short walk after dinner will do you good.
phrases.exZh: 晚餐後散個短步會對你有好處。
phrases.note: 可寫 do sb. good 或 do good to sb.；語氣較口語

phrases.ex: Had it not been for your advice, the project would have failed.
phrases.exZh: 若不是有你的建議，這個專案早就失敗了。
phrases.note: 與過去事實相反；等於 If it had not been for
phrases.trap: Had not it been for your advice,

phrases.ex: Sharing a meal with neighbors is what we call community spirit.
phrases.exZh: 和鄰居一起吃頓飯，就是我們所說的社區精神。
phrases.note: what we call 相當於 so-called，後面接補語

phrases.ex: It happened that my best friend was on the same bus that morning.
phrases.exZh: 碰巧那天早上我最要好的朋友也搭同一班公車。
phrases.note: 後接完整子句；也可改寫成 sb. happen to V

phrases.ex: Should you have any questions, feel free to contact the office.
phrases.exZh: 如果您有任何問題，歡迎隨時聯絡辦公室。
phrases.note: 省略 if 的倒裝條件句，正式；主要子句常用祈使句或 will

phrases.ex: My little brother takes after our father and loves to tell jokes.
phrases.exZh: 我弟弟很像我們的爸爸，愛講笑話。
phrases.note: 只用於有血緣關係的長輩；不用被動

phrases.ex: Cheaper solar panels could bring down the cost of electricity.
phrases.exZh: 更便宜的太陽能板可能會降低電費成本。
phrases.note: 受詞常為價格、成本、比率

phrases.ex: The festival brings in thousands of visitors and a lot of money every year.
phrases.exZh: 這個慶典每年帶來數千名遊客和大筆收入。
phrases.note: 可指引進新制度、人才或收入

phrases.ex: Students must turn in their homework before the bell rings.
phrases.exZh: 學生必須在鐘響前繳交作業。
phrases.note: 比 hand in 稍口語；也可指上床睡覺

phrases.ex: The new version of the game will come out early next month.
phrases.exZh: 這款遊戲的新版本將在下個月初上市。
phrases.note: 可指書、電影上市，也可指花開或真相曝光

phrases.ex: Half of the class came down with the flu after the long holiday.
phrases.exZh: 長假過後全班有一半的人染上了流感。
phrases.note: 後接 flu、cold 等輕微病症；口語

phrases.ex: The teacher called on a quiet student to read the paragraph aloud.
phrases.exZh: 老師點了一位安靜的學生大聲朗讀這一段。
phrases.note: 後接人；call on sb. to V 表示呼籲某人做某事
phrases.trap: called on to a quiet student

phrases.ex: Sorry, I am busy now, so I will call you back later.
phrases.exZh: 抱歉，我現在有點忙，等一下再回電給你。
phrases.note: phrase 為 call sb. back；受詞是代名詞放中間

phrases.ex: Guests can check in at the hotel desk after two o'clock.
phrases.exZh: 旅客可以在兩點過後到飯店櫃檯辦理入住。
phrases.note: 不及物；機場報到、飯店入住都用
phrases.trap: checking in at the hotel desk

phrases.ex: Someone broke into the shop and took several computers.
phrases.exZh: 有人闖入那間店，偷走了好幾台電腦。
phrases.note: 也可接 laughter、tears 表突然開始

phrases.ex: Drivers must slow down when they pass a school.
phrases.exZh: 駕駛人經過學校時必須減速。
phrases.note: 也可指放慢步調；相反是 speed up

phrases.ex: As the population ages, more elderly people are expected to live alone in the future.
phrases.exZh: 隨著人口老化，預計未來會有更多老人獨居。
phrases.note: 後接原形 V；常用於預測，比 be supposed to 正式

phrases.ex: Local governments must work together to address the issue of air pollution.
phrases.exZh: 各地政府必須合作處理空氣汙染的問題。
phrases.note: 及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 to；比 deal with 正式
phrases.trap: to address with the issue of air pollution.

phrases.ex: This bakery specializes in cakes made without sugar.
phrases.exZh: 這家麵包店專門製作不加糖的蛋糕。
phrases.note: in 後接名詞或 V-ing；名詞是 specialty

phrases.ex: Each of us can help fight against climate change by saving energy at home.
phrases.exZh: 我們每個人都可以在家節約能源，幫忙對抗氣候變遷。
phrases.note: against 後接要對抗的對象；fight for 是「為…奮鬥、爭取」

phrases.ex: The city plans to invest in more bicycle lanes.
phrases.exZh: 這座城市打算投資興建更多腳踏車道。
phrases.note: in 後接投資對象，也可指投入時間精力

phrases.zh: 向某人保證…；使某人確信…
phrases.ex: The pilot assured the passengers that the plane would land safely despite the storm.
phrases.exZh: 機長向乘客保證，儘管有暴風雨，飛機仍會安全降落。
phrases.note: 先接人再接 that 子句，人前不加 to；ensure 不接人，意思是確保

phrases.ex: The bus driver was kind to the lost child and called her parents.
phrases.exZh: 公車司機對走失的孩子很親切，還打電話給她的父母。
phrases.note: 稱讚某人的行為用 It is kind of sb. to V
phrases.trap: was kind for the lost child

phrases.ex: Farmers are accustomed to getting up before sunrise.
phrases.exZh: 農夫習慣在日出前起床。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞；與 be used to 同義

phrases.ex: Scientists are engaged in research on clean energy.
phrases.exZh: 科學家正在從事清潔能源的研究。
phrases.note: 正式；in 後接工作或活動

phrases.ex: Did she leave the door open on purpose, or was it only a mistake?
phrases.exZh: 她是故意把門開著，還是一時疏忽了？
phrases.note: 與 by accident 意思相反

phrases.ex: On average, teenagers need about eight hours of sleep each night.
phrases.exZh: 平均來說，青少年每晚大約需要八小時的睡眠。
phrases.note: 多放句首，後面接逗號；引出概括性的數字

phrases.ex: Hungry birds flew over the fields in search of food.
phrases.exZh: 飢餓的鳥兒飛過田野尋找食物。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞；語意同 looking for，較書面

phrases.ex: Learning a second language can help break down barriers between people from different cultures.
phrases.exZh: 學第二外語有助於打破不同文化的人之間的隔閡。
phrases.note: 這裡 break down 是及物「拆除」；常接 between A and B

phrases.phrase: come as a surprise to sb.
phrases.ex: The news that our school would close came as a surprise to everyone in town.
phrases.exZh: 我們學校要關閉的消息讓鎮上每個人都很意外。
phrases.note: 主詞是事情不是人；人當主詞用 be surprised at sth.

phrases.ex: After moving abroad, she still maintains contact with her old classmates through video calls.
phrases.exZh: 搬到國外後，她仍透過視訊和老同學保持聯絡。
phrases.note: 比 keep in touch with 正式；contact 不加 s

phrases.ex: The teacher made a comment on my essay that helped me improve my writing.
phrases.exZh: 老師對我的作文給了一則評語，幫助我改進寫作。
phrases.note: ＝comment on sth.；comment 是可數名詞，前面要加 a
phrases.trap: made a comment to my essay

phrases.ex: The coach asked the player to talk in private after the game.
phrases.exZh: 教練要求那位球員在比賽後私下談一談。
phrases.note: 相反為 in public

phrases.ex: It is unwise to reach a conclusion based only on what you see online.
phrases.exZh: 只根據網路上看到的東西就下結論是不明智的。
phrases.note: 可接 about sth.；同 draw a conclusion

phrases.ex: Good stories stand the test of time because their messages still matter today.
phrases.exZh: 好故事經得起時間考驗，因為它們傳達的訊息至今仍很重要。
phrases.note: time 不加 s、不加 the；主詞常是作品、建築、想法

phrases.ex: I twisted my ankle while running down the stairs, so I could not join the race.
phrases.exZh: 我跑下樓梯時扭到腳踝，所以沒辦法參加賽跑。
phrases.note: one's 換成所有格（my、his）；主動語態，不寫 was twisted

phrases.ex: Many teenagers feel pressure to conform to what their friends think is cool.
phrases.exZh: 許多青少年感到壓力，必須迎合朋友眼中的酷。
phrases.note: 正式；to 是介系詞，後接規則、標準、期待等名詞

phrases.ex: During the storm, the school gym functioned as a shelter for nearby families.
phrases.exZh: 暴風雨期間，學校體育館充當附近家庭的避難所。
phrases.note: ＝serve as；as 後接名詞（角色、用途），主詞常是物

phrases.ex: This small classroom can hold at most thirty students, so we need a bigger room.
phrases.exZh: 這間小教室最多只能容納三十名學生，所以我們需要更大的教室。
phrases.note: 放在數字後，表示不超過
phrases.trap: can hold at mostly thirty students,

phrases.ex: Learning to manage time may prove to be the most useful skill in high school.
phrases.exZh: 學會管理時間可能會是高中最有用的技能。
phrases.note: ＝turn out to be；後接形容詞或名詞，to be 有時可省略

phrases.ex: Once in a while, our class has lunch in the park.
phrases.exZh: 我們班偶爾會在公園吃午餐。
phrases.note: 頻率很低；放句首或句尾皆可

phrases.ex: Volunteers transformed the empty lot into a small garden where neighbors grow vegetables.
phrases.exZh: 志工把那塊空地改造成鄰居種菜的小花園。
phrases.note: 比 turn A into B 正式，強調徹底改變
phrases.trap: was transformed the empty lot into

phrases.ex: The road becomes very slippery at times during the rainy season.
phrases.exZh: 雨季時這條路有時會變得很滑。
phrases.note: ＝ sometimes，語氣較書面，多放句尾

phrases.ex: I have tons of homework to finish this weekend.
phrases.exZh: 這個週末我有一大堆作業要寫完。
phrases.note: 口語；寫正式文章時改用 a large amount of

phrases.ex: After he lost his job, my uncle lived on his savings for nearly a year.
phrases.exZh: 我叔叔失業後，靠積蓄過了將近一年。
phrases.note: 後接錢或食物；靠父母供養用 live off one's parents
phrases.trap: my uncle lived of his savings

phrases.ex: The camp offers a range of activities for young teenagers.
phrases.exZh: 這個營隊為青少年提供各種活動。
phrases.note: 後接複數名詞，比 a variety of 稍正式

phrases.ex: The island's air is free from pollution because cars are not allowed there.
phrases.exZh: 那座島禁止汽車通行，所以空氣沒有污染。
phrases.note: 後接壓力、污染、疼痛等不好的東西；be free of 意思相近

phrases.ex: Once again, the team proved that hard work beats natural talent.
phrases.exZh: 這支隊伍再一次證明努力勝過天分。
phrases.note: 可放句首或句尾；again and again 則是一再、反覆

phrases.ex: The soup is far from ready, so please be patient.
phrases.exZh: 湯還遠遠沒煮好，請耐心等候。
phrases.note: 後接形容詞或名詞，表示遠不到……的程度

phrases.ex: The final test was anything but easy for most of us.
phrases.exZh: 期末考對我們多數人來說一點也不容易。
phrases.note: 後接形容詞或名詞；意思不是「除了」

phrases.zh: 伸手去拿…；努力追求（目標）
phrases.ex: The little boy reached for the cookie jar on the top shelf.
phrases.exZh: 小男孩伸手去拿最上層架子的餅乾罐。
phrases.note: reach sth. 是抵達、搆到；伸手去拿要加 for

phrases.ex: Quite a few visitors forgot to bring an umbrella to the park.
phrases.exZh: 不少遊客忘了帶傘到公園來。
phrases.note: 意思是「不少」，不是「很少」；接複數可數名詞

phrases.ex: Some teenagers spend as much as half of their free time on their phones.
phrases.exZh: 有些青少年花在手機上的時間，多達空閒時間的一半。
phrases.note: 後接不可數名詞或金額、時間等數量
phrases.trap: as many as half of their free time

phrases.ex: In art class, we experiment with different colors and shapes.
phrases.exZh: 在美術課上，我們嘗試不同的顏色與形狀。
phrases.note: 做實驗的對象用 with；on 則是在生物上做實驗

phrases.ex: The store manager accused him of taking a candy bar without paying.
phrases.exZh: 店經理指控他沒付錢就拿走一條糖果。
phrases.note: of 後接 V-ing 或名詞，表示被指控的行為
phrases.trap: accused him for taking a candy bar

phrases.ex: The cheap umbrella I bought was inferior to my old one; it broke in a day.
phrases.exZh: 我買的便宜雨傘不如舊的那把，一天就壞了。
phrases.note: 後面用 to，不用 than；語氣較正式
phrases.trap: was inferior than my old one;

phrases.ex: Regular exercise is key to staying healthy as we grow older.
phrases.exZh: 隨著年紀增長，規律運動是保持健康的關鍵。
phrases.note: key 是形容詞不加 the；名詞說 be the key to

phrases.ex: During the holidays, many people travel home to see their loved ones.
phrases.exZh: 假期期間，許多人返鄉探望摯愛的家人。
phrases.note: 多用複數，前加所有格；單數說 a loved one

phrases.ex: Expensive products are not necessarily better than cheap ones.
phrases.exZh: 昂貴的產品未必比便宜的好。
phrases.note: 部分否定，語氣委婉；by no means 是「絕不」，意思完全不同

phrases.ex: The class leader gave a short thank-you speech on behalf of all the students.
phrases.exZh: 班長代表全體同學發表了簡短的感謝致詞。
phrases.note: 較正式；of 後接被代表的人
phrases.trap: on behalf for all the students

phrases.ex: Many advertisements play on our fear of missing out on popular trends.
phrases.exZh: 許多廣告利用我們怕跟不上流行的心理。
phrases.note: 多指利用人的恐懼、好奇等心理；take advantage of 用法較廣

phrases.ex: We decided to declutter our closets and give away the clothes we never wear.
phrases.exZh: 我們決定把衣櫃斷捨離，把從不穿的衣服送人。
phrases.note: 動詞，可直接接受詞；名詞是 decluttering，不必音譯 danshari

phrases.ex: This rare flower is unique to the island and grows nowhere else in the world.
phrases.exZh: 這種稀有的花是那座島特有的，世界上其他地方都沒有。
phrases.note: 介系詞用 to，不用 of 或 for；指只在某地或某群體才有

phrases.ex: The price of vegetables is determined by the weather and the season.
phrases.exZh: 蔬菜的價格由天氣和季節決定。
phrases.note: 主詞是被決定的事；be determined to V 是下定決心

phrases.ex: On this flight, each passenger's carry-on bag is limited to seven kilograms.
phrases.exZh: 這班飛機每位乘客的隨身行李限重七公斤。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接名詞；近義 be restricted to

phrases.zh: 從…出現；從…浮現；走出（困境）
phrases.ex: A small turtle slowly emerged from the sand and crawled toward the sea.
phrases.exZh: 一隻小海龜慢慢從沙裡鑽出來，朝大海爬去。
phrases.note: 比 come out of 正式；也可指度過困境後變得如何

phrases.ex: Good teachers never resort to shouting to keep their classes quiet.
phrases.exZh: 好老師從不靠大吼來讓班上安靜。
phrases.note: 多指不得已才用的手段；to 是介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

phrases.ex: Not every parent approves of letting kids stay up late.
phrases.exZh: 不是每個家長都贊成讓孩子熬夜。
phrases.note: of 後接名詞或 V-ing；直接接受詞是「批准」

phrases.ex: My brother is always the first to arrive at the basketball court.
phrases.exZh: 我哥哥總是第一個到籃球場的人。
phrases.note: first 後接 to V；也可說 the last to V

phrases.ex: If you do not know the word, look it up in a dictionary.
phrases.exZh: 如果你不認識這個字，就去字典裡查一查。
phrases.note: 受詞是代名詞時必須放中間：look it up

phrases.ex: When the music started, the audience could not help but dance.
phrases.exZh: 音樂一響起，觀眾忍不住跳起舞來。
phrases.note: but 後接原形動詞；語氣稍正式

phrases.ex: If you take away three from ten, you get seven.
phrases.exZh: 十減去三，就得到七。
phrases.note: 美式外帶較常說 take out，英式說 takeaway

phrases.ex: Please fill in your name and phone number on the form.
phrases.exZh: 請在表格上填寫你的姓名與電話號碼。
phrases.note: 英式常用；美式也說 fill out，後者較常指整張表
phrases.trap: fill on your name and phone number

phrases.ex: The new club met for the first time and quickly got down to choosing a leader.
phrases.exZh: 新社團第一次開會，很快就開始認真選社長。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing
phrases.trap: and quickly got down to choose

phrases.ex: We were so excited that we got carried away and stayed out too late.
phrases.exZh: 我們太興奮了，玩得忘我，待到太晚。
phrases.note: 口語；表示情緒過度而失去分寸

phrases.ex: Take down the address before you forget it.
phrases.exZh: 趁還沒忘記，把地址記下來。
phrases.note: 受詞是代名詞時放中間：take it down

phrases.ex: Before the trip, our teacher set out the safety rules very clearly.
phrases.exZh: 出發前，老師把安全規則講得很清楚。
phrases.note: 與 set off 近義；set out 也可表「陳述」
phrases.trap: our teacher set out of the safety rules

phrases.ex: Please look out for slippery floors when you walk into the bathroom.
phrases.exZh: 走進浴室時，請留意濕滑的地板。
phrases.note: 強調保持警覺；可指提防或留意好事物

phrases.ex: How should we go about solving the traffic problem near the school?
phrases.exZh: 我們該如何著手解決學校附近的交通問題？
phrases.note: 後接 V-ing 或名詞；常用於問方法

phrases.ex: Guests are asked to dress up for the anniversary dinner.
phrases.exZh: 賓客受邀盛裝出席週年晚宴。
phrases.note: dress up as 表示扮成；也指穿正式服裝

phrases.ex: The teacher handed out the worksheets at the start of class.
phrases.exZh: 老師在上課一開始就發下了學習單。
phrases.note: 受詞可放中間或後面；也可用 give out

phrases.ex: In theory, this method is simple, but it is hard to use every day.
phrases.exZh: 理論上這個方法很簡單，但要天天使用並不容易。
phrases.note: 常與 in practice 對比；放句首加逗號，後面常接 but

phrases.ex: Poor diet and lack of exercise account for most cases of obesity.
phrases.exZh: 飲食不良和缺乏運動導致了大多數的肥胖案例。
phrases.note: 表原因時等於 explain；另有「占…比例」的意思

phrases.ex: Could you take a look at my essay before I hand it in?
phrases.exZh: 你可以在我交作文之前幫我看一下嗎？
phrases.note: 後面接 at；口語常說 have a look
phrases.trap: take a look on my essay

phrases.ex: Half of the class did not finish the homework, so we are all in the same boat.
phrases.exZh: 班上一半的人沒寫完作業，所以大家的處境都一樣。
phrases.note: 表示大家面臨同樣困難，常搭配 be

phrases.ex: On top of his schoolwork, he takes care of his younger brother every day.
phrases.exZh: 除了功課之外，他每天還要照顧弟弟。
phrases.note: 介系詞片語，多指額外增加的負擔；口語偏多
phrases.trap: On the top of his schoolwork,

phrases.ex: Learning a language takes time; nonetheless, small daily efforts bring clear progress.
phrases.exZh: 學語言需要時間，儘管如此，每天一點小小的努力仍會帶來明顯的進步。
phrases.note: 與 nevertheless 同義，更偏書面；也可放句中

phrases.phrase: I would appreciate it if you could …
phrases.ex: I would appreciate it if you could send me the schedule by email.
phrases.exZh: 我會很感激，如果你能用電子郵件把時間表寄給我。
phrases.note: 禮貌請求；it 不可省略，could 後接原形動詞
phrases.trap: I would appreciate if you could

phrases.ex: Frankly speaking, the new school schedule leaves too little time for sports and hobbies.
phrases.exZh: 坦白說，新的課表留給運動和興趣的時間太少了。
phrases.note: 略口語；也可寫 to be frank，放句首

phrases.ex: Robots can answer questions quickly, but I doubt whether they can ever replace a caring teacher.
phrases.exZh: 機器人能快速回答問題，但我懷疑它們是否能取代用心的老師。
phrases.note: 肯定句用 whether／if；否定句才用 that

phrases.ex: Prices in the city are high; in comparison, those in the countryside are quite low.
phrases.exZh: 城市的物價很高；相比之下，鄉下的相當低。
phrases.note: 放句首並加逗號，語氣比 in contrast 中性

phrases.ex: Stress can harm sleep; conversely, poor sleep can make people feel more stressed.
phrases.exZh: 壓力會影響睡眠；反過來說，睡不好也會讓人更有壓力。
phrases.note: 正式；指兩件事顛倒過來也成立，放句首並加逗號

phrases.ex: This club focuses on team spirit as opposed to winning every game.
phrases.exZh: 這個社團重視團隊精神，而不是贏得每一場比賽。
phrases.note: 後接名詞或 V-ing，強調兩者的對照；偏正式

phrases.ex: Some believe more homework means better grades, but sometimes the opposite is true.
phrases.exZh: 有些人認為作業越多成績越好，但有時情況正好相反。
phrases.note: 用來否定前面的說法，指實際情形相反，可加 in fact

phrases.ex: The rule sounds fair, but in practice few students follow it.
phrases.exZh: 這條規定聽起來很公平，但實際上很少學生遵守。
phrases.note: 指實際執行的情形，常與 in theory 對比

phrases.ex: On the surface, the shop looks small, but it stores thousands of books.
phrases.exZh: 表面上這家店很小，卻收藏了數千本書。
phrases.note: 後面常接 but 或 however 帶出真相，放句首加逗號

phrases.ex: The first exam was long; by comparison, the second one was short and easy.
phrases.exZh: 第一次考試很長；相比之下，第二次又短又簡單。
phrases.note: 放句首並加逗號，語氣比 by contrast 中性

phrases.ex: Admittedly, online classes are convenient, but they cannot replace face-to-face talk.
phrases.exZh: 誠然，線上課程很方便，但無法取代面對面的交談。
phrases.note: 先承認對方論點，後面常用 but 轉回自己的看法

phrases.ex: Travel can be expensive; that said, there are many cheap ways to see the world.
phrases.exZh: 旅行可能很花錢，話雖如此，還是有許多便宜的方式能看看世界。
phrases.note: 半正式；前用分號、後加逗號，先承認再補上相反的看法

phrases.ex: Public transport is sometimes crowded; having said that, it is still cheaper than driving.
phrases.exZh: 大眾運輸有時很擁擠，即便如此，它還是比開車便宜。
phrases.note: 與 that said 同義，較完整；放句首並加逗號

phrases.ex: The battery lasts longer; hence, users do not need to charge it often.
phrases.exZh: 電池更持久，因此使用者不需要經常充電。
phrases.note: 正式書面語；後面可接名詞片語，前面用分號或句號

phrases.ex: Students slept very little during exams; as a consequence, many of them felt exhausted.
phrases.exZh: 考試期間學生睡得很少，結果許多人筋疲力盡。
phrases.note: 正式；後面接 of 加名詞時，變成介系詞片語

phrases.ex: Quarrels between friends often arise from simple misunderstandings.
phrases.exZh: 朋友之間的爭吵常常起因於簡單的誤會。
phrases.note: 不及物動詞，不用被動；主詞是結果

phrases.ex: In view of the heavy traffic, the teacher told us to leave early.
phrases.exZh: 鑑於交通壅塞，老師要我們提早出發。
phrases.note: 正式介系詞片語，多放句首，後接名詞

phrases.ex: Traffic was heavy this morning, and on top of that, it started to rain.
phrases.exZh: 今天早上塞車很嚴重，再加上又下起雨來。
phrases.note: 多用於補充不好的事；偏口語，正式作文少用
phrases.trap: and on the top of that,

phrases.ex: To illustrate, a single plastic bottle can take hundreds of years to break down in nature.
phrases.exZh: 舉例說明，一個塑膠瓶在自然環境中可能要花數百年才會分解。
phrases.note: 放句首、後面加逗號；用來引出說明性的例子，較正式

phrases.ex: Our town faces one serious problem, namely a shortage of safe places for children to play.
phrases.exZh: 我們鎮上面臨一個嚴重的問題，也就是缺乏讓孩子安全玩耍的地方。
phrases.note: 前面已提到概括的說法，namely 後面具體點名；前面通常有逗號

phrases.ex: To give an example, my cousin saves money by cooking at home instead of eating out.
phrases.exZh: 舉個例子，我表哥藉由在家煮飯而不外食來省錢。
phrases.note: 放句首、後面加逗號；用來引出個人或生活中的例子

phrases.ex: This program is designed specifically for beginners who have never used a computer before.
phrases.exZh: 這個課程是專為從未使用過電腦的初學者所設計的。
phrases.note: 副詞，修飾其後的片語；specifically for 表示「專門為了」

phrases.ex: Several countries have cut waste, notably those that charge fees for plastic bags.
phrases.exZh: 有數個國家減少了廢棄物，尤其是對塑膠袋收費的那些國家。
phrases.note: 正式書面語，用來點出最顯著的例子；前面加逗號

phrases.ex: The steps for making the poster are as follows: choose a topic, draw a sketch, and add color.
phrases.exZh: 製作海報的步驟如下：選定主題、畫出草圖，再上色。
phrases.note: 固定用法，follows 不隨主詞變化；後面接冒號

phrases.ex: To put it another way, a small habit repeated every day can change a whole life.
phrases.exZh: 換個方式說，每天重複的小習慣可以改變整個人生。
phrases.note: 常接在分號或句號後，後面接逗號；用不同說法重述前一個想法

phrases.ex: No doubt, robots will take over many simple jobs in the coming decades.
phrases.exZh: 無疑地，未來幾十年機器人會接手許多簡單的工作。
phrases.note: 放句首加逗號；語氣比 undoubtedly 口語

phrases.ex: The plan was approved and subsequently put into action by the city.
phrases.exZh: 這項計畫先獲得核准，接著由市政府開始執行。
phrases.note: 正式書面用語，指較晚發生的事；口語常用 later

phrases.ex: In brief, the new rule is fair to everyone and easy to follow.
phrases.exZh: 簡單說，這項新規定對大家都公平，也容易遵守。
phrases.note: 用於精簡歸納；放句首加逗號，句子宜短

phrases.ex: Taking everything into account, working from home seems to suit most families quite well.
phrases.exZh: 把一切因素都考慮進去後，在家工作似乎相當適合大多數家庭。
phrases.note: 正式；放句首加逗號，用於權衡利弊後下結論

phrases.ex: It can be concluded that online learning is helpful only when students stay disciplined.
phrases.exZh: 由此可知，線上學習只有在學生自律時才有幫助。
phrases.note: 正式；後接完整子句，前文須已有論據支持

phrases.phrase: to make a long story short
phrases.ex: To make a long story short, we missed the last train and had to walk home.
phrases.exZh: 長話短說，我們錯過了末班車，只好走路回家。
phrases.note: 口語；多用於敘事文，不適合正式論說文
phrases.trap: To make a long story shortly,

phrases.phrase: it is safe to say that
phrases.ex: It is safe to say that technology has changed the way we study forever.
phrases.exZh: 可以有把握地說，科技已經永遠改變了我們的學習方式。
phrases.note: 語氣肯定但不武斷；後面接完整子句

phrases.ex: From these facts, we can draw the conclusion that exercise improves both mood and memory.
phrases.exZh: 從這些事實，我們可以得出結論：運動同時改善心情與記憶力。
phrases.note: 常用 can draw the conclusion that；後接完整子句
phrases.trap: we can draw the conclusion of

phrases.ex: In the modern world, almost everyone relies on smartphones for daily communication.
phrases.exZh: 在現代世界，幾乎每個人都靠智慧型手機進行日常溝通。
phrases.note: 可與 in today's society 替換，避免重複用字

phrases.ex: As is well known, water is the source of all life on Earth.
phrases.exZh: 眾所周知，水是地球上一切生命的來源。
phrases.note: 比 as we all know 更書面；後面接逗號

phrases.ex: In this day and age, it is hard to imagine life without electricity.
phrases.exZh: 在這個時代，很難想像沒有電的生活。
phrases.note: 略帶強調的慣用語；適合談現代生活的改變

phrases.ex: It is generally agreed that teamwork leads to better results than working alone.
phrases.exZh: 一般人都同意團隊合作比單打獨鬥能帶來更好的成果。
phrases.note: 語氣比 universally acknowledged 稍緩、較保險

phrases.ex: There is growing concern about the amount of plastic waste in the oceans.
phrases.exZh: 人們越來越關注海洋中的塑膠垃圾量。
phrases.note: about 後接名詞或 V-ing；concern 不加 a

phrases.ex: Few people would deny that a healthy diet leads to a longer life.
phrases.exZh: 很少人會否認健康的飲食能帶來更長壽的人生。
phrases.note: few 本身已帶否定意味，不再加 not

phrases.ex: Every coin has two sides, and the same is true of modern technology.
phrases.exZh: 凡事都有兩面，現代科技也是如此。
phrases.note: 常用來開頭引出正反討論；the same is true of 可接續

phrases.ex: Opinions differ on whether students should be allowed to use phones in class.
phrases.exZh: 對於學生是否應該被允許在課堂上使用手機，看法不一。
phrases.note: on 後接名詞或 whether 子句；適合爭議性題目

phrases.phrase: there is a growing trend toward …
phrases.ex: There is a growing trend toward working from home in big cities.
phrases.exZh: 大城市中居家工作的趨勢日益明顯。
phrases.note: toward 後接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形
phrases.trap: There are a growing trend toward

phrases.phrase: I am inclined to think that …
phrases.ex: Having compared both plans carefully, I am inclined to think that the second one is safer.
phrases.exZh: 仔細比較兩個計畫後，我傾向認為第二個比較安全。
phrases.note: 語氣委婉；適合在比較後下判斷

phrases.ex: Although online courses are convenient, I would argue that classroom learning is more rewarding.
phrases.exZh: 雖然線上課程很方便，但我認為課堂學習更有收穫。
phrases.note: would 使語氣較委婉；常用於先讓步再表態

phrases.ex: It is my belief that kindness is worth more than talent in the long run.
phrases.exZh: 我相信長遠來看，善良比才華更有價值。
phrases.note: 正式；以 it 作虛主詞，that 子句是真主詞

phrases.ex: Since prices keep rising, I tend to think that buying second-hand clothes is a wise choice.
phrases.exZh: 由於物價不斷上漲，我傾向認為買二手衣服是明智的選擇。
phrases.note: 語氣比 I think 稍委婉、較口語

phrases.ex: Every citizen uses the streets, so I feel strongly that everyone should help keep them clean.
phrases.exZh: 人人都會使用街道，所以我強烈覺得每個人都應該幫忙維持整潔。
phrases.note: 強調情感上的堅持，常接 should 的句子

phrases.ex: Our town plans to plant more trees along busy roads, and I am all for it.
phrases.exZh: 我們鎮上打算在繁忙的道路旁多種些樹，我完全贊成。
phrases.note: 口語；for 後接名詞或 V-ing
phrases.trap: and I am all to it.

phrases.ex: When asked about good teachers, I would say that patience is their most important quality.
phrases.exZh: 談到好老師，我會說耐心是他們最重要的特質。
phrases.note: 語氣溫和、不絕對；適合下判斷

phrases.ex: As I see it, sharing bikes is a cheap way to reduce traffic.
phrases.exZh: 依我看，共享腳踏車是減少交通量的便宜辦法。
phrases.note: 半正式；放句首加逗號，也可放句中

phrases.phrase: it is clear to me that …
phrases.ex: It is clear to me that a good night's sleep makes every athlete play better.
phrases.exZh: 我很清楚，充足的睡眠會讓每位運動員表現更好。
phrases.note: 表示個人已有明確判斷；that 後接完整子句
phrases.trap: It is clear for me that

phrases.ex: It is advisable to check the weather report before planning a mountain trip.
phrases.exZh: 規劃登山行程前，最好先看看天氣預報。
phrases.note: 正式；後接 to V，也可用 It is advisable that 子句

phrases.phrase: sth. should be paid attention to
phrases.ex: Sleep quality should be paid attention to by teenagers as well.
phrases.exZh: 青少年也應該注意自己的睡眠品質。
phrases.note: 被動式仍要保留介系詞 to；句首的名詞是被注意的事物

phrases.ex: The city built new bike lanes with a view to encouraging people to cycle.
phrases.exZh: 市政府興建新的腳踏車道，為的是鼓勵民眾騎車。
phrases.note: to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing 而非原形；書面用語

phrases.ex: Surveys are often used for the purpose of collecting public opinions.
phrases.exZh: 問卷調查常被使用，目的是蒐集民意。
phrases.note: 正式；of 後接名詞或 V-ing，不可接原形動詞
